title: अहो रसिक सुकुमारी करौ विनती कर जोरि  - श्री अलबेली अलि, विनय कुंडलियाँ (17)
sanskrit_text:
अहो रसिक सुकुमारी, करौ विनती कर जोरि।
बंध्यौ रहै मन रैन दिना, तुव प्रेम के डोरि॥
- श्री अलबेली अलि, विनय कुंडलियाँ (17)
english_text: Hey lovely Sukumari, please do so, please. My mind is tied with you, my love is with you.. - Shri Albeli Ali, Vinay Kundaliyaan (17)
english_translation: Hey lovely Sukumari, please do so, please. My mind is tied with you, my love is with you.. - Shri Albeli Ali, Vinay Kundaliyaan (17)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: लावण्यं परमाद्भुतं रतिकला - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (118)
sanskrit_text:
लावण्यं परमाद्भुतं रतिकला चातुर्यमत्यद्भुतं, कान्ति: कापि महाद्भुता वरतनो लीला गतिश्चाद्भुता।
द्रगभंगी पुनरद्भुताद्भुततमा यस्य: स्मितं चाद्भुतं सा राधाद्भुतमूर्तिरद्भुतरसं दास्यं कदा दास्यति॥
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (118)
english_text: Lavanyam Paramadbhutam Ratikala Chaturyamatyadbhutam, Kanti: Kapi Mahadbhuta Vartano Leela Gatischadbhuta. द्राभंगी पुनराद्भुतद्भूतात्मा यस्य: स्मितं चद्भूतं स राधादभुतामुर्तिद्भूतारसं दस्यं कदा दास्यती. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (118)
english_translation: Lavanyam Paramadbhutam Ratikala Chaturyamatyadbhutam, Kanti: Kapi Mahadbhuta Vartano Leela Gatischadbhuta. द्राभंगी पुनराद्भुतद्भूतात्मा यस्य: स्मितं चद्भूतं स राधादभुतामुर्तिद्भूतारसं दस्यं कदा दास्यती. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (118)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ध्यावत महेश हू गनेश हू धनेश हू - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (52)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
ध्यावत महेश हू गनेश हू धनेश हू,
दिनेश हू फनेश त्यौं मुनेस मनमानी है। [1]
तीनों लोक जपत त्रिताप की हरन हार,
नवौ निध्दि सिद्धि मुक्ति भई दरबानी है॥ [2]
कीरति दुलारी सेवैं चरन बिहारी धन्य,
जाको कित्त नित्त विधि वेदन बखानी है। [3]
साधा काजपल में अराधा छिन आधा हठी,
बाधा हरिबे को एक राधा महारानी है॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (52)
english_text: (Poem) Dhyavat Mahesh hu Ganesh hu Dhanesh hu, Dinesh hu phenesh tyun munes manmani hai. [1] Haran Har Haran of the three worlds, Japat Tritap, Navau Nidhi Siddhi Mukti Bhai Darabi. [2] Kirti Dulari Sevain Charan Bihari is blessed, go and tell how many rituals are given daily. [3] In Sadh Kajapal, Aradh Chhin Adha Haathi, Badha Haribe Ko Ek Radha Maharani.. [4] - Shri Hathi Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (52)
english_translation: (Poem) Dhyavat Mahesh hu Ganesh hu Dhanesh hu, Dinesh hu phenesh tyun munes manmani hai. [1] Haran Har Haran of the three worlds, Japat Tritap, Navau Nidhi Siddhi Mukti Bhai Darabi. [2] Kirti Dulari Sevain Charan Bihari is blessed, go and tell how many rituals are given daily. [3] In Sadh Kajapal, Aradh Chhin Adha Haathi, Badha Haribe Ko Ek Radha Maharani.. [4] - Shri Hathi Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (52)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: दूरे सृष्ट्यादिवार्त्ता न कलयति - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (235)
sanskrit_text:
दूरे सृष्ट्यादिवार्त्ता न कलयति मनाङ्नारदादीन्स्वभक्ताञ्छ्रीदामाद्यैः सुहृद्भिर्न मिलति हरति स्नेहवृद्धिं स्वपित्रोः।
किन्तु प्रेमैकसीमां मधुररससुधासिन्धुसारैरगाधां श्रीराधामेव जानन्मधुपतिरनिशं कुंजवीथीमुपास्ते॥
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (235)
english_text: दुरे स्र्ष्ट्यादिवर्त्त न कलायती मनन्गनर्दादिन्स्वभक्तन्यच्छृद्मदयः सुह्रद्भिर्न मलती हरती स्नेहवृद्धिं स्वपित्रोः। But girlfriend Simm Madhurrasasudhasindhusrairagdhan Shriradhamev Jananamdhupatinishnam Kunjavithimupaste. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (235)
english_translation: दुरे स्र्ष्ट्यादिवर्त्त न कलायती मनन्गनर्दादिन्स्वभक्तन्यच्छृद्मदयः सुह्रद्भिर्न मलती हरती स्नेहवृद्धिं स्वपित्रोः। But girlfriend Simm Madhurrasasudhasindhusrairagdhan Shriradhamev Jananamdhupatinishnam Kunjavithimupaste. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (235)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावनं परित्यज्य नैव गच्छामि अहं क्वचित् - सनत्कुमार संहिता (36.165)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावनं परित्यज्य नैव गच्छामि अहं क्वचित्।
निवसाम्यनया सार्ध - महमत्रैव सर्वदा॥ 
- सनत्कुमार संहिता (36.165)
english_text: Vrindavan Parityajya Naiva Gachhami Aham Kvachit. Nivasamanyaya sardha - Mahamatraiva sarvada.. - Sanatkumar Snahita (36.165)
english_translation: Vrindavan Parityajya Naiva Gachhami Aham Kvachit. Nivasamanyaya sardha - Mahamatraiva sarvada.. - Sanatkumar Snahita (36.165)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: किशोरी मोहे सोहनी देन सिखावो - श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (22)
sanskrit_text:
(राग पूरिया, त्रिताल)
किशोरी मोहे सोहनी देन सिखावो। 
हे, मंद मुस्काये लाड़ली, नव नव कृपा कोर बरसाओ॥ [1]
कोटि किरण छिड़कत अंगन में, बेगि कृपा करी धावो। 
तब बोलो हंस-हंस के श्यामा, मंद स्वरन बतलावो॥ [2]
ऐसी सेवा करो री बांवरी, तो गाल पे मीठी सी चपत लगाओ।
श्री गोपाल हित ललित लाड़िली श्री हित सजनी कि दासी बनाओ॥ [3]
- श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (22)
english_text: (Raag Puriya, Tritala) Kishori mohe sohni den sikhavo. Hey, smile softly darling, shower your blessings again and again.. [1] Sprinkle millions of rays in the courtyard, shower your blessings again and again. Then tell me, tell me your laughter, your slow voice… [2] If you do such service, Banwari, then give me a sweet slap on the cheek. Shri Gopal Hit Lalit Ladili, make Shri Hit Sajni's maid.. [3] - Shri Hit Gopal Das [Service Key Holder], Nikunj Ras Vallari (22)
english_translation: (Raag Puriya, Tritala) Kishori mohe sohni den sikhavo. Hey, smile softly darling, shower your blessings again and again.. [1] Sprinkle millions of rays in the courtyard, shower your blessings again and again. Then tell me, tell me your laughter, your slow voice… [2] If you do such service, Banwari, then give me a sweet slap on the cheek. Shri Gopal Hit Lalit Ladili, make Shri Hit Sajni's maid.. [3] - Shri Hit Gopal Das [Service Key Holder], Nikunj Ras Vallari (22)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: इतनी कहि हिय विवस ह्वै रुदन कियौ ब्रजवाल - श्री वंशी अलि, श्री राधिका महारास, दोहा (14)
sanskrit_text:
इतनी कहि हिय विवस ह्वै, रुदन कियौ ब्रजवाल। 
मृदु मुसिकात प्रगट भईं, नवकिशोरि तिहिं काल॥
- श्री वंशी अलि, श्री राधिका महारास, दोहा (14)
english_text: Itani kahi hii vivas wai, roodan kiyou brajawal. Soft music is revealed brother, Navkishorei three days ago.. - Mr. Vanshi Ali, Mr. Radhika Maharas, Doha (14)
english_translation: Itani kahi hii vivas wai, roodan kiyou brajawal. Soft music is revealed brother, Navkishorei three days ago.. - Mr. Vanshi Ali, Mr. Radhika Maharas, Doha (14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नाम पतित पावन सुनि - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (83)
sanskrit_text:
नाम पतित पावन सुनि, निर्भय ह्वै कीय पाप।
यामें दोष बताउ मम, दोषी तो हैं आप॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, भक्ति शतक (83)
english_text: Listen to the holy name of the fallen, be fearless of sin. Yamen, tell me the blame, Maa, you are the one to blame.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (83)
english_translation: Listen to the holy name of the fallen, be fearless of sin. Yamen, tell me the blame, Maa, you are the one to blame.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Bhakti Shatak (83)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: उर भीतर अति चाहना, बाहर राखत त्याग  - श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (30)
sanskrit_text:
उर भीतर अति चाहना, बाहर राखत त्याग।
नारायण वा त्याग पै, परो भार की आग॥
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (30)
english_text: Inside you have extreme desires, outside you have sacrifices. Narayan Va Tyag Pai, Paro Bhar Aag.. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (30)
english_translation: Inside you have extreme desires, outside you have sacrifices. Narayan Va Tyag Pai, Paro Bhar Aag.. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (30)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीवृन्दावन तेरी जय होवे - श्री राधाचरण दास, वृन्दावन विरुदावली (35)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीवृन्दावन तेरी जय होवे।
हे करुणाधन रसिकन जीवन रसमय कानन जय होवे॥ [1]
हे अभयंकर परम शुभंकर युगल प्रियंकर जय होवे।
हृदय धरोहर परम मनोहर महामोदकर जय होवे॥ [2]
परम प्रभाकर प्रेम सुधाकर रस रत्नाकर जय होवे।
'राधाचरणदास' हृदयधन जय होवे तेरी जय होवे॥ [3]
- श्री राधाचरण दास, वृन्दावन विरुदावली (35)
english_text: Glory be to you Sri Vrindavan. O Karunadhan Rasikan, Jeevan Rasmay Kanan Jai.. [1] O Abhayankar, the supreme mascot couple, Priyankar Jai. Hail to the most beautiful Mahamodakar, the heritage of the heart.. [2] Hail to the supreme Prabhakar, Prem Sudhakar, Rasa Ratnakar. 'Radhacharan Das' Hridayadhan Jai Hove Teri Jai Hove.. [3] - Shri Radhacharan Das, Vrindavan Virudavali (35)
english_translation: Glory be to you Sri Vrindavan. O Karunadhan Rasikan, Jeevan Rasmay Kanan Jai.. [1] O Abhayankar, the supreme mascot couple, Priyankar Jai. Hail to the most beautiful Mahamodakar, the heritage of the heart.. [2] Hail to the supreme Prabhakar, Prem Sudhakar, Rasa Ratnakar. 'Radhacharan Das' Hridayadhan Jai Hove Teri Jai Hove.. [3] - Shri Radhacharan Das, Vrindavan Virudavali (35)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हमारी राधे, रसिकनि - जीवन - मूरि - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदीरा, श्री राधा माधुरी (55)
sanskrit_text:
हमारी राधे, रसिकनि - जीवन - मूरि।
रसिक शिरोमणि श्यामहुँ याचत, जिन के पग की धूरि॥
ललीचरन चापन हित आपन, भाग मनावत भूरि।
पल पल कलप लखात ललिहिं गये, पलक - ओटहूँ दूरि॥
गहवर - मंजु - निकुंजनि - पुंजनि, रस बरसत भरपूरि।
लखि ‘कृपालु’ बलि जात सरस रस, ज्ञानी रहे बिसूरि॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदीरा, श्री राधा माधुरी (55)
english_text: Our Radhe, Rasikani - Jeevan - Muri. Rasik Shiromani Shyamhun Yachat, the axis of whose steps.. Lalicharan Chapan Hit Apna, Bhag Manawat Bhuri. Every moment Kalap Lakhat Lalihin Gaye, Palak - Otahun Duri.. Gehwar - Manju - Nikunjani - Punjani, Ras Barsaat Bharapuri. Lakhi 'Kripalu' Bali Jaat Saras Rasa, Gyani Rahe Bisuri.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madhuri, Shri Radha Madhuri (55)
english_translation: Our Radhe, Rasikani - Jeevan - Muri. Rasik Shiromani Shyamhun Yachat, the axis of whose steps.. Lalicharan Chapan Hit Apna, Bhag Manawat Bhuri. Every moment Kalap Lakhat Lalihin Gaye, Palak - Otahun Duri.. Gehwar - Manju - Nikunjani - Punjani, Ras Barsaat Bharapuri. Lakhi 'Kripalu' Bali Jaat Saras Rasa, Gyani Rahe Bisuri.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madhuri, Shri Radha Madhuri (55)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: देखौ श्री वृन्दाविपिन प्रभाइ - श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (30)
sanskrit_text:
(राग धनाश्री)
देखौ श्री वृन्दाविपिन प्रभाइ।
सब तीरथ धामनि फिर आवत देखत उपजत भाई॥ [1]
श्रीजमुना तट लता भवन रज, छिन-छिन बाढ़त चाइ।
मगन होत जब सुधि-बुधि बिसरत, कहूँ चलत नहिं पाइ॥ [2]
यह रस चाखि और रस भूले, फूलत लखि मन अति घहराई।
अचरज कहा व्यास सुख वर्णत, थके रसिक ताहि गाई॥ [3]
- श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (30)
english_text: (Raaga Dhanashree) Look Shri Vrindavipin Prabhai. Brother, seeing all the places of pilgrimage coming again.. [1] Shri Jamuna, Tat Lata Bhavan Raj, is increasing bit by bit. [3] - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, first half (30)

title: तें मोह्यौ प्यारी मेरौ लाल - श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, विट्ठल विपुल देव जू की बानी (18)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
तें मोह्यौ प्यारी मेरौ लाल। [1]
जिहिं गुन सर्बसु चोरि लियौ नागरि,
ते गुन अब प्रतिपाल॥ [2]
तैं कछु प्रेम-ठगौरी मेली,
तुव मुख जोवत नैंन बिसाल। [3]
भाँमिनि कनक लता ह्वै लपटी,
श्रीबीठल विपुल उर स्याम तमाल॥ [4]
- श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, विट्ठल विपुल देव जू की बानी (18)
english_text: (Raaga Saranga) Ten Mohyau Pyari Merau Lal. [1]. [3] Bhanmini Kanak Lata Hwai Lapati, Shrivitthal Vipul Ur Syam Tamal.. [4] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Bani (18)
english_translation: (Raaga Saranga) Ten Mohyau Pyari Merau Lal. [1]. [3] Bhanmini Kanak Lata Hwai Lapati, Shrivitthal Vipul Ur Syam Tamal.. [4] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Bani (18)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कालीय दह, वृंदावन
sanskrit_text:
कालीय दह-इसका वर्तमान नाम कालीय दह है। श्रीकृष्णने कालिया नाग यहीं दमन किया था पासमें ही केलि-कदम्ब है, जिसपर चढ़कर श्रीकृष्ण कालीय हृदय में बड़े वेग से कूदे थे। कालिया नाग के विष से आस-पास के वृक्ष-लता सभी जलकर भस्म हो गये थे। केवल यही एक केलि-कदम्ब बच गया था। इसका कारण यह है कि महापराक्रमी गरुड़ अपनी माता विनता को अपनी विमाता कद्रू के दासीपन से मुक्त कराने के लिए देवलोक से अमृतका कलश लेकर इस केलि-कदम्ब के ऊपर कुछ देर के लिए बैठे थे। उसके गंध या छींटे के प्रभाव से यह केलिकदम्ब बचा रहा था।

कालिया नाग भी बड़ा पराक्रमी था। जब उसने कृष्ण को अपने फेंटेमें बांध लिया, उस समय कृष्ण कुछ असहाय एवं निश्चेष्ट हो गये। उस समय नागपत्नियाँ, जो कृष्ण की परम भक्त थीं, प्रार्थना करने लगीं कि भगवद् विरोधी पति की स्त्री होने के बदले हम विधवा होना ही अधिक पसन्द करती हैं। किन्त, ज्योंही कृष्ण नागके फेंटेसे निकलकर उसके मस्तकपर पदाघात करते हुए नृत्य करने लगे, उस समय कालीय अपने सहस्रों मखोंसे रक्त उगलते हुए भगवान के शरणागत हो गया। उस समय नाग पत्नियां उसके शरणागत भाव से अवगत होकर, हाथ जोड़कर कृष्ण से उसे जीवन-दान के लिए प्रार्थना करने लगीं। श्री कृष्ण ने उनकी स्तव-स्तुतिसे प्रसन्न होकर कालीय नागको अभय प्रदान कर सपरिवार रमणक द्वीपमें जानेके लिए आदेश दिया तथा उसे अभय देते हुए बोले-अब तुम्हें गरुड़ का भय नहीं रहेगा।

वे तुम्हारे फणों पर मेरे चरणचिह्नको देखकर तुम्हारे प्रति शत्रुता भूल जायेंगे। नाग-पत्नियों ने यह प्रार्थना की थी
हे देव! आपके जिस पदरजकी प्राप्तिके लिए श्री लक्ष्मीदेवी ने अपनी सारी अन्य अभिलाषाओंको छोड़कर चिरकाल तक व्रत धारण करती हुई तपस्या की थी, किन्तु वे विफल-मनोरथ हुई, उसी दुर्लभ चरणरेणुको कालीय नाग न जाने किस पुण्यके प्रभावसे प्राप्त करनेका अधिकारी हुआ है।
english_text: Kaliya Daha-Isaka's current name is Kaliya Daha. Shri Krishna had subdued the Kaliya serpent here. There is Keli-Kadamba in Pasa itself, by offering it to Shri Krishna, Kaliya was a great vegetarian in his heart. All the nearby trees and creepers were burnt to ashes due to the poison of Kaliya Naag. Only here one Keli-Kadamba was saved. The reason for this is that the mighty Garuda, in order to free his mother Vinata from the slavery of his mother Kadru, was sitting on top of this Kelly-Kadamba with the pot of nectar from the world of gods for some time. This was protecting Kalikadambha from the effect of its smell or splash. Kaliya Naag was also very mighty. When he took Krishna off his phantasmagoria, we got some help from Krishna and got fixed. It is time that we snake wives, who are ardent devotees of Krishna, start praying that we would rather be widows than be the wives of a husband who is opposed to God. Thus, as soon as Krishna came out of the snake's trap and started dancing, hitting him on the head, Samay Kali surrendered to God, spewing blood from his thousands of mouths. At that time, the snake wives, aware of his feeling of surrender, started praying to Krishna with folded hands to spare his life. Pleased with his praise, Shri Krishna gave him protection to Kaliya Naga and falsely ordered him to go to Ramanak Dweep along with his family and while giving him protection, he said - Now you will not be afraid of Garuda. They will forget their enmity towards you after seeing my footprints on your fans. The Naga wives had prayed this: Oh God! Shri Lakshmidevi had given up all her desires and performed penance by fasting for a long time to attain the throne of hers, but her desire failed, we have got the right to attain the rare feet of Kalya Naag due to the influence of God knows what virtue.
english_translation: Kaliya Daha-Isaka's current name is Kaliya Daha. Shri Krishna had subdued the Kaliya serpent here. There is Keli-Kadamba in Pasa itself, by offering it to Shri Krishna, Kaliya was a great vegetarian in his heart. The reason for this is that the mighty Garuda, in order to free his mother Vinata from the slavery of his mother Kadru, was sitting on top of this Kelly-Kadamba with the pot of nectar from the world of gods for some time. This was protecting Kalikadambha from the effect of its smell or splash. Kaliya Naag was also very mighty. When he took Krishna off his phantasmagoria, we got some help from Krishna and got fixed. It is time that we snake wives, who are ardent devotees of Krishna, start praying that we would rather be widows than be the wives of a husband who is opposed to God. Thus, as soon as Krishna came out of the snake's trap and started dancing, hitting him on the head, Samay Kali surrendered to God, spewing blood from his thousands of mouths. At that time, the snake wives, aware of his feeling of surrender, started praying to Krishna with folded hands to spare his life. Pleased with his praise, Shri Krishna gave him protection to Kaliya Naga and falsely ordered him to go to Ramanak Dweep along with his family and while giving him protection, he said - Now you will not be afraid of Garuda. They will forget their enmity towards you after seeing my footprints on your fans. The Naga wives had prayed this: Oh God! Shri Lakshmidevi had given up all her desires and performed penance by fasting for a long time to attain the throne of hers, but her desire failed, we have got the right to attain the rare feet of Kalya Naag due to the influence of God knows what virtue.

title: मनमोहन जाकी दृष्टि परत - श्री नारायण स्वामी, ब्रज विहार, युगल छदम लीला (5)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सोरठ व जिला)
मनमोहन जाकी दृष्टि परत, ताकी गति होत है और और।
न सुहात भवन तन अशन वसन, बन ही कूँ धावत दौर दौर॥ [1]
नहिं धरत धीर हिय विरह पीर, ब्याकुल भई भटकत ठौर ठौर।
कबहूँ अँसुवन भरि नारायण, मग झाँकत डोलत पौर पौर॥ [2]
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, ब्रज विहार, युगल छदम लीला (5)
english_text: (Raaga Sorath Vee Jila) Manmohan Jaaki Drishti layer, so that the pace is hot and. There is no pleasant house, no seat in the house, no good is there running around.. [1] Neither is the earth patient, it is the pain of separation, the distraught brother is wandering from place to place. Kabhun Ansuvan Bhari Narayan, Mag Jhankat Dolat Pour Pour.. [2] - Shri Narayan Swami, Braj Vihar, Yugal Chadam Leela (5)

[1] Neither is the earth patient, it is the pain of separation, the distraught brother is wandering from place to place. Kabhun Ansuvan Bhari Narayan, Mag Jhankat Dolat Pour Pour.. title: दुविधा तब जैहै या मन की - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी
sanskrit_text:
दुविधा तब जैहै या मन की।
निर्भय ह्वै कैं जब सेवहुगे रज श्रीवृन्दावन की॥
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (224)
english_text: The dilemma is whether of the soul or of the mind. How can one become fearless when he serves the kingdom of Sri Vrindavan? - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, first half (224)
english_translation: The dilemma is whether of the soul or of the mind. How can one become fearless when he serves the kingdom of Sri Vrindavan? - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, first half (224)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कल्पलता के किधो पल्लव ये नवीन दोऊ - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (2)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
कल्पलता के किधो पल्लव ये नवीन दोऊ,
हरण मञ्जुता के कंजता के वनिता के है। [1]
पावन पतित गुँण गावें मुनि ताके छबि,
छलै सविता के जनता के गुरुता के है॥ [2]
नऊ निधिता के सिधिता के आदि आलै हठी,
तीनों लोक ताके प्रभुता के प्रभु ताके हैं। [3]
कटैं पाप ताके बढ़ै पुण्य के पताके जिन,
ऐसे पद ताके वृषभानु की सुता के हैं॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (2)
english_text: (Poem) These new couple, Kidho Pallava of Kalpalata, belong to Vanita of Najata of Haran Manjuta. [1] Pawan Patit Guna Gaven Muni Taake Image, Chalai Savita's Gurutaake of the public.. [2] Adi Alai Elephant of nine Nidhita's Siddhita, the Lord of all three worlds Taake Taake is the Gurutaake. [3] How many sins are there, congratulations are bursting with firecrackers, such verses are from Vrishabhanu's Suta.. [4] - Shri Hathi Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (2)
english_translation: (Poem) These new couple, Kidho Pallava of Kalpalata, belong to Vanita of Najata of Haran Manjuta. [1] Pawan Patit Guna Gaven Muni Taake Image, Chalai Savita's Gurutaake of the public.. [2] Adi Alai Elephant of nine Nidhita's Siddhita, the Lord of all three worlds Taake Taake is the Gurutaake. [3] How many sins are there, congratulations are bursting with firecrackers, such verses are from Vrishabhanu's Suta.. [4] - Shri Hathi Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (2)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री राधे बरसाने वारी, नँदनंदन सुखघन बनवारी - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, ब्रज रस माधुरी 3 (85)
sanskrit_text:
श्री राधे बरसाने वारी, नँदनंदन सुखघन बनवारी॥
जब चह रास करन बनवारी, मुकुट उतारि धरत पग प्यारी।
सब जग वारी लखि बनवारी, बनवारी वारी लखि प्यारी॥ [1]
सब जग आत्मा है बनवारी, बनवारी हूँ आत्मा प्यारी।
प्राण हमारो है बनवारी, प्राण प्राण है भानुदुलारी॥ [2]
श्रुति कह रसस्वरूप बनवारी, रसिक बनाय दीन तिन प्यारी।
तबहि 'कृपालु' भये बनवारी, जबहिं कृपा किय भानुदुलारी॥ [3]
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, ब्रज रस माधुरी 3 (85)
english_text: Shri Radhe Barsanawari, Nandanandan Sukhghan Banwari.. Banwari whenever you want for the sake of love, Removed the crown from the beloved earth. All the world is hostile to the beloved, everyone is hostile to the beloved.. [1] The whole world is a soul, the soul is beloved. Life is our life, life is life, life is love.. [2] Shruti says, life is love, love is love, day is love. Then 'Kripalu' bhaye banwari, when Kripa ki Bhanudulari.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Braj Ras Madhuri 3 (85)
english_translation: Shri Radhe Barsanawari, Nandanandan Sukhghan Banwari.. Banwari whenever you want for the sake of love, Removed the crown from the beloved earth. All the world is hostile to the beloved, everyone is hostile to the beloved.. [1] The whole world is a soul, the soul is beloved. Life is our life, life is life, life is love.. [2] Shruti says, life is love, love is love, day is love. Then 'Kripalu' bhaye banwari, when Kripa ki Bhanudulari.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Braj Ras Madhuri 3 (85)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जौ पै वृन्दावन धन भावै - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (221)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
जौ पै (श्री) वृन्दावन धन भावै।
तौ कत स्वारथ परमारथ लगि मूढ़ मनहि दौरावै॥ [1]
नव निधि अष्ट सिधि वनवैभव, स्वपनैं अंत न पावै।
घर घर भटकत मुक्ति वापुरी, कमलहिं को बतरावै॥ [2]
महा पतित पावन जमुना जल, भूतल ताप नसावै।
नव निकुंज रति पुंजनि वरषत हरषि राधे गुन गावै॥ [3]
सदा अधीन रहत नित मोहन मन लै प्रियहि रिझावै।
व्यास स्वामिनी रास-मंडलमें चुटकिनि पियहिं नचावै॥ [4]
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (221)
english_text: (Raaga Sarang) Jau Pai (Shri) Vrindavan Dhan Bhavai. That's why a fool does not wander for the sake of selfishness. [1] There is no end to the new treasure, eight accomplishments, one glory, dreamlike. Mukti Vapuri wanders from house to house, lotus flowers get scattered.. [2] The holy water of Jamuna is great fallen, the water on the ground floor is filled with penance. Nav Nikunj Rati Punjani Varash, Harshi Radhe Guna Gavai.. [3] Always remain submissive, always keep Mohan in your mind and please me. Vyas Swamini Ras-Mandalmen Chutkini Piyahin Nachavai.. [4] - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardha (221)
english_translation: (Raaga Sarang) Jau Pai (Shri) Vrindavan Dhan Bhavai. That's why a fool does not wander for the sake of selfishness. [1] There is no end to the new treasure, eight accomplishments, one glory, dreamlike. Mukti Vapuri wanders from house to house, lotus flowers get scattered.. [2] The holy water of Jamuna is great fallen, the water on the ground floor is filled with penance. Nav Nikunj Rati Punjani Varash, Harshi Radhe Guna Gavai.. [3] Always remain submissive, always keep Mohan in your mind and please me. Vyas Swamini Ras-Mandalmen Chutkini Piyahin Nachavai.. [4] - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardha (221)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: किशोरी तोरे, चरनन की बलि जाऊँ - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज
sanskrit_text:
किशोरी तोरे, चरनन की बलि जाऊँ ।
जिन युग – चरण अरुणिमा – उपमा, पचिहारी नहिं पाऊँ॥
जपा गुलाल प्रवाल आदि की, उपमा देत लजाऊँ ।
मृदुता में गुलाब नवनी की, समता लखि न सकाऊँ॥
जिन चरनन को चापत हरि नित, का महिमा मैं गाउँ ।
यह ‘कृपालु’ की चाह रैन दिन, चरनन ध्यान लगाऊँ॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, श्रीराधा माधुरी (11)
english_text: Kishori Tore, Charanan's Bali Jaun. Jin Yug - Charan Arunima - Upma, Pachihari nahin Paun.. Chanting Gulal, Praval etc., Lajaun gives the simile. Rose of Navani in softness, I cannot write the equality.. I sing the glory of Hari whose feet I touch every day. Yah, the desire for 'Kripalu' rains day, I meditate on his feet.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha Madhuri (11)
english_translation: Kishori Tore, Charanan's Bali Jaun. Jin Yug - Charan Arunima - Upma, Pachihari nahin Paun.. Chanting Gulal, Praval etc., Lajaun gives the simile. Rose of Navani in softness, I cannot write the equality.. I sing the glory of Hari whose feet I touch every day. Yah, the desire for 'Kripalu' rains day, I meditate on his feet.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha Madhuri (11)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जिनके पग चाँपत नन्दलला - श्री लाल गोपाल जी
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
जिनके पग चाँपत नन्दलला, वेतो वेद प्रसिद्ध सुभायन में।
सुर तेतिसै कोटि की कोन गिने, जँह ब्रह्म रह्यो लपटायन में॥ [1] 
कविलाल गुपाल की जीवन मूरि शशि कोटि की काँति प्रभा इनमें।
रहुरे मन तोसौं करों विनती, वृषभानु किशोरी के पायन में॥ [2]
- श्री लाल गोपाल जी
english_text: (Savaiya) Whose footsteps were followed by Nandlala, Veto Veda, the famous Subhay Purush. Sur Tetisai Koti Ki Kon Gayen, Janh Brahm Rahayo Lapatayan Mein.. [1] Kavilal Gupal's life died with millions of Shashi Koti Ki Kanti Prabha Inamen. Please pray to my beloved, please my beloved Vrishabhanu Kishori.. [2] - Shri Lal Gopal Ji
english_translation: (Savaiya) Whose footsteps were followed by Nandlala, Veto Veda, the famous Subhay Purush. Sur Tetisai Koti Ki Kon Gayen, Janh Brahm Rahayo Lapatayan Mein.. [1] Kavilal Gupal's life died with millions of Shashi Koti Ki Kanti Prabha Inamen. Please pray to my beloved, please my beloved Vrishabhanu Kishori.. [2] - Shri Lal Gopal Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: दृष्टि चौंप बर फंदा मन राख्यौ लै पंछी बिहारी - स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (9)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कान्हरौ)
दृष्टि चौंप बर फंदा मन राख्यौ लै पंछी बिहारी।
चुनों सुभाव प्रेम जल अंग स्त्रवत
पिवत न अघात रहे मुख निहारी॥ [1]
प्यारी प्यारी रटत रहत छिन ही छिन याकें और न कछु हिया री।
सुनी हरिदास पंछी नाना रंग देखत ही देखत ही प्यारी जू न हारी॥ [2]
- ललिता अवतार श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (9)
english_text: (Rag Kanharau) Drishti Chomp Bar Phanda Man Rakhyou Lai Panchhi Bihari. Choose good feelings, love, water, organs, fluid, fluid, the mouth does not remain unchanged.. [1] The lovely, lovely night remains as clean as it is, nor is there any turtle in it. Listen, Haridas, the birds are seeing different colors, they are lovely, they are green.. [2] - Lalita Avatar Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (9)
english_translation: (Rag Kanharau) Drishti Chomp Bar Phanda Man Rakhyou Lai Panchhi Bihari. Choose good feelings, love, water, organs, fluid, fluid, the mouth does not remain unchanged.. [1] The lovely, lovely night remains as clean as it is, nor is there any turtle in it. Listen, Haridas, the birds are seeing different colors, they are lovely, they are green.. [2] - Lalita Avatar Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (9)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तोसी न निहारी मैं - श्री रूप रसिक देवाचार्य, नित्य विहार पदावली (58)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कानरौ)
तोसी न निहारी मैं तिहारी सोंह मोहिरी।
करत इतै पै प्रानप्रीतम सों मान मन, 
कोंनव सयांन यह सिखयो है तोहिरी॥ [1]
सदय सुद्रिष्टि रस-वृष्टि करि प्यारी अहे, 
प्रांनप्रतिपाल रहे लाल-मुख जोहिरी॥ [2]
रूपरसिक वस रहत सदाई वलि, 
तासों यह दुचितई उचित न होंहिरी॥ [3]
- श्री रूप रसिक देवाचार्य, नित्य विहार पदावली (58)
english_text: (Raaga Kanarau) Tosi na nihari main tihari sonh mohiri. Karat itai pai pranpreetam putra man man, Konnav sayanna yah teachhiye tohiri.. [1] Sadya sudrishti ras-vrishti kari pyari ahe, pranapratipal rahe lala-mukh johiri.. [2] Ruprasik vaas rahat rahat sadai vali, tason yah duchitai apuri na honiri.. [3] - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Nitya Vihar Padavali (58)
english_translation: (Raaga Kanarau) Tosi na nihari main tihari sonh mohiri. Karat itai pai pranpreetam putra man man, Konnav sayanna yah teachhiye tohiri.. [1] Sadya sudrishti ras-vrishti kari pyari ahe, pranapratipal rahe lala-mukh johiri.. [2] Ruprasik vaas rahat rahat sadai vali, tason yah duchitai apuri na honiri.. [3] - Shri Roop Rasik Devacharya, Nitya Vihar Padavali (58)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: गिरि कीजै गोधन, मयूर कुंजन को मोहिं - श्री हठी जी, श्री राधा सुधा शतक (101)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
गिरि कीजै गोधन, मयूर कुंजन को मोहिं, 
पसु कीजै महाराज नन्द के बगर कौ। [1]
नर कौन? तौन, जौन ‘राधे-राधे' नाम रटै, 
तट कीजै वर कूल कालिंदी कगर कौ॥ [2]
इतने पै जोई कछु कीजिए कुँवर कान्ह, 
राखिए न आन फेर ‘हठी’ के झगर कौ। [3]
गोपी-पद-पंकज-राग कीजै महाराज! 
तृन कीजै रावरेई गोकुलनगर कौ॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, श्री राधा सुधा शतक (101)
english_text: (Poem) The cow is like a cow, the peacock is a fascinate, the cattle are the trouble of Maharaj Nand. [1] Who is male? You, when you memorize the name 'Radhe-Radhe', why is your family on the brink of Kalindi? [2] In such a situation, why don't you say anything to the bachelor, why don't you return to the 'elephant'. [3] Gopi-Pad-Pankaj-Raag Kijai Maharaj! Trin Kijai Ravari Gokulnagar Kau.. [4] - Shri Hathi Ji, Shri Radha Sudha Shatak (101)
english_translation: (Poem) The cow is like a cow, the peacock is a fascinate, the cattle are the trouble of Maharaj Nand. [1] Who is male? You, when you memorize the name 'Radhe-Radhe', why is your family on the brink of Kalindi? [2] In such a situation, why don't you say anything to the bachelor, why don't you return to the 'elephant'. [3] Gopi-Pad-Pankaj-Raag Kijai Maharaj! Trin Kijai Ravari Gokulnagar Kau.. [4] - Shri Hathi Ji, Shri Radha Sudha Shatak (101)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अब विलम्ब जिन करहुँ लाड़िली - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (२६)
sanskrit_text:
(राग देस उतरी)
अब विलम्ब जिन करहुँ लाड़िली कृपा दृष्टि टुक हेरो।
यमुना पुलिन गलिन गहवर की बिचरू साँज सवेरो॥
निसि दिन निरखूँ युगल माधुरी रसिकनते भव भेरो।
ललित किशोरी तन मन व्याकुल जीवन चरण बसेरो॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (२६)
english_text: (Rag desh utari) Now, if I delay, my fighting kindness will end, hero. Yamuna Pulin Gulin Gehwar's poor Sanj Savaro.. Every day, may you be filled with joyless couples of love and joy. Lalit Kishori, body and mind are distraught, life is under phase.. - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (26)
english_translation: (Rag desh utari) Now, if I delay, my fighting kindness will end, hero. Yamuna Pulin Gulin Gehwar's poor Sanj Savaro.. Every day, may you be filled with joyless couples of love and joy. Lalit Kishori, body and mind are distraught, life is under phase.. - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (26)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रसिकबर रसिक रसीलौ रसिया - श्री भगवत रसिक जी, अनन्यरसिकाभरण ग्रन्थ 6 (3)
sanskrit_text:
(राग पूर्वी)
रसिकबर रसिक रसीलौ रसिया। [1]
अंजन दै, मन रंजन कीनौं, खंजन दृग फसिया॥ [2]
करि मनुहारि भुजन भरि भेंटी, बदन चूमि हसिया। [3]
सुनि भगवत फिरी लेत बलइया, करत मदन बसिया॥ [4]
- श्री भगवत रसिक जी, अनन्यरसिकाभरण ग्रन्थ 6 (3)
english_text: (Raga Purvi) Rasikbar Rasik Rasilau Rasiya. [1]. [3] Suni Bhagwat Phir Let Balaiya, Karat Madan Basiya.. [4] - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji, Ananyarsikbharana Granth 6 (3)
english_translation: (Raga Purvi) Rasikbar Rasik Rasilau Rasiya. [1]. [3] Suni Bhagwat Phir Let Balaiya, Karat Madan Basiya.. [4] - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji, Ananyarsikbharana Granth 6 (3)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: काहू को शरन शम्भु - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (1)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
काहू को शरन शम्भु गिरिजा गणेश शेष,
काहू को शरन है कुबेर ऐसे घोरी कौ। [1]
काहू को शरन मच्छ कच्छ बलराम राम,
काहू को शरण गोरी साँमरौ सौ जोरी कौ॥ [2]
काहू को शरन बौद्ध वामन वराह व्यास,
यही निराधार सदाँ रहै मति मोरी कौ। [3]
आनंद शरण बिधि वंदित चरन एक,
हठी को शरन बृषभानु की किशोरी कौ॥ [4]
- श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक (1)
english_text: (Poem) Who has got refuge, Shambhu Girija, Ganesh Shesh, Who has got refuge, Kubera, who is so fair. [1] Kahu's refuge is Machch Kachchha Balram Ram, Kahu's refuge is Gori Samrau Sau Jori Kau.. [2] Kahu's refuge is Buddhist Vamana Varah Vyas, that is, the baseless house remains only my death. [3] Anand Sharan Bidhi Vandit Charan Ek, Hathi Ko Sharan Brisbhanu's Kishori Kau.. [4] - Shri Hathi Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (1)
english_translation: (Poem) Who has got refuge, Shambhu Girija, Ganesh Shesh, Who has got refuge, Kubera, who is so fair. [1] Kahu's refuge is Machch Kachchha Balram Ram, Kahu's refuge is Gori Samrau Sau Jori Kau.. [2] Kahu's refuge is Buddhist Vamana Varah Vyas, that is, the baseless house remains only my death. [3] Anand Sharan Bidhi Vandit Charan Ek, Hathi Ko Sharan Brisbhanu's Kishori Kau.. [4] - Shri Hathi Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सुधाकरमुधाकरं प्रतिपदस्फुरन्माधुरी - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (161)
sanskrit_text:
सुधाकरमुधाकरं प्रतिपदस्फुरन्माधुरी, धुरीण नव चन्द्रिका जलधि तुन्दिलं राधिके।
अतृप्त हरि-लोचन-द्वय चकोर-पेयं कदा, रसाम्बुधि समुन्नतं वदन-चन्द्रमीक्षे तव॥
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (161)
english_text: Sudhakarmudhakarna pratipadasphuranamadhuri, dhurin nava chandrika jaladhi tundilan radhike. Satisfied Hari-Lochan-Dwaya Chakora-Pen Kada, Rasabuddhi Samunnatam Vadana-Chandramakshe Tav.. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (161)
english_translation: Sudhakarmudhakarna pratipadasphuranamadhuri, dhurin nava chandrika jaladhi tundilan radhike. Satisfied Hari-Lochan-Dwaya Chakora-Pen Kada, Rasabuddhi Samunnatam Vadana-Chandramakshe Tav.. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (161)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नन्दगाँव गोकुल गोवर्धन की काह कहौं - श्री मधुरेश जी
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
नन्दगाँव, गोकुल, गोवर्धन की काह कहौं, 
काह कहौं गोपी-गोप-ग्वालबाल-गैया की।
काह कहौं बरसाना, मथुरा की काह कहौं, 
काह कहौं यमुना औ वंशीवट-छैया की॥
वृन्दावन-बीच बाग-बीथिन की काह कहौं, 
काह कहौं राग-रंग-उत्सव समैया की।
'मधुरेश' मन तौ मगन-उन्मन रहै, 
देखि छबि कीरति कुमारी औ कन्हैया की॥ [4]
- श्री मधुरेश जी
english_text: (Poem) I should say about Nandgaon, Gokul, Govardhan, I should say about Gopi-Gop-Gwalabala-Gaiya. What should I say about Barsana, what should I say about Mathura, what should I say about Yamuna and Vanshivta-Chaiya.. what should I say about Vrindavan-Bich Baga-Bithin, what should I say about Raga-Ranga-Utsav Samaiya. 'Madhuresh' The mind is full of joy, see the picture of Kirti Kumari and Kanhaiya.. [4] - Shri Madhuresh ji
english_translation: (Poem) I should say about Nandgaon, Gokul, Govardhan, I should say about Gopi-Gop-Gwalabala-Gaiya. What should I say about Barsana, what should I say about Mathura, what should I say about Yamuna and Vanshivta-Chaiya.. what should I say about Vrindavan-Bich Baga-Bithin, what should I say about Raga-Ranga-Utsav Samaiya. 'Madhuresh' The mind is full of joy, see the picture of Kirti Kumari and Kanhaiya.. [4] - Shri Madhuresh ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अति अलबेली भाँति झूलैं अलबेली प्रिये - श्री ध्रुवदास, ब्यालीस लीला, श्रृंगार शत 1 (35)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
अति अलबेली भाँति झूलैं अलबेली प्रिये,
सहज छबीली छबि नवल निहारहिं। [1]
सारी सुही सुरंग परत खसि खसि सखी,
बार बार प्यारौ पिय फूल सों सँवारहीं॥ [2]
जेही ओर अंग पट भूषण खिसत पिय,
तेहिं ओर मुरि मुरि प्राण ज्यौं संभारहिं। [3]
हित ध्रुव प्रीतम के नाहिं और दूजी गति,
छिन छिन तिनहीं के सुखही विचारहीं॥ [4]
- श्री ध्रुवदास, ब्यालीस लीला, श्रृंगार शत 1 (35)
english_text: (Poem) Jhulain is very carefree, carefree dear, easy and carefree images are visible. [1] All the beautiful tunnel layer is a very special friend, the beloved flowers are being kept alive again and again.. [2] Where every part of our body is falling apart, our life is being saved like that. [3] Hit Dhruva is not for the beloved but for the second speed, happiness of Chhin Chhin Tinahin's happiness.. [4] - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Shringaar Shat 1 (35)
english_translation: (Poem) Jhulain is very carefree, carefree dear, easy and carefree images are visible. [1] All the beautiful tunnel layer is a very special friend, the beloved flowers are being kept alive again and again.. [2] Where every part of our body is falling apart, our life is being saved like that. [3] Hit Dhruva is not for the beloved but for the second speed, happiness of Chhin Chhin Tinahin's happiness.. [4] - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Shringaar Shat 1 (35)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: धनी धनी वृंदावन की धरनि - श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (31)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कामोद)
“धनी धनी वृंदावन की धरनि।”
वृंदावन की भूमि धन्य धन्य है।
english_text: (Raga Kamoda) "The land of rich Vrindavan." The land of Vrindavan is blessed and blessed.
english_translation: (Raga Kamoda) "The land of rich Vrindavan." The land of Vrindavan is blessed and blessed.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राजत निकुंज धाम ठकुरानी - श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी
sanskrit_text:
(राग देस)
राजत निकुंज धाम ठकुरानी॥
कुसुम सेज पर पौढ़ी प्यारी राग सुनत मृदु बानी।
बैठी ललिता चरण पलोटत, लाल दृष्टि ललचानी।
पाएं परत सजनी के मोहन हित सो हाहा खानी।
भई कृपालु लाल पर ललिता दे आग्या मुसकानी।
आओ मोहन चरण पलोटो जैसे कुँवरी न जानी।
आग्या दई सखी की प्यारी मुख ऊपर पट तानी।
बीना बजाय गाय कछु तानन ज्यौं उपजे सुखसानी॥
गावन लगे रसिक मनमोहन तब जानी महारानी।
उठ बैठी व्यास की स्वामिनी श्री वृन्दावन रानी॥
- श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी
english_text: (Raag Desa) Rajat Nikunj Dham Thakurani.. Planted on the safflower bed, the lovely raga Sunat Mridu Bani. Lalita was sitting with her feet crossed, her eyes red and red. Mohan hit of pen layer sajni so ha ha khani. Bhai Kripalu Lal Par Lalita De Agya Musakani. Oh Mohan Charan Palto, it's as if a virgin doesn't know. Agya Day's friend's lovely face raised its lid. Without playing any song, as if happiness was produced, then the beloved Manmohan became famous. Vyas's mistress Shri Vrindavan Rani sat up.. - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani
english_translation: (Raag Desa) Rajat Nikunj Dham Thakurani.. Planted on the safflower bed, the lovely raga Sunat Mridu Bani. Lalita was sitting with her feet crossed, her eyes red and red. Mohan hit of pen layer sajni so ha ha khani. Bhai Kripalu Lal Par Lalita De Agya Musakani. Oh Mohan Charan Palto, it's as if a virgin doesn't know. Agya Day's friend's lovely face raised its lid. Without playing any song, as if happiness was produced, then the beloved Manmohan became famous. Vyas's mistress Shri Vrindavan Rani sat up.. - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारीजू के प्यारौ रूप विमोहित - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (66)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
जित जित भामिनि पग धरै, तित तित भावत लाल।
करत पलक निज पाँमड़े, रूप विमोहित बाल॥
english_text: (Doha) Jit Jit Bhamini Pag Dharai, Tit Tit Bhavat Lal. Karat Palak Nij Panamde, Roop Vimohit Bal.
english_translation: (Doha) Jit Jit Bhamini Pag Dharai, Tit Tit Bhavat Lal. Karat Palak Nij Panamde, Roop Vimohit Bal.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा-राधा कहत है - श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक
sanskrit_text:
राधा-राधा कहत है, जे नर आठो याम।
ते भव सिंधु उलंघी के, बसत सदाँ ब्रजधाम॥
-  श्री हठी जी, राधा सुधा शतक
english_text: Radha-Radha says, Je Nar Aatho Yam. Te Bhava Sindhu Ulngi Ke, Basat Sadan Brajdham.. - Shri Hathi Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak
english_translation: Radha-Radha says, Je Nar Aatho Yam. Te Bhava Sindhu Ulngi Ke, Basat Sadan Brajdham.. - Shri Hathi Ji, Radha Sudha Shatak
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन बसि कष्ट जो होइ, कोटि मुक्ति सुख भुगतै सोइ - श्री रसिकदेवजी, श्री रसिकदेवजी की वाणी
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन बसि कष्ट जो होइ, कोटि मुक्ति सुख भुगतै सोइ।
दुखी - सुखी वृन्दावन में मरे, जैसे सूर न रण ते टरे॥ 
- श्री रसिकदेवजी, श्री रसिकदेवजी की वाणी
english_text: The Vrindavan resident suffered whatever hardships and suffered millions of liberating pleasures. The sad and the happy died in Vrindavan, just as the stars do not rain.. - Shri Rasikdevji, Shri Rasikdevji's voice
english_translation: The Vrindavan resident suffered whatever hardships and suffered millions of liberating pleasures. The sad and the happy died in Vrindavan, just as the stars do not rain.. - Shri Rasikdevji, Shri Rasikdevji's voice
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नित्य विहार आधार हमारे, श्री बिहारी बिहारिनि की बलि जैहौं
sanskrit_text:
नित्य विहार आधार हमारे, श्री बिहारी बिहारिनि की बलि जैहौं 
- श्री बिहारिन देव जी

 श्री बिहारिन देव कहते हैं कि हम रसिकों के जीवन का आधार एक मात्र नित्य विहार है, हम बार बार श्री बिहारी और बिहारिनि पर बलिहार जाते हैं ।
english_text: Nitya Vihar is our basis, Shri Bihari Biharini is sacrificed - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Shri Biharin Dev says that the only basis of the life of us rasikas is Nitya Vihar, we go to Balihar on Shri Bihari and Biharini again and again.
english_translation: Nitya Vihar is our basis, Shri Bihari Biharini is sacrificed - Shri Biharin Dev Ji Shri Biharin Dev says that the only basis of the life of us rasikas is Nitya Vihar, we go to Balihar on Shri Bihari and Biharini again and again.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: एक स्वरूप सदा द्वै नाम - श्री हरिव्यास देवाचार्य, महावानी, सिद्धान्त सुख (२६)
sanskrit_text:
एक स्वरूप सदा द्वै नाम॥
आनन्द की अहलादिन श्यामा।
अहलादिन के आनन्द श्याम।
सदा सर्वदा युगल एक तन एक युगल तन विलसत धाम॥
श्री हरिप्रिया निरन्तर नितप्रति काम रूप अद्भुत अभिराम॥
- श्री हरिव्यास देवाचार्य, महावानी, सिद्धान्त सुख (26)
english_text: One form, always two names... Anand ki Alhadin Shyama. Anand Shyam of Alhadin. Always a couple, one body, one couple, one body, the abode of luxury.. Shri Haripriya, continuous daily work, form of amazing pleasure.. - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Siddhant Sukh (26)
english_translation: One form, always two names... Anand ki Alhadin Shyama. Anand Shyam of Alhadin. Always a couple, one body, one couple, one body, the abode of luxury.. Shri Haripriya, continuous daily work, form of amazing pleasure.. - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Siddhant Sukh (26)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: दोऊ जन क्रीडत हैं बन माँहि -  श्री कृष्णदास अधिकारी जी की वाणी (720)
sanskrit_text:
(राग मल्हार)
दोऊ जन क्रीडत हैं बन माँहि।
उमडि घटा घुमडी चहुँ दिसितैं, 
देखत उर न समाँहि॥ [1]
देखि घटा धावत कुंजनि कौं, 
बिच ही बूंदनि आँहि।
"कृष्णदास" गहि ओट कदम्ब की, 
भींजत क्यों न सुहाँहि॥ [2]
- श्री कृष्णदास, श्री कृष्णदास अधिकारी जी की वाणी (720)
english_text: (Raag Malhara) Dou jan kridat hain ban manhi. Umadi ghata ghumadi chahun disitain, dekht ur na samnahi.. [1] Dekhi ghata dhaavat kunjani kaun, bich hi bundani ahi. "Krishnadas" The voice of Shri Krishnadas Adhikari ji is full of Kadamba, why is Bhinjat not pleasant.. [2] - Shri Krishnadas, Shri Krishnadas Adhikari ji's voice (720)
english_translation: (Raag Malhara) Dou jan kridat hain ban manhi. Umadi ghata ghumadi chahun disitain, dekht ur na samnahi.. [1] Dekhi ghata dhaavat kunjani kaun, bich hi bundani ahi. "Krishnadas" The voice of Shri Krishnadas Adhikari ji is full of Kadamba, why is Bhinjat not pleasant.. [2] - Shri Krishnadas, Shri Krishnadas Adhikari ji's voice (720)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ताज बेगम की जीवनी
sanskrit_text:
परिचय :
ताज बीबी श्री कृष्ण की परम भक्त थीं। इनका जन्म 17वीं शताब्दी में हुआ था। ताज बीबी के पिता का नाम पद्न खान था। ताज बीबी का विवाह बादशाह अकबर के साथ हुआ था।
 
आध्यात्मिक जीवन :
अकबर के मंत्री बीरबल की बेटी शोभावती और जैमल की बेटी लीलावती की गुसाईं श्री विट्ठलनाथ जी के चरणों में अनन्य निष्ठा थी और वे दोनों श्री कृष्ण की भक्त थीं। दोनों गोवर्धन में श्रीनाथजी के दर्शनों के लिए आया करती थीं। लीलावती और शोभावती ताज बीबी के पास आती थीं जिससे ताज बीबी को सत्संग और श्री कृष्ण चरित्र श्रवण का अवसर मिलता था जिससे ताज बीबी के ह्रदय में श्री कृष्ण के प्रति श्रद्धा प्रकट हो गयी।
english_text: Introduction: Taj Bibi Thin, a great devotee of Shri Krishna. He was born in the 17th century. Taj Bibi's father's name was Padan Khan. Taj Bibi was married to Emperor Akbar. Spiritual Life: Akbar's minister Birbal's daughter Shobhavati and Jaimal's daughter Lilavati's sisters had immense devotion at the feet of Shri Vitthalnath ji and both of them were devotees of Shri Krishna. In both Govardhan, the lie of Shrinathji's darshan came and made me thin. Lilavati and the beautiful Taj Bibi were very thin, which gave Taj Bibi the opportunity to listen to satsang and the character of Shri Krishna, which manifested devotion towards Shri Krishna in Taj Bibi's heart.
english_translation: Introduction: Taj Bibi Thin, a great devotee of Shri Krishna. He was born in the 17th century. Taj Bibi's father's name was Padan Khan. Taj Bibi was married to Emperor Akbar. Spiritual Life: Akbar's minister Birbal's daughter Shobhavati and Jaimal's daughter Lilavati's sisters had immense devotion at the feet of Shri Vitthalnath ji and both of them were devotees of Shri Krishna. In both Govardhan, the lie of Shrinathji's darshan came and made me thin. Lilavati and the beautiful Taj Bibi were very thin, which gave Taj Bibi the opportunity to listen to satsang and the character of Shri Krishna, which manifested devotion towards Shri Krishna in Taj Bibi's heart.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बनी राधिका गिरधर की जोरी - श्री कुंभनदास, श्री कुम्भनदास जी की वाणी (171)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंगsara)
बनी राधिका गिरधर की जोरी।
मनहु परस्पर कोटि मदन रति की सुन्दरता चोरी॥
नूतन श्याम नन्द के नन्दन वृषभान सुता नव गोरी।
मनहु परिमल बदन चंद को पवित चकोर चकोरी॥
कुम्भन दास प्रभु रसिक लाल बहु विध रसिकनी निहोरी।
मनहु परस्पर रंग बढ्यो अति कि उपजी प्रीत न थोरी॥
- श्री कुंभनदास, श्री कुम्भनदास जी की वाणी (171)
english_text: (Raag Sarangsar) Jori by Bani Radhika Girdhar. Manhu, the beauty of the love of each other's heart... Nutan Shyam Nand's Nandan Vrishabhan Suta Nav Gori. Manhu Parimal Badan Chand Ko Pavitra Chakor Chakori.. Kumbhan Das Prabhu Rasik Lal Bahu Vidh Rasikani Nihori. Love is not the product of too much love... - Shri Kumbhnadas, words of Shri Kumbhnadas ji (171)
english_translation: (Raag Sarangsar) Jori by Bani Radhika Girdhar. Manhu, the beauty of the love of each other's heart... Nutan Shyam Nand's Nandan Vrishabhan Suta Nav Gori. Manhu Parimal Badan Chand Ko Pavitra Chakor Chakori.. Kumbhan Das Prabhu Rasik Lal Bahu Vidh Rasikani Nihori. Love is not the product of too much love... - Shri Kumbhnadas, words of Shri Kumbhnadas ji (171)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: एक बार छबि देखी तिनकौं - श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (457)
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
एक बार छबि देखी तिनकौं, त्रिभुवन तृण सा लागे है। [1]
इस दर का जु भिखारी उससे, सब जग भिक्षा माँगे है॥ [2]
जो ह्याँ का फिर सो न अनत का, दंपति पानिप पागे है। [3]
'हित भोरी' मतवारा बेसुध, सोता सा जग जागे है॥ [4]
- श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (457)
english_text: (Savaiya) Once I saw the picture, Tribhuvan looks like a straw. [1] Due to this fear, we are beggars, the whole world is begging for alms.. [2] The couple is the Panip page of the world. [3] 'Hit Bhori' Intoxicated, the world has woken up like a sleeping person.. [4] - Shri Bhori Sakhi, the pain of love (457)
english_translation: (Savaiya) Once I saw the picture, Tribhuvan looks like a straw. [1] Due to this fear, we are beggars, the whole world is begging for alms.. [2] The couple is the Panip page of the world. [3] 'Hit Bhori' Intoxicated, the world has woken up like a sleeping person.. [4] - Shri Bhori Sakhi, the pain of love (457)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ब्रजरसरसिक तो गोविंद राधे - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, राधा गोविन्द गीत (5965)
sanskrit_text:
ब्रजरसरसिक तो गोविंद राधे।
द्वारिका के रस को भी फीका बता दे॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, राधा गोविन्द गीत (5965)
english_text: Brajarsarsik te Govind Radhe. Even the juice of Dwarka should be declared dull.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Radha Govind Geet (5965)
english_translation: Brajarsarsik te Govind Radhe. Even the juice of Dwarka should be declared dull.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Radha Govind Geet (5965)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: स्वामिनि हौं पतितन शिरताज - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (81)
sanskrit_text:
(राग जंगला)
स्वामिनि हौं पतितन शिरताज।
तेरी जगत कहाय बिमुख ज्यों, डोलत लगत न लाज॥ [1]
श्रीवन बेगि बसाय उबारो, नाहिंन परम अकाज।
ललिताकिशोरी बिषे सिंधु महं, बूडत वैस जहाज॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (81)
english_text: (Raag Jangala) Swamini hoon patitan Shirataj. Your world is as if it is bereft, it does not feel ashamed.. [1] Shrivan Begi Basay Ubaro, Nahinn Param Akaj. Lalit Kishori Bishe Sindhu Mahan, Budat Vais Jahaaz.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (81)
english_translation: (Raag Jangala) Swamini hoon patitan Shirataj. Your world is as if it is bereft, it does not feel ashamed.. [1] Shrivan Begi Basay Ubaro, Nahinn Param Akaj. Lalit Kishori Bishe Sindhu Mahan, Budat Vais Jahaaz.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (81)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भ्रातर्यर्हि निमीलिताऽसि नयने - श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.81)
sanskrit_text:
भ्रातर्यर्हि निमीलिताऽसि नयने तत्र क्व कान्तात्मज- भ्रातृ-स्वाप्त-सुहृद्गणाः क्व च गुणाः कुत्र प्रतिष्ठादयः। 
कुत्राहंकृतयः प्रभुत्व-धनविद्याद्यैस्ततः सर्वत- स्त्वं निर्विद्य सविद्य! किं नु न चलस्यद्यैव वृन्दावनम्‌?॥ 
- श्री प्रबोधानंद सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (1.81)
english_text: भ्रात्रआर्हि निमिलितऽसी नयने तत्र क्व कंतत्म्जा- भ्रात्र-स्वप्त-सुह्रद्गानह क्व च गुनाह कुत्र प्रित्तिशायः. Kutrahankritayah dhvamanva-dhanavidyaistath sarvat- stavan nirvidya savidya! Kin nu na Chalasyadyava Vrindavanam?.. - Sri Prabodhananda Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (1.81)
english_translation: भ्रात्रआर्हि निमिलितऽसी नयने तत्र क्व कंतत्म्जा- भ्रात्र-स्वप्त-सुह्रद्गानह क्व च गुनाह कुत्र प्रित्तिशायः. Kutrahankritayah dhvamanva-dhanavidyaistath sarvat- stavan nirvidya savidya! Kin nu na Chalasyadyava Vrindavanam?.. - Sri Prabodhananda Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (1.81)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: साँचौ निहचै प्रेम कौ जीवन मुक्ति रसाल - श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर (4713.26)
sanskrit_text:
साँचौ निहचै प्रेम कौ, जीवन मुक्ति रसाल।
एकै निहचै प्रेम कौ, जबै मिलें गोपाल॥
- श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर (4713.26)
english_text: Sanchou nihachai prem kau, jeevan mukti rasal. Ekai Nihchai Prem Kou, Jabai Milen Gopal.. - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar (4713.26)
english_translation: Sanchou nihachai prem kau, jeevan mukti rasal. Ekai Nihchai Prem Kou, Jabai Milen Gopal.. - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar (4713.26)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: "तू ही मेरी मैं भी तेरी, मेरी प्यारी राधे"  - जगदगुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज
sanskrit_text:
"तू ही मेरी मैं भी तेरी मेरी प्यारी राधे" 
- जगदगुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज

हे मेरी प्यारी राधा! आप ही केवल मेरी हैं और मैं भी आपकी हूँ।
english_text: "You are mine, I am also yours, my dear Radhe" - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj O my dear Radha! AP Hi is only mine and I am also yours.
english_translation: "You are mine, I am also yours, my dear Radhe" - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj O my dear Radha! AP Hi is only mine and I am also yours.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा रससुधासिन्धु राधा सौभाग्यमञ्जरी - ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण, राधास्तोत्रम् (6)
sanskrit_text:
राधा रससुधासिन्धु राधा सौभाग्यमञ्जरी।
राधा व्रजाङ्गनामुख्या राधैवाराध्यते मया॥
- ब्रह्माण्ड पुराण, राधास्तोत्रम् (6)
english_text: Radha Rasasudhasindhu Radhasaubhagyamanyajari. Radha Vrajanganamukhya Radhavaradhyate Maya.. - Brahmanda Purana, Radhastotram (6)
english_translation: Radha Rasasudhasindhu Radhasaubhagyamanyajari. Radha Vrajanganamukhya Radhavaradhyate Maya.. - Brahmanda Purana, Radhastotram (6)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अल्ला बिसमिल्ला रहिमान और रहीम छोड़ - ताज बीबी
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
अल्ला बिसमिल्ला रहिमान और रहीम छोड़,
पीर और शहीदों की चर्चा न चलाऊँगी। [1]
सूथना उतार पहिन घांघरा घुमावदार,
फरिया को फार शीश चूनरी चढ़ाऊँगी॥ [2]
कहत शहजादी ठाकुर कवी सों पैज कर,
वृन्दावन छोड़ अब कितहूँ न जाऊँगी। [3]
बांदी बनूँगी राधा-महारानी जू की,
तुर्किनी बहाय नाम गोपिका कहाऊँगी॥ [4]
- ताज बीबी
english_text: (Poem) Allah Bismillah Leave Rahiman and Rahim, I will continue discussing the pirs and martyrs. [1] I will take off my hair and put on my curls, I will put my head away from Fariya.. [2] Says the princess, Thakur, poet, son, please leave Vrindavan, where will I go now. [3] I will become the captive of Radha-Maharani Zoo, I will call Turkish Bahai name Gopika.. [4] - Taj Bibi
english_translation: (Poem) Allah Bismillah Leave Rahiman and Rahim, I will continue discussing the pirs and martyrs. [1] I will take off my hair and put on my curls, I will put my head away from Fariya.. [2] Says the princess, Thakur, poet, son, please leave Vrindavan, where will I go now. [3] I will become the captive of Radha-Maharani Zoo, I will call Turkish Bahai name Gopika.. [4] - Taj Bibi
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हरि हरि जप लेनी औसर बीतो जाय - श्री सहजोबाई
sanskrit_text:
(राग काफ़ी)
हरि हरि जप लेनी औसर बीतो जाय।
जो दिन गये सो फिर नहिं आवैं, करि विचार मन लाय॥ [1]
या जग बाजी साँच न जानो, तामें मत भरमाय।
कोई किसी का है नहिं बौरे, नाहक लियौ लगाय॥ [2]
अंत समय कोई काम न आवैं, जब जम देहि बोलाय।
चरणदास कहैं ‘सहजो बाई’, सत संगत सरनाय॥ [3]
- श्री सहजोबाई
english_text: (Raaga Kafai) Hari Hari Jaap Leni Ausar Bito Jai. The days that are gone will not come again, think about it in your mind.. [1] Or don't know the world's world, don't get confused in it. Someone does not belong to anyone else, he takes them unnecessarily.. [2] At the end of the day, he becomes of no use, when the body speaks. Charandas says 'Sahjo Bai', Sat Sangat Sarnaya.. [3] - Shri Sahjo Bai
english_translation: (Raaga Kafai) Hari Hari Jaap Leni Ausar Bito Jai. The days that are gone will not come again, think about it in your mind.. [1] Or don't know the world's world, don't get confused in it. Someone does not belong to anyone else, he takes them unnecessarily.. [2] At the end of the day, he becomes of no use, when the body speaks. Charandas says 'Sahjo Bai', Sat Sangat Sarnaya.. [3] - Shri Sahjo Bai
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कहाँ सुख वृज को सो संसार - श्री सूरदास
sanskrit_text:
(राग धनाश्री)
कहाँ सुख वृज को सो संसार। 
कहाँ सुखद वंशीवट यमुना, यह मन सदॉ विचार॥ [1]
कहाँ बनधाम कहाँ राधा संग, कहाँ संग वृजबाम। 
कहाँ रस रास बीच अन्तर सुख कहाँ नारी तन ताम॥ [2]
कहाँ लता तरु तरु प्रति बूझनि, कुंज कुंज नव धाम।
कहाँ विरह सुख बिनु गोपिन संग, 'सूरश्याम' मन काम॥ [3]
- श्री सूरदास
english_text: (Raaga Dhanashree) Where is the world, where is the happiness of the tree? Where is the pleasant forest, Shivat Yamuna, these thoughts remain in the mind.. [1] Where is Bandham, where is with Radha, where is with Vrijabam. Where is the joy and happiness between the two, where is the woman's body and mind... [2] Where is the tree and the trees extinguished, Kunj Kunj is the new abode. Where is the happiness of separation without Gopi, 'Surshyam' is the mind of work.. [3] - Shri Surdas
english_translation: (Raaga Dhanashree) Where is the world, where is the happiness of the tree? Where is the pleasant forest, Shivat Yamuna, these thoughts remain in the mind.. [1] Where is Bandham, where is with Radha, where is with Vrijabam. Where is the joy and happiness between the two, where is the woman's body and mind... [2] Where is the tree and the trees extinguished, Kunj Kunj is the new abode. Where is the happiness of separation without Gopi, 'Surshyam' is the mind of work.. [3] - Shri Surdas
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हमारे ब्रज की रानी राधे - श्री भारतेंदु हरिशचंद्र, भारतेंदु ग्रंथावली, प्रेम फुलवारी (74)
sanskrit_text:
हमारे ब्रज की रानी राधे।
जिन निज बस करि मोहन सह सब ब्रज-नर-नारी नाधे॥ [1]
परम उदार धाइ सुमिरन के पहिलेहि नासत बाघे।
कहि 'हरिचंद' सोच उनकी मोहि जे नहिं इनहि अराधे॥ [2]
- श्री भारतेंदु हरिशचंद्र, भारतेंदु ग्रंथावली, प्रेम फुलवारी (74)
english_text: Queen Radhe of our Braj. Jinn Nij Bas Kari Mohan Saha Sab Braj-Nara-Nari Nadhe.. [1] The first unsatisfied robe of the most generous Dhay Sumiran. Where 'Harichand' thinks that he is his lover, he does not worship them.. [2] - Shri Bharatendu Harishchandra, Bharatendu Granthawali, Prem Phulwari (74)
english_translation: Queen Radhe of our Braj. Jinn Nij Bas Kari Mohan Saha Sab Braj-Nara-Nari Nadhe.. [1] The first unsatisfied robe of the most generous Dhay Sumiran. Where 'Harichand' thinks that he is his lover, he does not worship them.. [2] - Shri Bharatendu Harishchandra, Bharatendu Granthawali, Prem Phulwari (74)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: क्वासौ राधा निगम पदवीदुरगा कुत्र चासौ कृष्णस्तस्याः कुचकमलयोरन्तरै कान्तवासः । - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (260)
sanskrit_text:
क्वासौ राधा निगम पदवीदुरगा कुत्र चासौ कृष्णस्तस्याः कुचकमलयोरन्तरै कान्तवासः। 
क्वाहं तुच्छ परममधमः प्राण्यहो गर्ह्मकर्मा यत्तन्नाम स्फुरति महिमा एष वृन्दावनस्य॥
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (260)
english_text: Kwasau Radha Nigam Padvidurga Kutra Chasau Krishnastasya: Kuchakamalayorantaya Kantavash. क्वहन तुच्च परमम्मदमह प्रनायहो गार्हमकर्म यत्तन्न्म स्फूरती महिमा एश व्रिन्दावनस्य.. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (260)
english_translation: Kwasau Radha Nigam Padvidurga Kutra Chasau Krishnastasya: Kuchakamalayorantaya Kantavash. क्वहन तुच्च परमम्मदमह प्रनायहो गार्हमकर्म यत्तन्न्म स्फूरती महिमा एश व्रिन्दावनस्य.. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (260)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: गुरु सोइ जो विपिन बसावे - श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (137)
sanskrit_text:
गुरु सोइ जो विपिन बसावे, गुरु सोइ जो हरिहि मिलावै। 
या करनी विन गुरु न कहावै॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (137)
english_text: Guru Soi Jo Vipin Basave, Guru Soi Jo Harihi Milvai. Ya karni vin guru na kahawai.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, friend of Siddhant (137)
english_translation: Guru Soi Jo Vipin Basave, Guru Soi Jo Harihi Milvai. Ya karni vin guru na kahawai.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, friend of Siddhant (137)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हम चाकर राधा रानी के - श्री भारतेंदु हरिशचंद्र, भारतेंदु ग्रंथावली, होली (11)
sanskrit_text:
हम चाकर राधा रानी के।
ठाकुर श्री नंद नंदन के, वृषभानु लली ठकुरानी के॥ [1]
निरभय रहत वदत नहिं काहू डर नहिं डरत भवानी के।
'हरीचंद’ नित रहत दीवाने, सूरत अजब दीवानी के॥ [2]
- श्री भारतेंदु हरिशचंद्र, भारतेंदु ग्रंथावली, होली (11)
english_text: We are servants of Radha Rani. Thakur Shri Nand of Nandan, Vrishabhanu of Lali Thakurani.. [1] There is no need to fear while remaining fearless, there is no fear of Bhavani. 'Harichanda' Nita Rahat Diwane, Surat Ajab Diwane K.. [2] - Shri Bharatendu Harishchandra, Bharatendu Granthawali, Holi (11)
english_translation: We are servants of Radha Rani. Thakur Shri Nand of Nandan, Vrishabhanu of Lali Thakurani.. [1] There is no need to fear while remaining fearless, there is no fear of Bhavani. 'Harichanda' Nita Rahat Diwane, Surat Ajab Diwane K.. [2] - Shri Bharatendu Harishchandra, Bharatendu Granthawali, Holi (11)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृंदावन तजि तीरथ जांही - श्री रसिक देव जी, श्री रसिक देव जू की वाणी
sanskrit_text:
वृंदावन तजि तीरथ जांही, ते अज्ञान कछु समझत नाहिं।
- श्री रसिक देव जी, श्री रसिक देव जू की वाणी

जो वृंदावन को त्याग कर किसी और धाम जाता है, इससे बढ़कर कोई अज्ञान नहीं हो सकता।
english_text: I don't know anything about the pilgrimage to Vrindavan, but ignorance doesn't understand anything. - Shri Rasik Dev Ji, Words of Shri Rasik Dev Ji One who leaves Vrindavan and knows some other place, there can be no greater ignorance than this.
english_translation: I don't know anything about the pilgrimage to Vrindavan, but ignorance doesn't understand anything. - Shri Rasik Dev Ji, Words of Shri Rasik Dev Ji One who leaves Vrindavan and knows some other place, there can be no greater ignorance than this.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन वैकुण्ठ कों, तोल्यौ तुलसी दास - श्री तुलसीदास जी महाराज
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन वैकुण्ठ कों, तोल्यौ तुलसी दास। 
गरूऔ हो सो थिर रह्यो, हलकौ गयौ अकास॥ 
- श्री तुलसीदास जी महाराज
english_text: Vrindavan Vaikuntha Kon, Tolyau Tulsi Das. If you are afraid, stay firm, if you are afraid, please remain firm.. - Shri Tulsidas Ji Maharaj
english_translation: Vrindavan Vaikuntha Kon, Tolyau Tulsi Das. If you are afraid, stay firm, if you are afraid, please remain firm.. - Shri Tulsidas Ji Maharaj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: लालन तन नैनन भरि चितई - श्री वंशी अलि, माधुर्य शत (21)
sanskrit_text:
लालन तन नैनन भरि चितई।
मुरझि परयौ सुधि देह बिसारी, अनी दृग हियेरे परै गई॥ [1]
अधर फुरक श्री राधा गुन गाबत, कबहू कहाय कही।
वंशी अलि स्वामिन अति कोमल, हियरे लाय लई॥ [2]
- श्री वंशी अलि, माधुर्य शत (21)
english_text: Lalan tan nanan bhari chitai. Murazhi parayu sudhi deh bisari, ani drg hiare parai gai.. [1] Adhar furak Shri Radha guna gabaat, kabahu kahai kahi. Vanshi Ali Swami is very soft, brought the hair.. [2] - Shri Vanshi Ali, Madhuri Shat (21)
english_translation: Lalan tan nanan bhari chitai. Murazhi parayu sudhi deh bisari, ani drg hiare parai gai.. [1] Adhar furak Shri Radha guna gabaat, kabahu kahai kahi. Vanshi Ali Swami is very soft, brought the hair.. [2] - Shri Vanshi Ali, Madhuri Shat (21)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नन्द को लाल गोपाल माल उर - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, फुटकर पद (49)
sanskrit_text:
(राग दीपचंदी)
नन्द को लाल गोपाल माल उर, भ्रमत रहत नवबाल के चायन।
खंजन नैन बैन मन रंजन, अंजन नैन मैन सकुचायन॥ [1]
ललित किशोरी हेरि इतै कित, जाहि उतै निज सहज सुभायन।
कदम्ब की कुंज कुटीर कहुँ वह, ह्वै है पलोटत राधिका पायन॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, फुटकर पद (49)
english_text: (Rag Deepachandi) Nand Ko Lal Gopal Mal Ur, Bhramat Rahat Naavbal's selection. Khanjan Nain Bain Man Ranjan, Anjan Nain Main Sakuchayan.. [1] Lalit Kishori Hairi Itai Kit, Jahi Utai Nij Sahaj Subhayan. Kadamba's Kunj Kutir Kahoon wow, hawai hai palotat Radhika Payan.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Futakar Pad (49)
english_translation: (Rag Deepachandi) Nand Ko Lal Gopal Mal Ur, Bhramat Rahat Naavbal's selection. Khanjan Nain Bain Man Ranjan, Anjan Nain Main Sakuchayan.. [1] Lalit Kishori Hairi Itai Kit, Jahi Utai Nij Sahaj Subhayan. Kadamba's Kunj Kutir Kahoon wow, hawai hai palotat Radhika Payan.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Futakar Pad (49)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मृदु मुसकान निहारि के - श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (111)
sanskrit_text:
मृदु मुसकान निहारि के, धीर धरत है कौन।
नारायण कै तन तजै, कै बौरा के मौन॥
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (111)
english_text: Nihari's soft smile, who is patient? Narayan's body is shed, Kai Baura's silence.. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (111)
english_translation: Nihari's soft smile, who is patient? Narayan's body is shed, Kai Baura's silence.. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (111)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री मुख यों न बखान सके - श्री रसखान जी
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
श्री मुख यों न बखान सके, वृषभानु सुता जू को रूप उजारौ। [1]
हे रसखान तू ज्ञान संभार, नैन निहार जु रीझन हारौ॥ [2]
चारू सिंदूर को लाल रसाल, लसै वृजबाल को भाल टीकारौ। [3]
गोद में मानौं विराजत है, घनश्याम के सारे के सारे को सारौ॥ [4]
- श्री रसखान जी
 
वृषभानु-नंदिनी श्री राधा के मुखचंद्र की अनुपम छवि का वर्णन स्वयं वाणी की देवी सरस्वती भी करने में असमर्थ हैं। [1]
english_text: (Savaiya) Shri Mukh could not express like this, Vrishabhanu Suta Ju Ko Roop Ujrau. [1] O Raskhan, you are the storehouse of knowledge, look at the reasons behind your eyes.. [2] You may stick to the vermilion like red rasal, the lasai to the green tree. [3] The God is present in the mind, the Saru of all of Ghanshyam.. [4] - Shri Raskhan ji Vrishabhanu-Nandini, Goddess Saraswati herself is capable of describing the unique image of Shri Radha's face. [1]
english_translation: (Savaiya) Shri Mukh could not express like this, Vrishabhanu Suta Ju Ko Roop Ujrau. [1] O Raskhan, you are the storehouse of knowledge, look at the reasons behind your eyes.. [2] You may stick to the vermilion like red rasal, the lasai to the green tree. [3] The God is present in the mind, the Saru of all of Ghanshyam.. [4] - Shri Raskhan ji Vrishabhanu-Nandini, Goddess Saraswati herself is capable of describing the unique image of Shri Radha's face. [1]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ऐसैं हिय में बसत रहौ - श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, भजन कुण्डलिया (11)
sanskrit_text:
ऐसैं हिय में बसत रहौ, नव-किसोर रस-रासि।
चितवनि अति अनुराग की, करत मंद मृदु हाँसि॥ [1]
करत मंद मृदु हाँसि दोउ, होत जु प्रेम प्रकास।
छके रहत मदमत्त गति, आनँद मदन विलास॥ [2]
'हित ध्रुव' छबि सौं कुंज में, दै अंसनि-भुज वैसे।
मेरी मति इति नाहिं, कहौं उपमा दै ऐसे॥ [3]
- श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, भजन कुण्डलिया (11)
english_text: Aisan hiy man basat raho, nawa-kishore ras-rasi. Warning of extreme love, do a slow soft laugh. [1] Do a slow soft laugh, you become the light of love. The intoxicating pace, the blissful pleasure, the luxury... [2] 'Hit Dhruva' is visible in a hundred groves, by the way. My opinion is not enough, can I say the simile like this.. [3] - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Bhajan Kundalia (11)
english_translation: Aisan hiy man basat raho, nawa-kishore ras-rasi. Warning of extreme love, do a slow soft laugh. [1] Do a slow soft laugh, you become the light of love. The intoxicating pace, the blissful pleasure, the luxury... [2] 'Hit Dhruva' is visible in a hundred groves, by the way. My opinion is not enough, can I say the simile like this.. [3] - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Bhajan Kundalia (11)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: साधो भाई ऐसौ महल हमारौ - श्री ललित किशोरी देव, सिद्धांत के पद (101)
sanskrit_text:
साधो भाई ऐसौ महल हमारौ।
निर्गुण सगुण वारि है जाकी कहत न वेद विचारौ॥ [1]
अद्भुत प्रेम रंग रस अद्भुत अद्भुत नित्य बिहारौ।
ललित प्रिये सुख रासि रसिकवर करि राख्यौ उरहारौ॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (101)
english_text: Sadho bhai, this palace is ours. Vedas say that nirgun and sagun waari hai. [1] Amazing love, colors and juice, amazing and amazing daily bliss. Lalit dear, keep the pleasures of happiness alive. [2] - Sri Lalit Kishori Dev, Sri Lalit Kishori Dev Joo's words, principle posts (101)
english_translation: Sadho bhai, this palace is ours. Vedas say that nirgun and sagun waari hai. [1] Amazing love, colors and juice, amazing and amazing daily bliss. Lalit dear, keep the pleasures of happiness alive. [2] - Sri Lalit Kishori Dev, Sri Lalit Kishori Dev Joo's words, principle posts (101)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मनमोहन मनमोहना - श्री कुंभनदास, श्री कुम्भनदास जी की वाणी
sanskrit_text:
मनमोहन मनमोहना, मनमोहन मन माहिं। 
या मोहन ते सोहना, तीन लोक में नाहीं॥ 
- श्री कुंभनदास, श्री कुम्भनदास जी की वाणी
english_text: Manmohan Manmohan, Manmohan man mahi. Ya Mohan te Sohana, not in three worlds.. - Shri Kumbhnadas, words of Shri Kumbhnadas ji
english_translation: Manmohan Manmohan, Manmohan man mahi. Ya Mohan te Sohana, not in three worlds.. - Shri Kumbhnadas, words of Shri Kumbhnadas ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वेद भेद जानें नहीं नेति नेति कहै बैन - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
बेद भेद जानें नहीं, नेति नेति कहै बैन।
ता मोहन पै राधिका, रहै महावर दैन॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: There is no need to discriminate in bed, there is no ban on neti neti. Ta Mohan Pai Radhika, Rahe Mahavar Dain.. - Couplets of Braj
english_translation: There is no need to discriminate in bed, there is no ban on neti neti. Ta Mohan Pai Radhika, Rahe Mahavar Dain.. - Couplets of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: पायो बड़े भाग्यन सों आसरो किशोरी जू कौ - श्री ब्रज निधि ग्रंथावली, हरि पद संग्रह (50)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
पायो बड़े भाग्यन सों आसरो किशोरी जू कौ,
ओर निरवाहि ताहि नीके गहि गहिरे। [1]
नैननि सौं निरखि लड़ैती जू को वदन चन्द्र,
ताही के चकोर ह्वैके रूपसुधा चहिरे॥ [2]
स्वामिनी की कृपासों आधीन हुयी हैं 'ब्रजनिधि',
ताते रसनासों सदां श्यामा नाम कहिरे। [3]
मन मेरे मीत जोपै कह्यो माने मेरो तौं,
राधा पद कंज कौ भ्रमर है के रहिरे॥ [4]
- श्री ब्रज निधि जी, ब्रज निधि ग्रंथावली, हरि पद संग्रह (50)
english_text: (Poem) Payo bade bhagya putra asaro kishori ju kau, ya nirvahi tahi nike gahih gihire. [1] Nainani Saun Nirkhi Ladaiti Ju Ko Vadan Chandra, Tahi Ke Chakor Hawaike Roopsudha Chahre.. [2] 'Brajnidhi' has come under the blessings of Swami, Taate Rasasanaso Sadan Shyama Naam Kahere. [3] Man mere mit jopai khayo mane mere taun, Radha pad kaanj kaun bhramar hai ke rahire.. [4] - Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Hari Pad Sangrah (50)
