english_text: My mind should take refuge in Vrindavan, this rasa pasu niras tu chhandat, bhajat pethi bharan. Vyas other devotional biography, Mangal Maran in Bain. - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, First Part (93) Oh man! Take refuge in Sri Vrindavan. Leaving aside this divine pleasure throughout his life, where is he lying to fill his stomach with a heart as dull as that of an animal? Shri Hariram Vyas ji says that the biography of a passionate devotee is in Shri Vrindavan itself and it is auspicious to die in this forest.
english_translation: My mind should take refuge in Vrindavan, this rasa pasu niras tu chhandat, bhajat pethi bharan. Vyas other devotional biography, Mangal Maran in Bain. - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, First Part (93) Oh man! Take refuge in Sri Vrindavan. Leaving aside this divine pleasure throughout his life, where is he lying to fill his stomach with a heart as dull as that of an animal? Shri Hariram Vyas ji says that the biography of a passionate devotee is in Shri Vrindavan itself and it is auspicious to die in this forest.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधे अलबेली सरकार - श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (115)
sanskrit_text:
(राग भुपाली, त्रिताल)
राधे अलबेली सरकार।
वनरानी रसिकन की प्यारी, अति उदार सुकमार॥ [1]
जाके पग नूपुर रव सों ही, कोटि ब्रह्म अवतार।
रास विहारिन कुञ्ज विहारिण, महिमा अमित अपार॥ [2]
नव-निकुञ्ज की नव निधि राधे, करती नित्त बिहार।
श्रीगोपालहित नवल प्रिया पै, बार-बार बलिहार॥ [3]
- श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (115)
english_text: (Rag Bhupali, Tritala) Radhe Albeli Sarkar. The beloved, very generous Sukmar of Vanarni Rasikan.. [1] He is the son of Nupur Rao, the incarnation of Koti Brahma. Rasa Viharin Kunj Viharin, Mahima Amit Apar.. [2] Nav-Nikunj's Nav Nidhi Radhe, Karati Nitta Bihar. Shri Gopalhit Naval Priya Pai, Baara Baar Balihaar.. [3] - Shri Hit Gopal Das [Seva Kunj Vele], Nikunj Ras Vallari (115)
english_translation: (Rag Bhupali, Tritala) Radhe Albeli Sarkar. The beloved, very generous Sukmar of Vanarni Rasikan.. [1] He is the son of Nupur Rao, the incarnation of Koti Brahma. Rasa Viharin Kunj Viharin, Mahima Amit Apar.. [2] Nav-Nikunj's Nav Nidhi Radhe, Karati Nitta Bihar. Shri Gopalhit Naval Priya Pai, Baara Baar Balihaar.. [3] - Shri Hit Gopal Das [Seva Kunj Vele], Nikunj Ras Vallari (115)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधे दुलारी मान तजि -  श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (22)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कान्हरौ)
राधे दुलारी मान तजि।
प्रान पायौ जात है री मेरौ सजि॥ [1]
अपनौं हाथ मेरे माथे धरि अभै दान दै अजि।
श्रीहरिदास के स्वामी स्याम कहत री प्यारी
रंग रुचि सौं बलि लजि॥ [2]
- ललिता अवतार श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (22)
english_text: (Rag Kanharau) Radhe Dulari Man Taji. My life is dear to me.. [1] O Lord, put your hands on my forehead and give me fearlessness. Sri Haridas's Swami Syam says lovely color, interest in hundred sacrifices.. [2] - Lalita Avatar Sri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (22)
english_translation: (Rag Kanharau) Radhe Dulari Man Taji. My life is dear to me.. [1] O Lord, put your hands on my forehead and give me fearlessness. Sri Haridas's Swami Syam says lovely color, interest in hundred sacrifices.. [2] - Lalita Avatar Sri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (22)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बलिहारी जाऊँ जक परी - श्री बिहारिन देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (660)
sanskrit_text:
बलिहारी जाऊँ जक परी, बातन बहुत दंडौत।
पालत देह कुटुंब कौं, भले समझि भागौत॥
- श्री बिहारिन देव जी, श्री बिहारिन देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (660)
english_text: Balihari Jaun Jak Pari, Batan Bahut Dandaut. Who is the family after turning the body, even if you consider yourself a Bhagat.. - Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Speech of Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Friend of Siddhant (660)
english_translation: Balihari Jaun Jak Pari, Batan Bahut Dandaut. Who is the family after turning the body, even if you consider yourself a Bhagat.. - Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Speech of Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Friend of Siddhant (660)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कोऊ चाहै सिर कमलकर - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
कोऊ चाहै सिर कमलकर, कोऊ निरखै मुख माथ। 
हौं तो राधा पद कमल, सिरधरि होंऊ सनाथ॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: How much do you want, Sir Kamalakar, how much do you want, how much do you want, the head of mathematics. If I am Radha, my feet are lotus, my head is Sanath… - braj ke dohe
english_translation: How much do you want, Sir Kamalakar, how much do you want, how much do you want, the head of mathematics. If I am Radha, my feet are lotus, my head is Sanath… - braj ke dohe
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीकुंजबिहारिनि ललित लाडिली - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, श्रृंगार रस के पद (4)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीकुंजबिहारिनि ललित लाडिली, 
अद्भुत रूप रसाला। [1]
हँसनि लसनि मुसकनि रस बरसत, 
लालै करति निहाला॥ [2] 
उमँगि उमँगि दोउ मदन लडावत, 
दोउ दोउन उरमाला। [3]
श्रीललितकिसोरी के हित विहरत, 
जानि महा निजु हाला॥ [4]
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, श्रृंगार रस के पद (4)
english_text: Shrikunjbiharini, beautiful lady, amazing beauty. [1] Hansani Lasani Muskani Ras Barsaat, Lalai Karati Nihala.. [2] Umangi Umangi Dou Madan Ladawat, Dou Doon Uramala. [3] Shri Lalit Kishori ke hit viharat, jani mah niju hala.. [4] - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's speech, Shringaar Rasa's words (4)
english_translation: Shrikunjbiharini, beautiful lady, amazing beauty. [1] Hansani Lasani Muskani Ras Barsaat, Lalai Karati Nihala.. [2] Umangi Umangi Dou Madan Ladawat, Dou Doon Uramala. [3] Shri Lalit Kishori ke hit viharat, jani mah niju hala.. [4] - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's speech, Shringaar Rasa's words (4)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हम चाकर कुंज विहारिणि के - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालुजी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, श्री राधा मधुरी (52)
sanskrit_text:
हम चाकर कुंज विहारिणि के ।
डरत न डर रुक्मिणि वल्लभ अरु, श्री रुक्मिणि अवतारिणि के ।
मुक्ति चार मनुहार करत पै, जाऊँ न ढिंग जग तारिणि के ।
नित्य - विहार लखौं गहवर वन, सरस रास - रस कारिणि के ।
बनि अलमस्त नाम गुन गाउँ, शरणागत - भय हारिणि के ।
जूठनि खाऊँ ‘कृपालु’ जाऊँ बलि, नित नीलांबरधारिणि के॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालुजी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, श्री राधा मधुरी (52)
english_text: We are servants of Kunj Viharini. Darat Na Dar Rukmini Vallabh Aru, Shri Rukmini Avatarini's. Mukti prays for you, who doesn't care about the world. Daily walks of lakhs of deep forests, full of sweet nectar. Bani Almast Naam Gun Gaun, Suranaagat - fear of the deer. Juthani where 'Kripalu' Jaun Bali, Nit Nilanbardharini's.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha Madhuri (52)
english_translation: We are servants of Kunj Viharini. Darat Na Dar Rukmini Vallabh Aru, Shri Rukmini Avatarini's. Mukti prays for you, who doesn't care about the world. Daily walks of lakhs of deep forests, full of sweet nectar. Bani Almast Naam Gun Gaun, Suranaagat - fear of the deer. Juthani where 'Kripalu' Jaun Bali, Nit Nilanbardharini's.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Shri Radha Madhuri (52)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जै जै श्री घनश्याम वपु - श्री भारतेंदु हरिशचंद्र, भारतेंदु ग्रंथावली, वेणु गीत (1)
sanskrit_text:
जै जै श्री घनश्याम वपु, जै श्री राधा वाम।
जै जै सब ब्रज-सुंदरी, जै जै वृंदावन धाम॥
- श्री भारतेंदु हरिशचंद्र, भारतेंदु ग्रंथावली, वेणु गीत (1)
english_text: Jai Jai Shri Ghanshyam Vapu, Jai Shri Radha Vam. Jai Jai Sab Brajasundari, Jai Jai Vrindavan Dham.. - Shri Bharatendu Harishchandra, Bharatendu Granthawali, Venu Geet (1)
english_translation: Jai Jai Shri Ghanshyam Vapu, Jai Shri Radha Vam. Jai Jai Sab Brajasundari, Jai Jai Vrindavan Dham.. - Shri Bharatendu Harishchandra, Bharatendu Granthawali, Venu Geet (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्यामा पग लवलीन हो, उन्हीं के हाथ विकाय  - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (236.2)
sanskrit_text:
श्यामा पग लवलीन हो, उन्हीं के हाथ विकाय।
तोही कर में ये भटू, मोहन विकिहै आय॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (236.2)
english_text: Shyama's feet are full of love, they are in her hands. Tohi kar man ye bhatu, Mohan vikihai ai.. - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (236.2)
english_translation: Shyama's feet are full of love, they are in her hands. Tohi kar man ye bhatu, Mohan vikihai ai.. - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (236.2)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मुसकान से काम तमाम हुआ - ब्रज के सवैया
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
मुसकान से काम तमाम हुआ, तिरछे दृग क्यों अब तानता है।
अति सुन्दर गोल कपोल तेरे, भृकुटी-लकुटी पहिचानता है॥ [1]
परिणाम में दुःखको जानता है, पर हाय नहीं हठ ठानता है।
बहुतेरा कहा पर तेरे बिना, मन मेरा न मोहन ! मानता है॥ [2]
- ब्रज के सवैया
english_text: (Sawaiya) It became less than a smile, why is there fear now, there is tension. Your very beautiful round cheeks, he recognizes every frown... [1] The result is that a man knows sorrow, but does not wave his hand. I have said a lot but without you, my mind and Mohan! Celebrates.. [2] -Savaiya of Braj
english_translation: (Sawaiya) It became less than a smile, why is there fear now, there is tension. Your very beautiful round cheeks, he recognizes every frown... [1] The result is that a man knows sorrow, but does not wave his hand. I have said a lot but without you, my mind and Mohan! Celebrates.. [2] -Savaiya of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कंचन की यह भूमि है - श्री चरणदास, भक्ति सागर
sanskrit_text:
कंचन की यह भूमि है, धरे सतोगुण बेख।
चरणदास बलि बलि गयौ, दिव्यदृष्टि करदेख॥
- श्री चरणदास, भक्ति सागर
english_text: This is the land of Kanchan, do not forget the good qualities. Charandas sacrificed his life, got divine vision... - Shri Charandas, Bhakti Sagar
english_translation: This is the land of Kanchan, do not forget the good qualities. Charandas sacrificed his life, got divine vision... - Shri Charandas, Bhakti Sagar
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु परात्परायै - श्री वंशी अलि, श्री राधा स्तोत्र (1)
sanskrit_text:
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु परात्परायै राधाभिधायै निखिलाश्रयायै॥
सकृद्गृणान्तस्तवनामये वै ते त्वां गतिं यान्तिभवप्रमुक्ता:॥
- श्री वंशी अलि, श्री राधा स्तोत्र (1)
english_text: Namo Namastestu Paratparaayi Radhabhidhayai Nikhilashrayai.. Sakridgrinantastvanmayai Vai Te Tvam Gatim Yantibhavpramuktah.. - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radha Stotra (1)
english_translation: Namo Namastestu Paratparaayi Radhabhidhayai Nikhilashrayai.. Sakridgrinantastvanmayai Vai Te Tvam Gatim Yantibhavpramuktah.. - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radha Stotra (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री राधिका माधव छवी अपार - श्री प्रिया सखी (श्री ब्रह्म गोपाल गोस्वामी), हरि लीला (18)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
छवि अपार श्रृंगार की, आरति जय जय कार।
करत प्रेम परिवार मिल, बार बार बलिहार॥
english_text: (Doha) Image of immense makeup, Aarti Jai Jai Kar. Working together with love and family, sacrificing again and again.
english_translation: (Doha) Image of immense makeup, Aarti Jai Jai Kar. Working together with love and family, sacrificing again and again.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आशिक होकर इश्क कमावे - श्री सरस माधुरी जी
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
आशिक होकर इश्क कमावे,  सो प्रीतम मन भाता है।
लोक वेद की कैद दूर कर,  प्रेम देव को ध्याता है॥ [1]
रोवे हँसे मौन हो बैठे,  प्यारे के रंग राता है।
सरसमाधुरी का रस पीकर, दिलवर के गुण गाता है॥ [2]
- श्री सरस माधुरी
english_text: (Savaiya) If one earns love by being a lover, then the beloved likes it. The world removes the imprisonment of the Vedas and meditates on the God of love.. [1] Weeps, laughs and sits silent, enjoying the colors of the beloved. Drinking the juice of Sarasmadhuri, he sings the praises of Dilawar.. [2] - Shri Saras Madhuri
english_translation: (Savaiya) If one earns love by being a lover, then the beloved likes it. The world removes the imprisonment of the Vedas and meditates on the God of love.. [1] Weeps, laughs and sits silent, enjoying the colors of the beloved. Drinking the juice of Sarasmadhuri, he sings the praises of Dilawar.. [2] - Shri Saras Madhuri
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री स्वामी हरिदास के चरन कमल चित लाउ - श्री कान्त किशोर, कान्त रसिक जी की वाणी, दोहा (1)
sanskrit_text:
श्री स्वामी हरिदास के, चरन कमल चित लाउ।
कान्त रसिक रस-माधुरी, लखै न और उपाउ॥
- श्री कान्त किशोर, कान्त रसिक जी की वाणी, दोहा (1)
english_text: The lotus feet of Shri Swami Haridas. Kant Rasik Ras-Madhuri, Lakhain and Upau.. - Shri Kant Kishore, Kant Rasik ji's voice, Doha (1)
english_translation: The lotus feet of Shri Swami Haridas. Kant Rasik Ras-Madhuri, Lakhain and Upau.. - Shri Kant Kishore, Kant Rasik ji's voice, Doha (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रे चित्त मा त्यज वनं वृषभानुजाया - श्री वागीश शास्त्री जी, श्री राधासप्तशती (5.61)
sanskrit_text:
रे चित्त मा त्यज वनं वृषभानुजायाः नान्यत्र गच्छ मम याचिलमेतदेव। 
वृन्दावने त्वमिह आश्वपचान् सदैव याचत्व भक्षय तदीयसुभुक्तमुक्तम्॥
- श्री वागीश शास्त्री जी, श्री राधासप्तशती (5.61)
english_text: Re chitta ma tyaj vann vrishabhanujayah naanyatra gachch mam yachilmetdev. Vrindavane tvamih ashwapachan sadayav yachatva bhakshaya tadiyasubhuktamuktam. - Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radhasaptashati (5.61)
english_translation: Re chitta ma tyaj vann vrishabhanujayah naanyatra gachch mam yachilmetdev. Vrindavane tvamih ashwapachan sadayav yachatva bhakshaya tadiyasubhuktamuktam. - Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radhasaptashati (5.61)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नवल लाल अरु नवल किसोरी - श्री राधा प्रसाद देव जू
sanskrit_text:
(राग-विहाग)
नवल लाल अरु नवल किसोरी।
पौढे नवल निकुंज-महल में, हँसत, लसत, विलसत सुख सोरी॥ [1]
सीतल-मन्द-सुखद मलयानिल, बसननि चन्दनादि चरचोरी।
श्रीराधाप्रसाद पिय-प्यारी, सदा रहौ अविचल यह जोरी॥ [2]
- श्री राधा प्रसाद देव जू
english_text: (Raga-Vihaga) Naval Lal Aru Naval Kisori. Plants Naval Nikunj-Mahal Purush, Hansat, Lasat, Vilasat Sukh Sori.. [1] Shitala-Manda-Sukhad Malayanil, Basanani Chandanadi Charchori. Shri Radha Prasad Beloved, always remain steadfast this Jori.. [2] - Shri Radha Prasad Dev Ju
english_translation: (Raga-Vihaga) Naval Lal Aru Naval Kisori. Plants Naval Nikunj-Mahal Purush, Hansat, Lasat, Vilasat Sukh Sori.. [1] Shitala-Manda-Sukhad Malayanil, Basanani Chandanadi Charchori. Shri Radha Prasad Beloved, always remain steadfast this Jori.. [2] - Shri Radha Prasad Dev Ju
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रसना रस की खानि तू सरस मधुर प्रिय तोय - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
रसना रस की खानि तू, सरस मधुर प्रिय तोय। 
तौ पी राधा प्रेम रस, या सम मधुर न कोय॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: You are a food of rasna ki rasna, sweet and sweet toy. But Radha's love juice, there is no one as sweet as this.. - Couplets of Braj
english_translation: You are a food of rasna ki rasna, sweet and sweet toy. But Radha's love juice, there is no one as sweet as this.. - Couplets of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हम भूखे ब्रज की गारी के - श्री कृपालुजी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, सिद्धांत माधुरी (132)
sanskrit_text:
हम भूखे ब्रज की गारी के।
वारत निज बैकुण्ठ लोक-सुख, सुनि सुनि गारी 'दारी के'॥ [1] 
भाव न मो कहँ नेकहुँ अस्तुति, महावाक्य श्रुति चारी के। 
होत विभोर सुनत ब्रजनारिन, वाक्यन चोरी जारी के॥ [2]
भाव न मो कहँ चरण समर्चन, पद्मा सी घरवारी के। 
मोहिं 'कृपालु' तो चरण पलोटन, भावत भानुदुलारी के॥ [3]
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालुजी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, सिद्धांत माधुरी (132)
english_text: We are hungry for the milk of Braj. Varat Nij Vaikuntha Lok-Sukh, Suni Suni Gari 'Dari Ke'.. [1] Bhava Na Mo Kahan Nekahun Astuti, Mahavakya Shruti Chari Ke. Hot Vibhor Sunat Brajnarin, Vakyan Chhori Jari Ke.. [2] Bhaav N Mo Kahan Charan Samarchan, Padma Si Gharwari Ke. Mohin 'Kripalu' to Charan Pallotan, Bhavat Bhanudulari's.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Siddhant Madhuri (132)
english_translation: We are hungry for the milk of Braj. Varat Nij Vaikuntha Lok-Sukh, Suni Suni Gari 'Dari Ke'.. [1] Bhava Na Mo Kahan Nekahun Astuti, Mahavakya Shruti Chari Ke. Hot Vibhor Sunat Brajnarin, Vakyan Chhori Jari Ke.. [2] Bhaav N Mo Kahan Charan Samarchan, Padma Si Gharwari Ke. Mohin 'Kripalu' to Charan Pallotan, Bhavat Bhanudulari's.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Siddhant Madhuri (132)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अति अद्भुत लावण्य निधि श्री वृन्दावन चन्द - श्री ब्रजवासीदास, ब्रज विलास
sanskrit_text:
अति अद्भुत लावण्य निधि, श्री वृन्दावन चन्द।
निगम नेति किमि वरणिये, रसिक नवल नंदनन्द॥
- श्री ब्रजवासीदास, ब्रज विलास
english_text: Very amazing Lavanya Nidhi, Shri Vrindavan Chand. Nigam Neti Kimi Varaniye, Rasik Naval Nandanand.. - Shri Brajvasidas, Braj Vilas
english_translation: Very amazing Lavanya Nidhi, Shri Vrindavan Chand. Nigam Neti Kimi Varaniye, Rasik Naval Nandanand.. - Shri Brajvasidas, Braj Vilas
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मन्दीकृत्य मुकुन्द सुन्दर पदद्वन्द्वारविन्दामल, - मुरली अवतार श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु - श्री राधा सुधा निधि (142)
sanskrit_text:
मन्दीकृत्य मुकुन्द सुन्दर पदद्वन्द्वारविन्दामल,
प्रेमानन्दममन्दमिन्दु-तिलकाद्युन्माद कन्दं परम् ॥
राधा-केलि-कथा-रसाम्बुधि चलद्वीचीभिरान्दोलितं,
वृन्दारण्य निकुञ्ज मन्दिर वरालिन्दे मनो नन्दतु ॥
- मुरली अवतार श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु - श्री राधा सुधा निधि (142)
english_text: Mandikriti Mukund Sundar Padvandvarvindamal, Premanandammandamindu-tilkadyunmad kandna param.. Radha-Keli-Katha-Rasambuddhi Chaladvichibhirandolitna, Vrindaranya Nikunj Mandir Varlinde Mano Nandatu.. - Murali Avatar Sri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu - Sri Radha Sudha Nidhi (142)
english_translation: Mandikriti Mukund Sundar Padvandvarvindamal, Premanandammandamindu-tilkadyunmad kandna param.. Radha-Keli-Katha-Rasambuddhi Chaladvichibhirandolitna, Vrindaranya Nikunj Mandir Varlinde Mano Nandatu.. - Murali Avatar Sri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu - Sri Radha Sudha Nidhi (142)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीराधे रानी दे डारो बंशी मोरी - श्री मीराबाई
sanskrit_text:
श्रीराधे रानी दे डारो बंशी मोरी।
जा बंसी में मेरी प्राण बसत है, सो बंसी गई चोरी॥ [1]
काहे से गाऊँ प्यारी काहे से बजाऊँ, काहे से लाऊँ गईयाँ फेरी।
मुख से गावो कान्हा हाथों से बजाओ, लकुटी से लाओ गईयाँ घेरी॥ [2]
हा हा करत तेरे पैयाँ परत हूँ, तरस खाओ प्यारी मोरी।
मीरा के प्रभु गिरधर नागर, बंसी लेकर छोरी॥ [3]
- श्री मीराबाई
english_text: Shriradhe Rani De Daro Banshi Mori. My soul resides in the flute, so I don't play the flute, girl.. [1] Why should I play the flute, dear cow, why should I bring the cows back. Sing Kanha with your mouth, play it with your hands, bring the cows around with your lakuti.. [2] Ha ha I am singing to you, have pity on me, dear Mari. Prabhu Girdhar Nagar of Meera, girl with flute.. [3] - Shri Meerabai
english_translation: Shriradhe Rani De Daro Banshi Mori. My soul resides in the flute, so I don't play the flute, girl.. [1] Why should I play the flute, dear cow, why should I bring the cows back. Sing Kanha with your mouth, play it with your hands, bring the cows around with your lakuti.. [2] Ha ha I am singing to you, have pity on me, dear Mari. Prabhu Girdhar Nagar of Meera, girl with flute.. [3] - Shri Meerabai
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्रेम दिवाने जो भये प्रीतम के रँग माहिं  - श्री सहजो बाई
sanskrit_text:
प्रेम दिवाने जो भये, प्रीतम के रँग माहिं।
सहजो सुधि बुधि सब गई, तन की सोधी नाहिं॥
- श्री सहजो बाई
english_text: Those who are crazy about love, they love the colors of their beloved. Sahajo remembers the intellect, not the body.. - Shri Sahajo Bai
english_translation: Those who are crazy about love, they love the colors of their beloved. Sahajo remembers the intellect, not the body.. - Shri Sahajo Bai
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: गुञ्ज गरें सिर मोरपखा - श्री रसखान, रसखान रत्नावली
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
गुञ्ज गरें सिर मोरपखा अरु चाल गयंद की मो मन भावै। [1]
साँवरो नन्द कुमार सबै  ब्रजमण्डल में ब्रजराज कहावै॥ [2]
साज समाज सबै सिरताज, औ लाज की बात नहीं कही आवै। [3]
ताहि अहीर की छोहरियाँ, छछिया भरि छाछ पै नाच नचावै॥ [4]
- श्री रसखान, रसखान रत्नावली
english_text: (Savaiya) Gunj garen sir morpakha aru chal gand ki mo man bhavai. [1] Samvaro Nand Kumar, everyone is called Brajraj in Brajmandal.. [2] Everyone in the society is crowned, and there is no talk of shame. [3] Tahi Ahir's girls, chhhiya bhari chchh pai naachvai.. [4] - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnawali
english_translation: (Savaiya) Gunj garen sir morpakha aru chal gand ki mo man bhavai. [1] Samvaro Nand Kumar, everyone is called Brajraj in Brajmandal.. [2] Everyone in the society is crowned, and there is no talk of shame. [3] Tahi Ahir's girls, chhhiya bhari chchh pai naachvai.. [4] - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnawali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ग्राम-सिंह भूंस्यौ बिपिन - श्री भगवत रसिक जी की वाणी, अनन्य निश्चयात्मक ग्रंथ [पूर्वार्ध] (26)
sanskrit_text:
ग्राम-सिंह भूंस्यौ बिपिन, देखि सिंह कौ रूप।
सुन-सुनि भूसैं गलिन में, सबै स्वान बेकूप॥
- श्री भगवत रसिक जी, श्री भगवत रसिक जी की वाणी, अनन्य निश्चयात्मक ग्रंथ [पूर्वार्ध] (26)
english_text: Gram-Singh Bhunsyu Bipin, see who is the form of a lion. Sun-Suni Bhusai in the galin, everyone is silent. - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji, Speech of Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji, Other definitive texts [First half] (26)
english_translation: Gram-Singh Bhunsyu Bipin, see who is the form of a lion. Sun-Suni Bhusai in the galin, everyone is silent. - Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji, Speech of Shri Bhagwat Rasik Ji, Other definitive texts [First half] (26)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वेगि कृपाकरि कुँवरि स्वामिनी - श्री ललित माधुरी
sanskrit_text:
(राग काफी)
वेगि कृपाकरि कुँवरि स्वामिनी, वृन्दाविपिन बसावो। 
राधाकुंड निकुंज मनोहर, तहां दुऊ सचुपावो॥ [1]
प्रीति विवस रसरीति सो पूरन, नूतन नेह उपावो। 
नेक अधर मुसकाय माधुरी, मोहन चितहि चुरावो॥ [2] 
लै वीरी प्रिय करहि आपने, लालन मुखहि खवावो।
दोउ भुज मेली मुकुर निहारो, लोल कपोल मिलावो॥ [3] 
अरस परस अधरामृत पीवत, हासविलास बढ़ावो। 
‘ललितमाधुरी’ करत खवासी, यह छवि दृग दरसावो॥ [4]
- श्री ललित माधुरी
english_text: (Raga Kafi) Vegi Kripakari Kunwari Swamini, Vrindavipin Basavo. Radhakund Nikunj Manohar, Tahan Duu Sachupvo..[1] Preeti Vivaas Rasriti So Puran, Nutan Neh Upvo. Madhuri smiles with noble lips, Mohan chitahi churavo.. [2] Lai Veeri dear karhi apne, Lalan mukhahi khawavo. Dou Bhuj Meli Mukur Niharo, Lol Kapol Milavo.. [3] Aras Paras Adhraamrit Pivat, Hasvilas Badhavo. 'Lalitmadhuri' doing Khawasi, this image is visible.. [4] - Shri Lalit Madhuri
english_translation: (Raga Kafi) Vegi Kripakari Kunwari Swamini, Vrindavipin Basavo. Radhakund Nikunj Manohar, Tahan Duu Sachupvo..[1] Preeti Vivaas Rasriti So Puran, Nutan Neh Upvo. Madhuri smiles with noble lips, Mohan chitahi churavo.. [2] Lai Veeri dear karhi apne, Lalan mukhahi khawavo. Dou Bhuj Meli Mukur Niharo, Lol Kapol Milavo.. [3] Aras Paras Adhraamrit Pivat, Hasvilas Badhavo. 'Lalitmadhuri' doing Khawasi, this image is visible.. [4] - Shri Lalit Madhuri
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सुर-नर-किन्नर-उरग हू  - श्री ब्रज निधि ग्रंथावली, ब्रज शृंगार (6)
sanskrit_text:
सुर-नर-किन्नर-उरग हू, कहत रहैं यह बैन।
धन्य हमारौ भाग जौ, कहुँ पावैं ब्रज-रैन॥
- श्री ब्रज निधि जी, ब्रज निधि ग्रंथावली, ब्रज श्रृंगार (6)
english_text: I am Sura-Nara-Kinnara-Urg, I keep saying these bans. Blessed are we, we run away, where can we find Braj-rain.. - Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Shringaar (6)
english_translation: I am Sura-Nara-Kinnara-Urg, I keep saying these bans. Blessed are we, we run away, where can we find Braj-rain.. - Shri Braj Nidhi Ji, Braj Nidhi Granthawali, Braj Shringaar (6)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रस बस सुरत भई अब मोरी - श्री रूपमाधुरी जी की वाणी, पदावली (135)
sanskrit_text:
(राग तिलककामोद व मालकोश)
रस बस सुरत भई अब मोरी। 
जुगल रूप छवि नैन समाई, बंधी प्रेम की डोरी॥ [1]
रोम रोम में आनँद छायो, ये सुख कहाँ कहोरी। 
"रूपमाधुरी" मगन ध्यान में, मिली रंगीली जोरी॥ [2]
- श्री रूपमाधुरी जी, श्री रूपमाधुरी जी की वाणी, पदावली (135)
english_text: (Raaga Tilakkamod Vi Malakosha) Ras Bas Surat Bhai Ab Mori. Jugal form image, eyes entwined, tied with the string of love.. [1] Every pore of the mind is filled with joy, how can I say this happiness. "Roopmadhuri" In rapt meditation, found colorful Jori.. [2] - Shri Roopmadhuri ji, Shri Roopmadhuri ji's speech, phraseology (135)
english_translation: (Raaga Tilakkamod Vi Malakosha) Ras Bas Surat Bhai Ab Mori. Jugal form image, eyes entwined, tied with the string of love.. [1] Every pore of the mind is filled with joy, how can I say this happiness. "Roopmadhuri" In rapt meditation, found colorful Jori.. [2] - Shri Roopmadhuri ji, Shri Roopmadhuri ji's speech, phraseology (135)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तीन लोक कौ राज सुख - श्री अनन्य अलि, श्री वृंदावन वास अवस्था (2.45)
sanskrit_text:
तीन लोक कौ राज सुख, संपति सब परिवार।
छाँड़ि सबै बसि विपिन में, जहँ रस सिंधु अपार॥
- श्री अनन्य अली, श्री अनन्य अली जी की वाणी, श्री वृंदावन वास अवस्था (2.45)
english_text: Who knows the kingdom of three worlds, happiness, wealth and all the family. Chandi Sabai Basi Vipin Purush, Jahan Ras Sindhu Apar.. - Shri Ananya Ali, Speech of Shri Ananya Ali Ji, Shri Vrindavan Vas Avastha (2.45)
english_translation: Who knows the kingdom of three worlds, happiness, wealth and all the family. Chandi Sabai Basi Vipin Purush, Jahan Ras Sindhu Apar.. - Shri Ananya Ali, Speech of Shri Ananya Ali Ji, Shri Vrindavan Vas Avastha (2.45)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री वृन्दावन रानी साहिबनी - श्री वंशी अलि, सिद्धांत के पद (14)
sanskrit_text:
श्री वृन्दावन रानी साहिबनी।
स्वामिनी चरन कमल की सेवा, हमको भली ठनी॥ [1]
ललितादिक सखियन सों मित्रता, हौंहू तो या पात गनी।
जुगल रसिक रस जय श्री बंसीअलि, जानत क्योंहू ना मुख जात भनी॥ [2]
- श्री वंशी अलि, सिद्धांत के पद (14)
english_text: Sri Vrindavan Rani Sahibani. Serving the lotus feet of my wife is a good place for us.. [1] Lalitadik friends, son friendship, hounhu to ya pat gani. Jugal Rasik Ras Jai Shri Bansali, Janat Kyunhu Na Mukh Jaat Bhani.. [2] - Shri Vanshi Ali, Verses of Siddhant (14)
english_translation: Sri Vrindavan Rani Sahibani. Serving the lotus feet of my wife is a good place for us.. [1] Lalitadik friends, son friendship, hounhu to ya pat gani. Jugal Rasik Ras Jai Shri Bansali, Janat Kyunhu Na Mukh Jaat Bhani.. [2] - Shri Vanshi Ali, Verses of Siddhant (14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: संकर्षण-प्रिय-अनुज की, प्रिया प्राण आधार - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
संकर्षण-प्रिय-अनुज की, प्रिया प्राण आधार।
वरद पाद अम्भोज पर, रहौं सतत बलिहार॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: Sankarshan-Priya-Anuj's, Priya Pran Adhar. On the occasion of Varad Pad Ambhoj, may I remain a constant sacrifice. - Couplets of Braj
english_translation: Sankarshan-Priya-Anuj's, Priya Pran Adhar. On the occasion of Varad Pad Ambhoj, may I remain a constant sacrifice. - Couplets of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री वल्लभ वल्लभ कहौ - श्री भारतेंदु हरिशचंद्र, भारतेंदु ग्रंथावली, भक्त सर्वस्व (21)
sanskrit_text:
श्री वल्लभ वल्लभ कहौ, छाँड़िं उपाय अनेक।
जानि आपनौ राखि हैं, दीन बंधु की टेक॥ 
- श्री भारतेंदु हरिशचंद्र, भारतेंदु ग्रंथावली, भक्त सर्वस्व (21)
english_text: Say Shri Vallabh Vallabh, there are many rhymes and solutions. Know your own Rakhi, the support of your humble friend.. - Shri Bharatendu Harishchandra, Bharatendu Granthawali, Devotee of all (21)
english_translation: Say Shri Vallabh Vallabh, there are many rhymes and solutions. Know your own Rakhi, the support of your humble friend.. - Shri Bharatendu Harishchandra, Bharatendu Granthawali, Devotee of all (21)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कब मेरे मनमहँ बसै वृन्दावन वर धाम - श्रीप्रभुदत्तजी ब्रह्मचारी, श्रीवृन्दावन माहात्म्य (1)
sanskrit_text:
कब मेरे मनमहँ बसै, वृन्दावन वर धाम । 
कब रसना निशि दिन रटै, सुख तैं श्यामा श्याम॥
- श्रीप्रभुदत्तजी ब्रह्मचारी, श्रीवृन्दावन माहात्म्य (1)
english_text: When did Vrindavan reside in my mind? When Rasna Nishi Din Ratai, Sukh Tain Shyam Shyam.. - Shri Prabhudattji Brahmachari, Shri Vrindavan Mahatmya (1)
english_translation: When did Vrindavan reside in my mind? When Rasna Nishi Din Ratai, Sukh Tain Shyam Shyam.. - Shri Prabhudattji Brahmachari, Shri Vrindavan Mahatmya (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सकल भजन के माहिं है - श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, भजन शत (60)
sanskrit_text:
सकल भजन के माहिं है, हित-ध्रुव यह रस सार।
नवल-किसोर सु नव-कुँवरी, करत हैं विपिन-विहार॥
 - श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, भजन शत (60)
english_text: This is the essence of gross bhajan, the pole of interest is the essence of this essence. Nawala-kishore su new-virgin, do Vipina-Vihar.. - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Bhajan Shat (60)
english_translation: This is the essence of gross bhajan, the pole of interest is the essence of this essence. Nawala-kishore su new-virgin, do Vipina-Vihar.. - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Bhajan Shat (60)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सखि! सुन सुधि आवत वा ब्रज की - श्री द्वारकेश जी
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहाग)
सखि! सुन सुधि आवत वा ब्रज की।
जहां निकट हरिदासवर्य के, रही तलहटी रज की॥ [1]
रहसि बिहार नित्य नूतन रस, केली कला मदगज की।
‘द्वारकेश’ हों रहों निकट यह, अरज सुनो निर्लज की॥ [2]
- श्री द्वारकेश जी
english_text: (Raaga Vihaga) Friend! Listen, the memories of Braj come back. Where Haridaswari is near, the foothills are of the kingdom.. [1] Rahasi Bihar is a place of daily new juice, the art of Madgaj. 'Dwarkesh' I am coming near you, please listen to the shameless one.. [2] - Shri Dwarkesh ji
english_translation: (Raaga Vihaga) Friend! Listen, the memories of Braj come back. Where Haridaswari is near, the foothills are of the kingdom.. [1] Rahasi Bihar is a place of daily new juice, the art of Madgaj. 'Dwarkesh' I am coming near you, please listen to the shameless one.. [2] - Shri Dwarkesh ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: चातिक चुहल चहुँ ओर चाहै स्वाति - घनानंद ग्रंथावली, सुजान हित (187)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
चातिक चुहल चहुँ ओर चाहै स्वाति ही कों,
सूरे पन-पूरे जिन्हें बिष सम अमी है। [1]
प्रफुलित होत भान के उदोत कंज-पुंज,
ता बिन बिचारनि ही जोति-जाल तमी है। [2]
चाहौ अनचाहौ जान प्यारे पै अनंदघन,
प्रीति-रीति बिषम सु रोम रोम रमी है। [3]
मोहिं तुम एक, तुम्हें मो सम अनेक आहिं,
कहा कछू चंदहिं चकोरन की कमी है॥ [4]
- श्री घनानंद जी, घनानंद ग्रंथावली, सुजान हित (187)
english_text: (Poem) Chatik Chuhal Chahoon or Chahai Swati Hi Koon, Sure Pana-Shuddh who is like poison like ami. [1] The spring of blossoming consciousness, without spreading it, is the source of light and water. [2] Wanted and unwanted, beloved people are happy, Preeti-reeti Bisham su rom rom rami hai. [3] Mohin, you are one, you are equal to me, there are many, where there is no shortage of some chakoran.. [4] - Shri Ghananand Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Sujan Hit (187)
english_translation: (Poem) Chatik Chuhal Chahoon or Chahai Swati Hi Koon, Sure Pana-Shuddh who is like poison like ami. [1] The spring of blossoming consciousness, without spreading it, is the source of light and water. [2] Wanted and unwanted, beloved people are happy, Preeti-reeti Bisham su rom rom rami hai. [3] Mohin, you are one, you are equal to me, there are many, where there is no shortage of some chakoran.. [4] - Shri Ghananand Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Sujan Hit (187)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्रीतम मोहि प्रानन हूँ तें प्यारौ  - श्री हित कमलनैन, श्री हित कमलनैन जी की वाणी, अष्टायामी पदावली (110)
sanskrit_text:
प्रीतम मोहि प्रानन हूँ तें प्यारौ।
निसिदिन उर लगायें रहौं हित सौं, 
नैंक न करिहौं न्यारौ॥ [1]
देखत जाय परम सुख उपजत, 
रूप-रंग-गुन गारौ। 
जै श्रीकमलनैंन हित सुनि प्रिय बैंननि,
तन-मन-धन सब वारौ॥ [2]
- श्री हित कमलनैन, श्री हित कमलनैन जी की वाणी, अष्टायामी पदावली (110)
english_text: I love you dearly. Always keep your mind focused on your interests, don't ignore my eyes.. [1] Seeing Jai, ultimate happiness arises, look, beauty and qualities. Jai Shri Kamalnain Hit Suni Priya Bainnani, body, mind and wealth are all good.. [2] - Shri Hit Kamalnain, speech of Shri Hit Kamalnain ji, Ashtyami Padavali (110)
english_translation: I love you dearly. Always keep your mind focused on your interests, don't ignore my eyes.. [1] Seeing Jai, ultimate happiness arises, look, beauty and qualities. Jai Shri Kamalnain Hit Suni Priya Bainnani, body, mind and wealth are all good.. [2] - Shri Hit Kamalnain, speech of Shri Hit Kamalnain ji, Ashtyami Padavali (110)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: क्षीर सारमपहृत्य शंकया - श्रीकृष्ण सूक्ति
sanskrit_text:
क्षीर सारमपहृत्य शंकया स्वीकृतं यदि पलायनं त्वया।
मानसे मम नितान्ततामसे नन्दनन्दन कथं न लीयसे॥
- श्रीकृष्ण सूक्ति
english_text: Kshir sarmapahriti shankaya svikritam agar palayanna tvaya. Manse mam nitanttamse nandanandan kathan na liyase.. - Shri Krishna Sukti
english_translation: Kshir sarmapahriti shankaya svikritam agar palayanna tvaya. Manse mam nitanttamse nandanandan kathan na liyase.. - Shri Krishna Sukti
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मेरौ लाल स्यामा रंग भीनौं - श्री ठाकुर दास जी
sanskrit_text:
मेरौ लाल स्यामा रंग भीनौं।
बोलत नाँहिं प्रिया तू मुख तें, कै काहू कछु कीनौं॥ [1]
मैं प्यारी तेरे चरननि लोटूँ, तिहिं मोल मोहिं लीनौं।
ठाकुर सखी रीझि हँसि प्रिया, स्याम अंक भरि लीनौं॥ [2]
- श्री ठाकुर दास, श्री ठाकुर दास जी की वाणी, पद (2)
english_text: My red syama complexion bhinoun. She says, little darling, why should I open my mouth? [1] I dear, I will return to your feet, I will fall in love with you only. Thakur Sakhi Rizhi Hansi Priya, Syam Ank Bhari Linaun.. [2] - Shri Thakur Das, Shri Thakur Das Ji's speech, verse (2)
english_translation: My red syama complexion bhinoun. She says, little darling, why should I open my mouth? [1] I dear, I will return to your feet, I will fall in love with you only. Thakur Sakhi Rizhi Hansi Priya, Syam Ank Bhari Linaun.. [2] - Shri Thakur Das, Shri Thakur Das Ji's speech, verse (2)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जयति जयति राधा प्रेमसारैरगाधा - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.45)
sanskrit_text:
जयति जयति राधा प्रेमसारैरगाधा, जयति जयति कृष्णस्तद्भसापारतृष्णः।
जयति जयति वृन्दं सत्सखीनां द्वयैक्यं, जयति जयति वृन्दाकाननं तत्स्वधाम॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (9.45)
english_text: Jayati Jayati Radha Premasarairagadha, Jayati Jayati Krishnastadbhasparatrishna. Jayati Jayati Vrindana Satskhinam Dwayayikin, Jayati Jayati Vrindakananna Tatsavadam.. - Sri Prabodhananda Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.45)
english_translation: Jayati Jayati Radha Premasarairagadha, Jayati Jayati Krishnastadbhasparatrishna. Jayati Jayati Vrindana Satskhinam Dwayayikin, Jayati Jayati Vrindakananna Tatsavadam.. - Sri Prabodhananda Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (9.45)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बस गये नैनन माँहि बिहारी  - रूप कुँवरि जी
sanskrit_text:
(राग हमीर ताल तिताला)
बस गये नैनन माँहि बिहारी॥ 
देखी जबसे श्यामलि मूरति, टरत न छबि दृग टारी। 
मोर मुकुट मकराकृत कुंडल, बाम अंग श्री प्यारी॥ [1]
प्रेम भक्ति दीजै मुहि स्वामी, अपनी ओर निहारी। 
रूपकुंवरि रानी के साधहु, कारज सकल मुरारी॥ [2]
- रूप कुँवरि जी
english_text: (Rag Hamir Taal Titala) Nainan Manhi Bihari has settled..Dekhi Jabse Shyamali Murati, Tarat Na Chhabi Drig Tari. Peacock crown, Capricorn ring, bomb body, Shri Pyari.. [1] Prem bhakti dijai muhi swami, apani ya nihari. Sadhu of Queen Roop Kunwari, Karj Sakal Murari.. [2] - Roop Kunwari Ji
english_translation: (Rag Hamir Taal Titala) Nainan Manhi Bihari has settled..Dekhi Jabse Shyamali Murati, Tarat Na Chhabi Drig Tari. Peacock crown, Capricorn ring, bomb body, Shri Pyari.. [1] Prem bhakti dijai muhi swami, apani ya nihari. Sadhu of Queen Roop Kunwari, Karj Sakal Murari.. [2] - Roop Kunwari Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्रेम मगन जे साधवा विचरत रहत निसंक - श्री दयाबाई
sanskrit_text:
प्रेम मगन जे साधवा, विचरत रहत निसंक।
हरि रस के माते ‘दया’, गिनैं राव न रंक॥
- श्री दयाबाई
english_text: Sadhva who is engrossed in love, keeps thinking without fear. 'Mercy' in the words of Hari Rasa, Ginain Rav Na Ranka.. - Shri Dayabai
english_translation: Sadhva who is engrossed in love, keeps thinking without fear. 'Mercy' in the words of Hari Rasa, Ginain Rav Na Ranka.. - Shri Dayabai
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जब दांत न थे तब दूध दियो - ब्रज के सवैया
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
जब दांत न थे तब दूध दियो,  दांत दिये तो कों अन्न हू देहै। [1]
जल में थल में पशु पक्षिन में,  सबकी सुधि लेत वो तेरी हू लैहै॥ [2] 
जान को देत अजान को देत,  जहान को देत वे तोकों भी दैहै। [3]
रे मनमूरख सोच करै क्यूं,  सोच करे कछू हाथ न ऐहै॥ [4]
- ब्रज के सवैया
english_text: (Sawaiya) When I had my teeth, I gave them milk, when I gave them my teeth, who was there? [1] Water, mind, land, animals, birds, men, taking care of everyone, he is yours.. [2] Giving to people, giving to Azaan, wherever he gives, he has also given tokens. [3] O fool, why should you think, why should you think that nothing has come to your hands.. [4] - Savaiya of Braj.
english_translation: (Sawaiya) When I had my teeth, I gave them milk, when I gave them my teeth, who was there? [1] Water, mind, land, animals, birds, men, taking care of everyone, he is yours.. [2] Giving to people, giving to Azaan, wherever he gives, he has also given tokens. [3] O fool, why should you think, why should you think that nothing has come to your hands.. [4] - Savaiya of Braj.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जिनको मन निज वश भयो - श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (65)
sanskrit_text:
जिनको मन निज वश भयो, तजकर विषै विलास।
नारायण ते घर रहैं, चहें करैं वनवास॥
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (65)
english_text: Those whose mind has come under their own control, are freed from poisonous luxury. Stay at home with Narayan, even if you go to exile.. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (65)
english_translation: Those whose mind has come under their own control, are freed from poisonous luxury. Stay at home with Narayan, even if you go to exile.. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (65)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारी जू तैं मोहि मोल लियो - श्री रसिक देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (15)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहागरौ)
प्यारी जू तैं मोहि मोल लियो ।
तेरी कृपा मदन दल जीत्यौ, तेरो जिवायो जियो॥ [1]
उमडी सैन महा मनमथ की, तैं अंधरामृत दियो ।
श्रीरसिकबिहारी कहत दीन ह्वै, धनि स्यामा को हियो॥ [2]
- श्री रसिक देव जी, श्री रसिक देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (15)
english_text: (Rag Vihagarau) Dear you, you have bought my love. By your grace Madan Dal wins, your creatures live.. [1] Umadi Sain of Maha Manmath, you gave Andhramrit. Shri Rasika Bihari says, 'Dhani Shyama Ko Hayo..'
english_translation: (Rag Vihagarau) Dear you, you have bought my love. By your grace Madan Dal wins, your creatures live.. [1] Umadi Sain of Maha Manmath, you gave Andhramrit. Shri Rasika Bihari says, 'Dhani Shyama Ko Hayo..'
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रक्षा करी न जीव की दियो न आदर दान - श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (137)
sanskrit_text:
नारायण घाटी कठिन, जहां नेह को धाम।
बिकल मूर्च्छा सिसकिबौ, यह मग में विश्राम॥
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (137)
english_text: Narayan Valley Kathin, where Neh Ko Dham. Bikal Murchch Sisakibau, Yah Mag Me Resting.. - Sri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (137)
english_translation: Narayan Valley Kathin, where Neh Ko Dham. Bikal Murchch Sisakibau, Yah Mag Me Resting.. - Sri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (137)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ललित लतान पर नन्हीं नन्हीं बूँद परें - गोस्वामी श्री हरिराय जी
sanskrit_text:
ललित लतान पर नन्हीं नन्हीं बूँद परें 
भींजत रंगीले दोऊ प्रीतम प्यारी। [1]
हँसि हँसि बात करें भुज मूल धरें 
लाग्यो पीत पट तन सुरंग कसूँभी सारी॥ [2] 
बिंब बदन पर रही कछु फुहीं फबि 
उपमा न जात कछु जियमे बिचारी। [3]
‘रसिक’ उभय उदार गावत राग मल्हार 
हित दे सुनि तान देत प्राण वारी॥ [4]
- गोस्वामी श्री हरिराय जी
english_text: Tiny drops of rain on the beautiful vines, beautiful and colorful ones. [1]. [3] 'Rasika' Ubhay Udhaar Gavat Raga Malhar Hit De Suni Tan Deet Praan Vaari.. [4] - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji
english_translation: Tiny drops of rain on the beautiful vines, beautiful and colorful ones. [1]. [3] 'Rasika' Ubhay Udhaar Gavat Raga Malhar Hit De Suni Tan Deet Praan Vaari.. [4] - Goswami Shri Harirai Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आज वन उमगि रही - श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
sanskrit_text:
(राग मल्हार)
आज वन उमगि रही वृजनारी।
फूली फिरत निशंक गुन गावत, झूलत प्रान पियारी॥ [1]
एक कुसुम लाई डारत ऊपर, एक चितनत रही ठाड़ो। 
एक जो आय धाय मोहन पर, अन्क भरत है गाढी॥ [2]
नील पीत अंग-अंग विराजत, और श्रृंगार सिंगरे। 
'सूर' संग विलसत है भामिनि, नेकहु होत न न्यारै॥ [3] 
- श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
english_text: (Raag Malhara) Aaj van umagi rahi vrajnari. The song is full of fearless songs, the swinging life of my beloved.. [1] One flower carries the fear above, the other one remains worried. The one who is on O Dhay Mohan, number is India's garden.. [2] The blue heart is present in every part, and adorns it with makeup. Bhamini, there is luxury with 'Sur', Nekahu Hot Na Nyarai.. [3] - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar
english_translation: (Raag Malhara) Aaj van umagi rahi vrajnari. The song is full of fearless songs, the swinging life of my beloved.. [1] One flower carries the fear above, the other one remains worried. The one who is on O Dhay Mohan, number is India's garden.. [2] The blue heart is present in every part, and adorns it with makeup. Bhamini, there is luxury with 'Sur', Nekahu Hot Na Nyarai.. [3] - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारी तेरे नैना री अति बांके, ललित त्रिभंगी बिहारी नागर - श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जू की वाणी (25)
sanskrit_text:
प्यारी तेरे नैना री अति बांके,
ललित त्रिभंगी बिहारी नागर, तैं अपने करि आंके 
- श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जू की वाणी (25)

श्री राधिका, आपकी आंखें वास्तव में तिरछी हैं जो अमृत से भरी हैं। श्री ललित त्रिभंगी  (जो तीन स्थानों नेत्र ,गर्दन और कमर पर मुड़ी हुई है और झुकी हुई है) बिहारी जी उन्हें (श्री राधा) अपने अंक में किया हुआ है।
english_text: Pyaari tere naina ri ati banke, lalit tribhangi bihari nagar, tain apne kari aneke - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vaani (25) Shri Radhika, your eyes are indeed slanted which are full of nectar. Shri Lalit Tribhangi (which is folded and bent at three places - eyes, garden and waist) Bihari ji has included him (Shri Radha) in his number.
english_translation: Pyaari tere naina ri ati banke, lalit tribhangi bihari nagar, tain apne kari aneke - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vaani (25) Shri Radhika, your eyes are indeed slanted which are full of nectar. Shri Lalit Tribhangi (which is folded and bent at three places - eyes, garden and waist) Bihari ji has included him (Shri Radha) in his number.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: व्यासहि बॉमन जिनि गनौं हरिभक्तन कौ दास - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (14)
sanskrit_text:
व्यासहि बॉमन जिनि गनौं, हरिभक्तन कौ दास।
(श्री) राधावल्लभ कारनैं, सह्यौ जगत उपहास॥
- श्री हरिराम व्यास,  व्यास वाणी, साखी (14)
english_text: Vyasahi Boman Jini Ganaun, Haribhaktan Ko Das. (Shri) Radhavallabh Karanain, Sahyayu Jagat Uphaas.. - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Sakhi (14)
english_translation: Vyasahi Boman Jini Ganaun, Haribhaktan Ko Das. (Shri) Radhavallabh Karanain, Sahyayu Jagat Uphaas.. - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Sakhi (14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कमल से लोइन ललित अति शोभा देत - श्री माधुरी दास, वंशीवट माधुरी (273)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
कमल से लोइन ललित अति शोभा देत, 
कुंवर के संग तौ विराजें कोटि कामिनी। [1]
अपने अपने कर जोर जुरि ठाड़ी भई, 
चहुँ ओर मानों घन घेरो आय दामिनी॥ [2]
रूप गुन गान रस एक एक ते सरस,
निर्तन सकल नाना भाइन सों भामिनी। [3]
रस सीम रास सीम परम विलास सीम,
राजे रास मंडल में माधुरी की स्वामिनी॥ [4]
- श्री माधुरी दास, वंशीवट माधुरी (273)
english_text: (Poem) The loin of a lotus is very beautiful, you sit with the virgin, many women. [1] Apne apne kar joor jeuri thadai brother, whether I want it or not, I am surrounded by a cube, Aayi Damini.. [2] Roop guna gan rasa ek ek te saras, niratan sakal nana bhain putra bhamini. [3] Ras Sim Ras Sim Param Vilas Sim, Madhuri's mistress in Raje Ras Mandal.. [4] - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (273)
english_translation: (Poem) The loin of a lotus is very beautiful, you sit with the virgin, many women. [1] Apne apne kar joor jeuri thadai brother, whether I want it or not, I am surrounded by a cube, Aayi Damini.. [2] Roop guna gan rasa ek ek te saras, niratan sakal nana bhain putra bhamini. [3] Ras Sim Ras Sim Param Vilas Sim, Madhuri's mistress in Raje Ras Mandal.. [4] - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (273)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जेतो अन्तर वास में तेतो जानि उपास - श्री बिहारिन देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (603)
sanskrit_text:
जेतो अन्तर बास में, तेतौ जानि उपास।
श्रीबिहारीदास कछु साँच है, कछु कछु लोभ लिबास॥
- श्री बिहारिन देव जी, श्री बिहारिन देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (603)
english_text: Jeto antar bus main, tetau jani upas. Sri Biharidas, some are molds, some are greedy clothes.. - Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji's speech, friend of Siddhant (603)
english_translation: Jeto antar bus main, tetau jani upas. Sri Biharidas, some are molds, some are greedy clothes.. - Shri Biharin Dev Ji, Shri Biharin Dev Ji's speech, friend of Siddhant (603)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्याम हौं कब ह्वै हौं ब्रज धूरि - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, दैन्य माधुरी (88)
sanskrit_text:
श्याम हौं कब ह्वै हौं ब्रज धूरि,
ह्वै ब्रज धूरि अंग लपटै हौं, उर आनंद भर पूरी । जेहि ब्रज रज कहँ रसिकन मानत, प्राण संजीवनी मूरि॥ 
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, दैन्य माधुरी (88)
english_text: When I am Shyam, I am Braj Dhuri, I am Braj Dhuri, I am wrapped around my body, I am full of joy. Jehi Braj Raj Kahan Rasikan Maanat, Praan Sanjivani Muri.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Daily Madhuri (88)
english_translation: When I am Shyam, I am Braj Dhuri, I am Braj Dhuri, I am wrapped around my body, I am full of joy. Jehi Braj Raj Kahan Rasikan Maanat, Praan Sanjivani Muri.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Daily Madhuri (88)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मेरी स्वामिनि ललित किसोरी - श्री किशोरी अलि
sanskrit_text:
(राग मलार)
मेरी स्वामिनि ललित किसोरी।
प्रीतम-संग कुंज के आँगन, बिहरत बॉहनि जोरी॥ [1]
हिय हरखत निरखत बन-सोभा, पावस रितु पिय-गोरी। 
अद्भुत छबि दंपत्ति-संपति की, लखि अलिगन तृन तोरी॥ [2]
- श्री किशोरी अलि
english_text: (Raaga Malara) My mistress Lalit Kisori. The courtyard of the garden with Preetam, Biharat Bohni Jori.. [1] Hi Harkhat Nirkhat Bana-Sobha, Pavas Ritu Piya-Gori. Amazing image of a rich man, Lakhi Aligan Trin Tori.. [2] - Shri Kishori Ali
english_translation: (Raaga Malara) My mistress Lalit Kisori. The courtyard of the garden with Preetam, Biharat Bohni Jori.. [1] Hi Harkhat Nirkhat Bana-Sobha, Pavas Ritu Piya-Gori. Amazing image of a rich man, Lakhi Aligan Trin Tori.. [2] - Shri Kishori Ali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: गहवर बन अरु साँकरी, गलियन लीला होय - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
गहवर बन अरु साँकरी, गलियन लीला होय।
तब ही अनुभव होत जब, भाव सरस हिय पोय॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: The pits become narrow and the streets become leela. Experience is felt only when the feeling is sweet.. - Couplets of Braj
english_translation: The pits become narrow and the streets become leela. Experience is felt only when the feeling is sweet.. - Couplets of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारी जू तिहारे पद पंकज की बलिहारी - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, विप्रलब्धा (9)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
प्यारी जू तिहारे पद पंकज की बलिहारी,
सदाँ ही बिहारी लाल मन ते न टारै हैं। [1]
वे हरत कुसुम पराग तबै लागैं जबै हेर,
अलबेले पीत पट की सों झारै हैं॥ [2]
जावक बनाय चित्र सुखमा विचित्र हेर,
लूटत मयूर पिच्छ प्रान धन वारै हैं। [3]
हित ध्रुव रस यह सबन तें दुर्लभ है,
रसिक सु ‘बलबीर’ दासी उर धारै हैं॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, विप्रलब्धा (9)
english_text: (Poem) Pyari Ju Tihare Pad Pankaj's Balihari, Sadan Hi Bihari Lal Man Te Na Tarai Hai. [1]. [3] Hit Dhruva Rasa, this Saban Das is rare, Rasik Su 'Balbeera' Dasi Ur Dharai Hain.. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Vipralabdha (9)
english_translation: (Poem) Pyari Ju Tihare Pad Pankaj's Balihari, Sadan Hi Bihari Lal Man Te Na Tarai Hai. [1]. [3] Hit Dhruva Rasa, this Saban Das is rare, Rasik Su 'Balbeera' Dasi Ur Dharai Hain.. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Vipralabdha (9)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जाकौ गति चाहत दियौ लेत अगति तैं राखि- श्री रसनिधि
sanskrit_text:
जाकौ गति चाहत दियौ, लेत अगति तैं राखि।
रसनिधि हैं या बात के, भक्त भागवत साखि॥
- श्री रसनिधि
english_text: When you want speed, you keep moving forward. Is it Rasanidhi or talk, devotee Bhagwat Sakhi.. - Shri Rasanidhi
english_translation: When you want speed, you keep moving forward. Is it Rasanidhi or talk, devotee Bhagwat Sakhi.. - Shri Rasanidhi
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जिनके श्रीहरिवंश सहायक - श्री नेह नागरी दास जी की वाणी
sanskrit_text:
जिनके श्रीहरिवंश सहायक।
तेई सजन भजन अधिकारी 
वृन्दावन घन बसिवे लायक॥ [1]
अलक लड़े आनन्द भरे डोलें
सिर पर व्याससुवन सुखदायक। 
कुंवरि कुंवर जाहि सुलभ नागरिदास 
रसिक शिरोमनि के गुनगायक॥ [2]
- श्री नेह नागरी दास, श्री नेह नागरी दास जी की वाणी
english_text: Whose Shri Harivansh is assistant. Tie Sajan Bhajan Adhikari Vrindavan Ghan Basiv Layak.. [1] Alak Lade Anand Bheere Dole, Vyas Suvan Soothing on the head. Kunwari Kunwar Jahi Sulabh Nagridas is the praiser of Rasik Shiromani.. [2] - Shri Neh Nagri Das, speech of Shri Neh Nagri Das Ji
english_translation: Whose Shri Harivansh is assistant. Tie Sajan Bhajan Adhikari Vrindavan Ghan Basiv Layak.. [1] Alak Lade Anand Bheere Dole, Vyas Suvan Soothing on the head. Kunwari Kunwar Jahi Sulabh Nagridas is the praiser of Rasik Shiromani.. [2] - Shri Neh Nagri Das, speech of Shri Neh Nagri Das Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नैंना प्रगट करत पिय प्रेमैं  - श्री विट्ठल विपुल देव जू की बानी (24)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
नैंना प्रगट करत पिय प्रेमैं।
झूठें हीं ऊतर कत ठानति, 
छाँड़ि मान के नेमैं॥ [1]
कोप कपट कौ अधर कंप सखी,
अति हुलास हृदै मैं।
श्रीबीठलविपुल बिहारी नग बर,
जटित सु तुव तन हेमैं॥ [2]
- श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, श्री विट्ठल विपुल देव जू की बानी (24)
english_text: (Raaga Saranga) Naina pragat karat piya preman. Lies have not come to an end, poetry is the love of the mind. [1] Anger and deceit are at the mercy of everything, there is great joy in my heart. Shrivitthalvipul bihari nag bar, jatit su tuv tan heman.. [2] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Bani (24)
english_translation: (Raaga Saranga) Naina pragat karat piya preman. Lies have not come to an end, poetry is the love of the mind. [1] Anger and deceit are at the mercy of everything, there is great joy in my heart. Shrivitthalvipul bihari nag bar, jatit su tuv tan heman.. [2] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Bani (24)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जुगल बिहारी विरह में - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय श्रृंगार शतक (98)
sanskrit_text:
जुगल बिहारी विरह में, नाहिंन अब अवकास।
ललितकिशोरी दीजिये, श्रीवृन्दाबन वास॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय श्रृंगार शतक (98)
english_text: Jugal Bihari is a separated man, now there is no space. Give Lalit Kishori, Sri Vrindaban Vas.. - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Centuries (98)
english_translation: Jugal Bihari is a separated man, now there is no space. Give Lalit Kishori, Sri Vrindaban Vas.. - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay Shringar Centuries (98)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कल कुण्डल केकी किरीट लसै - डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
कल कुण्डल केकी किरीट लसै, 
कल कुञ्जित केश सँवारी की जय-जय। [1]
मुख देखत ही दुख दूर भये, 
मुसिकान मनोहर धारी की जय-जय॥ [2]
जय हो कमला-कुच कुंकुम की, 
जय केशव कुंज बिहारी की जय-जय। [3]
जग पूषण कृष्ण मुरारी की जै, 
ब्रज भूषण बाँके बिहारी की जय-जय॥ [4]
- डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’
english_text: (Savaiya) Yesterday, the crown of the earring was braided, tomorrow is the victory of combing the hair. [1] May sorrow go away just by looking at her face, Jai to the beautiful and beautiful lady.. [2] Jai to Kamla-Kuch Kumkum, Jai to Keshav Kunj Bihari. [3] Jag Pushan Krishna Murari ki Jai, Braj Bhushan Banke Bihari ki Jai-Jai.. [4] - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnananda Saraswati 'Hare Krishna'
english_translation: (Savaiya) Yesterday, the crown of the earring was braided, tomorrow is the victory of combing the hair. [1] May sorrow go away just by looking at her face, Jai to the beautiful and beautiful lady.. [2] Jai to Kamla-Kuch Kumkum, Jai to Keshav Kunj Bihari. [3] Jag Pushan Krishna Murari ki Jai, Braj Bhushan Banke Bihari ki Jai-Jai.. [4] - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnananda Saraswati 'Hare Krishna'
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अति नागरि वृषभानु किसोरी - श्री हरिवंश महाप्रभु - हित चतुरासी (43)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
अति नागरि वृषभानु किसोरी।
सुनि दूतिका चपल मृगनैंनी, आकरषत चितवत चित गोरी॥ 
श्रीफ़ल उरज कंचन सी देही, कटि केहरि गुन सिंधु झकोरी। 
बैंनी भुजंग चंद्र सत वदनी, कदलि जंघ जलचर गति चोरी॥
सुनि ‘हरिवंश’ आजु रजनी मुख , बन मिलाइ मेरी निज जोरी। 
यद्पि मान समेत भामिनी , सुनि कत रहत भली जिय भोरी॥
श्री हरिवंश महाप्रभु - हित चतुरासी (43)
english_text: (Raaga Saranga) Ati Nagari Vrishabhanu Kisori. Suni Dutika Chapal Mriganaini, Akashat Chitawat Chit Gori.. Quince, Uraj Kanchan like body, Kati Kehari Gun Sindhu Jhakori. Baini Bhujang Chandra Sat Vadani, Kadali Jangh Jalchar Gati Chhori.. Listen 'Harivansh' Aju Rajni Mukh, become my personal Jori. Even though the mind is collected, Bhamini, listen to her, live well Bhori.. Shri Harivansh Mahaprabhu - Hit Chatursi (43)
english_translation: (Raaga Saranga) Ati Nagari Vrishabhanu Kisori. Suni Dutika Chapal Mriganaini, Akashat Chitawat Chit Gori.. Quince, Uraj Kanchan like body, Kati Kehari Gun Sindhu Jhakori. Baini Bhujang Chandra Sat Vadani, Kadali Jangh Jalchar Gati Chhori.. Listen 'Harivansh' Aju Rajni Mukh, become my personal Jori. Even though the mind is collected, Bhamini, listen to her, live well Bhori.. Shri Harivansh Mahaprabhu - Hit Chatursi (43)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन निज धाम में, इक रस युगल विलास - श्री बेगमदास (शुक संप्रदाय के रसिक भक्त)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन निज धाम में, इक रस युगल विलास।
सखीभाव बिन काहुँ की, गम नहिं ‘बेगमदास’॥
- श्री बेगमदास (शुक संप्रदाय के रसिक भक्त)
english_text: Vrindavan is one's own abode, one's own pleasure and couple's luxury. Friendship without words, not sorrow 'Begamdas'.. - Shri Begamdas (Rasik devotee of Shuka sect)
english_translation: Vrindavan is one's own abode, one's own pleasure and couple's luxury. Friendship without words, not sorrow 'Begamdas'.. - Shri Begamdas (Rasik devotee of Shuka sect)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अति अलवेली भाँति सौं लई मुरलिका हाथ  - श्री वंशी अलि, श्री राधिका महारास, दोहा (5)
sanskrit_text:
अति अलवेली भाँति सौं, लई मुरलिका हाथ। 
थिर चर सब वृन्दा विपिन, किये सबनि मन साथ॥
- श्री वंशी अलि, श्री राधिका महारास, दोहा (5)
english_text: Hundred like a very Alveli, with Muralika's hand. Tire four sab Vrinda Vipin, Kiye sabni man saath.. - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radhika Maharas, Doha (5)
english_translation: Hundred like a very Alveli, with Muralika's hand. Tire four sab Vrinda Vipin, Kiye sabni man saath.. - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Radhika Maharas, Doha (5)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: पिय प्यारी को विहरिवो - श्री माधुरी दास, वंशीवट माधुरी (298)
sanskrit_text:
पिय प्यारी को विहरिवो, राखी हीय दुराय।
छिन छिन रोकत अधिक तऊँ, निकसि निकसि मुख जाय॥     
- श्री माधुरी दास, वंशीवट माधुरी (298)
english_text: Love your beloved, keep him safe. Chhin Chhin Rokat Adhik Taun, Niksi Niksi Mukh Jai.. - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (298)
english_translation: Love your beloved, keep him safe. Chhin Chhin Rokat Adhik Taun, Niksi Niksi Mukh Jai.. - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (298)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: या रस के तभी अधिकारी, कृपा करे जब राधा प्यारी | -श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, रसानंद [7]
sanskrit_text:
"या रस के तभी अधिकारी, कृपा करे जब राधा प्यारी ।"
-श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, रसानंद [7]

नित्य विहार रुपी दुर्लभ रस में तभी कोई अधिकारी बन सकता है जब श्री राधा प्यारी की कृपा हो अन्यथा नहीं।
english_text: "Or possess the juice only, please please when Radha dear." -Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Rasanand [7] One can become an authority in the rare pleasure of daily vihar only when there is the grace of Shri Radha Pyari and not otherwise.
english_translation: "Or possess the juice only, please please when Radha dear." -Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Rasanand [7] One can become an authority in the rare pleasure of daily vihar only when there is the grace of Shri Radha Pyari and not otherwise.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हमारे आली बरसानो निज ग्राम  - श्री सरस माधुरी जी
sanskrit_text:
हमारे आली बरसानो निज ग्राम।
श्रीपटरानी नाम राधिका, राजा श्रीघनश्याम॥ [1] 
ब्रज चौरासी कोस कुञ्ज में, राज परम अभिराम। 
'सरसमाधुरी' रहत महल में, श्रीवृन्दावन धाम॥ [2]
- श्री सरस माधुरी
english_text: Our Ali Barsano own village. Shri Patrani's name is Radhika, King Shri Ghanshyam.. [1] Braj Chaurasi Kos Kunj Purush, Raj Param Abhiram. 'Sarasmadhuri' in Rahat Mahal, Sri Vrindavan Dham.. [2] - Sri Saras Madhuri
english_translation: Our Ali Barsano own village. Shri Patrani's name is Radhika, King Shri Ghanshyam.. [1] Braj Chaurasi Kos Kunj Purush, Raj Param Abhiram. 'Sarasmadhuri' in Rahat Mahal, Sri Vrindavan Dham.. [2] - Sri Saras Madhuri
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: लटकत आावत बाहाँ जोरी - श्री अलबेली अलि, समय प्रबन्ध (186)
sanskrit_text:
लटकत आावत बाहाँ जोरी। 
फूले फूले दोउ जन सुन्दर, देखत बन घन खोरी॥ [1]
फूलन की माला उर पहिरें, नवल स्याम नव गोरी। 
अलबेली अलि प्रानरवन दिन, अविचल भूतल जोरी॥ [2]
- श्री अलबेली अलि, समय प्रबन्ध (186)
english_text: Latkat Avat Bahan Jori. These two people are beautiful, they look beautiful.. [1] Wear a garland of flowers, they are new in color, they are new in color. Albeli Ali Pranaravaan Deen, Avichal Surface Jori.. [2] - Mr. Albeli Ali, Time Management (186)
english_translation: Latkat Avat Bahan Jori. These two people are beautiful, they look beautiful.. [1] Wear a garland of flowers, they are new in color, they are new in color. Albeli Ali Pranaravaan Deen, Avichal Surface Jori.. [2] - Mr. Albeli Ali, Time Management (186)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मूर्तिमान श्रिंगार हरि - श्री वृंदावन देव जी
sanskrit_text:
मूर्तिमान श्रृंगार हरि, सब रस कौ आधार।
रसपोषक सब शक्ति लै, ब्रज में करत विहार॥
- श्री वृंदावन देव जी
english_text: Hari's statuesque makeup, all the juice is in the balance. Brought all the nourishing powers, roaming around in Braj.. - Shri Vrindavan Dev Ji
english_translation: Hari's statuesque makeup, all the juice is in the balance. Brought all the nourishing powers, roaming around in Braj.. - Shri Vrindavan Dev Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अब मन युगल चरन में अटक्यो - श्री अली माधुरी जी, श्री निकुञ्ज केली माधुरी
sanskrit_text:
अब मन युगल चरन में अटक्यो। 
जन्म अनेक भये या जग में, धर्म कर्म में भटक्यो॥ [1]
कृपा करी श्री नित्य किशोरी, विपन राज में ठटक्यो। 
रसिकन के संग रहस केलि सुनि, हिय आनंद में लटक्यो॥ [2]
पायो मारग प्रेम प्रीति को, चित कौ संषय सटक्यो। 
अली माधुरी भई नचीता, दूर भयो भव खटक्यो॥ [3]
- श्री अली माधुरी जी, श्री निकुञ्ज केली माधुरी
english_text: Now mind couple charan purush atakyo. Janma anek bhaye ya jag purush, dharma karma purush bhatkyo.. [1] Please please Sri Nitya Kishori, vipan raj purush bhatkyo. Listen to the mystery with the lover, I am immersed in joy.. [2] May you find the path of love and love, but your mind is tormented by doubt. Ali Madhuri Bhai Nachita, Dur Bhayo Bhava Khatkyo.. [3] - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri
english_translation: Now mind couple charan purush atakyo. Janma anek bhaye ya jag purush, dharma karma purush bhatkyo.. [1] Please please Sri Nitya Kishori, vipan raj purush bhatkyo. Listen to the mystery with the lover, I am immersed in joy.. [2] May you find the path of love and love, but your mind is tormented by doubt. Ali Madhuri Bhai Nachita, Dur Bhayo Bhava Khatkyo.. [3] - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji, Shri Nikunj Keli Madhuri
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मात तात जाके नहीं वृषभानु सुता नहिं नाम - श्री ललितकिशोरी देव जू की वाणी, विशिष्ट पद एवं साखी (686)
sanskrit_text:
मात तात जाके नहीं, वृषभानु सुता नहिं नाम।
कुंजबिहारी नाम निजु, कुंज बिहारिनि बाम॥
- श्री ललितकिशोरी देव, श्री ललितकिशोरी देव जू की वाणी, विशिष्ट पद एवं साखी (686)
english_text: Don't go there, don't listen to Vrishabhanu. Kunj Bihari Naam Niju, Kunj Biharini Bam.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Special Post Avon Sakhi (686)
english_translation: Don't go there, don't listen to Vrishabhanu. Kunj Bihari Naam Niju, Kunj Biharini Bam.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Special Post Avon Sakhi (686)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रादाने धारणे धा च इति धातुद्वयादपि - श्री वागीश शास्त्री जी, श्री राधा नाम सुधा (10)
sanskrit_text:
रादाने धारणे धा च इति धातुद्वयादपि।
राधानाम्नोऽस्ति निष्पत्तिर्विज्ञेया भक्तसत्तमै:॥
- श्री वागीश शास्त्री जी, श्री राधा नाम सुधा (10)
english_text: रादेन धारने ध च इति धातुद्व्यादपी. Radhananamnosti Nishpattirvigyanyeya Bhaktasattmai:.. - Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Naam Sudha (10)
english_translation: रादेन धारने ध च इति धातुद्व्यादपी. Radhananamnosti Nishpattirvigyanyeya Bhaktasattmai:.. - Shri Vagish Shastri Ji, Shri Radha Naam Sudha (10)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: डोल झूलिये दोऊ प्यारे - श्री हित परमानंद दास जी
sanskrit_text:
डोल झूलिये दोऊ प्यारे।
कुंजमहल में फूलनि-रचना, फूलनि फूल सँवारे॥ [1]
फूलनि के अम्बर आभूषन, फूलनि सौं उर धारे।
श्रीहित गुलाब फूले “परमानँद”, जुगल-फूल-छबि वारे॥ [2]
- श्री हित परमानंद दास जी
english_text: Swing and swing, you two dear ones. Fulani creation in Kunjmahal, Fulani flower adornment.. [1] Fulani amber ornaments, Fulani hundred ur dhere. Shrihit Gulab Phule "Parmanand", Jugla-phula-chabhi vaare.. [2] - Shri Hit Parmanand Das ji
english_translation: Swing and swing, you two dear ones. Fulani creation in Kunjmahal, Fulani flower adornment.. [1] Fulani amber ornaments, Fulani hundred ur dhere. Shrihit Gulab Phule "Parmanand", Jugla-phula-chabhi vaare.. [2] - Shri Hit Parmanand Das ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्वेतोत्पल दल सम सुखद विभ्रद मणि मय वास - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
श्वेतोत्पल दल सम सुखद, विभ्रद मणि मय वास।
कोटि कोटि शत दंडवत, राधा पद प्रति श्वास॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: Shwetotpal Dal is as pleasant, Vibhrad Mani May Vas. Millions of prayers, every breath of Radha... - Couplets of Braj
english_translation: Shwetotpal Dal is as pleasant, Vibhrad Mani May Vas. Millions of prayers, every breath of Radha... - Couplets of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: धन धन वृन्दाविपिन भई पनिहारी - श्री अभयराम, वृंदावन रहस्य विनोद (59)
sanskrit_text:
धन धन वृन्दाविपिन भई पनिहारी।
प्रात होय जमुना जल न्हावै, सब ही गोप कुमारी॥ [1]
बातें करैं धरैं सिर गागर, चाल चलैं मतवारी।
अभयराम ऐ तो बड़भागिन, स्याम सुन्दर की प्यारी॥ [2]
- श्री अभयराम, वृंदावन रहस्य विनोद (59)
english_text: Wealth wealth Vrindavipin Bhai Panihari. In the morning, Yamuna water bathes all the Gop Kumaris. Abhayram, oh great sister, beloved of Siyam Sundar.. [2] - Shri Abhayram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (59)
english_translation: Wealth wealth Vrindavipin Bhai Panihari. In the morning, Yamuna water bathes all the Gop Kumaris. Abhayram, oh great sister, beloved of Siyam Sundar.. [2] - Shri Abhayram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (59)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कबहूँ तौ लाड़िली ऐसी कृपा करौ री - श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (348)
sanskrit_text:
कबहूँ तौ लाड़िली ऐसी कृपा करौ री। 
हौं तौ लोटि रहौं कुंजन मग, तुम हिय आइ कैं पाँव धरौ री॥ [1]
हौं तौ लागि रहौं चरणन सौं, तुम झुकि विहँसि भुजा पकरौ री। 
हौं तौ नैंक उठौं न उठाये, तुम बल कर हठ भुजन भरौ री॥ [2]
हौं तौ सब विधि अधम अपावन, तुम तौ आपनी ढरनि ढरौ री। 
'भोरी' नीच सबै नीचन में, कृपा आस नित द्वार ररौं री॥ [3]
- श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (348)
english_text: When will you do such a favor to me, damsel? I am the one who kept lying down, Kunjan Mug, you are the one who held my feet.. [1] I am you, I am the one who kept my feet, you are the one who bent down and caught hold of my arms. I am here, I am not raising my eyes, you are raising your hands and arms with force.. [2] I am you, all the rules are impure, you are holding on to your land. 'Bhori', below all, below the mind, grace comes to us every day.. [3] - Shri Bhori Sakhi, the pain of love (348)
english_translation: When will you do such a favor to me, damsel? I am the one who kept lying down, Kunjan Mug, you are the one who held my feet.. [1] I am you, I am the one who kept my feet, you are the one who bent down and caught hold of my arms. I am here, I am not raising my eyes, you are raising your hands and arms with force.. [2] I am you, all the rules are impure, you are holding on to your land. 'Bhori', below all, below the mind, grace comes to us every day.. [3] - Shri Bhori Sakhi, the pain of love (348)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बिछुरन मिलन जहाँ रहै - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (231)
sanskrit_text:
बिछुरन मिलन जहाँ रहै, सुद्ध प्रेम नहिं होइ।
मिलत मिलत बढ़ै चाह अति, सुद्ध प्रेम है सोंइ॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (231)
english_text: Where there is separated union, there is no pure love. Milat Milat congratulations, very much love, pure love Soni.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, Siddhant's friend (231)
english_translation: Where there is separated union, there is no pure love. Milat Milat congratulations, very much love, pure love Soni.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, Siddhant's friend (231)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन को नाम ले, भज वृन्दावन धाम - श्री रामराय, गीत गोविंद ब्रज भाषा, दोहा (87)
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन को नाम ले, भज वृन्दावन धाम।
श्रीवृन्दावन सो नहीं, तीन लोक विश्राम॥
- श्री रामराय, गीत गोविंद ब्रज भाषा, दोहा (87)
english_text: Take the name of Vrindavan, Bhaj Vrindavan Dham. Sri Vrindavan sleeps, three worlds rest.. - Shri Ram Rai, Geet Govind Braj language, Doha (87)
english_translation: Take the name of Vrindavan, Bhaj Vrindavan Dham. Sri Vrindavan sleeps, three worlds rest.. - Shri Ram Rai, Geet Govind Braj language, Doha (87)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री सवामन शालिग्राम मंदिर, वृंदावन
sanskrit_text:
स्थान:
सवामन शालिग्राम मंदिर, वृंदावन के लोई बाजार में श्री राधा श्यामसुंदर मंदिर के सामने स्थित है।

पद्मपुराण में उल्लेख है कि सतयुग में दैत्य जालंधर की पत्नी वृंदा के अभिशाप से भगवान विष्णु ने शालिग्राम शिला का रूप रखकर गंडकी नदी में निवास किया था, जो नेपाल में स्थित है। इसी गंडकी नदी से सवामन की एक शालिग्राम शिला प्राप्त हुई। जिसकी आज वृंदावन के मंदिर में विधवत रूप से पूजा-अर्चना हो रही है। मंदिर सेवायत श्रीकांत बौहरे के अनुसार, श्री वैष्णव संप्रदाय के एक महात्मा कालांतर में नेपाल के जंगल में तपस्या कर रहे थे, उन्हें स्वप्न में आदेश हुआ कि गंडकी नदी में एक विशालकाय शालिग्राम शिला विराजमान है, जिसे निकालकर वृंदावन पहुंचाना है। संत गंडकी नदी पहुंचे तो उन्हें शिला मिल गई। उन्होंने बांस की बहंगी बनाई और उसमें शिला को विराजमान करवाकर वृंदावन के लिए चल दिए। जहां शहर के मध्य बने इस मंदिर में शालिग्राम शिला को स्थापित करवाया। मान्यता है कि शालिग्राम की एक शिला अधूरी मानी जाती है, तभी मंदिर में सेवा पूजा कर रहे संत को स्वप्न आया कि हैदराबाद के सीताराम बाग में विराजमान मंदिर में एक अन्य विशालकाय शिला स्थापित है जो कि तुलसीदल न मिलने के कारण अपूर्ण है, उस शिला को वृंदावन लाकर मंदिर में विराजमान करवाया गया। इस मंदिर का निर्माण सन 1823 में सेठ गनेरीलाल ने करवाया था।
english_text: Location: Sawaman Shaligram Temple is located in front of Shri Radha Shyamsundar Temple in Loi Bazar, Vrindavan. It is mentioned in Padmapuran that due to the curse of Vrinda, wife of the demon Jalandhar, in Satyayuga, Lord Vishnu took the form of Shaligram Shila and resided in the Gandaki River, which is located in Nepal. A Shaligram stone of Sawaman was found from this same Gandaki river. Which is being worshiped properly in the temple of Vrindavan today. Temple Sevayat According to Srikant Bauhare, a Mahatma of Shri Vaishnav sect was doing penance in the forest of Nepal, he got the order in his dream that there is a huge Shaligram stone sitting in the Gandaki river, which has to be taken out and taken to Vrindavan. When the saint reached Gandaki river, he found a rock. He was made a bamboo palanquin and after enshrining a stone in it, he was sent to Vrindavan. Where Shaligram Shila has been installed in this temple built in the middle of the city. It is believed that a stone of Shaligram is considered incomplete, when the saint was doing service and worship in the temple, he had a dream that there is a huge stone installed in the temple situated in Sitaram Bagh of Hyderabad which is incomplete due to Tulsidal and Milan, we have brought the stone to Vrindavan and got it installed in the temple. This temple was built by Seth Ganerilal in 1823.
english_translation: Location: Sawaman Shaligram Temple is located in front of Shri Radha Shyamsundar Temple in Loi Bazar, Vrindavan. It is mentioned in Padmapuran that due to the curse of Vrinda, wife of the demon Jalandhar, in Satyayuga, Lord Vishnu took the form of Shaligram Shila and resided in the Gandaki River, which is located in Nepal. A Shaligram stone of Sawaman was found from this same Gandaki river. Which is being worshiped properly in the temple of Vrindavan today. Temple Sevayat According to Srikant Bauhare, a Mahatma of Shri Vaishnav sect was doing penance in the forest of Nepal, he got the order in his dream that there is a huge Shaligram stone sitting in the Gandaki river, which has to be taken out and taken to Vrindavan. When the saint reached Gandaki river, he found a rock. He was made a bamboo palanquin and after enshrining a stone in it, he was sent to Vrindavan. Where Shaligram Shila has been installed in this temple built in the middle of the city. It is believed that a stone of Shaligram is considered incomplete, when the saint was doing service and worship in the temple, he had a dream that there is a huge stone installed in the temple situated in Sitaram Bagh of Hyderabad which is incomplete due to Tulsidal and Milan, we have brought the stone to Vrindavan and got it installed in the temple. This temple was built by Seth Ganerilal in 1823.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारी प्रीतम को सदा जिनके उरमें भाव- श्री रूप माधुरी जी की वाणी, रसिक पच्चीसी (14)
sanskrit_text:
प्यारी प्रीतम को सदा, जिनके उरमें भाव।
रूप माधुरी मन छके, उनके दर्शन पाव॥
- श्री रूप माधुरी, श्री रूप माधुरी जी की वाणी, रसिक पच्चीसी (14)
english_text: May you always be with your beloved beloved. Roop Madhuri touched my heart, I got her darshan.. - Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri ji's voice, Rasik Pachisi (14)
english_translation: May you always be with your beloved beloved. Roop Madhuri touched my heart, I got her darshan.. - Shri Roop Madhuri, Shri Roop Madhuri ji's voice, Rasik Pachisi (14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मेरौ मन श्री वृन्दावन अटक्यो, राख्यो श्री हरिदास विपुल बल, भूली न इत उत भटक्यो।  - श्री बिहारिन देव - बिहारिन देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (154)
sanskrit_text:
मेरौ मन श्री वृन्दावन अटक्यो,
राख्यो श्री हरिदास विपुल बल, भूली न इत उत भटक्यो। 
- श्री बिहारिन देव - बिहारिन देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (154)

श्री बिहारिन देव जी कहते हैं कि स्वामी श्रीहरिदास जी और श्री विट्ठल विपुल देव जी की कृपा से मेरा मन श्री वृन्दावन में ऐसा अटक गया है की भूल कर भी वृन्दावन धाम को छोड़कर वह अब इधर उधर नहीं भटकता।
english_text: My mind is stuck in Shri Vrindavan, keep Shri Haridas's abundant strength, don't forget it and wander there. - Shri Biharin Dev - Biharin Dev Ji's speech, principle verses (154) Shri Biharin Dev Ji says that by the grace of Swami Shri Haridas Ji and Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, my mind has become so stuck in Shri Vrindavan that even by mistake, I do not leave Vrindavan Dham and wander here and there.
english_translation: My mind is stuck in Shri Vrindavan, keep Shri Haridas's abundant strength, don't forget it and wander there. - Shri Biharin Dev - Biharin Dev Ji's speech, principle verses (154) Shri Biharin Dev Ji says that by the grace of Swami Shri Haridas Ji and Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, my mind has become so stuck in Shri Vrindavan that even by mistake, I do not leave Vrindavan Dham and wander here and there.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मोहन तड़ाग बाग फूल फल मोहन हैं - श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’, वृन्दावन शतक (14)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
मोहन तड़ाग बाग फूल फल मोहन हैं,
मोहन गाय गिरि गोवर्धन ललाम है। [1]
मोहन मन मोहन धार बहै यमुना की,
मोहन मधुपुरी मोहन नन्द ग्राम है॥ [2]
मोहन हैं गोपीजन ग्वाल वाल मोहन हैं,
मोहन श्रीराधा और मोहन श्रीश्याम है। [3]
मोहन हैं लता पता कुंज सब मोहन हैं,
मोहन स्वरूप यह वृन्दावन धाम है॥ [4]
- डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’, वृन्दावन शतक (14)
english_text: (Poem) Mohan is the full fruit of Mohan, Mohan is gay Giri Govardhan Lalam. [1] Mohan Man is Mohan Dhar Bahai of Yamuna, Mohan is Madhupuri Mohan Nand Gram.. [2] Mohan is Gopijan Gwal Val Mohan, Mohan is Shriradha and Mohan Shri Shyam. [3] Lata Pata Kunj is Mohan, all are Mohan, this is Vrindavan Dham in the form of Mohan.. [4] - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnananda Saraswati 'Hare Krishna', Vrindavan Shatak (14)
english_translation: (Poem) Mohan is the full fruit of Mohan, Mohan is gay Giri Govardhan Lalam. [1] Mohan Man is Mohan Dhar Bahai of Yamuna, Mohan is Madhupuri Mohan Nand Gram.. [2] Mohan is Gopijan Gwal Val Mohan, Mohan is Shriradha and Mohan Shri Shyam. [3] Lata Pata Kunj is Mohan, all are Mohan, this is Vrindavan Dham in the form of Mohan.. [4] - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnananda Saraswati 'Hare Krishna', Vrindavan Shatak (14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आजु सखि आये मेह सुहाये - श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, श्रिंगार रस के पद (45)
sanskrit_text:
(राग गौड़ मल्हार)
आजु सखि आये मेह सुहाये।
गौर घटा उमड़ी आनंद में, महाप्रेम झरि लाये॥ [1]
राजत धनुष चहूँ दिसि नीके, छिन-छिन रंग सवाये। 
श्री ललित किसोरी के हित बिहरत, करत लाल मन भाये॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, श्रिंगार रस के पद (45)
english_text: (Raaga Gauda Malhara) Aaju sakhi ae meh suhaaye. The attention decreased in joy, great love brought the fountain.. [1] The silver bow was always in my hands, the colors were snatched away. Shri Lalit Kishori ke Hit Bihar, Karat Lal Man Bhaye.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's Vani, Shringaar Ras's verses (45)
english_translation: (Raaga Gauda Malhara) Aaju sakhi ae meh suhaaye. The attention decreased in joy, great love brought the fountain.. [1] The silver bow was always in my hands, the colors were snatched away. Shri Lalit Kishori ke Hit Bihar, Karat Lal Man Bhaye.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's Vani, Shringaar Ras's verses (45)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रसिक रसीली रंग भरी रमनी कमनी नारि - श्री किशोरी अलि, राधा नामावलि (14)
sanskrit_text:
रसिक रसीली रंग भरी, रमनी कमनी नारि।
रस सलिता रस रूपिनी, रस क्रीड़ा की सारि॥
- श्री किशोरी अलि, राधा नामावलि (14)
english_text: Interesting, juicy color, heavy, beautiful and lustful woman. Ras Salita Ras Rupini, Ras Krida ki saree.. - Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (14)
english_translation: Interesting, juicy color, heavy, beautiful and lustful woman. Ras Salita Ras Rupini, Ras Krida ki saree.. - Shri Kishori Ali, Radha Namavali (14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: स्याम बतायौ नैंन में रही समुझि सुकुँवारि- श्रीभट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (30)
sanskrit_text:
स्याम बतायौ नैंन में, रही समुझि सुकुँवारि।
चरन लग्यौ जब कह्यौ तब, हरषी लाल निहारि॥
- श्रीभट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (30)
english_text: Siam Batayou Nainan Purush, Rahi Samujhi Sukunwari. Charan lagyao jab kahayo tob, Harshi Lal Nihari.. - Shribhat Devachari, double century (30)
english_translation: Siam Batayou Nainan Purush, Rahi Samujhi Sukunwari. Charan lagyao jab kahayo tob, Harshi Lal Nihari.. - Shribhat Devachari, double century (30)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: उरज उतंग अति भरित भरे से अंग -  श्री वल्लभ रसिक जी की वाणी
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
उरज उतंग अति भरित भरे से अंग,
अधर सुरंग सों रंगी सी मति जाति हैं। [1]
ऊँची गुँथी वेणी सों तनेनी भौंह भई भरी,
आई भरी छवि हँसि लसि इतराति हैं॥ [2]
‘वल्लभ रसिक’ दोऊ, सनमुख मुख सनें,
चकित थकित कित दिवस कित राति हैं। [3]
नैननि सिहानी ललचानी मुस्कानी,
तरसानी सरसानी आनि-आनि दरसाति हैं॥ [4]
- श्री वल्लभ रसिक, श्री वल्लभ रसिक जी की वाणी
english_text: (Poem) Uraj Utang is very heavy with full body, the medial tunnel, the son is a colored mind. [1] High braided hair, thin eyebrows, brother, heavy, oh heavy image, laughing and boasting.. [2] 'Vallabh Rasika' couple, faces facing each other, surprised, tired, how many nights. [3] Nainani Sihani, Laalchani Muskani, Tarsani Sarsani, Ani-Ani Darsati.. [4] - Shri Vallabh Rasik, speech of Shri Vallabh Rasik ji.
english_translation: (Poem) Uraj Utang is very heavy with full body, the medial tunnel, the son is a colored mind. [1] High braided hair, thin eyebrows, brother, heavy, oh heavy image, laughing and boasting.. [2] 'Vallabh Rasika' couple, faces facing each other, surprised, tired, how many nights. [3] Nainani Sihani, Laalchani Muskani, Tarsani Sarsani, Ani-Ani Darsati.. [4] - Shri Vallabh Rasik, speech of Shri Vallabh Rasik ji.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हित मय श्रीवृन्दाविपिन हित मय श्यामा श्याम - श्री मगल अलि
sanskrit_text:
हित मय श्रीवृन्दाविपिन, हित मय श्यामा श्याम।
हित मय श्री ललितादि सखि, हित मय कुंज सुठाम॥
- श्री मगल अलि
english_text: Hit me with Shri Vrindavipin, hit me with Shyama Shyam. Hit may shri lalitadi sakhi, hit may kunj sutham.. - Shri Magal Ali
english_translation: Hit me with Shri Vrindavipin, hit me with Shyama Shyam. Hit may shri lalitadi sakhi, hit may kunj sutham.. - Shri Magal Ali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हमारें बल इक राधिका प्यारी, प्यारी हू सुख देत सहज ही, जानत निजु सहचारी। - श्री किशोरी अली, किशोरी अली ग्रंथावली
sanskrit_text:
हमारें बल इक राधिका प्यारी,
प्यारी हू सुख देत सहज ही, जानत निजु सहचारी। 
अली किशोरी की निजु सम्पति, बलिहारी बलिहारी॥ 
- श्री किशोरी अली, किशोरी अली ग्रंथावली
english_text: Our child Radhika is dear, she is dear and gives happiness easily, she knows and is my companion. Ali Kishori's personal property, Balihari Balihari.. - Shri Kishori Ali, Kishori Ali Granthawali
english_translation: Our child Radhika is dear, she is dear and gives happiness easily, she knows and is my companion. Ali Kishori's personal property, Balihari Balihari.. - Shri Kishori Ali, Kishori Ali Granthawali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यह वृन्दावन मेरी सम्पति, इहलोक परलोक वृन्दावन मेरौ पुरुषार्थ परमार्थ गथु गति।  - श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (27)
sanskrit_text:
यह वृन्दावन मेरी सम्पति,
इहलोक परलोक वृन्दावन मेरौ पुरुषार्थ परमार्थ गथु गति। 
- श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (27)

केवल श्री वृन्दावन धाम ही मेरी सम्पति है, यह लोक, परलोक, पुरुषार्थ, परमार्थ, पूँजी, और गति सब कुछ वृन्दावन धाम ही है।
english_text: This: Vrindavan is my property, this world and the next world, Vrindavan is my effort and spiritual progress. - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, first part (27) Only Shri Vrindavan Dham is my property, this world, the next world, effort, charity, capital, and speed, everything is Vrindavan Dham only.
english_translation: This: Vrindavan is my property, this world and the next world, Vrindavan is my effort and spiritual progress. - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, first part (27) Only Shri Vrindavan Dham is my property, this world, the next world, effort, charity, capital, and speed, everything is Vrindavan Dham only.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रवनि रसायनि परिहरि साह न मानत कौन - श्री लाल स्वामी
sanskrit_text:
रवनि रसायनि परिहरि, साह न मानत कौन।
आसू के हरिदास की, लगै लाल पग पौन॥
- श्री लाल स्वामी
english_text: Ravani Rasaani Parihari, who does not believe in it? Asu's Haridas, took every quarter step.. - Shri Lal Swami
english_translation: Ravani Rasaani Parihari, who does not believe in it? Asu's Haridas, took every quarter step.. - Shri Lal Swami
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जाकी कृपा सों नित्य दिव्य ब्रजमंडल माँहि - श्री गिरिराज गोस्वामी 'अनन्त' (गोकुल)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
जाकी कृपा सों नित्य दिव्य ब्रजमंडल माँहि,
ललित विलास खास रमण विहारी के। [1]
वाणी अरु वीणापाणि ऋद्धि सिद्धि रमा उमा,
गायत्री सावित्री रूप बरसाने वारी के॥ [2]
भाव भरपूर चित्त चूर श्याम चिन्तन में,
नारद शुक व्यास हरिदास दास प्यारी के। [3]
बंदौं मनमोहनकी माधुरी धुरी जग की,
बंदौं पद कंज मंजु कीरति कुमारी के॥ [4]
- श्री गिरिराज गोस्वामी 'अनन्त' (गोकुल)
english_text: (Poem) By the grace of your son, Nitya Divya Brajmandal Manhi, Lalit Vilas Khas Raman Vihari. [1] Vani Aru Vinpani Riddhi Siddhi Rama Uma, Gayatri Savitri Roop Barsane Vaari Ke..
