me inaki buddhi samany balakon se kahin adhik tivr aur dharanashakti chamatkari thi. inhonne apane sneh aur saujany se shaishav men hi apane charo or achchha-khasa sakha-mandal sthapit kar liya tha. in bala-sakhaon ke sath inaki kridaen asadharan hoti thi. prayh bhagavadbhakti ke ashrit hi koi n koi khel yah khelate the. thakur ji ki seva-puja karane ki or bhi inaki naisargik ruchi thi aur inhonne mahaprasad ka mahatmy shaishav men hi apane bal sakhaon ke samaksh varnan kiya tha. ekadashi vrat ke prati inaka vilakshan bhav isi ayu men vyakt ho gaya tha. shanai shanai apani anany bhavana aur seva-puja ke karan inaki khyati samipavarti pradesh men hui aur inake pas rasapipasuon ka agaman hona prarambh hua. is ayu men inhonne jo chamatkar kie unaka varnan sampradayik vani-grnthon men bhara paड़a hai. solah varsh ki ayu men shri hitachary ka vivah rukmini devi ke sath sampann hua. grihasth jivan men pravesh karane par bhi inhonne apani dharmik nishtha men parivartan nahi kiya. grihasthashram ke samast karttavyon ka palan karate huye ye sachche rup men bhakt aur sant bane rahe. is jivan ke prati inake man me n to vairagy bhavana thi aur n isake prati kisi prakar ka hin bhav hi ye rakhate the. inaka dampatya-jivan sukhi-sampann aur adarsh tha. sarv prakar ke aishvary evn bhogavilas ki samagri inake pas thi kintu inaki bhavana men usake liye kisi prakar ki asakti n hone se usako lekar ye kabhi vyagr, vichalit ya lipt n hote the. shrimati rukmini devi se shri hitachary ke ek putri aur tin putr utpann hue. jyeshth putr shri vanachndraji sa0 1585, dvitiy putr shri krishnachndraji snvat 1587, tritiy putr shri gopinathaji savat 1588 tatha putri sahib de samvat 1589 me utpann hui. shri harivnshaji ki mata tararani ka 1589 men tatha pita shri vyas mishr ka nikunjagaman 1590 samvat men hua. mata-pita ki mrityu ke uparant shri harivnshaji ke man men yah bhav aaya ki kisi prakar bhagavan ki lilasthali men jakar vahan ki rasamayi bhakti-paddhati men lin hokar jivan safal karen. usi samay inaki khyati se prabhavit hokar tatkalin raja ne inako apane darabar men bulane ke liye sadar nimntran bheja kintu inhonne apane antarman men bhagavan ki lilabhumi ka nimntran svikar kar liya tha isaliye raja ke nimntran ko asvikar kar diya. aur ek shlok men yah uttar bhijava diya ki srishti ke adi se narendra-surendr, brahma adi kalagrasit hote aye hain ath haricharan men lin hokar unaka hi dhyan karana abhisht hai. shri radha ki ajnya se vrindavan ke lie prasthan : battis varshaki ayu men shriradha ne shri hit harivnsh ko shri vrindavana-vas evn dharma-prachar ki ajnya di. is ajnya ke prapt hote hi shri hit ji vrindavan chal die. unhonne chalate samay rukmini ji se sath chalane ko kaha kintu ve sath n a saki. devavan se prasthan ke bad marg men inako shri radha ke svapn men darshan huye aur unhone inase kaha ki "age ek chirathaval nam ka ganv tumhare marg men padaega, us ganv men yadi koi brahman apani do kanyaon ka tum se vivah karana chahe to tum use svikar kar lena. yah vivah tumhare bhakti-path me kisi prakar ka antaray utpann karane vala n hoga. is vivah ke dvara tum dampaty jivan ka adarsh pratishthit karoge." sath hi yah bhi us svapn me unhen radhaji ne kaha ki "mera ek vigrah (radhavallabhaji ke rup me) tumhe milega jise tum vrindavan me le jakar mndir men vidhivat sthapit karana." aisa hi svapn atmadev namak brahman ko bhi hua jo usi chirathaval ganv ka rahane vala tha. is svapn ke bad shri harivnsh ji apane yatra path men agrasar huye aur us ganv me (chirathavala) pahunche jisamen atmadev nam ka brahman rahata tha. usake do navayuvati kanyaen thi aur purv drisht svapn ke adhar par vah shri harivnshaji ke agaman ki satat pratiksha kar raha tha. unake ate hi usane apani donon kanyaon ka panigrahan karane ke liye harivnshaji se prarthana ki jise unhone saharsh svikar kiya. in kanyayon ke nam krishnadasi aur manoharidasi the. chirathaval ganv men kuchh samay tak thahar kar fir shri harivnsh ji ne apani yantra prarambh ki aur samvat 1590 ko falgun ki ekadashi ko vrindavan pahunche. yahan pahunchane par madanater namak sthan par vishram ke liye dera dala. yah sthan aj bhi vrindavan men prasiddh hai. vahin shri hitachary ne shri radhavallabh ke lie lata-kunyj nirman kar unhen sthapit kiya aur seva prarambh ki. panychakosi vrindavan ka prakash : shri hitachary jis samay vrindavan men aye us samay vah lata punjakar dala-fal aur fulon se paripurn ek saghan kunj ke rup men tha. yah lata punjakar vrindavan shuk pika-saras hns adi pakshiyon ke kalarav se mukharit aur charon or yamuna se samavritt tha. kahin-kahin yamuna tatasth unche tilon par yamuna snan hetu aye hue brajavasigan se avashy dikhai dete the. samagat shri hitachary ke dvara yah jnyat hone par ki- is saghan nirjan van men ham nivas karenge un sabhi brajavasiyon ko atyadhik vismay aur hardik prasannata hui. unhonne shri hitachary ke hath men tir kaman dete hue kaha ke gusain ji ap tir chalaiye, apaka tir jahan tak pahunchega vahan tak ki bhumi apaki hogi. yah shri hitachary ka madhur prabhav hi tha ki in batamar vritti vale brajavasiyon ke chitton ka purn parivartan ho gaya aur ve pnchakosi vrindavan men shri hitachary ko bhumi pradan karane ke liye taiyar ho gaye. brajavasiyon ke kahane par shri hitachary nen ek tir chhoda aur vah paryapt duri par jakar gira. shri hitachary ne jahan se tir fenka, apana nivasalay usi sthan ko banaya aur jahan par vah tir gira, kalantar men vah sthan 'tir ghat' aur bad men 'chir ghat' ke nam se prasiddh ho gaya. shri hitachary ke divy svarup par mugdh hokar brajavasi darshanarth ane lage aur shighr hi samipavarti ganvo men inake agaman ka samachar fail gaya. jab shri hitachary vrindavan aye tab us samay vrindavan ghanaghor jngal tha. vahan ek naravahan nam ka daku rahata tha jisake bhay se vahan din men bhi koi n ata. usane apani shakti ke dvara sampurn braj pradesh par apana adhikar hi bana liya tha. usaki is shakti se badae-badae raje maharaje bhi darate the. yahan tak ki dillishvar ka bhi is naravahan par koi niyantran nahin tha. jab naravahan ko apane guptacharon dvara yah jnyat hua ki koi aisa chamatkari mahapurush hinsak jantuon se snsevit nirjan van men aya hai; jisake madhur prabhav se hinsak jantu tatha nirjan van ke parisar men base batamaron ke mana-buddhi aur chitt badal gaye hain aur ve sab us mahapurush ki seva sushrusha men nirat ho gaye hain; to kutuhal dekhane ki drishti se ek din naravahan bhi shri hitachary ke nivas sthan par aya. us samay shri hitachary apane shishyon tatha brajavasiyon se samavritt the aur 'naval' namak shishy ke sath kuchh alapa-snlap kar rahe the. raja naravahan bhi shri hitachary ke madhur prabhav se achhuta n rah saka. vartalap sunakar use apani vritti par bahut khed hua. usane apana hardik dukh prakat karate hue shri hitachary se svayn ko sharan men lene ki prarthana ki. shri hitachary ne usaki nishkapat vani sunakar mantradan ke satha-sath upadesh bhi diye jisase usake jivan ka amulachul parivartan ho gaya. naravahan jaise khunkhar daku ke jivan ke is parivartan se pnchakosi vrindavan men nivas karana sabake lie sugam ho gaya. falath brihad vrindavanasth braj ke nandagram, barasana, radhakund aur snket adi gramon men base hue santajan bhi shri hitachary dvara prakatit is pnchakosi rasasthal vrindavan men nivas karane lage. isase purv sabhi bhaktagan is pnchakosi vrindavan se aparichit hi the. shri hitachary ne jis sthan se tir fenka tha usi sthan par lata vinirmit mandir ya parn kuti men shri radhaballabhalal ji ko virajaman kar diya aur apane nivas ke lie kisi prakar ka nivasalay banakar shri radhaballabhalal ji ki ashtayami seva karane lage. ve is parn vinirmit mandir men us samay tak seva karate rahe jab tak raja naravahan dvara navin mandir ka nirman nahin hua tha. raja naravahan ne shri radhaballabhalal ji ka navin mandir usi sthan par banavaya tha, jahan par shri hitachary saparivar nivas karate the. navin mandir nirman ho jane par vi. sn. 1591 ki kartik shu teras ko shri hitachary ne shri radhaballabhalal ji ko usamen virajaman kiya aur vishesh samaroh ke sath patotsav manaya. anek sntagan gokul, govardhan, nndagav aur barasane men nivas karate the. us samay govardhan, nndagav aur barasana bhi vrihad vrindavan tha. shri harivnsh ji ne yahan anek lila sthaliyon ko prakat kiya aur vrindavan ki sima pnchakosi nirdharit ki. usi din aj bhi vrindavan prakaty utsav manaya jata hai. shri naravahan ji par kripa karana : rahen bhauganv nanv narabahan sadhusevi, luti lai nav, jaki bandikhanai diyau hai. laundai avai dain kachhu, khayave ko, ai daya, ati akulai lai, upay yah kiyau hai.. bolau radhavallabh au, levau harivnsh nam, puchhai shishy nam kahau, puchhi nam liyau hai. dai mngavay vastu, rakhiyo duray bat, ay das bhayau, kahi rijhi pad diyau hai.. - shri bhaktamal (419) shri “naravahana” ji shriharivnshaji ke shishy, param sntasevi, "bhaiganva” men rahate the. braj ke ek jamindar the aur lutere bhi. koi seth lakhon ki snpada nav men bhare yamuna ji ke marg se ja raha tha, naravahan ne sntaseva ke liye sab lutaliya, aur us seth ko karagar (bandighara) men dal diya. us vanik (setha) ko bhojan dene ek laundai (tahalani) karagar men jati thi, seth ki durdasha dekhakar us tahalani ke hriday men badai daya ai, tab bahut akulake usako ek upay bataya ki "tum badae unche svar se "radhavallabh shriharivnsh !” yah nam japo, jab puchha jay, tab kahana ki main shriharivnsh ji ka shishy hun.” us seth ne aisa hi kiya aur uchch svar se "radhavallabh shriharivnsha” nam ratane laga. jab shrinaravahanaji ne yah suna to us seth ke pas gae aur puchha ki “tum yah nam kyon japate ho?” us seth ne kaha “main shriharivnshaji ka shishy hun.” raja naravahan badae hi guru nishth the. sunate hi us seth ko mukt kar diya aur dhan dekar kaha ki "shrigusainji se yah bat nahin kahana." vah seth shighr hi shrivrindavan jakar shrihit harivnshaji ka shishy ho gaya, aur apana vrittant bhi sunaya "naravahan ji ne lakhon ka dhan lekar mujhe karagar men dal diya so mainne apaka nam liya aur jhuth hi kaha ki "apaka shish hun.” yah sunate hi naravahan ji ne mujhe mukt kar diya aur mera sampurn dhan dekar mujhe ghar bhej diya." sunakar prasann ho shri gusainji ne donon ko prabhupad prem pradan kiya. shrinaravahan ji ki gurubhakti par rijhakar inhin ki chhap dekar shri harivnsh ji ne do pad banakar apani "chaurasi" granth men rakh liya aur shri naravahan ji ko nity vihar ras ka sakshatkar kara diya. navin siddhant evn sveshta-seva-snsthapana : shri hitachary ke paramopasy shataishvary sampann bhagavan nahin the; pratyut koti brahm aishvary ke parakote ke antargat kintu usase dur purn madhury murti, rasa-rasik, advay yugal kishor the. bhagavan ki seva puja vaidik vidhan dvara hi snvidhey hoti hai kintu madhury murti, 'prem' kinva 'ras' vigrah shri radhavallabhalal ji ki seva priti-vidhan se hi sambhav thi. ath shri hitachary ne apane sneh bhajan shriradhaballabhalal ji ka aharnishi samayanurup anek prakar se lada-dular pyar kiya. is lada-pyar ko hi unhonne sat bhog aur panch arati vali vidhi nishedh shuny 'ashtayami seva' tatha varsh men ane vale ritu utsavon [vasant, holi, horidol, jalabihar, pavas, jhula aur adi) ki 'utsavik seva' ka suramy rup pradan kiya. sath hi apane acharanon evn vani dvara dainik svesht ki manasi seva karane ka bhi murt vidhan diya. siddh kelisthalon ka prakaty : shri hitachary ne aise vrindavan ka pragaty kiya tha joki bhutalasth hote hue bhi 'devanamath bhakta-mukt' aur shri krishn ke lila parikar ke lie bhi durlakshy tha. isilie yah vrindavan param rahasy snjnyak bana raha aur bana rahega. aise vrindavan men hone vali lilayen aur lila sthalon ka pragaty bhi anek drishtiyon se anivary tha. ath shri hitachary ne un lila sthalon ka bhi pragaty kiya jinaka ullekh shrimadbhagavat adi puranon men nahin hai. in lila sthalon ka pragaty hi pnchakosi vrindavan ka pragaty hai aur jo rahasy rup vrindavan ke parichay pradata tatha pratyaksh pratik hain. pnchakosi vrindavan men unake dvara prakatit lila sthal hain-rasamandal, sevakunj, vnshivat, dhirasamir, manasarovar, hindol sthal, shringaravat aur van vihar. namo jayati jamuna vrindavan. namo nikunj kunj seva, hit mandal ras, dol, anndaghan.. namo pulin vnshivat, rasamay dhirasamir, subhag bhuv khelan. namo-namo jai manasarovar sukh upajavan dnpati ke man.. namo-namo dum beli khaga-mrig je-je pragat gopy shri kanan. namo jayati hit svamini radha alabeli alabelau mohan.. - shri alabelisharan ji nity rasalilanukaran pragaty : prem kinva ras murti shyama-shyam prakritith ras aur vilas priy hain. ras aur vilas priyata inake svarup ki prakat pratik hai. isilie shri hitachary inhen ashirvad dete hue kahate hain ki rasa-vilas ke sath yah jori sada virajaman rahe - nav nikunj abhiram shyam sng niko banyo hai samaj. jai shri hit harivnsh vilas ras jut jori avichal raju.. radhakinkarigan is rasa-ras ka pan netra- chakshuon dvara kiya karati hain. radhakinkari bhavanubhavitahriday rasikon ko bhi pratyaksh darshan dvara is rasa-vilas ka rasasvad nirantar mil sake is uddeshy ki purti ke lie shri hitachary ne prem murti shyamashyam ki is nity rasalila ke anukaran ka pragaty kiya. yah rasalilanukaran vrindavan men hone vale us nadyant nityaras ka anukaran tha jo muktajanon, bhaktajanon aur govind priy parikar se sarvatha alakshit hai. yah bhagavat varnit dvaparant men hone vale maharas se bhinn us nityaras ka anukaran tha jise keval radha-priy kinkarigan hi dekha karati hain. is rasalilanukaran ka shubharnbh shri hitachary ne vi. se. 1592 ke lagabhag pnchakosi vrindavanasth chain ghat [vartaman nam govind ghata) men vinirmit ras mandal par brajavasi balakon ko shyama-shyam v sahachariyon ke vesh se susajjit karake kiya tha. isi rasamandal men ek samay maharas ke madhy shri radha ke charanon ki nupur tut gayi thi aur vahan upasthit shri hariram vyas ji ne apane yajnyopavit se nupur gunth kar shri priya ji ke charanon men dharan karaya tha. samajagayan [ sngit ]- samudbhav : 'prem' kinva 'ras' jab ujjrimbhit hota hai tab usamen rag ki urmiyan prakritith uchchhalit hoti hain. shyama-shyama-prem kinva ras ki saghan murti hi hain. yahi karan hai ki unhen ragalapan tatha vina-vnshi vadan atyadhik priy hai. kabhi rasikashekhar shyamasundar vnshi vadan ke madhyam se shri priya ke sath gayan karake unhen prasann karate hain to kabhi keval priya ji apane madhur gayan tatha vina vadana-dvara apane priyatam ko anndit karati hain. isi prakar rag aur anurag ki rajiv murtiyan sahacharigan bhi samaya-samay par yugal ke ragalap ka anugaman karake kabhi prath, kabhi madhyantar, utthapan kal men aur kabhi ratri ras men gayana-vadan karake yugalavar ka manornjan kiya karati hain. radhakinkari bhavanubhavit rasik bhi isi prakar se ras lilaon ke padyatmak gayan dvara apane isht yugal ko anandit kar sake tatha svayn vrindavanarasanand ka anubhav kar sake - is uddeshy se shri hitachary ne 'samaj gayan' ki abhinav aur maulik gayan paddhati ka bhi samudbhav kiya. yahan par yah nitant avismaraniy hai ki unhonne samaved ke svar pradhan sngit ko akshar pradhan banakar is maulik gan paddhati ko janm diya aur ras lila snbndhi gey padon ko ek dhun vishesh men abaddh karake un vishisht 'dhunon' ka bhi avishkar kiya; jo aj bhi radhavallabhiy samajagan gayako ke kanth men parampara se surakshit hain. shishy parikar : rasikachary go. hit harivnsh ji ke anek shishy hue, unamen se bhagavat mudit ji dvara rachit 'rasikananyamal' men varnit shishyon ka namollekh kiya jata hai in ullikhit rasikon men se shri naravahan, hariramavyas, chhabiledas, naharamal, bithaladas, mohanadas, navaladas, haridas tuladhar, haridas ji [karmathi bai ke tau], paramanandadas, prabodhanand sarasvati, karmathi bai, sevak ji, kharagasen, gnga, jamuna, puranadas, kishor, santadas, manohar, khem, balakrishn, jnyanu, gopaladas nagar, adi. rachanayen : shri hitachary dvara virachit rachanayen nimnankit hain - 1: shriradhasudhanidhi yah ek snskrit kavy hai jisaki shlok snkhya 270 hai. is granth men shri radhakrishn ki vibhinn nikunyj lilaon ka varnan hai, sng men abhilasha evn vndana ke shlok bhi sngrihit hain. 2: shri yamunashtak shri yamunashtak snskrit men rachit ek ashtak hai jisaki shlok snkhya 9 hai. isamen shri yamuna ji ka yash evn unaki vndana ka varnan hai. 3: shri hit chaurasi shri hit chaurasi brajabhasha men ek pady rachana hai jisamen 84 pad snkalit hain. is granth men shri shyamashyam ki nikunj lila ka varnan hai. 4: sfut vani is granth men brajabhasha men 24 pad snkalit hain, jisamen siddhant, arati, shri shyamashyam ki nikunj lila, adi ke pad hain. in 4 rachanaon ke atirikt shri hitachary ji ke 2 patr brajabhasha gady men rachit hain. lila snvaran : jayakrishn ji ne shri hitachary ka nikunj gaman varnan karate hue likha hai ki - shri yamuna ji ke tat par manasarovar ke nikat bhandiravat hai. kusumit lalit latikaon se ramaniy is van sthali men ‘bhnvarani bhavan' namak ek nibhrit nikunj hai. is nikunj men shyama-shyam rati ras bihar kiya karate hain. sharadiy purnima [ashvin ki purnima] ki chandra-chandrika men rati ras bihar ke rasasav se aghurnit nayan shri rasik yugal jhum rahe the, ghum rahe the, unaki shri ang ki kanti chandra-kanti ko atyadhik kant bana rahi thi. shri hitachary ko priya ji ke ang ki sugandh ne apani or balat akarshit kiya. parinamath ve us sugandh ke adhar se "priya ji ! ap kahan ho ? kahan ho ?" yah kahate hue us van men ghusate hi chale gaye aur thodai der men priya ji ki anga-chandrika men ghul mil gaye. is prakar se vi. sn. 1609 ki ashvin purnima ki ratri men shri hit ji loka-drishti se ojhal ho gaye. divy kamal shri yamuna kul. vat bhandir nikat ras mul.. sntat jahn bhnvaran ki bhir. shitala-manda-sugndh samir.. jahn biharat shri ravani-ravan. takau nam bhnvarani bhavan.. sharad mas raka ujiyari. puran shashi ju prakashit bhari.. priya-jaunh men yaun mili gai. tihi chhin sahachari snbhram bhai.. kahat ki kahan-kahan ho lali. saundhe ke dore lagi chali.. drishtantar yaun shri harivnsh. manasarovar ras ke hns.. bhnvar bhnvarani men dou chalain. shri hit ju tin sng hi ralain.. samvat sorah sai ru nav, ashvin punau mas. ta din shri hit jaga-drigan, kiyau apragat vilas.. shri hariram vyas ji ne hitachary ke nikunj gaman kar jane ke falasvarup vrindavan ke rasik samaj ki durdasha aur apani hardik vedana ka varnan kiya hai - hutau ras rasikan kau adhar. binu harivnshahi saras riti kau kapai chalihai bhar.. ko radha dularavai gavai vachan sunavai char. vrindavan ki sahaj madhuri kahihai kaun udar.. pad rachana ab kapai hvai hai niras bhayau snsar. badau abhag anany sabha kau uthigau thath singar.. jin binu din chhin sat yug bitat sahaj rup agar. 'vyas' ek kul kumud bandhu binu udagan juthau thar..

vyasanndan vyasanndan vyasanndan gaiye. jako hit nam let dampati rati paiye.. ras madhy lalitadik prarthana ju kinhin. kar te sukumari pyari vnshi tab dinhin.. soi kali pragat rup vnshi vapu dharyau. radharani ke gram raval ke nikat bad gram men prakat hui aur tino lokon men is divy madhur nity vihar ras ka vistar kiya. shri lalita ju shri svami haridas ju ke rup men vrindavan ke rajapur gram men prakat hue. bhumika : uttar pradesh ke saharanapur jile men ek gram hai devavan, jahan shri tapan mishr ke putr, jyotish ke param vidvan, yajurvediy, kashyap gotriy, gauड़ brahman shri vyas mishr ji nivas karate the. vyas mishr us samay ke prasiddh jyotishi the aur is vidya ke dvara unhonne prachur snpatti prapti ki thi. dhire-dhire unaki khyati tatkalin prithvipati ke kanon tak pahunchi aur usane bahut adar sahit vyas mishr ko bula bheja. vyas mishr badashah se char shrifal lekar mile. badashah unase batachit karake unake gunon par mugdh ho gaya aur unako 'char hajari ki nidhi' dekar sadaiv apane sath rakhane laga. vyas mishr ki samriddhi ka ab koi thikana nahin raha aur ve rajasi thata-bat se rahane lage. vyas mishr ke purn sukhi jivan men ek hi prabal abhav tha. ve nissntan the. is abhav ke karan ve evn unaki patni tararani sadaiv udas rahate the. vyas mishr ji barah bhai the jinamen ek nrisinhashram ji virakt the. nrisinhashram ji uchchakoti ke bhakt the, evn lok men unaki siddhata ki anek kathayen prachalit thin. virakt hote hue bhi inaka vyas ji se sneh tha aur kabhi-kabhi yah unase milane aya karate the. ek bar mishra-dnpati ko samriddhi men bhi udas dekh kar unhonne isaka karan puchha. vyas mishr ne apani sntan hinata ko udasi ka karan bataya aur nrisinhashram ji ke samane 'param bhagavat rasik anany' putr prapt karane ki apani tivr abhilasha pragat ki. nrisinhashram ji ne uttar diya "bhai, tum to svayn jyotishi ho. tumako apane janmaksharon se apane bhagy ki gati ko samajh lena chahiye aur sntosha-purn jivanayapan karana chahiye." yah sunakar vyas mitr to chup ho gae, kintu unaki patni ne driढ़ta-purvak puchha "yadi sab kuchh bhagy ka hi kiya hota hai, yadi vidhi ka banaya vidhan hi saty hai, to isamen apaki mahima kya rahi ?" is bar nrisinhashram ji uttar n de sake aur vicharamagn hokar vahan se chale gaye. ekant van men jakar unhonne apane isht ka aradhan kiya aur unase vyas mishr ki manokamana purn karane ki prarthana ki. ratri ko svapn men prabhu ne unako sandesh diya ki "tumhare satsnkalp ko purn karane ke liye svayn hari apani vnshi sahit vyas mishr ke ghar men pragat honge." nrisinhashram ji ne yah sandesh vyas mishr ko suna diya aur isako sunakar mishra-dampati ke anand ka thikana nahi raha. janm : badashah vyas mishr ji ko sarvatr apane sath to rakhata hi tha. shri hit harivnsh ke janm ke samay bhi vyas mishr apani patni-sahit badashah ke sath the aur brajabhumi men thahare the. vahin mathura se 5 mil dur 'bad' namak gram men vaishakh shukla ekadashi somavar samvat 1559 men arunoday kal men shrihit harivnsh ka janm hua. mahapurushon ke sath sadharanataya jo mangalikata snsar men pragat hoti hai, vah shri hit harivnsh ke janm ke sath bhi hui aur sab logon men anayas dharmik ruchi, parasparik priti evn sukha-shanti ka snchar ho gaya. braj ke van hare-bhare ho gae, lataon men pushp khilane lage, sukhe sarovar jal se bhar gae, vatavaran men sugandhi vyapt ho gayi, akash men bijali chamakane lagi, halaki-halaki barish ki bunde girane lagi, vatavaran suhavana ho gaya, brajavasiyon ke hraday akasmat hi prem evn harsh se bhar gae, pakshigan madhur kalarav karane lage, mor nrity karane lage. shri radha sudha nidhi ji ka prakaty : jab shri hitachary 6 mas ke the tab unake mukh se snskrit ke shlok uddhrit hone lage, jise vahan upasthit shri nrisinhashram ji ne shravan kiya. vah koi sadharan shlok nahin the, apitu shri shyamashyam ki divy nikunj lila se sambndhit the. aisa bahut dinon tak hota raha aur jab shlokon ki snkhya 270 pahunchi to shri hitachary ke mukh se shlok uddhrit hona bnd ho gaya. un samast 270 shlokon ko shri nrisinhashram ji ne granth men lipibaddh kar liya jisaka nam "shri radhasudhanidhi" hua. shaishav krida : shri hit harivnsh ke pita shri vyas ji braj darshan ke uddeshy se aye the. ath unhonne braj men chhah mahine nivas kar divy lila sthalon ke darshan kiye aur devavan chale gaye. namakaran ke samay jyotishiyon ne batalaya tha ki yah balak anek adbhut karm karane vala hoga. unaki bhavishy vani balak ki janm kundali par adharit thi ath vah sampurnath saty bhi hui. balak harivnsh ke un shaishav kalin anek chamatkar purn karyon ka varnan rasikajan pranit anek charitr granthon men milata hai. shri hitachary samavayask kumaron ke sath sadharan bal krida karate dekhakar jnyanu namak bhakt ko jyotishiyon ki bat par avishvas hone laga tha ath vah apana sandeh dur karane ke uddeshy se ek din balak harivnsh ki pariksha lene gaya kintu use shri hitachary ne apani bal krida men hi shyama-shyam ki kunj keli ke pratyaksh darshan kara diye aur vah deh tyag kar nikunj mahal men sampravisht ho gaya. shri navarngilal ji ka prakaty : ek din ratri men hit harivnsh ko shriji ne ajnya di ki "baग़ men ek kuna hai jisame hamara ek dvibhuj svarup hai jo kar men bansuri lie hue hain, unhen meri gadi sng sthapit kar seva karo." dusare din shri harivnsh ji kuen men kud paड़e aur vahan se shyam varn dvibhuj muralidhari ek shri vigrah nikalakar le aye. unhonne us vigrah ko shriradha ki gaddi ke sath ek nav nirmit mandir men virajaman karake vidhi nishedh shuny apani maulik seva paddhati ka shubharambh kiya. balak harivnsh ne us vigrah ka nam 'rngilal' rakkha; jo adyapi devavan nagarasth mandir men virajaman hai. is ghatana ka smarak vah kuna bhi 'harivnsh chah' ke nam se vikhyat aj bhi dekha jata hai. yah ghatana tab ki hai jab shri hitachary ki ayu sat varsh ki thi. shiksha : shri hitachary ko kina-kin vidvanon se kab aur kina-kin shastron ki shiksha hui yah ajnyat hai. kintu inake dvara virachit 'hit chaurasi' aur 'sfut vani namak brajabhasha granth tatha 'radhasudhanidhi' evn 'yamunashtak' jaisi snskrit kritiyon se jnyat hota hai ki unhen snskrit vyakaran, sahity, sngit, jyotish tatha shruti puranadikon ki sarvochch shiksha prapt hui hogi. unaki charon kritiyan hi is tathy ko praman banati hain. guruvar v mantr prapti : rasikon dvara virachit charitr granthon v vani granthon ke anusar shri hitachary ko unaki svesht shriradha ne mntr pradan kiya tha. ek divas sovat sukh lahyau. shri radhe supane men kahyau.. dvar tihare pipar jo hai. unchi dar sabani men sohai.. tamai arun patr ik nyarau. jamen jugal mntr hai bharau.. lehu mntr tum karahu prakash. rasikajanani ki pujavahu ash.. - shri hit charitr, uttamadas ji vyasanndan vyasanndan vyasanndan gaiye. tinako piy nam sahit mantr diyau shri radhe. sata-chita-annd rup nigam agam sadhe.. - shri hit rupalal ji svayn shri hitachary ne apani 'radhasudhanidhi' namak rachana men anek sthalon par shri radha ko apani isht ke sath hi guru rup men bhi smaran kiya hai. yasyah kadapi vasananychal khelanotth, dhanyati dhany pavanen kritarth mani. yogindr durgam gatirmadhusudanopi, tasya namostu vrishabhanu bhuvanodisheऽpi.. rahau kou kahu manahi die. mere prananath shrishyama shapath karaun trin chhiye.. ek din shri hitachary ratri men so rahe the, tab shri radha ne svapn men adesh diya "tumhare ghar ke samane jo pipal ka vriksh hai, usaki sabase unchi dal par ek adbhut arun patr hai, usamen hamara yugal mantr hai, use grahan kar usaka rasikajanon men prakash karo." is adesh ko pakar shri hitachary ne subah us arun patr ko pipal vriksh ki dal se utar kar usaka rasikajanon men prakash kiya. shri harivnsh ji ko shri radha ke dvara "hit" chhap pradan karana : jab shri hitachary devavan men nivas karate the, tab shri radha ne svayn prakat hokar shri hitachary ko "hit" chhap pradan kiya tha. tabhi se shri hitachary ka nam hit harivnsh ho gaya. "hit" ka arth hai prem. rasamay kare charit parashnsh. jagaguru vidit shri harivnsh.. shri radha anugrah kiyau. shri mukh mntr niju kar diyau.. dayita krishn jinake isht. puni guru bhav priti garisht.. dini rijh hit ki chhap. ta kari badhyau bhakti pratap.. - chacha vrindavan das ji upanayan snskar, vidyadhyayan aur vivah : ath varsh ki ayu men shri hitachary ka upanayan snskar hua. is ayu me inaki buddhi samany balakon se kahin adhik tivr aur dharanashakti chamatkari thi. inhonne apane sneh aur saujany se shaishav men hi apane charo or achchha-khasa sakha-mandal sthapit kar liya tha. in bala-sakhaon ke sath inaki kridaen asadharan hoti thi. prayh bhagavadbhakti ke ashrit hi koi n koi khel yah khelate the. thakur ji ki seva-puja karane ki or bhi inaki naisargik ruchi thi aur inhonne mahaprasad ka mahatmy shaishav men hi apane bal sakhaon ke samaksh varnan kiya tha. ekadashi vrat ke prati inaka vilakshan bhav isi ayu men vyakt ho gaya tha. shanai shanai apani anany bhavana aur seva-puja ke karan inaki khyati samipavarti pradesh men hui aur inake pas rasapipasuon ka agaman hona prarambh hua. is ayu men inhonne jo chamatkar kie unaka varnan sampradayik vani-grnthon men bhara paड़a hai. solah varsh ki ayu men shri hitachary ka vivah rukmini devi ke sath sampann hua. grihasth jivan men pravesh karane par bhi inhonne apani dharmik nishtha men parivartan nahi kiya. grihasthashram ke samast karttavyon ka palan karate huye ye sachche rup men bhakt aur sant bane rahe. is jivan ke prati inake man me n to vairagy bhavana thi aur n isake prati kisi prakar ka hin bhav hi ye rakhate the. inaka dampatya-jivan sukhi-sampann aur adarsh tha. sarv prakar ke aishvary evn bhogavilas ki samagri inake pas thi kintu inaki bhavana men usake liye kisi prakar ki asakti n hone se usako lekar ye kabhi vyagr, vichalit ya lipt n hote the. shrimati rukmini devi se shri hitachary ke ek putri aur tin putr utpann hue. jyeshth putr shri vanachndraji sa0 1585, dvitiy putr shri krishnachndraji snvat 1587, tritiy putr shri gopinathaji savat 1588 tatha putri sahib de samvat 1589 me utpann hui. shri harivnshaji ki mata tararani ka 1589 men tatha pita shri vyas mishr ka nikunjagaman 1590 samvat men hua. mata-pita ki mrityu ke uparant shri harivnshaji ke man men yah bhav aaya ki kisi prakar bhagavan ki lilasthali men jakar vahan ki rasamayi bhakti-paddhati men lin hokar jivan safal karen. usi samay inaki khyati se prabhavit hokar tatkalin raja ne inako apane darabar men bulane ke liye sadar nimntran bheja kintu inhonne apane antarman men bhagavan ki lilabhumi ka nimntran svikar kar liya tha isaliye raja ke nimntran ko asvikar kar diya. aur ek shlok men yah uttar bhijava diya ki srishti ke adi se narendra-surendr, brahma adi kalagrasit hote aye hain ath haricharan men lin hokar unaka hi dhyan karana abhisht hai. shri radha ki ajnya se vrindavan ke lie prasthan : battis varshaki ayu men shriradha ne shri hit harivnsh ko shri vrindavana-vas evn dharma-prachar ki ajnya di. is ajnya ke prapt hote hi shri hit ji vrindavan chal die. unhonne chalate samay rukmini ji se sath chalane ko kaha kintu ve sath n a saki. devavan se prasthan ke bad marg men inako shri radha ke svapn men darshan huye aur unhone inase kaha ki "age ek chirathaval nam ka ganv tumhare marg men padaega, us ganv men yadi koi brahman apani do kanyaon ka tum se vivah karana chahe to tum use svikar kar lena. yah vivah tumhare bhakti-path me kisi prakar ka antaray utpann karane vala n hoga. is vivah ke dvara tum dampaty jivan ka adarsh pratishthit karoge." sath hi yah bhi us svapn me unhen radhaji ne kaha ki "mera ek vigrah (radhavallabhaji ke rup me) tumhe milega jise tum vrindavan me le jakar mndir men vidhivat sthapit karana." aisa hi svapn atmadev namak brahman ko bhi hua jo usi chirathaval ganv ka rahane vala tha. is svapn ke bad shri harivnsh ji apane yatra path men agrasar huye aur us ganv me (chirathavala) pahunche jisamen atmadev nam ka brahman rahata tha. usake do navayuvati kanyaen thi aur purv drisht svapn ke adhar par vah shri harivnshaji ke agaman ki satat pratiksha kar raha tha. unake ate hi usane apani donon kanyaon ka panigrahan karane ke liye harivnshaji se prarthana ki jise unhone saharsh svikar kiya. in kanyayon ke nam krishnadasi aur manoharidasi the. chirathaval ganv men kuchh samay tak thahar kar fir shri harivnsh ji ne apani yantra prarambh ki aur samvat 1590 ko falgun ki ekadashi ko vrindavan pahunche. yahan pahunchane par madanater namak sthan par vishram ke liye dera dala. yah sthan aj bhi vrindavan men prasiddh hai. vahin shri hitachary ne shri radhavallabh ke lie lata-kunyj nirman kar unhen sthapit kiya aur seva prarambh ki. panychakosi vrindavan ka prakash : shri hitachary jis samay vrindavan men aye us samay vah lata punjakar dala-fal aur fulon se paripurn ek saghan kunj ke rup men tha. yah lata punjakar vrindavan shuk pika-saras hns adi pakshiyon ke kalarav se mukharit aur charon or yamuna se samavritt tha. kahin-kahin yamuna tatasth unche tilon par yamuna snan hetu aye hue brajavasigan se avashy dikhai dete the. samagat shri hitachary ke dvara yah jnyat hone par ki- is saghan nirjan van men ham nivas karenge un sabhi brajavasiyon ko atyadhik vismay aur hardik prasannata hui. unhonne shri hitachary ke hath men tir kaman dete hue kaha ke gusain ji ap tir chalaiye, apaka tir jahan tak pahunchega vahan tak ki bhumi apaki hogi. yah shri hitachary ka madhur prabhav hi tha ki in batamar vritti vale brajavasiyon ke chitton ka purn parivartan ho gaya aur ve pnchakosi vrindavan men shri hitachary ko bhumi pradan karane ke liye taiyar ho gaye. brajavasiyon ke kahane par shri hitachary nen ek tir chhoda aur vah paryapt duri par jakar gira. shri hitachary ne jahan se tir fenka, apana nivasalay usi sthan ko banaya aur jahan par vah tir gira, kalantar men vah sthan 'tir ghat' aur bad men 'chir ghat' ke nam se prasiddh ho gaya. shri hitachary ke divy svarup par mugdh hokar brajavasi darshanarth ane lage aur shighr hi samipavarti ganvo men inake agaman ka samachar fail gaya. jab shri hitachary vrindavan aye tab us samay vrindavan ghanaghor jngal tha. vahan ek naravahan nam ka daku rahata tha jisake bhay se vahan din men bhi koi n ata. usane apani shakti ke dvara sampurn braj pradesh par apana adhikar hi bana liya tha. usaki is shakti se badae-badae raje maharaje bhi darate the. yahan tak ki dillishvar ka bhi is naravahan par koi niyantran nahin tha. jab naravahan ko apane guptacharon dvara yah jnyat hua ki koi aisa chamatkari mahapurush hinsak jantuon se snsevit nirjan van men aya hai; jisake madhur prabhav se hinsak jantu tatha nirjan van ke parisar men base batamaron ke mana-buddhi aur chitt badal gaye hain aur ve sab us mahapurush ki seva sushrusha men nirat ho gaye hain; to kutuhal dekhane ki drishti se ek din naravahan bhi shri hitachary ke nivas sthan par aya. us samay shri hitachary apane shishyon tatha brajavasiyon se samavritt the aur 'naval' namak shishy ke sath kuchh alapa-snlap kar rahe the. raja naravahan bhi shri hitachary ke madhur prabhav se achhuta n rah saka. vartalap sunakar use apani vritti par bahut khed hua. usane apana hardik dukh prakat karate hue shri hitachary se svayn ko sharan men lene ki prarthana ki. shri hitachary ne usaki nishkapat vani sunakar mantradan ke satha-sath upadesh bhi diye jisase usake jivan ka amulachul parivartan ho gaya. naravahan jaise khunkhar daku ke jivan ke is parivartan se pnchakosi vrindavan men nivas karana sabake lie sugam ho gaya. falath brihad vrindavanasth braj ke nandagram, barasana, radhakund aur snket adi gramon men base hue santajan bhi shri hitachary dvara prakatit is pnchakosi rasasthal vrindavan men nivas karane lage. isase purv sabhi bhaktagan is pnchakosi vrindavan se aparichit hi the. shri hitachary ne jis sthan se tir fenka tha usi sthan par lata vinirmit mandir ya parn kuti men shri radhaballabhalal ji ko virajaman kar diya aur apane nivas ke lie kisi prakar ka nivasalay banakar shri radhaballabhalal ji ki ashtayami seva karane lage. ve is parn vinirmit mandir men us samay tak seva karate rahe jab tak raja naravahan dvara navin mandir ka nirman nahin hua tha. raja naravahan ne shri radhaballabhalal ji ka navin mandir usi sthan par banavaya tha, jahan par shri hitachary saparivar nivas karate the. navin mandir nirman ho jane par vi. sn. 1591 ki kartik shu teras ko shri hitachary ne shri radhaballabhalal ji ko usamen virajaman kiya aur vishesh samaroh ke sath patotsav manaya. anek sntagan gokul, govardhan, nndagav aur barasane men nivas karate the. us samay govardhan, nndagav aur barasana bhi vrihad vrindavan tha. shri harivnsh ji ne yahan anek lila sthaliyon ko prakat kiya aur vrindavan ki sima pnchakosi nirdharit ki. usi din aj bhi vrindavan prakaty utsav manaya jata hai. shri naravahan ji par kripa karana : rahen bhauganv nanv narabahan sadhusevi, luti lai nav, jaki bandikhanai diyau hai. laundai avai dain kachhu, khayave ko, ai daya, ati akulai lai, upay yah kiyau hai.. bolau radhavallabh au, levau harivnsh nam, puchhai shishy nam kahau, puchhi nam liyau hai. dai mngavay vastu, rakhiyo duray bat, ay das bhayau, kahi rijhi pad diyau hai.. - shri bhaktamal (419) shri “naravahana” ji shriharivnshaji ke shishy, param sntasevi, "bhaiganva” men rahate the. braj ke ek jamindar the aur lutere bhi. koi seth lakhon ki snpada nav men bhare yamuna ji ke marg se ja raha tha, naravahan ne sntaseva ke liye sab lutaliya, aur us seth ko karagar (bandighara) men dal diya. us vanik (setha) ko bhojan dene ek laundai (tahalani) karagar men jati thi, seth ki durdasha dekhakar us tahalani ke hriday men badai daya ai, tab bahut akulake usako ek upay bataya ki "tum badae unche svar se "radhavallabh shriharivnsh !” yah nam japo, jab puchha jay, tab kahana ki main shriharivnsh ji ka shishy hun.” us seth ne aisa hi kiya aur uchch svar se "radhavallabh shriharivnsha” nam ratane laga. jab shrinaravahanaji ne yah suna to us seth ke pas gae aur puchha ki “tum yah nam kyon japate ho?” us seth ne kaha “main shriharivnshaji ka shishy hun.” raja naravahan badae hi guru nishth the. sunate hi us seth ko mukt kar diya aur dhan dekar kaha ki "shrigusainji se yah bat nahin kahana." vah seth shighr hi shrivrindavan jakar shrihit harivnshaji ka shishy ho gaya, aur apana vrittant bhi sunaya "naravahan ji ne lakhon ka dhan lekar mujhe karagar men dal diya so mainne apaka nam liya aur jhuth hi kaha ki "apaka shish hun.” yah sunate hi naravahan ji ne mujhe mukt kar diya aur mera sampurn dhan dekar mujhe ghar bhej diya." sunakar prasann ho shri gusainji ne donon ko prabhupad prem pradan kiya. shrinaravahan ji ki gurubhakti par rijhakar inhin ki chhap dekar shri harivnsh ji ne do pad banakar apani "chaurasi" granth men rakh liya aur shri naravahan ji ko nity vihar ras ka sakshatkar kara diya. navin siddhant evn sveshta-seva-snsthapana : shri hitachary ke paramopasy shataishvary sampann bhagavan nahin the; pratyut koti brahm aishvary ke parakote ke antargat kintu usase dur purn madhury murti, rasa-rasik, advay yugal kishor the. bhagavan ki seva puja vaidik vidhan dvara hi snvidhey hoti hai kintu madhury murti, 'prem' kinva 'ras' vigrah shri radhavallabhalal ji ki seva priti-vidhan se hi sambhav thi. ath shri hitachary ne apane sneh bhajan shriradhaballabhalal ji ka aharnishi samayanurup anek prakar se lada-dular pyar kiya. is lada-pyar ko hi unhonne sat bhog aur panch arati vali vidhi nishedh shuny 'ashtayami seva' tatha varsh men ane vale ritu utsavon [vasant, holi, horidol, jalabihar, pavas, jhula aur adi) ki 'utsavik seva' ka suramy rup pradan kiya. sath hi apane acharanon evn vani dvara dainik svesht ki manasi seva karane ka bhi murt vidhan diya. siddh kelisthalon ka prakaty : shri hitachary ne aise vrindavan ka pragaty kiya tha joki bhutalasth hote hue bhi 'devanamath bhakta-mukt' aur shri krishn ke lila parikar ke lie bhi durlakshy tha. isilie yah vrindavan param rahasy snjnyak bana raha aur bana rahega. aise vrindavan men hone vali lilayen aur lila sthalon ka pragaty bhi anek drishtiyon se anivary tha. ath shri hitachary ne un lila sthalon ka bhi pragaty kiya jinaka ullekh shrimadbhagavat adi puranon men nahin hai. in lila sthalon ka pragaty hi pnchakosi vrindavan ka pragaty hai aur jo rahasy rup vrindavan ke parichay pradata tatha pratyaksh pratik hain. pnchakosi vrindavan men unake dvara prakatit lila sthal hain-rasamandal, sevakunj, vnshivat, dhirasamir, manasarovar, hindol sthal, shringaravat aur van vihar. namo jayati jamuna vrindavan. namo nikunj kunj seva, hit mandal ras, dol, anndaghan.. namo pulin vnshivat, rasamay dhirasamir, subhag bhuv khelan. namo-namo jai manasarovar sukh upajavan dnpati ke man.. namo-namo dum beli khaga-mrig je-je pragat gopy shri kanan. namo jayati hit svamini radha alabeli alabelau mohan.. - shri alabelisharan ji nity rasalilanukaran pragaty : prem kinva ras murti shyama-shyam prakritith ras aur vilas priy hain. ras aur vilas priyata inake svarup ki prakat pratik hai. isilie shri hitachary inhen ashirvad dete hue kahate hain ki rasa-vilas ke sath yah jori sada virajaman rahe - nav nikunj abhiram shyam sng niko banyo hai samaj. jai shri hit harivnsh vilas ras jut jori avichal raju.. radhakinkarigan is rasa-ras ka pan netra- chakshuon dvara kiya karati hain. radhakinkari bhavanubhavitahriday rasikon ko bhi pratyaksh darshan dvara is rasa-vilas ka rasasvad nirantar mil sake is uddeshy ki purti ke lie shri hitachary ne prem murti shyamashyam ki is nity rasalila ke anukaran ka pragaty kiya. yah rasalilanukaran vrindavan men hone vale us nadyant nityaras ka anukaran tha jo muktajanon, bhaktajanon aur govind priy parikar se sarvatha alakshit hai. yah bhagavat varnit dvaparant men hone vale maharas se bhinn us nityaras ka anukaran tha jise keval radha-priy kinkarigan hi dekha karati hain. is rasalilanukaran ka shubharnbh shri hitachary ne vi. se. 1592 ke lagabhag pnchakosi vrindavanasth chain ghat [vartaman nam govind ghata) men vinirmit ras mandal par brajavasi balakon ko shyama-shyam v sahachariyon ke vesh se susajjit karake kiya tha. isi rasamandal men ek samay maharas ke madhy shri radha ke charanon ki nupur tut gayi thi aur vahan upasthit shri hariram vyas ji ne apane yajnyopavit se nupur gunth kar shri priya ji ke charanon men dharan karaya tha. samajagayan [ sngit ]- samudbhav : 'prem' kinva 'ras' jab ujjrimbhit hota hai tab usamen rag ki urmiyan prakritith uchchhalit hoti hain. shyama-shyama-prem kinva ras ki saghan murti hi hain. yahi karan hai ki unhen ragalapan tatha vina-vnshi vadan atyadhik priy hai. kabhi rasikashekhar shyamasundar vnshi vadan ke madhyam se shri priya ke sath gayan karake unhen prasann karate hain to kabhi keval priya ji apane madhur gayan tatha vina vadana-dvara apane priyatam ko anndit karati hain. isi prakar rag aur anurag ki rajiv murtiyan sahacharigan bhi samaya-samay par yugal ke ragalap ka anugaman karake kabhi prath, kabhi madhyantar, utthapan kal men aur kabhi ratri ras men gayana-vadan karake yugalavar ka manornjan kiya karati hain. radhakinkari bhavanubhavit rasik bhi isi prakar se ras lilaon ke padyatmak gayan dvara apane isht yugal ko anandit kar sake tatha svayn vrindavanarasanand ka anubhav kar sake - is uddeshy se shri hitachary ne 'samaj gayan' ki abhinav aur maulik gayan paddhati ka bhi samudbhav kiya. yahan par yah nitant avismaraniy hai ki unhonne samaved ke svar pradhan sngit ko akshar pradhan banakar is maulik gan paddhati ko janm diya aur ras lila snbndhi gey padon ko ek dhun vishesh men abaddh karake un vishisht 'dhunon' ka bhi avishkar kiya; jo aj bhi radhavallabhiy samajagan gayako ke kanth men parampara se surakshit hain. shishy parikar : rasikachary go. hit harivnsh ji ke anek shishy hue, unamen se bhagavat mudit ji dvara rachit 'rasikananyamal' men varnit shishyon ka namollekh kiya jata hai in ullikhit rasikon men se shri naravahan, hariramavyas, chhabiledas, naharamal, bithaladas, mohanadas, navaladas, haridas tuladhar, haridas ji [karmathi bai ke tau], paramanandadas, prabodhanand sarasvati, karmathi bai, sevak ji, kharagasen, gnga, jamuna, puranadas, kishor, santadas, manohar, khem, balakrishn, jnyanu, gopaladas nagar, adi. rachanayen : shri hitachary dvara virachit rachanayen nimnankit hain - 1: shriradhasudhanidhi yah ek snskrit kavy hai jisaki shlok snkhya 270 hai. is granth men shri radhakrishn ki vibhinn nikunyj lilaon ka varnan hai, sng men abhilasha evn vndana ke shlok bhi sngrihit hain. 2: shri yamunashtak shri yamunashtak snskrit men rachit ek ashtak hai jisaki shlok snkhya 9 hai. isamen shri yamuna ji ka yash evn unaki vndana ka varnan hai. 3: shri hit chaurasi shri hit chaurasi brajabhasha men ek pady rachana hai jisamen 84 pad snkalit hain. is granth men shri shyamashyam ki nikunj lila ka varnan hai. 4: sfut vani is granth men brajabhasha men 24 pad snkalit hain, jisamen siddhant, arati, shri shyamashyam ki nikunj lila, adi ke pad hain. in 4 rachanaon ke atirikt shri hitachary ji ke 2 patr brajabhasha gady men rachit hain. lila snvaran : jayakrishn ji ne shri hitachary ka nikunj gaman varnan karate hue likha hai ki - shri yamuna ji ke tat par manasarovar ke nikat bhandiravat hai. kusumit lalit latikaon se ramaniy is van sthali men ‘bhnvarani bhavan' namak ek nibhrit nikunj hai. is nikunj men shyama-shyam rati ras bihar kiya karate hain. sharadiy purnima [ashvin ki purnima] ki chandra-chandrika men rati ras bihar ke rasasav se aghurnit nayan shri rasik yugal jhum rahe the, ghum rahe the, unaki shri ang ki kanti chandra-kanti ko atyadhik kant bana rahi thi. shri hitachary ko priya ji ke ang ki sugandh ne apani or balat akarshit kiya. parinamath ve us sugandh ke adhar se "priya ji ! ap kahan ho ? kahan ho ?" yah kahate hue us van men ghusate hi chale gaye aur thodai der men priya ji ki anga-chandrika men ghul mil gaye. is prakar se vi. sn. 1609 ki ashvin purnima ki ratri men shri hit ji loka-drishti se ojhal ho gaye. divy kamal shri yamuna kul. vat bhandir nikat ras mul.. sntat jahn bhnvaran ki bhir. shitala-manda-sugndh samir.. jahn biharat shri ravani-ravan. takau nam bhnvarani bhavan.. sharad mas raka ujiyari. puran shashi ju prakashit bhari.. priya-jaunh men yaun mili gai. tihi chhin sahachari snbhram bhai.. kahat ki kahan-kahan ho lali. saundhe ke dore lagi chali.. drishtantar yaun shri harivnsh. manasarovar ras ke hns.. bhnvar bhnvarani men dou chalain. shri hit ju tin sng hi ralain.. samvat sorah sai ru nav, ashvin punau mas. ta din shri hit jaga-drigan, kiyau apragat vilas.. shri hariram vyas ji ne hitachary ke nikunj gaman kar jane ke falasvarup vrindavan ke rasik samaj ki durdasha aur apani hardik vedana ka varnan kiya hai - hutau ras rasikan kau adhar. binu harivnshahi saras riti kau kapai chalihai bhar.. ko radha dularavai gavai vachan sunavai char. vrindavan ki sahaj madhuri kahihai kaun udar.. pad rachana ab kapai hvai hai niras bhayau snsar. badau abhag anany sabha kau uthigau thath singar.. jin binu din chhin sat yug bitat sahaj rup agar. 'vyas' ek kul kumud bandhu binu udagan juthau thar..
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: पौढ़ी श्री वृषभान किसोरी नंद नंदन के संग - श्री छीत स्वामी (अष्टछाप कवि)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहागरौ)
पौढ़ी श्री वृषभान किसोरी नंद नंदन के संग।
कुसुम-सेज अति मृदुल ताही पर, जोरि रही अंग-अंग॥ [1]
अधर अमृत रस पीबति-प्याबति, छबि को उठति तरंग।
छीतस्वामी गिरिधरन रसिक वर, प्यारी लई उछंग॥ [2]
- श्री छीत स्वामी (अष्टछाप कवि)
english_text: (Raaga Vihgarau) Paudhai Shri Vrishabhan Kisori with Nand Nandan. Kusuma-sage is very soft on the surface, the emphasis remains on the body parts.. [1] The nectar juice is flowing in the middle, the wave is rising on the image. Chhitswami Giridharan Rasik Var, Pyaari Lai Uchhang.. [2] - Shri Chhit Swami (Ashtachhap Poet)
english_translation: (Raaga Vihgarau) Paudhai Shri Vrishabhan Kisori with Nand Nandan. Kusuma-sage is very soft on the surface, the emphasis remains on the body parts.. [1] The nectar juice is flowing in the middle, the wave is rising on the image. Chhitswami Giridharan Rasik Var, Pyaari Lai Uchhang.. [2] - Shri Chhit Swami (Ashtachhap Poet)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कुंजबिहारिनि लाड़िली मेरी जीवन प्राण श्री ललित किशोरी देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (413)
sanskrit_text:
कुंजबिहारिनि लाड़िली, मेरी जीवन प्राण।
ताहि के सुख में सुखी, मोहिं रसिक की आन॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जी की वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (413)
english_text: Kunjbiharini is a warrior, my life and soul. Tahi's happiness man is happy, Mohin Rasik's love.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ji's voice, friend of Siddhant (413)
english_translation: Kunjbiharini is a warrior, my life and soul. Tahi's happiness man is happy, Mohin Rasik's love.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ji's voice, friend of Siddhant (413)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अमंद प्रेमार्द्रात्किसलयमयात्केलिशयन - श्री विट्ठलनाथ जी (गुसाईं जी), श्री स्वामिनियाष्टकम् (5)
sanskrit_text:
अमंद प्रेमार्द्रात्किसलयमयात्केलिशयनादुषस्युत्थायाब्जारूणतर कपोलोतिरुचिरा॥
गृहंयांती श्रांति स्थगितरास्यां बुजगतं घनीभूतं राधारसमनुदिनं में वितरतु॥
- श्री विट्ठलनाथ जी (गुसाईं जी), श्री स्वामिनियाष्टकम् (5)
english_text: Amanda Premardratkisalayayatkelishayanadushsuttayabajaruntar kapolotiruchira..grihyanti shranti sthirarasyan bujgatna ghanibhootam radharsamanudin main vitratu.. - Shri Vitthalnath ji (Gusain ji), Shri Swaminishtakam (5)
english_translation: Amanda Premardratkisalayayatkelishayanadushsuttayabajaruntar kapolotiruchira..grihyanti shranti sthirarasyan bujgatna ghanibhootam radharsamanudin main vitratu.. - Shri Vitthalnath ji (Gusain ji), Shri Swaminishtakam (5)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कोटि कोटि कामधेनु कोटि कोटि कलपतरु - ब्रज के कवित्त
sanskrit_text:
कोटि कोटि कामधेनु कोटि कोटि कलपतरु,
चिंतामनि कोटि याकी समता न पावैं हैं। [1]
रमा सिव इन्द्र मुखिया हैं जिन माहिं,
तिन सौं दुरम्य ताकौ मारग बतावैं हैं॥ [2]
जाकी दिव्य महिमा कौं सकत बखानौ कोन,
रज कन हूँ के ओर छोर कौन विधि पावै हैं। [3]
ऐसी वृन्दावटी सर्वोपरि बिराजमान,
जापै हित कृपा करैं ताकौं अपनावैं हैं॥ [4]
- ब्रज के कवित्त
english_text: There are millions of Kamdhenu, millions of Kalpataru, millions of Chintamani, that is, equality has not been achieved. [1] Rama Siva Indra is the chief, who tells me the path to the three hundred Duramis.. [2] Who can tell the divine glory, who can tell me which secret or end of the kingdom, which method has been found. [3] Such Vrindavati sits supreme, pray for your welfare and please bless me.. [4] - Poet of Braj
english_translation: There are millions of Kamdhenu, millions of Kalpataru, millions of Chintamani, that is, equality has not been achieved. [1] Rama Siva Indra is the chief, who tells me the path to the three hundred Duramis.. [2] Who can tell the divine glory, who can tell me which secret or end of the kingdom, which method has been found. [3] Such Vrindavati sits supreme, pray for your welfare and please bless me.. [4] - Poet of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्यामा पग दृढ़ गहु सखी - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (236.4)
sanskrit_text:
श्यामा पग दृढ़ गहु सखी, मिलिहैं निश्चै श्याम।
न मानै दृग देख ले, श्यामा पद विच श्याम॥
 - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (236.4)
english_text: Shyam's step is a firm friend, I have definitely met you, Shyam. En maini drg dekh le, Shyama pad vich Shyam.. - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (236.4)
english_translation: Shyam's step is a firm friend, I have definitely met you, Shyam. En maini drg dekh le, Shyama pad vich Shyam.. - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (236.4)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हर्षि देहु वर मांगहूँ यशुमति जीवनमूर - श्री भक्तराम
sanskrit_text:
हर्षि देहु वर मांगहूँ, यशुमति जीवनमूर।
नित दासनके पगनकी, भक्तरामको धूर॥
- श्री भक्तराम
english_text: Harshi dehu groom manghun, Yashumati jeevanmur. Nita Dasnake Paganaki, Bhaktaramko Dhur.. - Shri Bhaktaram
english_translation: Harshi dehu groom manghun, Yashumati jeevanmur. Nita Dasnake Paganaki, Bhaktaramko Dhur.. - Shri Bhaktaram
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बलि जाऊं प्रेम-रस-सार की - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, प्रेम माधुरी (7)
sanskrit_text:
बलि जाऊं प्रेम-रस-सार की।
नागर अरु नागरी गुण-आगरी, मूरती रूप सिंगार की॥ [1]
ललित लवंग-लता-कुंजन महँ, रति-रस-सरस-बिहार की।
रास विलास-हास-परिहासन, बरसावत रस धार की॥ [2]
रूप-लुभाने जनू अलसाने, दिवाने दृग-चार की।
यह 'कृपालु' कछु अकथ कहानी, युगल-माधुरी प्यार की॥ [3]
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, प्रेम माधुरी (7)
english_text: Bali Jaun of love-lust-essence. The qualities of the city and the city, the beauty of the beauty. [1] Lalit clove-lata-kunjan mahaan, rati-rasa-saras-ki ki Bihar. Rasa-luxury-laughter-joke, rain of rasa-dhar.. [2] Beauty-alluring people, lazy, crazy about drugs. Yah 'Kripalu' tortoise untold story, couple-Madhuri love.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Prem Madhuri (7)
english_translation: Bali Jaun of love-lust-essence. The qualities of the city and the city, the beauty of the beauty. [1] Lalit clove-lata-kunjan mahaan, rati-rasa-saras-ki ki Bihar. Rasa-luxury-laughter-joke, rain of rasa-dhar.. [2] Beauty-alluring people, lazy, crazy about drugs. Yah 'Kripalu' tortoise untold story, couple-Madhuri love.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Prem Madhuri (7)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आज बनी लाड़िली प्रीतम संग आवति - श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, श्री विट्ठल विपुल देव जू की बानी (2)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विभास)
आज बनी लाड़िली प्रीतम संग आवति। [1]
सौंधे भींजी लट छूटीं, पिय के अंस भुज पाछैं,
सखी सुघर विभासहिं गावति॥ [2]
स्रम जल बिंदु निसि के सुख सूचत,
मोहन बदन सों बदन मिलावति। [3]
श्रीबीठलविपुल कल रसिक बिहारी लाल,
आनंद समुद्र मथि मदन झिलावति॥ [4]
- श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, श्री विट्ठल विपुल देव जू की बानी (2)
english_text: (Raga Vibhasa) Aaj Bani Ladaili Awati with Pritam. [1]. [3] Shri Vitthal Vipul Kaal Rasik Bihari Lal, Anand Samudra Mathi Madan Jhilavati.. [4] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Bani (2)
english_translation: (Raga Vibhasa) Aaj Bani Ladaili Awati with Pritam. [1]. [3] Shri Vitthal Vipul Kaal Rasik Bihari Lal, Anand Samudra Mathi Madan Jhilavati.. [4] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Bani (2)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सब तत्वनि कौ सार जो जुगल विहार है - श्री वंशी अलि, श्री ललिता मंगल (18)
sanskrit_text:
सब तत्वनि कौ सार जो, जुगल विहार है।
ताहू कौ पर सार, कीरती सकुँवार है॥
- श्री वंशी अलि, श्री ललिता मंगल (18)
english_text: Which is the essence of all elements, Jugal Vihar. Tahu kau par sir, Kirti Sakunwar hai.. - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Lalita Mangal (18)
english_translation: Which is the essence of all elements, Jugal Vihar. Tahu kau par sir, Kirti Sakunwar hai.. - Shri Vanshi Ali, Shri Lalita Mangal (18)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भूलै नहीं वह मंजुल माधुरि - ब्रज के सेवैया
sanskrit_text:
भूलै नहीं वह मंजुल माधुरि, मोहनि मूर्ति कहूँ पल आधा। [1]
छाक्यो रहौं छबि दम्पति की, निरखौं नव नित्य बिहार श्री राधा। [2]
त्यों दरियाव जू स्वामिनि राधिके, सेव मिलै महली सुख साधा, [3]
श्री वृषभान कुमारि कृपा करि, दे पद पंकज प्रेम अगाधा॥ [4]
- ब्रज के सेवैया
english_text: Have not forgotten that Manjul Madhuri, Mohani Murthy, should I say the moment. [1] Chhakyo rahoun chabhi couple ki, nirkhoun nav nitya bihar shri radha. [2] Tyon Dariyaav Ju Swamini Radhika, Sev Milai Mahali Sukh Sadh, [3] Shri Vrishabhan Kumari please please, give me the word Pankaj Prem Agdha.. [4] - Servant of Braj.
english_translation: Have not forgotten that Manjul Madhuri, Mohani Murthy, should I say the moment. [1] Chhakyo rahoun chabhi couple ki, nirkhoun nav nitya bihar shri radha. [2] Tyon Dariyaav Ju Swamini Radhika, Sev Milai Mahali Sukh Sadh, [3] Shri Vrishabhan Kumari please please, give me the word Pankaj Prem Agdha.. [4] - Servant of Braj.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: उलटौ पंथ है प्रेम कौ - श्री हित ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, ख्याल हुल्लास (60)
sanskrit_text:
उलटौ पंथ है प्रेम कौ, तहाँ रह्यौ मन हारि। 
जसहू सुनि लागत बुरौ, मीठी लागति गारि॥
- श्री हित ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, ख्याल हुल्लास (60)
english_text: Ulatau panth hai prem kaun, stay there you lose your mind. Jasahu Suni Lagat Burau, Mithi Lagati Gari.. - Shri Hit Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Khayal Hullas (60)
english_translation: Ulatau panth hai prem kaun, stay there you lose your mind. Jasahu Suni Lagat Burau, Mithi Lagati Gari.. - Shri Hit Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Khayal Hullas (60)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यह शोभा संसार की, ज्यों टेसू के फूल - श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (36)
sanskrit_text:
यह शोभा संसार की, ज्यों टेसू के फूल।
नारायण फल आश तजि, ललित देख जिन भूल॥
- श्री नारायण स्वामी, अनुराग रस (36)
english_text: Yes, the beauty of the world is like Tesu's flower. Narayan gives the fruit of ashes, Lalit dekh jin bhool.. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (36)
english_translation: Yes, the beauty of the world is like Tesu's flower. Narayan gives the fruit of ashes, Lalit dekh jin bhool.. - Shri Narayan Swami, Anurag Ras (36)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ब्रज मण्डल का ही सितार नहीं - ब्रज के सेवैया
sanskrit_text:
ब्रज मण्डल का ही सितार नहीं, जग तीतल का उजियारा है तू। [1]
मन मोहकता इतनी तुझमें, सबके मन को अति प्यारा है तू॥ [2]
यह जीवन क्यों न न्योछावर हो, जब जीवन का ही सहारा है तू। [3]
किस भांति बिसांरू बता तुझको, मनमोहन प्राण पियारा है तू॥ [4]
- ब्रज के सेवैया
english_text: You are not only the star of Braj Mandal, you are the light of the world. [1] There is so much charm in you, you are very dear to everyone's heart.. [2] Why should I sacrifice this life, when you are the support of life itself. [3] How Bisanru tell you, Manmohan, you are dear to my life.. [4] - Servant of Braj
english_translation: You are not only the star of Braj Mandal, you are the light of the world. [1] There is so much charm in you, you are very dear to everyone's heart.. [2] Why should I sacrifice this life, when you are the support of life itself. [3] How Bisanru tell you, Manmohan, you are dear to my life.. [4] - Servant of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधे मेरी लाडिली मेरी ओर तू देख - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
राधे मेरी लाडिली, मेरी ओर तू देख।
मैं तोहिं राखौं नयनमें, काजरकी सी रेख॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
 
श्री ठाकुर जी लाडिली जी से कहते हैं: हे मेरी प्यारी श्री राधा! आप कृपा करके एक बार मेरी ओर देखिये। मेरी यह अभिलाषा है कि मैं आपको अपने नेत्रों में सदा के लिए वैसे ही बसा लूँ, जैसे आँखों में काजल की अटूट रेखा बसी रहती है।
english_text: Radhe my dear, look at me or you. I only keep my eyes in my eyes, like Kajar's eyes.. - Couplets of Braj Shri Thakur ji says to the lady: O my dear Shri Radha! AP, please look at me once. It is my desire to keep you forever in my eyes, just like an inexhaustible line of kohl resides in my eyes.
english_translation: Radhe my dear, look at me or you. I only keep my eyes in my eyes, like Kajar's eyes.. - Couplets of Braj Shri Thakur ji says to the lady: O my dear Shri Radha! AP, please look at me once. It is my desire to keep you forever in my eyes, just like an inexhaustible line of kohl resides in my eyes.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रसिक नैन नाराचकी अजब अनोंखी रीत - श्री दयाराम जी
sanskrit_text:
रसिक नैन नाराचकी, अजब अनोंखी रीत। 
दुसमन को परसे नहीं, मारे अपनों मीत॥ 
- श्री दयाराम जी
english_text: Rasik Naan Naarachki, Ajab Anokhi Reet. Don't kill your enemies, kill your own ones.. - Shri Dayaram Ji
english_translation: Rasik Naan Naarachki, Ajab Anokhi Reet. Don't kill your enemies, kill your own ones.. - Shri Dayaram Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जाके हित में लाडिली, ताकौं विघन न कोई - श्री ललितकिशोरी देव जू की वाणी, विशिष्ट पद एवं साखी (651)
sanskrit_text:
जाके हित में लाडिली, ताकौं विघन न कोई।
ताकौ बार न बॉकाई, जो जग बैरी होइ॥
- श्री ललितकिशोरी देव, श्री ललितकिशोरी देव जू की वाणी, विशिष्ट पद एवं साखी (651)
english_text: Jake hit main ladili, takoun vighan n koi. Takou Bar En Bokai, Jo Jag Barry Hoi.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Special Post Avon Sakhi (651)
english_translation: Jake hit main ladili, takoun vighan n koi. Takou Bar En Bokai, Jo Jag Barry Hoi.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju Ki Vani, Special Post Avon Sakhi (651)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा प्यारी रूप उजारी मोतन नेक हेरो - श्री किशोरी अली जी
sanskrit_text:
(राग श्यामकल्याण)
राधा प्यारी रूप उजारी मोतन नेक हेरो।
मेरी प्यारी तन मन धन छबि ऊपर वारो नाम उचारों मैं तेरो॥ [1]
हँस मुसकाय वदन तन हेरो मोहिं करो चरणनको चेरो।
अली किशोरी एक-बार कहो लाल विहारी मेरो॥ [2]
- श्री किशोरी अली जी
english_text: (Raaga Shyamkalyan) Radha lovely form, strong and noble hero. My lovely body, mind, wealth, image, chant your name above.. [1] HNS Smile, body, body, hero, make me follow your feet. Ali Kishori, tell me once, Lal Vihari.. [2] - Shri Kishori Ali ji
english_translation: (Raaga Shyamkalyan) Radha lovely form, strong and noble hero. My lovely body, mind, wealth, image, chant your name above.. [1] HNS Smile, body, body, hero, make me follow your feet. Ali Kishori, tell me once, Lal Vihari.. [2] - Shri Kishori Ali ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मेरे पाप लिख बहीखाता धरो श्यामा - जगदगुरू श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, श्यामा श्याम गीत (146)
sanskrit_text:
मेरे पाप लिख बहीखाता धरो श्यामा।
तेरा बहीखाता जला देगा तेरा नामा॥
- जगदगुरू श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, श्यामा श्याम गीत (146)
english_text: Write down my sins and keep a ledger account, Shyama. Your ledger will burn your name.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (146)
english_translation: Write down my sins and keep a ledger account, Shyama. Your ledger will burn your name.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (146)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मंगल मनि आनंद निधि, परम प्रेम रस रूप - श्री किशोर दास, श्री वृंदाविपुन विलास (14)
sanskrit_text:
मंगल मनि आनंद निधि, परम प्रेम रस रूप।
ऐसे वृंदाविपिन की, उपमा अमित अनूप॥
- श्री किशोर दास, श्री वृंदाविपुन विलास (14)
english_text: Mangal Mani Anand Nidhi, supreme love juice form. Such is the simile of Vrindavipin, Amit Anup.. - Shri Kishore Das, Shri Vrindavipun Vilas (14)
english_translation: Mangal Mani Anand Nidhi, supreme love juice form. Such is the simile of Vrindavipin, Amit Anup.. - Shri Kishore Das, Shri Vrindavipun Vilas (14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: गैल श्रीवृन्दावनकी गहिये - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (228)
sanskrit_text:
(राग देस)
गैल श्रीवृन्दावनकी गहिये।
सेवाकुंज कौनमें बैठे जुगुललाल छवि लहिये॥ [1]
रसिकनके पग चांपि हुलसिये श्यामगौर मुख कहिये।
'ललितकिशोरी' जाविधि राखैँ ताहीविधि मन रहिये॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (228)
english_text: (Raaga Desa) Gail Srivrindavanki Gahiye. Sitting in the Seva Kunj corner, carry the image of Jugulalal.. [1] Say the steps of Rasikana, say Shyamgaur Mukh. 'Lalit Kishori' Keep the Javidhi in mind.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (228)
english_translation: (Raaga Desa) Gail Srivrindavanki Gahiye. Sitting in the Seva Kunj corner, carry the image of Jugulalal.. [1] Say the steps of Rasikana, say Shyamgaur Mukh. 'Lalit Kishori' Keep the Javidhi in mind.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (228)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीनागरीदास अनन्य धन, धर्म सुदृढ उर धारि - श्री नागरीदेव जी, श्री नागरीदेव जु की वाणी (15)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीनागरीदास अनन्य धन, धर्म सुदृढ उर धारि।
दंपति सम्पति संचि हियै, सुख सोवो पाँव पसारि॥
- श्री नागरीदेव जी, श्री नागरीदेव जु की वाणी( 15)
english_text: Shringari Das has other wealth and religion. The couple's wealth is gone, happiness is spread everywhere... - Shri Nagaridev Ji, Shri Nagaridev Ju's speech (15)
english_translation: Shringari Das has other wealth and religion. The couple's wealth is gone, happiness is spread everywhere... - Shri Nagaridev Ji, Shri Nagaridev Ju's speech (15)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जाके दरश को जग तरसत है - श्री सूरदास
sanskrit_text:
(राग केदार)
जाके दरश को जग तरसत है 
ताहि दरश तू दे मेरी प्यारी। [1]
जाकी मुरली की धुनि सुर मोहे 
ता तन नेक चितै मेरी प्यारी॥ [2] 
शिव विरंचि जाको पार न पावत 
सो तेरे पग परसै री प्यारी। [3]
सूरदास वश तीन लोक जाके 
सो तेरे वश है मेरी प्यारी॥ [4]
- श्री सूरदास
english_text: (Rag Kedaara) JK the world longs for the sight, please give it to me my dear. [1] The tune of the flute of Murli is pleasing to my heart, my dear.. [2] Shiv Viranchi, go beyond the path, so your steps are crossed my dear. [3] If I go to three worlds under the influence of Surdas, it is under your control my dear.. [4] - Shri Surdas
english_translation: (Rag Kedaara) JK the world longs for the sight, please give it to me my dear. [1] The tune of the flute of Murli is pleasing to my heart, my dear.. [2] Shiv Viranchi, go beyond the path, so your steps are crossed my dear. [3] If I go to three worlds under the influence of Surdas, it is under your control my dear.. [4] - Shri Surdas
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जो कछु सो तुव चरन बल, नहिं मेरो उपकार - श्री हरिव्यास देवाचार्य, महावानी, सहज सुख (17)
sanskrit_text:
जो कछु सो तुव चरन बल, नहिं मेरो उपकार। 
मोहिं बड़ाई देति हौ, अहु स्वामिनी सुखसार॥ 
- श्री हरिव्यास देवाचार्य, महावानी, सहज सुख (17)
english_text: Whatever I say is your power, not my favor. Mohin, you praise me, oh my lord, happiness.. - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (17)
english_translation: Whatever I say is your power, not my favor. Mohin, you praise me, oh my lord, happiness.. - Shri Harivyas Devacharya, Mahavani, Sahaj Sukh (17)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री राधा पद भक्ति रस 'रस वृन्दावन' माँहि - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
श्री राधा पद भक्ति रस, 'रस वृन्दावन' माँहि।
यह राधा रस धवलि है, या में संशय नाँहि॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: Shri Radha Paad Bhakti Ras, 'Ras Vrindavan' is prohibited. Or Radha's juice is white, or the heart's love is small.. - braj ke dohe
english_translation: Shri Radha Paad Bhakti Ras, 'Ras Vrindavan' is prohibited. Or Radha's juice is white, or the heart's love is small.. - braj ke dohe
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन धाम अपार जपे जा राधे राधे - श्री अली माधुरी जी
sanskrit_text:
वृन्दावन धाम अपार जपे जा राधे राधे।
जपे जा राधे राधे भजे जा राधे राधे॥ [1]
जो राधा राधा गावे सो प्रेम पदारथ पावे।
बाको बेड़ा हो जाय पार जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [2]
जो राधानाम न हो तो, रस राज विचारो रोतो।
नहीं हो तो कृष्ण अवतार जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [3]
या वृन्दावन की लीला मत समझो गुड़ को चीला।
यामें सुर नर मुनि गये हार जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [4]
बृन्दावन रास रचायो शिव गोपी भेष बनायो।
हो वंशीवट कियो विहार जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [5]
यह प्रेम की अकथ कहानी, नहीं समझै ज्ञानी ध्यानी।
हो याहि समझें बृज की नारि, जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [6]
या बृन्दावन में आयो, तेने राधा नाम न गायो।
तेरे जीवन को धिक्कार, जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [7]
राधा बृषभान दुलारी, श्रीकृष्णचन्द्र की प्यारी।
हो वह कीरति राज कुमार, जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [8]
मोहन मुरली में गावे, वन वन में धेनु चरावे।
सुनि-सुनि मगन होंय बृज नारि, जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [9]
या वृन्दावन के वासी, श्री राधा नाम उपासी।
हो यहाँ है रहो नित्य विहार, जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [10]
कुञ्जन में रास रचायो, 'श्रीअलीमाधुरी' गायो।
वह निरखें नित्य विहार, जपे जा राधे राधे॥ [11]
- श्री अली माधुरी जी
english_text: Vrindavan Dham, chant immense Radhe Radhe. Chant Ja Radhe Radhe Bhaje Ja Radhe Radhe.. [1] Whoever gives Radhe Radhe gets the object of love. The rest of the fleet should be on Jai and chant Radhe Radhe.. [2] If there is no Radhanam, then think of Rasa Raj and cry. If not, then go chant Krishna Avtaar, Radhe Radhe.. [3] or don't consider it as the leela of Vrindavan, screaming for the anus. Yamen Sur Nar Muni Gaye Har Jape Ja Radhe Radhe.. [4] Brindavan Rasa Rachayo Shiva disguised as Gopi. Ho Vanshivat Kiyo Vihar Japa Ja Radhe Radhe.. [5] This is an untold story of love, the knowledgeable meditator cannot understand it. Ho, this is the woman of Brij, go and chant Radhe-Radhe.. [6] Or you came to Brindavan, you did not remember the name of Radha. Curse your life, go chant Radhe-Radhe.. [7] Radha Brishabhan Dulari, beloved of Shri Krishnachandra. Ho wow Kirti Raj Kumar, chant Japa Radhe Radhe.. [8] Mohan Murli Purusha De, Van Van Purush Dhenu graze. Listen, listen, be happy Brij Nari, chant Radhe-Radhe.. [9] Or residents of Vrindavan, devotees of the name of Shri Radha. You are here, stay here daily, chant Radhe Radhe.. [10] Kunjan, create joy in your mind, 'Shrilimadhuri' is gone. Wah Nirakhen Nitya Vihar, Jape Ja Radhe Radhe.. [11] - Shri Ali Madhuri Ji

The rest of the fleet should be on Jai and chant Radhe Radhe.. [2] If there is no Radhanam, then think of Rasa Raj and cry. If not, then go chant Krishna Avtaar, Radhe Radhe.. Ho wow Kirti Raj Kumar, chant Japa Radhe Radhe.. [8] Mohan Murli Purusha De, Van Van Purush Dhenu graze. Listen, listen, be happy Brij Nari, chant Radhe-Radhe.. [9] Or residents of Vrindavan, devotees of the name of Shri Radha. You are here, stay here daily, chant Radhe Radhe.. [10] Kunjan, create joy in your mind, 'Shrilimadhuri' is gone. title: बाँकौ मारग प्रेम कौ कहत बनै नहिं बैन - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
बाँकौ मारग प्रेम कौ, कहत बनै नहिं बैन।
नैना श्रवन जु होत हैं, श्रवन होत हैं नैन॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: Banakau marga prem kaun, kahat ban nahi banaye. Naina Shravan Ju is hot, Shravan is hot Nain.. - couplets of Braj
english_translation: Banakau marga prem kaun, kahat ban nahi banaye. Naina Shravan Ju is hot, Shravan is hot Nain.. - couplets of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारी तौपै कितौक संग्रह छबिन कौ - श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (66)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
प्यारी तौपै कितौक संग्रह छबिन कौ
अंग अंग प्रति नाना भाइ दिखावति। [1]
हाथ किन्नरी मध्य सचु पाँइ सुलप 
राग रागिनी सौं तू मिलि गावति॥ [2]
कहा कहौं एक जीभ गुन अगनित 
हारि परयौ कछु कहत न आवति। [3]
श्रीहरिदास के स्वामी स्याम कहत री प्यारी
तू जे जे भाई ल्यावति॥ [4]
- ललिता अवतार श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (66)
english_text: (Raaga Saranga) Pyari Taupai Kitauk Sangra Chhabeen Kau Ang Ang Prati Nana Bhai Dekhawati. [1]. [3] Sri Haridas's Swami Syam Kahat Ri Pyari Tu JJ Bhai Lyavati.. [4] - Lalita Avatar Sri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (66)
english_translation: (Raaga Saranga) Pyari Taupai Kitauk Sangra Chhabeen Kau Ang Ang Prati Nana Bhai Dekhawati. [1]. [3] Sri Haridas's Swami Syam Kahat Ri Pyari Tu JJ Bhai Lyavati.. [4] - Lalita Avatar Sri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (66)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रसिक कहावै सोइ जाके दम्पति मिलन चटपटी - चाचा वृन्दावन दास जी
sanskrit_text:
रसिक कहावै सोइ जाके, दम्पति मिलन चटपटी।
वृन्दावन हित रूप प्रेम की, जानों सृष्टि अटपटी॥
- श्री हित वृन्दावन दास जी
english_text: Rasik kahawai soi JK, couple meeting chatpati. Vrindavan Hit form of love, Janan Srishti Atapati.. - Shri Hit Vrindavan Das Ji

title: कब बइकुण्ठ माहिं गायन चराय आए - श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, छूटक कवित्त (100)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
कब बइकुण्ठ माहिं गायन चराय आए,
कौंन रिझवारि उहाँ बँधी प्रेम पास तैं। [1]
कब बइकुण्ठ माहिं मोहनी बजी है बैंन,
प्यारिन कैं हेत रास रंग के विलास तैं॥ [2]
कब बैकुण्ठ माहिं केलि कीनी इहाँ जैसी,
कहूँ कैसी - कैसी जिय नागर हुलास तैं। [3]
व्रज ही समंधी रूप लीला सब जग गाई,
पाई परमेसुर हूँ शोभा व्रज बास तैं॥ [4]
- श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, छूटक कवित्त (100)
english_text: (Poem) When does the mountain of heaven graze the singing, which Rishavari is the love bound there? [1] When is the month of Vaikuntha, Mohini Baji is banned, for the sake of my beloved, there are luxuries of rosy colors.. [2] When is the month of Vaikuntha, why is it like this here, how should I say - what kind of life the city has. [3] Vraj is the sandhi rupa leela of the whole world, Pai Paramesura is the glory of Vraj… [4] - Shri Nagaridas (Maharaj Sawant Sinha), Shri Nagaridas ji ki vani, Chhutak Kavita (100)

[2] When is the month of Vaikuntha, why is it like this here, how should I say - what kind of life the city has. [3] Vraj is the sandhi rupa leela of the whole world, Pai Paramesura is the glory of Vraj… [4] - Shri Nagaridas (Maharaj Sawant Sinha), Shri Nagaridas ji ki vani, Chhutak Kavita (100)

title: राग मुक्त मन शुद्ध ह्वै विगत ज्ञान अज्ञान - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
राग मुक्त मन शुद्ध ह्वै, विगत ज्ञान अज्ञान।
प्रेमी के सुख में सुखी, यह स्वभाव अब आन॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: The mind free from attachment becomes pure, past knowledge is ignorant. The happiness of the lover, the man is happy, this nature is now unknown.. - Couplets of Braj
english_translation: The mind free from attachment becomes pure, past knowledge is ignorant. The happiness of the lover, the man is happy, this nature is now unknown.. - Couplets of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा मंगल नाम है, राधा मंगल रूप - श्री ब्रजजीवन जी
sanskrit_text:
राधा मंगल नाम है, राधा मंगल रूप।
राधा मूल संजीवनी, राधा केलि अनूप॥ [1]
राधा कृपा कटाक्ष की लागी हिय बौछार।
राधा गुन सुमिरन कथन छिन-छिन नित्य-विहार॥ [2]
जाग्रत सुपने सैन में हिय राधा कौ ध्यान।
अंतर-बाहर दिस-विदिस वही रूप मंडरान॥ [3]
- श्री ब्रजजीवन जी
english_text: The name is Radha Mangal, the form is Radha Mangal. Radha Mool Sanjivani, Radha Keli Anup.. [1] Radha Kripa is a child of sarcasm. Radha's virtues are remembered by saying 'Chhin-chhin Nitya-Vihar'. Antar-Bahar Disa-Vidis Vahi Roop Mandaran.. [3] - Shri Brajjeevan Ji
english_translation: The name is Radha Mangal, the form is Radha Mangal. Radha Mool Sanjivani, Radha Keli Anup.. [1] Radha Kripa is a child of sarcasm. Radha's virtues are remembered by saying 'Chhin-chhin Nitya-Vihar'. Antar-Bahar Disa-Vidis Vahi Roop Mandaran.. [3] - Shri Brajjeevan Ji

title: हरिनाम है केवल नित यहाँ - डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
हरिनाम है केवल नित यहाँ, सब विश्व अनित्य विचारना सीखो। [1]
परनिन्दा असत्य विवाद तजौ, मुख से 'हरे कृष्ण' उचारना सीखो॥ [2]
निज नैन चकोर बना करके, मनमोहन रूप निहारना सीखो। [3]
प्राणयेश अवश्य मिलेगा तुम्हें, तुम प्रेम से नेक पुकारना सीखो॥ [4]
- डंडी स्वामी श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’
english_text: (Savaiya) Harinam is only here daily, learn to think about the whole world eternally. [1] Avoid slander, untruth and controversy, learn to utter 'Hare Krishna' from your mouth.. [2] Make your eyes square and learn to look at the charming form. [3] You will definitely get Pranayash, you learn to call Nek with love.. [4] - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnananda Saraswati 'Hare Krishna'
english_translation: (Savaiya) Harinam is only here daily, learn to think about the whole world eternally. [1] Avoid slander, untruth and controversy, learn to utter 'Hare Krishna' from your mouth.. [2] Make your eyes square and learn to look at the charming form. [3] You will definitely get Pranayash, you learn to call Nek with love.. [4] - Dandi Swami Shri Hare Krishnananda Saraswati 'Hare Krishna'
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीजमुना जी वा पार है मान सरोवर स्वक्ष - श्री हित रूप लाल, श्री वृंदावन स्मरण (87)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीजमुना जी वा पार है, मान सरोवर स्वक्ष।
गंगा जमुना कौ भयौ, संगम इहां प्रतक्ष॥
- श्री हित रूप लाल, श्री वृंदावन स्मरण (87)
english_text: Shri Jamuna ji is beyond, mind is the lake of self. Who should fear Ganga and Jamuna, the confluence is visible here.. - Shri Hit Roop Lal, Shri Vrindavan Smaran (87)
english_translation: Shri Jamuna ji is beyond, mind is the lake of self. Who should fear Ganga and Jamuna, the confluence is visible here.. - Shri Hit Roop Lal, Shri Vrindavan Smaran (87)
