title: लालहिं बस करनी, मदन मन हरनी - श्री विट्ठल विपुल देव जू की वाणी (8)
sanskrit_text:
(राग बिलावल)
लालहिं बस करनी, मदन मन हरनी,
मल्हकि पग धरनी, उरज उदित री। [1]
हेमलता की फरनी, श्रमजल की झरनी,
निकट सुता तरनी, बदन मुदित री॥ [2]
रूप सुधा की भरनी, मोपै क्यों आवै बरनी,
पिय टकटरनी, तृषित छुधित री। [3]
रस बस कै बरनी, विपुल प्रेम परनी,
‘श्रीबीठल’ कुंज घरनी, बिहारी बुधित री॥ [4]
- श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, श्री विट्ठल विपुल देव जू की वाणी (8)
english_text: (Rag Bilawala) Lalhin bas karni, madan man harani, malhaki pag dharani, uraj udit ri. [1]. [3] Ras Bas Kai Barani, Vipul Prem Parani, 'Shribithala' Kunj Gharani, Bihari Budhit Ri.. [4] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (8)
english_translation: (Rag Bilawala) Lalhin bas karni, madan man harani, malhaki pag dharani, uraj udit ri. [1]. [3] Ras Bas Kai Barani, Vipul Prem Parani, 'Shribithala' Kunj Gharani, Bihari Budhit Ri.. [4] - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju Ki Vani (8)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जो त्रिय होइ न हरि की दासी
sanskrit_text:
जो त्रिय होइ न हरि की दासी।
कीजै कहा रूप गुण सुन्दर, नाहिंन श्याम उपासी॥
तौ दासी गणिका सम जानो दुष्ट राँड़ मसवासी।
निसिदिन अपनों अंजन मंजन करत विषय की रासी॥
परमारथ स्वप्ने नहिं जानत अन्ध बंधी जम फाँसी॥
 
यदि ये तीन रसिक शिरोमणि संत स्वामी श्री हरिदास, श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, और रसिक अनन्य श्री हरिराम व्यास अवतार नहीं लेते, तो वृंदावन की माधुर्य भक्ति रस उसी प्रकार होता जैसे कि एक सुंदर महिला हो जिसमें समस्त अच्छे गुण तो विद्यमान हो परंतु वह कृष्ण की उपासना भक्ति न करती हो अर्थात् भक्ति रहित हो। वह स्त्री गणिका की उस दासी (वैश्या) के समान है जो प्रतिदिन केवल शारीरिक कामनाओं एवं विषय वासनाओं से ग्रस्त हो। ऐसी सुंदर स्त्री होते हुए भी वह परमाथ के विषय में स्वप्न में भी कुछ नहीं जानती, और यमराज के द्वारा प्रताड़ित किए जाने योग्य है, वह एक अंधे व्यक्ति को यमराज द्वारा फांसी पर लटकाए जाने के समान है।
english_text: The three who are Hari's maids. Who said that my beauty and beauty are beautiful, but Shyam Upasi is not the same.. but I know you to be like a maid courtesan and an evil scoundrel. Rasi of the subject of Nisidi Apnano Anjan Manjan Karat.. Paramarath dream nahin jaant blind bandhi jam phasi.. If these three Rasik Shiromani Saint Swami Shri Haridas, Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, and other Rasik Shri Hariram Vyas do not incarnate, then Madhushala of Vrindavan Bhakti Rasa is the same as if there is a beautiful woman who has all the good qualities but does not inspire devotion by worshiping Lord Krishna, i.e. Be devoid of devotion. Wow, a woman is like a courtesan's maid (Vaishya) who suffers only from physical desires and sensual desires every day. Despite being such a beautiful woman, she does not know anything about Paramath even in her dreams, and is worthy of attaining the door of Yamraj, she is like a blind man being hanged on a fence at the door of Yamraj.

title: कोउ सुकिया, कोउ परकिया, कलपि किये मत बादि - श्री भगवत रसिक जी की वाणी, निर्विरोध मनरंजन (5)
sanskrit_text:
कोउ सुकिया, कोउ परकिया, कलपि किये मत बादि।
जोरी भगवतरसिक की, नित्य अनंत अनादि॥ [1]
नित्य अनंत अनादि, लोक ते रीति विलक्षन।
स्तृति-असतृती बिलगाइ, देखि अनुभव के अक्षम॥ [2]
सहज प्रेम माधुर्य रहत अनुरागे दोउ।
ललिता सखी प्रसार, बिना तहॅ जात न कोउ॥ [3]
- श्री भगवत रसिक, भगवत रसिक की वाणी, निर्विरोध मनरंजन (5)
english_text: Kou Sukia, Kou Parkiya, Kalapi Kiye Don't Bari. Jori of Bhagwatarsik, Nitya Anant Aadi.. [1] Nitya Anant Aadi, Unique in the manner of the world. Woman - unattainable, incapable of seeing. Lalita Sakhi Prasar, Bina Tahe Jat Na Kou.. [3] - Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik's speech, unopposed entertainment (5)
english_translation: Kou Sukia, Kou Parkiya, Kalapi Kiye Don't Bari. Jori of Bhagwatarsik, Nitya Anant Aadi.. [1] Nitya Anant Aadi, Unique in the manner of the world. Woman - unattainable, incapable of seeing. Lalita Sakhi Prasar, Bina Tahe Jat Na Kou.. [3] - Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik's speech, unopposed entertainment (5)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: और कोऊ समझै सो समझे - श्री हित रामदास
sanskrit_text:
और कोऊ समझै सो समझे, हमकूँ इतनी समझ भली। 
ठाकुर नन्दकिशोर हमारे, ठकुराइन वृषभानु लली॥
- श्री हित रामराय
 
जिसे जो समझना हो समझे, हमें तो बस इतनी ही समझ भली है कि हमारे ठाकुर-ठकुराइन केवल श्री राधा-कृष्ण ही हैं।
english_text: And if someone understands then he should understand, it is good for us to understand so much. Thakur Nand Kishore is ours, Thakurain Vrishabhanu Lali.. - Shri Hit Ram Rai, whoever understands whatever, we have only understood that our Thakur-Thakurain are only Shri Radha-Krishna.
english_translation: And if someone understands then he should understand, it is good for us to understand so much. Thakur Nand Kishore is ours, Thakurain Vrishabhanu Lali.. - Shri Hit Ram Rai, whoever understands whatever, we have only understood that our Thakur-Thakurain are only Shri Radha-Krishna.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हौं वृषभानु नन्दिनि भजौं - श्री वंशी अलि
sanskrit_text:
हौं वृषभानु नन्दिनि भजौं।
जुगल की सहचरि कहावति माँहि मन के लजौं॥ [1]
रहत जद्यपि लाल ढिंग ही कुंवरि के दिनरात।
हौं न जानौं गौर छबि सों अटकि साँवर गात॥ [2]
करि अलिंगन रहत छिन-छिन लाल गोरी संग।
मम नैन मुख श्रीराधिका के नाँहि दूजौ अंग॥ [3]
तहाँ ही लपटी विलोकों लाल मन की प्रीति।
तासु नाते नन्द-सुत सों बन गयी कछु रीति॥ [4]
श्रीराधिकापदकमल बिनु मम ह्रदय नाँहिन और।
जै श्रीवंशीअलि कहत टेरें करत जग में रौर॥ [5]
- श्री वंशी अलि
english_text: I am Vrishabhanu and worship Nandini. Jugal's companion says, 'Manhi man ke lajaun'. I don't want to pay attention to the beauty of this beauty.. [2] Kari remains in embrace with the beautiful red girl. Mam, eyes, face, little two parts of Shri Radhika.. [3] The love of the red heart lies there. Being Tasu, Nand-Sut's son became Kachu Riti. [4] Shri Radhika Padkamal Binu Mama Hriday Nahi and. Jai Shrivanshiali kahat tere kart mein roor jag.. [5] - Shri Vanshi Ali
english_translation: I am Vrishabhanu and worship Nandini. Jugal's companion says, 'Manhi man ke lajaun'. I don't want to pay attention to the beauty of this beauty.. [2] Kari remains in embrace with the beautiful red girl. Mam, eyes, face, little two parts of Shri Radhika.. [3] The love of the red heart lies there. Being Tasu, Nand-Sut's son became Kachu Riti. [4] Shri Radhika Padkamal Binu Mama Hriday Nahi and. Jai Shrivanshiali kahat tere kart mein roor jag.. [5] - Shri Vanshi Ali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बिगरी लेहि सँवारि कै - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (149)
sanskrit_text:
बिगरी लेहि सँवारि कै, श्रीकुंजबिहारिनि बाल।
और न ऐसो करि सकै, अपने को प्रतिपाल॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (149)
english_text: Bigri lehi sanwari kai, Shrikunjbiharini force. And she could not do it like this, every moment... - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, friend of Siddhant (149)
english_translation: Bigri lehi sanwari kai, Shrikunjbiharini force. And she could not do it like this, every moment... - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, friend of Siddhant (149)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीवृन्दावन चन्द छवि - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, श्री वृंदावन शतक (7)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीवृन्दावन चन्द छवि, कापर बरनी जाय।
काकी समता दीजिये, रही गिरा सिरनाय॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, श्री वृंदावन शतक (7)
english_text: Sri Vrindavan Chand Chhavi, Kapar Barani Jai. Aunty, give me equality, the head will remain.. - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Shri Vrindavan Shatak (7)
english_translation: Sri Vrindavan Chand Chhavi, Kapar Barani Jai. Aunty, give me equality, the head will remain.. - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Shri Vrindavan Shatak (7)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हमारी सर्वस राधारानी - श्री हित गोपाल दास, निकुंज रस वल्लरी (119)
sanskrit_text:
(राग भीमपलासी, त्रिताल)
हमारी सर्वस राधारानी।
जिनकी कृपा सों ही पायी वृंदावन रजधानी॥ [1]
मो निर्धन को धन श्रीश्यामा,  सेवाकुंज महारानी।
श्रीगोपाल हित नवल प्रिया ने, विनती सुनी हम जानी॥ [2]
- श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (119)
english_text: (Raaga Bhimpalasi, Tritala) Our Sarvas Radharani. By whose grace the son came to be the capital of Vrindavan. [1] He gave wealth to the poor, Shreeshyama, Sevakunj Maharani. Shri Gopal Hit Naval Priya Ne, Vanti Suni Hum Jaani.. [2] - Shri Hit Gopal Das [Seva Kunj Vele], Nikunj Ras Vallari (119)
english_translation: (Raaga Bhimpalasi, Tritala) Our Sarvas Radharani. By whose grace the son came to be the capital of Vrindavan. [1] He gave wealth to the poor, Shreeshyama, Sevakunj Maharani. Shri Gopal Hit Naval Priya Ne, Vanti Suni Hum Jaani.. [2] - Shri Hit Gopal Das [Seva Kunj Vele], Nikunj Ras Vallari (119)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: पाछैं बैठे मोहन मृगनैंनींकी बैंनी गुहत - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, उत्तरार्ध (44)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
पाछैं बैठे मोहन मृगनैंनींकी बैंनी गुहत,
सोभा न कही परै देखत नैंन सिरात। [1]
नखछबि रवि जानि पानि-कमल फूले,
निकसि चली अलि सैंनी अधरात॥ [2]
मानौं वारिज विधुसौं रिपु मति तजि,
सदल सुधा पीवत न अघात। [3]
श्याम-भुजंगिनिके डर डोरी बांधत,
व्यासकी स्वामिनीकौ सुंदर अकुलात॥ [4]
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, उत्तरार्ध (44)
english_text: (Raga Saranga) Sitting behind me is Mohan Mriganin's tiny cave, Sobha kahi kahi parai dekh nanan sirat. [1] Nakhchabi Ravi Jani water-lotus blossomed, Niksi chali Ali Saini Adharat.. [2] Manaun Varij Vidhusaun Ripu Mati Taji, Sadal Sudha Pivat Na Aghat. [3] A string is tied between the shoulders of Shyama-Bhujanginike, Vyasaki Swaminikau Sundar Akulat.. [4] - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, second half (44)
english_translation: (Raga Saranga) Sitting behind me is Mohan Mriganin's tiny cave, Sobha kahi kahi parai dekh nanan sirat. [1] Nakhchabi Ravi Jani water-lotus blossomed, Niksi chali Ali Saini Adharat.. [2] Manaun Varij Vidhusaun Ripu Mati Taji, Sadal Sudha Pivat Na Aghat. [3] A string is tied between the shoulders of Shyama-Bhujanginike, Vyasaki Swaminikau Sundar Akulat.. [4] - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, second half (44)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तेरे बने बिनु जीना जीना नहिं श्यामा - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, श्यामा श्याम गीत (151)
sanskrit_text:
तेरे बने बिनु जीना जीना नहिं श्यामा।
यूँ तो पेट भर लेते शूकर ग्रामा॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, श्यामा श्याम गीत (151)
english_text: Without you, Jeena Jeena, not Shyama. Like this, a village of pigs can fill the stomach.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (151)
english_translation: Without you, Jeena Jeena, not Shyama. Like this, a village of pigs can fill the stomach.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (151)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: किसोरी मोकौं दै श्री वृन्दावन वास - श्री लाल बलबीर
sanskrit_text:
किसोरी मोकौं दै श्री वृन्दावन वास। [1]
चाहे सो कीजै श्रीसुन्दरि पूजौ मन की आस॥ [2]
खग मृग लता रेनु द्रुम बेली निरखों रास बिलास। [3]
दासी जान आन उर स्वामिनि कीजै रूप प्रकाश॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, श्री वृन्दावन शतक (54)
english_text: Where is Kisori where Shri Vrindavan resides? [1] Whatever you want, worship Shri Sundari as per your heart.. [2] Khag Mrig Lata Renu Drum Beli Nirkhon Ras Bilas. [3] Daasi Jan An Ur Swamini Kijai Roop Prakash.. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Shri Vrindavan Shatak (54)
english_translation: Where is Kisori where Shri Vrindavan resides? [1] Whatever you want, worship Shri Sundari as per your heart.. [2] Khag Mrig Lata Renu Drum Beli Nirkhon Ras Bilas. [3] Daasi Jan An Ur Swamini Kijai Roop Prakash.. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Shri Vrindavan Shatak (54)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा पद रज स्वाति जल चातक मेरौ हीय - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
राधा पद रज स्वाति जल, चातक मेरौ हीय।
मोती से अंसुआ ढरैं, मनुआ मन भरि पीय॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: Radha Pad Raj Swati Jal, Chatak Merau Hiy. Tears shed from pearls, Manua's heart drinks heavily.. - couplets from Braj
english_translation: Radha Pad Raj Swati Jal, Chatak Merau Hiy. Tears shed from pearls, Manua's heart drinks heavily.. - couplets from Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आनँद की मूरति देखौ माई - श्री हित कमलनैन, श्री हित कमलनैन जी की वाणी, अष्टायामी पदावली (57)
sanskrit_text:
आनँद की मूरति देखौ माई।
नन्दनन्दन-वृषभानुदुलारी, कैसैं रहे लपटाई॥ [1]
अंगनि-अंग अनंग विराजत, निरखि-निरखि मेरौ मन ललचाई।
जैश्रीकमलनैंन हित यह सुख नैंननि, संतत रहौ समाई॥ [2]
- श्री हित कमलनैन, श्री हित कमलनैन जी की वाणी, अष्टायामी पदावली (57)
english_text: Look at the image of Anand, mother. Nandanandan-Vrishabhanudulari, how can you wrap up. [1] Sitting in every part of every part, my mind yearned for nothing. Jayashrikamalannain Hit Yah Sukh Nainnani, Santat Raho Samai.. [2] - Shri Hit Kamalnain, Speech of Shri Hit Kamalnain Ji, Ashtyami Padavali (57)
english_translation: Look at the image of Anand, mother. Nandanandan-Vrishabhanudulari, how can you wrap up. [1] Sitting in every part of every part, my mind yearned for nothing. Jayashrikamalannain Hit Yah Sukh Nainnani, Santat Raho Samai.. [2] - Shri Hit Kamalnain, Speech of Shri Hit Kamalnain Ji, Ashtyami Padavali (57)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बार बार मनाय युग पद - श्री ब्रजवासीदास, ब्रज विलास
sanskrit_text:
बार बार मनाय युग पद, नाथ पद माँगहूँ।
ह्वैं रहौं वृंदा विपिन रज, तव चरण पंकज लागहूँ॥
- श्री ब्रजवासीदास, ब्रज विलास
english_text: I repeatedly ask for the post of Many Yug, the post of Nath. Where should I be Vrinda Vipin Raj, where should I be with Pankaj.. - Shri Brajvasidas, Braj Vilas
english_translation: I repeatedly ask for the post of Many Yug, the post of Nath. Where should I be Vrinda Vipin Raj, where should I be with Pankaj.. - Shri Brajvasidas, Braj Vilas
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: "प्रेम मैं है सदा देना देना, सोचना भी नहीं कुछ है लेना, लेने वाला बरा भोला भला, ब्रज के रसिकों मैं शामिल नहीं है" -जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज
sanskrit_text:
"प्रेम मैं है सदा देना देना, सोचना भी नहीं कुछ है लेना, लेने वाला बरा भोला भला, ब्रज के रसिकों मैं शामिल नहीं है"
-जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज 


प्यार हमें देने और देने का सबक सिखाता है। जो कुछ पाने की इच्छा से प्यार करता है, वह निर्दोष है और ब्रज के रसिक संतों की श्रेणी में नहीं आता है।
english_text: “Love is always giving, there is nothing to think about taking, the one who takes is innocent and is not included among the lovers of Braj” - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj Love teaches us the lesson of giving and giving. One who loves with the desire to get something, is innocent and does not fall in the category of a rasik child of Braj.
english_translation: “Love is always giving, there is nothing to think about taking, the one who takes is innocent and is not included among the lovers of Braj” - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj Love teaches us the lesson of giving and giving. One who loves with the desire to get something, is innocent and does not fall in the category of a rasik child of Braj.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सुख बर्धन मर्दन गरब, गोबर्धन गुन खान - श्रीराधा प्रिया जी (राधिकानाथ जी)
sanskrit_text:
सुख बर्धन मर्दन गरब, गोबर्धन गुन खान।
सेवन करि राधा प्रिया, श्री वृंदावन जान॥
- श्रीराधा प्रिया जी (राधिकानाथ जी)
english_text: Sukh Bardhan Mardan Garb, Gobardhan Gun Khan. Seva Kari Radha Priya, Sri Vrindavan Jan.. - Sri Radha Priya Ji (Radhikanath Ji)
english_translation: Sukh Bardhan Mardan Garb, Gobardhan Gun Khan. Seva Kari Radha Priya, Sri Vrindavan Jan.. - Sri Radha Priya Ji (Radhikanath Ji)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: घर घर टहल करत है लक्ष्मी - श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह जी) की वाणी, छूटक पद (133)
sanskrit_text:
घर घर टहल करत है लक्ष्मी, छिन कतहूं नहिं जाय।
व्रज वृन्दावन सुख वैभव लखि, मुक्ति रही सिरनाय॥
- श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह जी), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, छूटक पद (133)
english_text: Lakshmi wanders from house to house, Jai, I don't say anything. Vraj Vrindavan is blessed with happiness and glory, freedom is in its head... - Shri Nagaridas (Maharaj Sawant Singh Ji), words of Shri Nagaridas Ji, Chhutak Pad (133)
english_translation: Lakshmi wanders from house to house, Jai, I don't say anything. Vraj Vrindavan is blessed with happiness and glory, freedom is in its head... - Shri Nagaridas (Maharaj Sawant Singh Ji), words of Shri Nagaridas Ji, Chhutak Pad (133)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मुरली की माला करी, नन्द लाला बस हेत - श्री नागरीदास जी (महाराज सावंत सिंह जी), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, व्रज सार (16)
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
जाकैं लियें सिन्धु मथ्यौ करि के जु श्रम भारी,
ताकी छटा जग में भई प्रकाशमान हैं। [1]
तन सुख त्यागैं नर ताकैं काज तप करैं,
देव औ अदेव चहैं कृपा सरसान हैं॥ [2]
ब्रह्म विश्व जानी वैकुण्ठरानी सर्वोपर,
"नागर" कहाँ लौं करौं प्रभुता बखान हैं। [3]
ऐसी ये रमा सो ताके पायन पलोटैं,
सो तो राधा पद जावक की सेवा में सुजान हैं॥ [4]
- श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह जी), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, ब्रज सार (23)
english_text: (Poem) Because of the heavy labor of the Sindhu Mathew Kari, so that the brothers are bright in the world. [1] I have renounced the pleasures of the body and performed penance for every work, God and non-gods want grace.. [2] Brahma is the creator of the world and is the supreme queen, where can I go to “city” to proclaim my sovereignty. [3] In this way, this Ram sleeps on the throne, so Radha is happy in the service of the outgoing one.. [4] - Shri Nagaridas (Maharaj Sawant Singh Ji), Shri Nagaridas Ji's speech, Braj Saar (23)
english_translation: (Poem) Because of the heavy labor of the Sindhu Mathew Kari, so that the brothers are bright in the world. [1] I have renounced the pleasures of the body and performed penance for every work, God and non-gods want grace.. [2] Brahma is the creator of the world and is the supreme queen, where can I go to “city” to proclaim my sovereignty. [3] In this way, this Ram sleeps on the throne, so Radha is happy in the service of the outgoing one.. [4] - Shri Nagaridas (Maharaj Sawant Singh Ji), Shri Nagaridas Ji's speech, Braj Saar (23)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: विष ले खाई आग में जरौ,  श्री यमुना में बूड़ ही मरौ, वृंदावन छाड़ौं नहिं  - श्री अनन्य अली
sanskrit_text:
विष ले खाई आग में जरौ, 
श्री यमुना में बूड़ ही मरौ,
वृंदावन छाड़ौं नहिं॥ 
- श्री अनन्य अली
english_text: Take poison in the fire, kill the old man in Shri Yamuna, don't leave Vrindavan.. - Shri Ananya Ali
english_translation: Take poison in the fire, kill the old man in Shri Yamuna, don't leave Vrindavan.. - Shri Ananya Ali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री सरसदेव जी की जीवनी
sanskrit_text:
परिचय :
श्री सरसदेव जी अपने पूर्वाचार्यों के समान ही सरस एवं परम रसिक अनन्य हुए हैं जो सदैव श्री श्यामा कुँजबिहारी को अपने ह्रदय में बसाये रहते। जीव मात्र इनका मित्र था, पर्वत राज के समान भारी होते हुए भी स्वयं को लघु मानते थे। आकाश के समान स्वच्छ एवं ह्रदय की गहराइयों में प्रेम समाये हुए घने बादलों के समान करुणा बरसानेवाले थे। ये समुद्र के समान गंभीर, पृथ्वी के समान क्षमाशील तथा जल के समान नम्र थे। इनका शरीर अग्नि के समान तेजस्वी तथा पवन के समान स्वछन्द था। नित्य विहार केलि के मूर्तिमान रस रूप थे। इनकी ऑंखें कमल की कोमल पंखुड़ियों के समान विशाल थे एवं जब मुख से कुछ कहते तो लगता वाणी से पुष्प झर रहे हैं। चंद्र के समान शीतल एवं सूर्य के समान प्रकाशवान थे। रसिक भक्तगण सहज ही इनके पास आते एवं इष्ट के रस में डूबते-उतराते।
श्री सरसदेव श्री स्वामी हरिदास कुल के महंतमणि थे जिन्होंने अखंड वृन्दावन वास किया। नित्य विहार रस का उल्लास ही इनका सुख था।
english_text: Introduction: Shri Sarasdev ji, like his predecessors, has been a very charming and extremely lovable person who always keeps Shri Shyama Kunjbihari in his heart. The living being was his only friend, despite being as heavy as a mountain king, he considered himself small. He was as pure as the sky and showered compassion like thick clouds filled with love deep in his heart. He was fierce in front of the sea, forgiving in front of the earth and humble in front of the water. His body was as bright as fire and as free as the wind. Nitya Vihar was the personified form of Keli. His eyes were as big as the soft petals of a lotus and whenever he spoke from his mouth, it seemed as if flowers were falling from his speech. The cool forests of the moon were the bright forests of the sun. The interested devotees would easily come to him and immerse themselves in the joy of love. Shri Sarasdev Shri Swami was the Mahantmani of Haridas clan who resided in unbroken Vrindavan. The joy of Nitya Vihar Raas was their happiness.
english_translation: Introduction: Shri Sarasdev ji, like his predecessors, has been a very charming and extremely lovable person who always keeps Shri Shyama Kunjbihari in his heart. The living being was his only friend, despite being as heavy as a mountain king, he considered himself small. He was as pure as the sky and showered compassion like thick clouds filled with love deep in his heart. The cool forests of the moon were the bright forests of the sun. The interested devotees would easily come to him and immerse themselves in the joy of love. Shri Sarasdev Shri Swami was the Mahantmani of Haridas clan who resided in unbroken Vrindavan. The joy of Nitya Vihar Raas was their happiness.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तजि सब आस, करै वृन्दावन वास खास - श्री छबीले जी
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
तजि सब आस, करै वृन्दावन वास खास,
कुंजन की सेवा में, निशंक चित धारे हैं। [1]
जप, तप, योग, यज्ञ, संयम, समाधि, राग,
ज्ञान, ध्यान, धारणा में मन नाहीं धारे हैं॥ [2]
देव, पितृ, भैरव, भवानी, भूत, प्रेत आदि
लोक-परलोक ते छबीले भये न्यारे हैं। [3]
एक बात जानैं, कछु दूजी पहिचानत नाहीं।
हम हैं श्रीबाँकेबिहारी जी के, बिहारी जू हमारे हैं॥ [4]
- श्री छबीले जी
english_text: (Poem) I do everything as is, Vrindavan is special, I am in the service of Kunjan, without any doubt. [1] Japa, penance, yoga, yagya, restraint, samadhi, attachment, knowledge, meditation, dharana are not in the mind of men. [2] Dev, Pitra, Bhairav, Bhavani, ghost, ghost etc. are different from the world and the other world. [3] Know one thing, do not know anything else. We are Shri Banke Bihari ji, Bihari is ours.. [4] - Shri Chhabile ji
english_translation: (Poem) I do everything as is, Vrindavan is special, I am in the service of Kunjan, without any doubt. [1] Japa, penance, yoga, yagya, restraint, samadhi, attachment, knowledge, meditation, dharana are not in the mind of men. [2] Dev, Pitra, Bhairav, Bhavani, ghost, ghost etc. are different from the world and the other world. [3] Know one thing, do not know anything else. We are Shri Banke Bihari ji, Bihari is ours.. [4] - Shri Chhabile ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्रात: स्मरामि युग-केलिरसाभिषिक्तं - जगद्गुरु आद्यनिम्बार्काचार्य, प्रात: स्मरण स्त्रोत (1)
sanskrit_text:
प्रात: स्मरामि युग-केलिरसाभिषिक्तं, वृन्दावनं सुरमणीयमुदारवृक्षम्।
सौरीप्रवाह वृतमात्मगुणप्रकाशं, युग्मांघ्रिरेणुकणिकाञ्चितसर्वसत्त्वम्॥
- जगद्गुरु आद्यनिम्बार्काचार्य, प्रात: स्मरण स्त्रोत (1)
english_text: Received: Smrami Yuga-Kelirasabhishiktna, Vrindavan Suramanyamudravruksham. Solar flow: Vritmatmagunprakashan, Yugmanghrunukniknikanyachitsarvasattvam. - Jagadguru Adyanimbarkacharya, Received: Memory Source (1)
english_translation: Received: Smrami Yuga-Kelirasabhishiktna, Vrindavan Suramanyamudravruksham. Solar flow: Vritmatmagunprakashan, Yugmanghrunukniknikanyachitsarvasattvam. - Jagadguru Adyanimbarkacharya, Received: Memory Source (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्यारी तेरे ललित चरन पिय वंदै-  श्री रूप सखी जी की वाणी, श्रृंगार रस के पद (514)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विहागरौ)
प्यारी तेरे ललित चरन पिय वंदै।
कोटि इंदु वदनारबिंद दुति देत चिनौती चंदै॥ [1]
अरुन अधर लोचन रतनारे जीतैं चाल गयंदै।
रूप रसिक वृन्दावन रानी मोद सदा आनंदै॥ [2]
- श्री रूप सखी, श्री रूप सखी जी की वाणी, श्रृंगार रस के पद (514)
english_text: (Raaga Vihgarau) Pyaari tere lalit charan piya vandai. Koti indu vadanarbind duti det chinauti chhandai..[1] Arun adhar lochan ratnare jiten chal gandai. Roop Rasik Vrindavan Rani Mod Sada Anandai.. [2] - Shri Roop Sakhi, Shri Roop Sakhi Ji's speech, verses of Shringaar Ras (514)
english_translation: (Raaga Vihgarau) Pyaari tere lalit charan piya vandai. Koti indu vadanarbind duti det chinauti chhandai..[1] Arun adhar lochan ratnare jiten chal gandai. Roop Rasik Vrindavan Rani Mod Sada Anandai.. [2] - Shri Roop Sakhi, Shri Roop Sakhi Ji's speech, verses of Shringaar Ras (514)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधे तू बड़भागिनी कौन तपस्या कीन - श्री परमानन्द दास जी
sanskrit_text:
राधे तू बड़भागिनी, कौन तपस्या कीन।
तीन लोक के नाथ हरि, सो तेरे आधीन॥
- श्री परमानन्द दास जी
english_text: Radhe, you are a bad girl, what penance is there? Lord Hari of three worlds, I am under you.. - Shri Parmanand Das Ji
english_translation: Radhe, you are a bad girl, what penance is there? Lord Hari of three worlds, I am under you.. - Shri Parmanand Das Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री रूपसखी जी की जीवनी
sanskrit_text:
जन्म एवं अध्यात्म :
श्री रूपसखी जी का जन्म बुन्देलखण्ड में हुआ। हरिदासी सम्प्रदाय के श्रीस्वामी रसिकदेव जी के चरणों में आपकी असीम प्रीति थी जो आपके गुरु थे। आप अहर्निश सखीस्वरूप से नित्यविहार की भावना परिचर्या में तत्पर तल्लीन रहते थे। रसिक अनन्य जनों में अगाध प्रेम निष्ठा थी। इसलिए आपकी वाणी और रसानुभव अत्यन्त सरस हैं तथा उसमें विनम्रता, सरलता और कृतज्ञता आदि विशेष गुण हैं। अपने गुरु भाई श्री ललितकिसोरी के प्रति कृतज्ञता प्रकट करते हुए आपने कहा है
english_text: Birth Avon Spirituality: Shri Roopsakhi ji was born in Bundelkhand. You had immense love for the feet of Shri Swami Rasikdev Ji of Haridasi sect who was your Guru. AP Aharnish used to live in Tallin ready to introduce the spirit of daily living as a friend. Rasik had immense love and devotion for other men. That is why your speech and taste are very pleasant and it has special qualities like humility, simplicity and gratitude etc. While expressing my gratitude towards my guru brother Shri Lalit Kishori, I have said that

title: उठती अभिलाषा यही उर में -  श्री हरे कृष्णानन्द सरस्वती ‘हरे कृष्ण’
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
उठती अभिलाषा यही उर में, उनके बनमाल का फूल बनूँ। [1]
कटि काछनी हो लिपटूँ कटि में, अथवा पट पीत दुकूल बनूँ॥ [2]
हरे कृष्ण! पियूँ अधरामृत को, यही मैं मुरली रस मूल बनूँ। [3]
पद पीड़िता हो सुख पाऊँ महा, कहीं भाग्य से जो ब्रज धूलि बनूँ॥ [4]
- श्री हरे कृष्ण जी
english_text: (Savaiya) The desire that arises is to become the flower of your man, his wealth. [1] Kati Kachhani Ho Liptun Kati Purush, or Pat Pit Dukul Banun.. [2] Hare Krishna! Drink this nectar of nectar, here I become the origin of Murli Rasa. [3] There may be pain and happiness, but by fate I may become dusty in Braj.. [4] - Shri Hare Krishna Ji
english_translation: (Savaiya) The desire that arises is to become the flower of your man, his wealth. [1] Kati Kachhani Ho Liptun Kati Purush, or Pat Pit Dukul Banun.. [2] Hare Krishna! Drink this nectar of nectar, here I become the origin of Murli Rasa. [3] There may be pain and happiness, but by fate I may become dusty in Braj.. [4] - Shri Hare Krishna Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: धन धन वृन्दावन में राधारानी - श्री अभयराम, वृंदावन रहस्य विनोद (3)
sanskrit_text:
धन धन वृन्दावन में राधारानी।
रवि शशि जाके रहैं पहरुआ
मुक्ति भरै तहाँ पानी॥ [1]
पवन आयके झाडू देवे
इन्द्र छिरकै पानी।
अभयराम रज वनकी महिमा
तीन लोक ने जानी॥ [2]
- श्री अभयराम, वृंदावन रहस्य विनोद (3)
english_text: Radharani in Dhan Dhan Vrindavan. Ravi Shashi keeps going, the guard fills the water there with salvation.. [1] The wind comes and gives the broom, Indra keeps the water flowing. Three worlds knew the glory of Abhayram Rajvan.. [2] - Shri Abhayram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (3)
english_translation: Radharani in Dhan Dhan Vrindavan. Ravi Shashi keeps going, the guard fills the water there with salvation.. [1] The wind comes and gives the broom, Indra keeps the water flowing. Three worlds knew the glory of Abhayram Rajvan.. [2] - Shri Abhayram, Vrindavan Rahasya Vinod (3)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मन लाग्यो गिरधर गावै - श्री कृष्णदास, श्री कृष्णदास अधिकारी जी की वाणी
sanskrit_text:
(राग भैरव)
मन लाग्यो गिरधर गावै।
ततथेई ततथेई तत तत ताथेई,
भैरौं राग मिल मुरली बजावै॥ [1]
नाचत नव वृषभानु दुलारी,
अवधर गति में गति उपजावै।
गिरधर पिय प्यारी की पदरज,
कृष्ण दास लै शीश चढ़ावै॥ [2]
- श्री कृष्णदास, श्री कृष्णदास अधिकारी जी की वाणी
english_text: (Raag Bhairav) I felt like singing Girdhar. Tatathi tatathi, bhairaun raga mil murli bajavai.. [1] Nachat naav vrishabhanu dulari, avadhar gati mein gati upajvai. Girdhar Piya Piyari's father, Krishna Das takes his head and offers his head.. [2] - Shri Krishnadas, Shri Krishnadas Adhikari ji's speech
english_translation: (Raag Bhairav) I felt like singing Girdhar. Tatathi tatathi, bhairaun raga mil murli bajavai.. [1] Nachat naav vrishabhanu dulari, avadhar gati mein gati upajvai. Girdhar Piya Piyari's father, Krishna Das takes his head and offers his head.. [2] - Shri Krishnadas, Shri Krishnadas Adhikari ji's speech
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कोटिक तीरथ न्हाइप - श्री रूपरसिक देवाचार्य, श्री वृंदावन माधुरी (72)
sanskrit_text:
कोटिक तीरथ न्हाइप, कोटिक करौ उपाव।
पैवो नाहिंन विपिन सुख, बिना सहचरी भाव॥
- श्री रूपरसिक देवाचार्य, श्री वृंदावन माधुरी (72)
english_text: Kotik tirath nahap, kotik karau upav. Paivo Nahinna Vipin Sukha, Bhava without companion.. - Shri Ruprasik Devacharya, Shri Vrindavan Madhuri (72)
english_translation: Kotik tirath nahap, kotik karau upav. Paivo Nahinna Vipin Sukha, Bhava without companion.. - Shri Ruprasik Devacharya, Shri Vrindavan Madhuri (72)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भुक्ति-मुक्ति-स्पृहा यावत् पिशाची हृदि वर्तते - श्री रूप गोस्वामी, भक्ति रसामृत सिंधु (1.2.22)
sanskrit_text:
भुक्ति-मुक्ति-स्पृहा यावत् पिशाची हृदि वर्तते।
तावद् भक्ति-सुखस्यात्र कथम् अभ्युदयो भवेत्॥
- श्री रूप गोस्वामी, भक्ति रसामृत सिंधु (1.2.22)
english_text: Bhukti-Mukti-Spruha Yavat Pishachi Hridi Vartate. Tavad Bhakti-Sukhasyatra Katham Abhyudayo Bhavet.. - Sri Rupa Goswami, Bhakti Rasamrita Sindhu (1.2.22)
english_translation: Bhukti-Mukti-Spruha Yavat Pishachi Hridi Vartate. Tavad Bhakti-Sukhasyatra Katham Abhyudayo Bhavet.. - Sri Rupa Goswami, Bhakti Rasamrita Sindhu (1.2.22)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन फुलवारि में, पहिरि फूल उरमाल - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (61)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
वृन्दावन फुलवारि में, पहिरि फूल उरमाल। 
बिहरत श्री बृषभानुजा, नंदनंदन गोपाल॥
english_text: (Doha) Vrindavan Phulwari Purush, Pahiri Phul Urmaal. Bihar Shri Brishabhanuja, Nandanandan Gopal.
english_translation: (Doha) Vrindavan Phulwari Purush, Pahiri Phul Urmaal. Bihar Shri Brishabhanuja, Nandanandan Gopal.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा हरि हरि राधिका बनि आए संकेत - श्री बिहारी लाल, बिहारी सतसई (343)
sanskrit_text:
राधा हरि हरि राधिका, बनि आए संकेत।
दम्पति रति-बिपरीत-सुखु, सहज सुरत हूँ लेत॥
- श्रीमहाकवी बिहारी लाल, बिहारी सतसई (343)
english_text: Radha Hari Hari Radhika, Bani Aye Snket. Couple Rati-Viparita-Sukhu, Sahaj Surat Hun Let.. - Shri Mahakavi Bihari Lal, Bihari Satsai (343)
english_translation: Radha Hari Hari Radhika, Bani Aye Snket. Couple Rati-Viparita-Sukhu, Sahaj Surat Hun Let.. - Shri Mahakavi Bihari Lal, Bihari Satsai (343)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कोटि ब्रह्म ऐश्वर्यता वैभवता की वारि - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (32)
sanskrit_text:
कोटि ब्रह्म ऐश्वर्यता, वैभवता की वारि।
व्यासदासकी कूँवरिकौं, अब को सकै निहारि॥ 
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (32)
english_text: Koti Brahma opulence, splendor of wealth. Vyasdasa's virgin wife, now she is unable to look at me. - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant's Sakhi (32)
english_translation: Koti Brahma opulence, splendor of wealth. Vyasdasa's virgin wife, now she is unable to look at me. - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant's Sakhi (32)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री ललित किशोरी जी की जीवनी (गौड़ीय संप्रदाय)
sanskrit_text:
जन्म :
श्री ललित किशोरी जी का जन्म लखनऊ में मिती कार्तिक कृष्णा में द्वितीय दिन सन 1825 में हुआ था। इनके पितामह शाह बिहारीलालजी उस समय लखनऊ में प्रसिद्ध धनाढ्य थे नवाबों से उनको “शाह" उपाधि प्राप्त थी। उनके ज्येष्ठ पुत्र शाह गोविंदलालजी की द्वितीय पत्नी के गर्भ से श्री ललित किशोरी जी का जन्म हुआ। इनका नाम शाह कुंदनलाल हुआ। इनके छोटे भाई का नाम शाह फुंदनलाल था।
english_text: Birth: Shri Lalit Kishori ji was born in Lucknow on the second day of Kartik Krishna in 1825. His grandfather Shah Biharilalaji was a famous rich man of our time and received the title of "Shah" from the Nabaabs. Shri Lalit Kishori ji was born from the womb of his eldest son Shah Govindlalji's second wife. His name was Shah Kundanlal. His younger brother's name was Shah Fundanlal.
english_translation: Birth: Shri Lalit Kishori ji was born in Lucknow on the second day of Kartik Krishna in 1825. His grandfather Shah Biharilalaji was a famous rich man of our time and received the title of "Shah" from the Nabaabs. Shri Lalit Kishori ji was born from the womb of his eldest son Shah Govindlalji's second wife. His name was Shah Kundanlal. His younger brother's name was Shah Fundanlal.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तेरौई ध्यान राधिका प्यारी गोवर्द्धनधर लालहिं - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री हित स्फुट वाणी (17)
sanskrit_text:
(राग गौरी)
तेरौई ध्यान राधिका प्यारी गोवर्द्धनधर लालहिं।
कनक लता सी क्यों न बिराजत, अरुझी श्याम तमालहिं॥ [1]
गौरी गान सुतान ताल गहि, रिझवति क्यौं न गुपालहिं।
यह जोवन कंचन-तन ग्वालिन, सफल होत इहिं कालहि॥ [2]
मेरे कहैं विलंब न करि सखि, भूरि भाग अति भालहिं।
(जैश्री) हित हरिवंश उचित हौं चाहति, श्याम कंठकी मालहिं॥ [3]
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री हित स्फुट वाणी (17)
english_text: (Raag Gauri) Terui Dhyan Radhika Pyari Govardhandhar Lalhin. Why not sit like Kanak Lata, Aruzhi Shyam Tamalahin.. [1] Gauri Gan Sutan Taal Gahi, Rijhwati why not Gupalhin. This young golden-bodied cowherd is becoming successful here.. [2] My friend, don't hesitate in saying this, the brown part is very good. (Jayashree) Hit Harivansh is appropriate, I want it, Shyam Kanthaki Malahin.. [3] - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Hit Sphut Vani (17)
english_translation: (Raag Gauri) Terui Dhyan Radhika Pyari Govardhandhar Lalhin. Why not sit like Kanak Lata, Aruzhi Shyam Tamalahin.. [1] Gauri Gan Sutan Taal Gahi, Rijhwati why not Gupalhin. This young golden-bodied cowherd is becoming successful here.. [2] My friend, don't hesitate in saying this, the brown part is very good. (Jayashree) Hit Harivansh is appropriate, I want it, Shyam Kanthaki Malahin.. [3] - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Hit Sphut Vani (17)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रे मन अरु सब छाँडि कै - श्री ध्रुवदास जी, बयालीस लीला, मन शिक्षा लीला (7)
sanskrit_text:
रे मन अरु सब छाँडि कै, जो अटकै इक ठौर।
वृन्दावन घन कुंज में, जहाँ रसिक शिरमौर॥
- श्री ध्रुवदास जी, बयालीस लीला, मन शिक्षा लीला (7)
english_text: Hey mind and all the verses, which are stuck at one place. In Vrindavan Ghan Kunj, where Rasik Shirmaur.. - Shri Dhruvdas Ji, Bayalis Leela, Man Shiksha Leela (7)
english_translation: Hey mind and all the verses, which are stuck at one place. In Vrindavan Ghan Kunj, where Rasik Shirmaur.. - Shri Dhruvdas Ji, Bayalis Leela, Man Shiksha Leela (7)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जहाँ कृष्ण राधा तहाँ - श्री भगवत रसिक, भगवत रसिक जी की वाणी, निर्विरोध मनरंजन (4)
sanskrit_text:
जहाँ कृष्ण राधा तहाँ, जहँ राधा तहँ कुष्ण।
न्यारे निमिष न होत दोउ, समुझि करौ यह प्रश्न॥ [1]
समुझि करौ यह प्रश्न, दोउ घन दामिनि जैसे।
सहज सुभाइ सुतंत्र, निरंतर बिहरत तैसे॥ [2]
भगवतरसिक अनन्य, बिना कोउ जात नहीं तहँ।
दंपति संपति - सहित, मदन रस रंग भरे जहँ॥ [3]
- श्री भगवत रसिक, भगवत रसिक जी की वाणी, निर्विरोध मनरंजन (4)
english_text: Where there is Krishna, there is Radha, where there is Radha, there is Kushna. There is no blinking, dou, understand this question.. [1] Understand this question, dou ghan damini like. Sahaj Subhai Sutantar, Continuous Biharat Taise.. [2] Others like God, without Kou there is no caste there. Dnapati Snapati - Sahit, Madan Ras Rang Bhare Jahan.. [3] - Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik ji's voice, unopposed entertainment (4)
english_translation: Where there is Krishna, there is Radha, where there is Radha, there is Kushna. There is no blinking, dou, understand this question.. [1] Understand this question, dou ghan damini like. Sahaj Subhai Sutantar, Continuous Biharat Taise.. [2] Others like God, without Kou there is no caste there. Dnapati Snapati - Sahit, Madan Ras Rang Bhare Jahan.. [3] - Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik ji's voice, unopposed entertainment (4)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री वंशी अलि जी की जीवनी
sanskrit_text:
वंश परंपरा :
श्री नाभा दास जी ने भक्तमाल ग्रंथ में श्रीमद्भागवत के महा पंडित श्री नारायण मिश्र जी का एक छप्पय में चरित्र गान किया है। यह नवला वंश के सारस्वत ब्राह्मण थे। श्रीमद्भागवत के मनन चिंतन से सहज ही ब्रज धाम के प्रति अनुराग उत्पन्न हो गया और ब्रज वास की इच्छा से मथुरा पधारें। शेष जीवन मथुरा वास करते हुए इन्हें यहीं ब्रज रज की प्राप्ति हुई। इन्हीं के वंशज श्री प्रद्युम्न गोस्वामी जी श्री धाम वृंदावन में श्रृंगार वट के निकट ललित कुंज में अपने ठाकुर श्री किशोरी रमन जी की सेवा में रहते थे। यह परम विद्वान एवं प्रभावशाली व्यक्ति थे। इनके सैंकड़ों शिष्य सेवक थे।
english_text: Vanshavali Paranapara: Shri Nabha Das ji has sung the character of Maha Pandit Shri Narayan Mishra ji of Shrimad Bhagwat in one Chhappay in Bhaktamal Granth. He was a Saraswat Brahmin of Navala dynasty. By meditating on Shrimad Bhagwat, love for Braj Dham naturally arose and the desire to reside in Braj came to Mathura. He lived in Mathura for the rest of his life and attained the kingdom of Braj here. His descendant Shri Pradyumna Goswami ji lived in the service of his Thakur Shri Kishori Raman ji in Lalit Kunj near Shringar Vat in Shri Dham Vrindavan. Yah: a very learned and influential person. He had hundreds of disciples and servants.
english_translation: Vanshavali Paranapara: Shri Nabha Das ji has sung the character of Maha Pandit Shri Narayan Mishra ji of Shrimad Bhagwat in one Chhappay in Bhaktamal Granth. He was a Saraswat Brahmin of Navala dynasty. By meditating on Shrimad Bhagwat, love for Braj Dham naturally arose and the desire to reside in Braj came to Mathura. He lived in Mathura for the rest of his life and attained the kingdom of Braj here. His descendant Shri Pradyumna Goswami ji lived in the service of his Thakur Shri Kishori Raman ji in Lalit Kunj near Shringar Vat in Shri Dham Vrindavan. Yah: a very learned and influential person. He had hundreds of disciples and servants.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कोउ याहि फाँसी कहत, कोउ कहत तरवार - श्री रसखान, प्रेम वाटिका (29)
sanskrit_text:
कोउ याहि फाँसी कहत, कोउ कहत तरवार।
नेजा भाला तीर कोउ, कहत अनोखी ढार॥
- श्री रसखान, प्रेम वाटिका (29)
english_text: Some call it fancy, some call it fancy. Neja Bhala Teer Kou, Kahat Unique Edge.. - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (29)
english_translation: Some call it fancy, some call it fancy. Neja Bhala Teer Kou, Kahat Unique Edge.. - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (29)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कोटि भजन एकादसी - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (237)
sanskrit_text:
कोटि भजन एकादसी, कोटि तीर्थ अस्नान।
दुखवै काहू संत कौं, (तौ) हरि नहिं करैं प्रमान॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (237)
english_text: Millions of Bhajan Ekadashi, millions of pilgrimage asanas. Who can say sad saint, (Tau) Hari can't prove.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, friend of principle (237)
english_translation: Millions of Bhajan Ekadashi, millions of pilgrimage asanas. Who can say sad saint, (Tau) Hari can't prove.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, friend of principle (237)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: पूरब पुन्यनि ते चितई जिन ये - श्री रसखान
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
पूरब पुन्यनि ते चितई जिन ये अँखियाँ मुसकानि भरी जू।
कोऊ रहीं पुतरी सी खरी कोउ घाट डरी कोउ बाट परी जू॥ [1]
जे अपने घरहीं रसखानि कहै अरु हौसनि जाति मरी जू।
लाल जे बाल बिहाल करी ते बिहाल करी न निहाल करी जू॥ [2]
- श्री रसखान
english_text: (Savaiya) Purab Puniyaani Te Chitai Jin Ye Ankhiyaan Musakani Bhari Ju. Who are you standing like a daughter, where are you standing and what are you talking about? [1] Where are the kitchens in your home and the people of the Hausani caste? Lal je bal bihal kari te bihal kari na nihal kari ju.. [2] - Shri Raskhana
english_translation: (Savaiya) Purab Puniyaani Te Chitai Jin Ye Ankhiyaan Musakani Bhari Ju. Who are you standing like a daughter, where are you standing and what are you talking about? [1] Where are the kitchens in your home and the people of the Hausani caste? Lal je bal bihal kari te bihal kari na nihal kari ju.. [2] - Shri Raskhana
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: नथवारी रंगीली महलवारी ब्रज रास बरसाने वारी- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालुजी महाराज
sanskrit_text:
नथवारी रंगीली महलवारी ब्रज रस बरसाने वारी 
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालुजी महाराज


जिनका धाम श्री बरसाना हैं एवं जो रंगीली महल मे विराजमान हैं, तथा जिनके नासिका मे नथमणि विराजमान है, वे श्री राधा महारानी हैं, जो सदैव ब्रज रस बरसाने वाली हैं।
english_text: Nathawari Rangili Mahalawari Braj Ras Barsane Vari - Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, whose abode is Sri Barsana and who is seated in Rangili Mahal, and in whose nostrils Nathamani is seated, is Shri Radha Maharani, who is always showering Braj Ras.
english_translation: Nathawari Rangili Mahalawari Braj Ras Barsane Vari - Jagadguru Shri Kripaluji Maharaj, whose abode is Sri Barsana and who is seated in Rangili Mahal, and in whose nostrils Nathamani is seated, is Shri Radha Maharani, who is always showering Braj Ras.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तीनों लोकों से न्यारी राधा रानी हमारी - ब्रज के लोकगीत
sanskrit_text:
तीनों लोकों से न्यारी राधा रानी हमारी
रानी हमारी महारानी हमारी।
ब्रह्मा शंकर पार न पावें
ऋषि मुनि सब ध्यान लगावें
इन्द्र लगावें बुहारी, राधारानी हमारी। [1]
तीनों लोकों से न्यारी……..
नित उठ दरशन करने आवत
सुन्दर श्याम चरण दोऊ धावत
चरणों के चाकर मुरारी, राधारानी हमारी। [2]
तीनों लोकों से न्यारी……..
एक बार जो बोले राधा
जन्म जन्म की मिट जाये व्याधा
इनके चरणों पै जाऊँ बलिहारी, राधारानी हमारी। [3]
- ब्रज के लोकगीत

तीनों लोकों से न्यारी श्री राधारानी हमारी हैं, महारानी हमारी हैं।
ब्रह्मा एवं भगवान शिव भी उनका पार नहीं पा सकते,
ऋषि मुनिगण उन्हीं के चरणों का ध्यान करते हैं,
इन्द्र वहां बुहारी लगाते हैं, ऐसी महारानी श्री राधारानी हमारी हैं। [1]

श्री कृष्ण नित्य उठकर उनका दर्शन करने आते हैं,
वे उनके चरणों की सेवा करते हैं,
श्री कृष्ण उनके चरण कमलों के चाकर हैं, ऐसी महारानी श्री राधारानी हमारी हैं। [2]

जो एक बार अपने मुख से श्री राधा नाम का उच्चारण करता है, उसकी जन्म-जन्म की बाधा मिट जाती है।
इनके चरण कमलों पर मैं स्वयं को न्योंछावर करता हूँ, ऐसी महारानी श्री राधारानी हमारी हैं। [3]
english_text: Radha Rani is unique from all the three worlds, our queen, our queen. Let all the holy sages and sages concentrate on Brahma Shankar and Indra and Buhari, Radharani is ours. [1] Different from the three worlds… wake up every day and see the beautiful dark feet of Murari, our Radharani, servant of the flowing feet. [2] Unique from the three worlds….. Once you say that Radha is born, the diseases will be eradicated, Jaun Balihari at her feet, Radharani is ours. [3] - Folk songs of Braj, Shri Radharani is ours, the queen is ours, different from the three worlds. Even Brahma and Lord Shiva could not overcome her, sages and sages meditate on her feet, Indra worships her there, such a queen Shri Radharani is ours. [1] Shri Krishna comes to see him daily, he serves his feet, Shri Krishna visits his lotus feet, such Queen Shri Radharani is ours. [2] One who once pronounces the name Shri Radha from his mouth, the obstacles of his births are removed. I offer myself at her lotus feet, such is our queen Shri Radharani. [3]
english_translation: Radha Rani is unique from all the three worlds, our queen, our queen. Let all the holy sages and sages concentrate on Brahma Shankar and Indra and Buhari, Radharani is ours. [1] Different from the three worlds… wake up every day and see the beautiful dark feet of Murari, our Radharani, servant of the flowing feet. [2] Unique from the three worlds….. Once you say that Radha is born, the diseases will be eradicated, Jaun Balihari at her feet, Radharani is ours. [3] - Folk songs of Braj, Shri Radharani is ours, the queen is ours, different from the three worlds. Even Brahma and Lord Shiva could not overcome her, sages and sages meditate on her feet, Indra worships her there, such a queen Shri Radharani is ours. [1] Shri Krishna comes to see him daily, he serves his feet, Shri Krishna visits his lotus feet, such Queen Shri Radharani is ours. [2] One who once pronounces the name Shri Radha from his mouth, the obstacles of his births are removed. I offer myself at her lotus feet, such is our queen Shri Radharani. [3]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अन्तःकरण मद्वाक्यं - महाप्रभु श्री वल्लभाचार्य, अन्तःकरण प्रबोध (1)
sanskrit_text:
अन्तःकरण मद्वाक्यं सावधानतया शृणु।
कृष्णात्परं नास्ति दैवं वस्तुतो दोषवर्जितम्॥
- महाप्रभु श्री वल्लभाचार्य, अन्तःकरण प्रबोध (1)
english_text: Antahkaran madvakyam savdhanata shrunu. Krishnatparna nasti daivan vastu doshavarjitam. - Mahaprabhu Shri Vallabhacharya, Antakarana Prabodh (1)
english_translation: Antahkaran madvakyam savdhanata shrunu. Krishnatparna nasti daivan vastu doshavarjitam. - Mahaprabhu Shri Vallabhacharya, Antakarana Prabodh (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आप ही मखेश्वरी क्रियेश्वरी स्वधेश्वरी है - श्री जयरामदेव
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
आप ही मखेश्वरी क्रियेश्वरी स्वधेश्वरी है,
देवे सी त्रिवेद भारतीश्वरी अधारी है। [1]
आप ही प्रमाण शासनेश्वरी रमेश्वरी है,
क्षमेसी प्रमोद काननेश्वरी निहारी है॥ [2]
कवि जय रामदेव ऐसी श्री बृजेश्वरी के,
चरणन कोटि-कोटि वन्दना हमारी है। [3]
राधे जू कृपाकटाक्ष मोपर करोगी कब,
आये हम स्वामिनीजू शरण तिहारी है॥ [4]
- श्री जयरामदेव
english_text: (Poetry) AP is Makheshwari Kriyashwari Swadheshwari, Deve Si Triveda Bharatishwari is Adhari. [1] AP is the proof, Shaneshwari is Rameshwari, Kshamesi Pramod Kaneshwari is Nihari.. [2] Poet Jai Ramdev, we worship such Shri Brijeshwari at his feet. [3] When will you curse Radhe, oh we are the ones who take refuge in us.. [4] - Shri Jairamdev
english_translation: (Poetry) AP is Makheshwari Kriyashwari Swadheshwari, Deve Si Triveda Bharatishwari is Adhari. [1] AP is the proof, Shaneshwari is Rameshwari, Kshamesi Pramod Kaneshwari is Nihari.. [2] Poet Jai Ramdev, we worship such Shri Brijeshwari at his feet. [3] When will you curse Radhe, oh we are the ones who take refuge in us.. [4] - Shri Jairamdev
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: व्यास कनक अरु कामिनी - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (106)
sanskrit_text:
व्यास कनक अरु कामिनी, तजियै भजियै दूरी।
हरिसौं अंतर पारिहैं, मुख दै जैहैं धूरि॥
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (106)
english_text: Vyas Kanak aru Kamini, tajiyai bhajiyai duri. Harisaun antar parihain, mukha dei jaihain dhuri.. - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant's Sakhi (106)
english_translation: Vyas Kanak aru Kamini, tajiyai bhajiyai duri. Harisaun antar parihain, mukha dei jaihain dhuri.. - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Siddhant's Sakhi (106)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्रान धन वृन्दावन ताकौं न विसार मन - श्री प्रेमदास जी
sanskrit_text:
प्रान धन वृन्दावन ताकौं न विसार मन,
निरख लतान छबि उमड़ी परत हैं। [1]
नैंन भर ढारैं हेर हेर मतवारे संत,
कदली कदम्ब अंब मन को हरत हैं॥ [2]
झुके हैं तमाल-वट रज कौं नबत माथ,
दम्पति विलोक मनभाई-सी करत हैं। [3]
सेवा की निकुंजन में चरन पलोटै प्यारौ,
प्यारीजू की "प्रेमसखी" बीजना ढोरत हैं॥ [4]
- श्री प्रेमदास जी
english_text: The life and wealth of Vrindavan are not lost in the mind, the hairless hair is a layer of age. [1] Every saint with eyes filled with his intoxicants, Kadali Kadamba is destroying the mind.. [2] Who bows down to tamala-like kingdoms instead of mathematics, the couple behaves like a brother-in-law. [3] Charan Palotai Pyaaru in the Nikunjan of Seva, Pyaariju's "love friend" Bijna Dhorat.. [4] - Shri Premdas Ji
english_translation: The life and wealth of Vrindavan are not lost in the mind, the hairless hair is a layer of age. [1] Every saint with eyes filled with his intoxicants, Kadali Kadamba is destroying the mind.. [2] Who bows down to tamala-like kingdoms instead of mathematics, the couple behaves like a brother-in-law. [3] Charan Palotai Pyaaru in the Nikunjan of Seva, Pyaariju's "love friend" Bijna Dhorat.. [4] - Shri Premdas Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्रीगोपेन्द्र-कुमार-मोहन - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (188)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीगोपेन्द्र-कुमार-मोहन-महाविद्ये स्फुरन्माधुरि, सारस्फार रसाम्बुराशि सहज प्रस्यन्दि-नेत्राञ्चले।
कारुण्यार्द्र कटाक्ष- भङ्गि मधुरस्मेराननांभोरुहे, हा हा स्वामिनि राधिके मयिकृपा-दृष्टिं मनाङ् निक्षिप॥
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री राधा सुधा निधि (188)

english_translation: Shri Gopendra-Kumar-Mohan-Mahavidye Sfuranmadhuri, Sarsafar Rasamburashi Sahaj Prasyandi-Netranyachale. Karunyadra sarcasm-bhangagi madhursmerananaanbhoruhe, ha ha swami radhike mayikripa-drishtin manang nikship.. - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Radha Sudha Nidhi (188)

title: श्री नागरीदास जी (महाराजा सावंत सिंह जी) की जीवनी
sanskrit_text:
जन्म :
किशनगढ़ के महाराजा राज सिंह जी के बड़े पुत्र सावंत सिंह जी का जन्म पौष सुदी द्वादशी, वि.सं. 1756 (1699 ई.) को हुआ।
 
जीवन परिचय :
 
बाल्यकाल - बचपन के वीरतापूर्ण कृत्य (हाथी और सर्प से युद्ध)
शौर्य, भक्ति कला का संगम माने जाते हैं महाराजा सावंतसिंह (नागरीदास) जी।
वि.स. 1766 (1709 ई.) के एक दिन दिल्ली में बादशाह के एक बिगड़ैल हाथी को 10 वर्षीय बालक सावंत सिंह ने अपनी तलवार से ऐसा वार किया कि हाथी चिंघाड़ता हुआ पलट कर भाग खड़ा हुआ। 
वि.स. 1771 में यही बालक दिल्ली दरबार की सभा में बैठा अपने पायजामे में घुसे विषधर सांप को वहीँ मसल कर बिना किसी को बताये सभा से बाहर फैंक दिया।
राजकुमार सावंतसिंह ने 13 वर्ष की अल्पायु में ही अकेले बूंदी के हाड़ा जैतसिंह को मार डाला था।
 
वैष्णवी दीक्षा :
उस समय श्रीनिम्बार्काचार्यपीठ (सलेमाबाद) के सिंहासन पर श्री वृन्दावन देवाचार्य जी महाराज विराजमान थे। राजसिंहजी ने आपसे ही अपने राजकुमार को दीक्षा (मन्त्रोपदेश) और शिक्षा भी दिलाई।
english_text: Birth: Sawant Singh ji, elder son of Maharaja Raj Singh ji of Kishangarh, was born on Paush Sudi Dwadashi, V.S. Happened in 1756 (1699 AD). Biography: Childhood - Maharaja Sawantsingh (Nagridas) ji is considered to be the confluence of heroic and devotional acts of childhood (war with elephant and snake). V.S. One day in 1766 (1709 AD) a spoiled elephant belonging to the Emperor in Delhi was attacked by a 10 year old boy, Sawant Singh, with his sword in such a way that the elephant turned and ran away screaming. V.S. In 1771, this same boy was sitting in the court of Delhi Darbar, crushed a poisonous snake that had entered his pajamas and threw it out of the court without telling anyone. Prince Sawantsingh had single-handedly killed Hada Jaita Singh of Bundi at the young age of 13. Vaishnavi Diksha: During our time, Shri Vrindavan Devacharya Ji Maharaj was seated on the throne of Shri Nimbaracharya Peeth (Salembada). Rajsinghji also gave mantras and education to his own prince.
english_translation: Birth: Sawant Singh ji, elder son of Maharaja Raj Singh ji of Kishangarh, was born on Paush Sudi Dwadashi, V.S. Happened in 1756 (1699 AD). Biography: Childhood - Maharaja Sawantsingh (Nagridas) ji is considered to be the confluence of heroic and devotional acts of childhood (war with elephant and snake). V.S. One day in 1766 (1709 AD) a spoiled elephant belonging to the Emperor in Delhi was attacked by a 10 year old boy, Sawant Singh, with his sword in such a way that the elephant turned and ran away screaming. V.S. In 1771, this same boy was sitting in the court of Delhi Darbar, crushed a poisonous snake that had entered his pajamas and threw it out of the court without telling anyone. Prince Sawantsingh had single-handedly killed Hada Jaita Singh of Bundi at the young age of 13. Vaishnavi Diksha: During our time, Shri Vrindavan Devacharya Ji Maharaj was seated on the throne of Shri Nimbaracharya Peeth (Salembada). Rajsinghji also gave mantras and education to his own prince.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: 'रा' का उच्चारण करने से श्री कृष्ण का रोम रोम प्रफुलित होजाता है  - ब्रह्म वैवर्त पुराण
sanskrit_text:
राशब्दोच्चारणादेव स्फीतो भवति माधवः।
धाशब्दोच्चारतः पश्चाद्धावत्येव ससंभ्रमः॥
- ब्रह्मवैवर्तपुराण -4.52.38 (खण्डः 4 [श्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्डः]/अध्यायः 52 / छंद 38)
