sundar anga-pratyng ke darshan kar chndr bhi lajjit ho raha hai. adharon par pan ki lalima ka darshan kar shri krishn ka chitt bhi asakt ho raha hai. rachana : shri alabeliali ki kul 7 rachanaen ab tak upalabdh hui hain. inake nam nimnalikhit hain : 1. gusain ji kau mngal 2. samay prabandh padavali 3. shri guru-parampara 4. vrindavan sat 5. shri radhashtak 6. priya ji kau mngal 7. vinay kundali uparyukt granthon men 'guru-parampara' snskrit ki rachana hai tatha shesh rachanaen hindi men hain.
english_translation: parichay : shri alabeliali lalitasampraday ke svanamadhany kavi hue hain. upasana ki drishti se shri vnshiali ji ke shishyon men ve agragany hain. yadyapi sahityik kshetr men unaki khyati paryapt samay pahale se hain, kintu unake jivana-charit, kavy tatha vyaktitv ke sutr abhi tak purn rup se prakash men nahin aye hain. adhyatmik jivan : alabeli ali ki niji uktiyon se yah siddh hota hai ki ve shri vnshiali ji ke shishy the.' 'vrindavanasat' unaki arambhik rachana hai, jisaka samay 1750 hai. anuman ke adhar par yah kaha ja sakata hai ki is granth ki rachana ke samay inaki avastha lagabhag 35 varsh rahi hogi aur unhonne is granth ki rachana se 5 ya 7 varsh purv shri vnshiali ji se diksha li hogi. is prakar inaka diksha samay 1743 ke lagabhag thaharata hai tatha janm 1713. shukl ji ne unaka kavita-kal 18 vin shatabdi ka antim samay mana hai. isase bhi ukt anuman ki siddhi hoti hai. hindi sahity ke itihasa-granthon men inaka namollekh hua hai, parantu inake sambandh men koi vishisht suchana unamen nahin di gayi. keval unaki rachanaon ke adhar par unaka sampraday vishnusvami tatha unaka vnshiali ji se diksha lena hi likha gaya hai. 'vrindavanasat' namak granth men inake kuchh atma-parak kathan milate hain. ek sthan par inhonne likha hai : paryo ho jagat bhav bharyo ajnyan saun vishai-rasa-lin jyon min sar men. paryo ho tak tahan kal bag dhyan dhari ginat ho ghari-pal nam kar men.. tori kari as aur fans kali-kal ki met kar man ati neh bhar men. liyo gahi bahu vivi kadhai alabeli var rashyo ab ani vana-kunja-ghar men.. he shri kishori ji, main bhav sindhu men paड़a hun, mere andar ajnyan bhara hua hai, aur main vishaya-ras ke sagar men lin hun jaise machhali sagar men. kal mujhapar drishti jamaye baitha hai aur mere har pal ko gan kar mere ant samay ka intaज़ar kar raha hai. he kishori ji, mera hath pakaड़ kar mujhe is snsar ki maya se ubar lijiye aur apane nij mahal ka vas pradan kijiye. anyatr likha hai : paryo jagat bhava-kup men, paryo mudha prajnyan. kathyau nij bhuj kunvari kar, rashyo van saran an.. he shri kishori ji, main bhav sindhu men paड़a hun, mere andar ajnyan bhara hua hai, mera hath pakaड़ kar mujhe is snsar ki maya se ubar lijiye aur apane nij mahal ka vas pradan kijiye. ukt uddharanon men inhonne bhakta-jana-sulabh kathan kar apani purvakalin vritti ka snket kiya hai. yadyapi dasy bhavana men is prakar ki uktiyan sahaj hi sambhav hoti hain aur unhen sakshy ke rup men grahan karana uchit nahin mana ja sakata, tathapi isase itana nishchay avashy hota hai ki ye diksha lene se purv grihasth the. kintu virakt hone ke pashchat ye snsar se nitant nihsng hokar bhagavadbhajan men lin rahane lage. 'vrindavanasat' ke anek dohon men inaki uchch koti ki bhakti-bhavana ki abhivyakti hui hai jo samany kavi ke dvara nahin likhi ja sakati. ye nirantar prem aur rup ke mad men chhake rahate the. shri alabeliali ne apane guru shri vnshialiji ki mahima ka varnan atyant bhava-bhine rup men kiya hai. vastuth vnshiali ji ke vyaktitv ke anurup hi inaki pratibha thi. inake kavyon ke adhyayan se inake fakkadapan aur masti ka sahaj hi anuman kiya ja sakata hai. ye brindavan ki kunjon men, yamuna ke tat par dolate hue anany bhav se shri radha madhav ke dhyana-parayan rahate the. any baton ki tarah inake nikunja-gamana-kal ka bhi koi nishchay nahin hai. snvat das aru ath sai, baras shashth aru tin. falgun subh saten badi, shri vrindavan sat kin.. 1806 ki falgun mas ke krishn paksh ke saptam divas ke din yah "vrindavanasat" granth purn hua hai. unake granthon ke adhyayan ke adhar par kaha ja sakata hai ki shri vnshiali ji ke siddhanton ko unhonne purnataya atmasat kar liya tha. unaki vani men jo sarasata, shabd chayan, ras ki madakata aur ananyata ki bhavana milati hai, vah bhi vnshiali ji ki kavya-garima ka smaran dilati hai. alabeliali ji ki vani ka pratipady : shri alabeliali ne apani vani men mukhy rup se apani upasya shriradha aur unaki nityaviharalila ka varnan vistar se kiya hai. isake atirikt apane gurudev aur ishtadev ke prati unhonne apani anany nishtha ko badae sundar rup men vyakt kiya hai. vrindavan jo nitya-lila-dham hai, usake jis saras aur divy rup ka varnan ve kar sake hain, vaisa anyatr durlabh hai. vishesh dhyan dene ki bat yah hai ki inhonne bhi apane guru shri vnshiali ji ki tarah shrikrishn ka svatantr rup men varnan kahin nahin kiya. yadi kahin unaka varnan aya bhi hai to unaka das ya bhakt rup hi varnit hua hai. alabeliali ji ki bhakti-bhavana : alabeliali ki bhakti-bhavana uchchatam koti ki hai. shriradha ke prati ki gayi unaki anany bhakti unaki 'vinay kundali' tatha 'vrindavanasat' namak rachanaon men purn rup se vyakt hui hai. ve kahate hain aho kunvari bar ladaili karuna-sindhu apar. tum bin nahi meri kuo kahun pukari-pukari.. kahun pukari-pukari sunau dai kanani pyari. tum data tihun lok maha hun din bhikhari.. deu yahai varadan rahun pada-pnkaj sarana. aur mitai jag dvandv timir bhram jan mani bharana.. 'bhava-sindhu men padae hue bhakt ka uddhar shighr hi karo, mujhe pukarate pukarate kitani der ho gai hai', ityadi shabdon ke dvara unhonne apani vikalata ko is prakar vyakt kiya hai. bahyau jat bhav sindhu vegi ab an gahi kar.. main snsar sagar men baha ja raha hun, he kishori ji, shighr aiye aur mera hath pakaड़ lijiye. kvas ! kvas ! ho svamini, mahabahu sukha-rasi. saranagat pratipal ke pujavo man ki as. pujavau man ki as sabai jo saranai ayau. haun ati din anath tumhare hath bikayau.. maha vishe jug jval dahat mohi an bachayau. prem bhare drig charu chitai ras sinch jivavau.. he svamini, tum kahan ho ? mujh sharanagat ka pratipalan karake mere man ki asha ko purn karo. main atyant din aur anath hun, aur tumhare hath bika hua hun, main jagat ke vishayon ki mahajval men jal raha hun. mujhe akar bachao. apane prem bhare sundar nayanon se dekhakar mujhe sinch kar jilao. bhakt aur bhagavan ke sambandh ko megh aur chatak ke prasiddh rupak se prakat karate hue alabeliali ji ne kaha hai : rahai sada chit chaunp trishat jyon chatrak vadi. jaise chatak nity hi badalon ki aur drishti kiye varsha ki pratiksha karata hai, usi prakar bhakt ko bhagavan ki or drishti rakhani chahie. viraha-dasha men hriday ke kampan sahit ashru-varsha karate hue, yamuna ke kinare men padae hue virah ki pir ko unhonne kaise sahan kiya, isaka varnan is dohe men drashtavy hai: chakit nain knpat hiyau, maha virah ki pir. asuan manaun jharana jharai, paryau jaman ke tir.. ऑnkhen chakit hain, hraday shri radha ke virah ki piड़a se kanp raha hai, main shri yamuna ji ke tat par paड़a hun aur ansu jharane ke saman bah rahe hain. apani abhilashaon ka yadyapi unhonne vistar se varnan kiya hai, parantu yahan ek udaharan hi diya ja raha hai : labha-hani jano n kachhu, kaun mana-abhiman. badan kamala-makarnd ras, karo nainna-mag pan.. [1] karo nainna-maga-pan, sudha anga-ang bharayau jake. ghumat rahaun din rainni, manaun madik mada-chhake.. [2] nirashi nirashi nav rup, kunvari bar bes kishori. badhat rahe chit chay chaunp, jayaun trashat chakori.. [3] labha-hani, mana-apaman evn abhiman ka tyag kar nity hi shri radha ke vadan kamal ke makarnd ras ka netron se pan karo. jinake anga-ang men prem sudha ras bhara hua hai, unake angon ke makarnd ras ka pan kar madak ki bhanti unmatt avastha men madamast ho dina-rat usi ras men dube raho. nity naval kishori ke nav rup ko niharate-niharate chitt men shri radha ke lie prem kshana-kshan baढ़ne lagega, jaise chakor pakshi chndr ko dekhakar bhi tript nahin hota. ant men ve kahate hain : mo sau nahi kuo pataki, tumasi adham udhar. tum hau taisi kijiyau, aho rasik sukunvari.. aho rasik sukumari, karaun binati kar jorai. bedhyau rahai man raina-dina tuv prem ke daure.. jo chahau so karau kunvari, trividh tam harana. alabeliali pari ani, pada-pnkaj sarana.. mujhasa n koi pataki hai aur tumasa n koi adham udharan, he rasik sukumari, ap vahi karana jaisa apaka svabhav hai (akaran daya aur kripa karana). he shri radhe, main apase vinati karata hun ki mera man dina-rat keval apake prem ki dor se hi bndha rahe. he shri kishori ji, main apake charana-kamalon ki sharan men hun, mere hraday ke andhakar ko dur kijiye. alabeliali ji ki guru-bhakti : shri alabeliali ne jahan apane isht men anany bhakti ka varnan kiya hai vahan apane guru shri vnshiali ji ke charanon men apani atut nishtha ka bhi parichay diya hai. ve shri vnshiali ji ko sakshat lalita ji ka avatar manate the. itana hi nahin, unhonne shriradha aur unamen bhed karake hi nahin dekha. 'gunsai ji ko mngal' namak granth men unhonne shri vnshiali ji ke mahatmy ka varnan vistar se kiya hai. vahan par unhonne shrivnshiali ji ko prem svarupini, nikunja-vilasini, lalitavapu, radhika dhana-dhani, anandasvarupini, ityadi anek visheshanon se bhushit kiya hai. ve apane gurudev ke anugat hone par purn vishvas rakhate hain. ve kahate hain jay jay shri vnshiali gun je gaihain. shri vrindavana-vas, kunvari pad paihain.. aru pavain rasa-riti ju munijan na lahain. neti neti kari ved jas brahmadik kahain.. alabeliali kal keli sampati sakal sahajain paihain. jo bhi shri vnshi ali ji ke gunon ka gan karega vah shighr hi shri vrindavan ka vas prapt kar lega aur shri kishori ji ke charanon ko prapt karega. use muniyon ke lie bhi durlabh shri radha rani ke charan kamalon ke ras ki prapti hogi, jise ved bhi neti-neti kahate hain aur bakhan karane men apani asamarthata prakat karate hain. vah sakhi deh sng nitya-vihar ras ko sahaj hi prapt kar lega. apane atut vishvas ke adhar par apane guru ka gaurav dharan karate hue ve kahate hain : shri vnsiali ki balihari. jake garab bhare ati nirbhay rahat sada banachari.. radha nam naval namavali so nis din ur dhari. alabeliali ek bharosai sovat pair pasari.. jinake garv men shri krishn nirbhay hokar vrindavan men dolate hain, un shri vnshi ali ji par balihari hai. shri radha nam ko hraday men dharan kar usake bharose main panv pasar kar sota hun. unhonne to apane guru ke vishay men yahan tak kah diya hai ki ananya-dharm ka aisa vakta, karta aur anumodan prapt karane vala koi dusara n ab tak hua, n hai aur n hoga. isase unaki atut guru-bhakti ka sahaj hi anuman lagaya ja sakata hai. alabeliali ji ki vrindavana-bhakti : shri alabeliali ki jitani bhakti apani ishtadevi shriradha ke charanon men thi, vaisi hi unake dhama-rup shri vrindavan men bhi thi. unake dvara rachit 'vrindavanasat' bhakti-sahity ka ek anupam ratn hai. vrindavan ki mahima varnan karate samay shri alabeliali usaki divy jhanki prastut karate hain. siddhant vivechan ke prasng men lalitasampraday men svikrit vrindavan dham ke svarup ka varnan karate samay unake ukt kavya-granth se kuchh udaharan prastut kiye ja chuke hain. ath yahan unaki punaravritti karana uchit nahin hai. yahan keval eka-do udaharan dekar vrindavan ka svarup prastut kiya ja raha hai : anurag son bhari as rup gun shari ati, madhuri vipin ki kaun jani. rati-mainn ki sainn lotat jahan raina-din, uma aur rama sab sudhi bhulani.. net kahi net kahi nigam kaun durgam ati, naradahi kachhu shri-pati bashanin.. parai soi ai alabeli nainnani kabai, raj jahan radhika kunvari rani.. prem se ota-prot shri vrindavan ki madhuri bhala kaun jan sakata hai. kam aur rati yahan ki raj men lotate hain, shri paravati ji aur lakshmi ji darshan kar hi apani sudhi bhul gayin hain. ved bhi jise neti-neti kahate hain, jo agam ke agochar hai, usaka kuchh varnan shri hari ne devarshi narad ko sunaya tha. jahan shri radhika ji ka raj hai, aisa shri vrindavan mere ankhon ke samaksh kab prakat hoga. vrindavan men premonmatt dasha se rahane ki abhilasha ka varnan is prakar kiya gaya hai : bharain drig vari uchchar van prem saun, purn soi priti kab hoi man ki. shan aur pan sukh sainn jo na milain, daiva-gati hoi jo hasi tan ki.. divas hvai jai anga-ang sat tuk jo, tajat nahin sur jyaun bhumi ran ki. hohi tan chhin dushalin jo koti vidhi, alabeli jin jav raj chhandai ban ki.. ankhon se premashrupat karate hue prem men bharakar radha nam ka uchcharan karate hue main shri vrindavan men kab dolunga. mujhe vahan khana-pan mile athava n mile, sukh se shayan mile athava n mile, mujhe koi chinta nahin, prarabdh vash is deh ki gati jo honi hai so hogi. mere angon ke sau tukaड़e hi kyon n kar diya jay, lekin jaise shuravir ranabhumi ka tyag nahin karata vaise main bhi shri vrindavan ka tyag nahin karunga. mera sharir kshin kyon n ho jaye, koti-koti duhkh mile lekin main shri vrindavan ka tyag nahin karunga. alabeliali ji dvara nityavihara-varnan : shri alabeliali ne nityavihar ka bada sundar aur vistrit varnan kiya hai. 'samay prabandh padavali' men nityavihar ke 300 ke lagabhag pad likhe gaye hain. lalitasampraday ke kaviyon ke upalabdh sahity men is granth ke akar ka dusara koi granth nahin hai jisamen itane padon men ashtayam ki nityalilaon ka varnan kiya gaya ho. inake varnan men ek visheshata yah bhi hai ki vah jitana vishad hai, utana hi saras bhi hai. isake anek padon men shriradha ke rup ka varnan kiya gaya hai tatha anek sthanon par madhury krida ka rasatmak svarup bhi vahan upasthit hai. alabeliali ji dvara shri radha ke rup ka varnan : alabeliali ji ne shriradha ke rup ka varnan vividh prakar se kiya hai. isake liye unhonne anek jhankiyan prastut ki hain. rup ka sangopang varnan us samay kiya gaya hai jab ki shriradha ka shringar sakhiyon dvara purn kar diya jata hai. ek pad men isaka varnan badae vistar se kiya gaya hai. pad ka akar itana bada hai ki use yahan sampurn uddhrit n kar usake kuchh anshon ko hi prastut kiya ja raha hai : bani nav rasika-mukuta-mani aju. adbhut rupa-lata manu fuli, nakha-sikh anga-ang saju.. majjan kari sajjit kach kusumit, rnjit beni bam. manon kanaka-khambh ke pachhen, luthat bhuangini syam.. naval kishori shri radha ki shobha aj adbhut bani hai. shri radha ka rup adbhut hai, nakh se shikh paryant ki shobha baड़i sundar bani hai. shri kishori ji ne snan kar sundar shrringar dharan kiya hai, gale men pushp ki mala shobha pa rahi hai, veni pushpon se guthi hui aisi shobhayaman hai jaise manon svarn ke khambe ke pichhe koi shyam varn kar sarp reng raha ho. alabeliali ji dvara shri radha ke svarup tatv ka varnan : shri alabeliali ne shriradha ke svarup ka varnan thik vaisa hi kiya hai jaisa ki vnshiali ji ne kiya tha. unhonne shriradha ki mahima tatha unake upasy svarup ka vishad aur rochak varnan kiya hai. alabeliali ke anusar shriradha ki visheshataen is prakar hain: 1. shriradha param prema-sudha-rasa-sindhu ke chadr ke saman sundar aur sukumar hain. 2. ve nirguna-saguna-svarupa hain. 3. ve sur nara-muni dvara vndit hain. brahma-vishnu-mahesh un par nyauchhavar karane yogy hain. 4. yogi jan nirantar unaka dhyan karate rahate hain. 5. svayn shrikrishn dvara unhen param tattv kah kar gunagan kiya jata hai aur ve unake charanon men javak lagakar unhen sajate hain. 6. unhin shriradha ko sakhi-gan nity dularati hain. 7. ve sharanagat ki raksha karane vali hain, tatha apar karunasindhu hain. 8. be braja-nagari-chuड़amani hain. 9. ve sukh ka sagar aur rup tatha ras ki rashi hain. alabeliali ne radha ke rup ka varnan vistar se kiya hai. unhonne apani upasya shriradha ka dhyan jis rup men kiya hai, usaka varnan radha-ashtak men is prakar kiya gaya hai : kanak knj sau vadan sundari nirakhi chnd lajavahi. lasat arunim pan ki kali chitai lal lubhavahi.. shri radha ke svarn ke kamal pushp ke saman sundar anga-pratyng ke darshan kar chndr bhi lajjit ho raha hai. adharon par pan ki lalima ka darshan kar shri krishn ka chitt bhi asakt ho raha hai. rachana : shri alabeliali ki kul 7 rachanaen ab tak upalabdh hui hain. inake nam nimnalikhit hain : 1. gusain ji kau mngal 2. samay prabandh padavali 3. shri guru-parampara 4. vrindavan sat 5. shri radhashtak 6. priya ji kau mngal 7. vinay kundali uparyukt granthon men 'guru-parampara' snskrit ki rachana hai tatha shesh rachanaen hindi men hain.

title: श्रीवृंदाविपुन विहार निजु, श्रीस्वामी कौ रूप - श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (443)
sanskrit_text:
श्रीवृंदाविपुन विहार निजु, श्रीस्वामी कौ रूप।
गौर-स्याम हिरदै दोऊ, बिहरैं केलि अनूप॥

title: अहह जन्म सहस्र समेधितै - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (15.25)
sanskrit_text:
अहह जन्म सहस्र समेधितै र्बहु तपोजप योग समाधिभिः।
असुलभ लभतेऽप्यधि राशिकावनमये नमयेदपि यः शिर॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (15.25)
english_text: Ahaḥ janma sahasra samdhitai rabahu tapojap yoga samadhibhiḥ. असूलभ लभतेप्याधी रसिकावानम्ये नाम्येदपी यह सिर.. - Sri Prabodhananda Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (15.25)

title: हरे कृष्ण सदा कहते-कहते - श्री हरे कृष्ण जी
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
‘हरे कृष्ण’ सदा कहते-कहते, मन चाहे जहाँ वहाँ घूमा करूँ। [1] 
मधु मोहन रूप का पी करके, उसमें उनमत्त हो झूमा करूँ॥ [2]
अति सुन्दर वेश ब्रजेश तेरा, रमा रोम-ही-रोम में रूमा करूँ। [3]
मन-मन्दिर में बिठला के तुझे, पग तेरे निरन्तर चूमा करूँ॥ [4]
- श्री हरे कृष्ण जी
english_text: (Savaiya) Always used to say 'Hare Krishna', I can roam wherever I want. [1] Make me drink the form of Madhu Mohan, let me dance wildly in it.. [2] Let me dance in your very beautiful attire Brajesh, Rama Roma-Hi-Roma. [3] I will sit you in the temple of my mind and kiss your feet continuously.. [4] - Shri Hare Krishna Ji
english_translation: (Savaiya) Always used to say 'Hare Krishna', I can roam wherever I want. [1] Make me drink the form of Madhu Mohan, let me dance wildly in it.. [2] Let me dance in your very beautiful attire Brajesh, Rama Roma-Hi-Roma. [3] I will sit you in the temple of my mind and kiss your feet continuously.. [4] - Shri Hare Krishna Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: दीप मालिका को दिन आयौ - श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
sanskrit_text:
(राग बिलावल)
दीप मालिका को दिन आयौ। 
नन्द राय सों कहत धरनि यो यह उच्छव मन भायौ॥ [1]
गोपी सकल साज सजि चल के नन्दराय दरबार सुहायौ। 
कंचन थार साजि धरि दीपक गावत गीत मन भायौ॥ [2]
भीर भई यसुमति के आँगन बृजनारी संकल्प करायौ। 
दीपदान की होत आरती सूरदास जस गायौ॥ [3]
- श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
english_text: (Rag Bilawala) May the day come for Dubki Malika. Nand re putra kahat dharni yo yah uchchav man bhayou.. [1] Gopi, fully dressed, go to Nandaray's court and enjoy. The earth adorned with Kanchan's throne, the lamp of Gavat Geet, my mind is afraid.. [2] Be afraid, make a resolution in the courtyard of Yasumati. Aarti of lamp donation is done as Surdas went.. [3] - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar

The earth adorned with Kanchan's throne, the lamp of Gavat Geet, my mind is afraid.. [2] Be afraid, make a resolution in the courtyard of Yasumati. Aarti of lamp donation is done as Surdas went.. [3] - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar

title: कौनकूँख कीरति कीर्ति प्रकास देतो - श्री नागरीदास जी
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
कौनकूँख कीरति कीर्ति प्रकास देतो,
कौतुकी कन्हैया काज दूल्ही काहि कहते। [1]
दान दधि-घातिन में बृंदावन-बाटिन में,
काको दधि लूट प्रेम चित्त चाह चहते॥ [2]
नागरिया जोपे स्यामा स्वामिनी सलोनी बिनु,
कैसे घनस्याम रस-रास रंग लहते। [3]
आदि में न होती यदि राधे की रकार जोपै,
तोपै मेरे जान राधे बिन आधे कृष्ण रहते॥ [4]
- श्री नागरीदास जी
english_text: (Poem) Kaunkunkh kirti kirti prakash deto, prodigious Kanhaiya kaj dulhi kahi kahi. [1] Dam Dadhi-Ghatin Man Brindavan-Batin Purush, Kako Dadhi Lut Prem Chitta Chahte.. [2] Nagariya Jope Syama Swamini Saloni Binu, Kaise Ghansyam Ras-Ras Rang Lahte. [3] If there was no Aadi Purusha, then my dear Radhe would have remained without Krishna.. [4] - Shri Nagaridas Ji
english_translation: (Poem) Kaunkunkh kirti kirti prakash deto, prodigious Kanhaiya kaj dulhi kahi kahi. [1] Dam Dadhi-Ghatin Man Brindavan-Batin Purush, Kako Dadhi Lut Prem Chitta Chahte.. [2] Nagariya Jope Syama Swamini Saloni Binu, Kaise Ghansyam Ras-Ras Rang Lahte. [3] If there was no Aadi Purusha, then my dear Radhe would have remained without Krishna.. [4] - Shri Nagaridas Ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कण-कण में जा रेणु के, बसत लाल के प्रान - श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (435.6)
sanskrit_text:
कण-कण में जा रेणु के, बसत लाल के प्रान।
हाय सोहनी ताहि याँ, साधारण मत मान॥
- श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (435.6)
english_text: Renu's life, Basat Lal's life is in earshot. Hi Sohni Tahi Yan, Sadharan Mat Man.. - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (435.6)
english_translation: Renu's life, Basat Lal's life is in earshot. Hi Sohni Tahi Yan, Sadharan Mat Man.. - Shri Bhori Sakhi, Prem Ki Peer (435.6)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अब तो कृपा करो श्रीराधा - श्री नागरीदास जी, श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, छूटक पद (96)
sanskrit_text:
अब तो कृपा करो श्रीराधा,
वृन्दा विपिन वसो श्री स्वामिनी छाड़ि जगत की बाधा। [1]
तीन लोक गावति वावन की लीला ललित अगाधा,
नागरिया पे तनक घटे तो हाथ सहज सुख साधा॥ [2]
- श्री नागरीदास जी, श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी, छूटक पद (96)
english_text: Now please please Shriradha, Vrinda Vipin Vaso Shri Swamini, overcome the obstacles of the world. [1] Teen Lok Gavati Vaavan's Leela Lalit Agadha, If you lose focus on Nagariya, you will easily attain happiness.. [2] - Shri Nagaridas Ji, Shri Nagaridas Ji's speech, Chutak Pad (96)
english_translation: Now please please Shriradha, Vrinda Vipin Vaso Shri Swamini, overcome the obstacles of the world. [1] Teen Lok Gavati Vaavan's Leela Lalit Agadha, If you lose focus on Nagariya, you will easily attain happiness.. [2] - Shri Nagaridas Ji, Shri Nagaridas Ji's speech, Chutak Pad (96)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सुघर भयै हौ बिहारी याही छाँह तें - श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (24)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कान्हरौ)
सुघर भयै हौ बिहारी याही छाँह तें। 
जे जे गटी सुघर सुर जानपनें की 
ते ते याही बाँह तें॥ [1] 
हुते तौ बड़े अधिक सब ही तैं,
पै इनकी कस न खटात याँह तैं॥ [2]
श्रीहरिदास के स्वामी स्यामा कुंजबिहारी 
जकि रहे चाह तें॥ [3] 
- ललिता अवतार श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (24)
english_text: (Raaga Kanharau) Sughar bhaayi hou bihari yahi chanah ten. JJ gati sughar sur janapanen ki te yahi baanh ten.. [1] Hute tau bade aadh sab hi tein, pai inke kas na khat yat yanh tein.. [2] Swami Shyam Kunjbihari of Shri Haridas Jaaki rahe chah ten.. [3] - Lalita Avtaar Shri Swami Haridas ji, Kelimal (24)
english_translation: (Raaga Kanharau) Sughar bhaayi hou bihari yahi chanah ten. JJ gati sughar sur janapanen ki te yahi baanh ten.. [1] Hute tau bade aadh sab hi tein, pai inke kas na khat yat yanh tein.. [2] Swami Shyam Kunjbihari of Shri Haridas Jaaki rahe chah ten.. [3] - Lalita Avtaar Shri Swami Haridas ji, Kelimal (24)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रस बस होत लाल प्यारी तेरी बदन झलक - श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जू की वाणी (17)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
रस बस होत लाल प्यारी तेरी बदन झलक। 
अपनें सहज सुभाव की माधुरी बनी है ललाट पर पतरी अलक॥ 
कौन हूँ भाँति चितवनि चितयौ तबतें मोहनजू की न लागें पलक।    
श्रीबीठलबिपुल बिनोद बिहारी सों हिल-मिलि जैसे बाढ़ै छिन छिन मदन ललक॥
- श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जी, श्री विठ्ठल विपुल देव जू की वाणी (17)
english_text: (Raga Saranga) Ras bas hota lal pyari teri badan jhalak. The sweetness of my innate good nature has become a sparkle on my heart.. Who am I like Chitavani Chityou, then Mohanaju's eyes are on my eyelids. Shree Vitthal Bipul Binod Bihari's son shook and shook as if he was congratulating Chhin Chhin Madan Lalak.. - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju's voice (17)
english_translation: (Raga Saranga) Ras bas hota lal pyari teri badan jhalak. The sweetness of my innate good nature has become a sparkle on my heart.. Who am I like Chitavani Chityou, then Mohanaju's eyes are on my eyelids. Shree Vitthal Bipul Binod Bihari's son shook and shook as if he was congratulating Chhin Chhin Madan Lalak.. - Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ji, Shri Vitthal Vipul Dev Ju's voice (17)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधा मोहन करत वियारू - श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
sanskrit_text:
(राग कान्हरौ)
राधा मोहन करत वियारू।
एक कर थार सवारें सुंदरि एक वेष एक रूप उज्यारी॥ [1]
मधु मेवा पकवान मिठाई दंपति अति रुचि कारी। 
सूरदास को जूँठन दीनी अति प्रसन्न ललिता री॥ [2]
- श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
english_text: (Raaga Kanharau) Radha Mohan Karat Viaru. One day, one beautiful lady, one dress, one form of light... [1] Honey, dry fruits, sweets, rich people are very interesting. Surdas was very pleased with Lalita ri.. [2] - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar
english_translation: (Raaga Kanharau) Radha Mohan Karat Viaru. One day, one beautiful lady, one dress, one form of light... [1] Honey, dry fruits, sweets, rich people are very interesting. Surdas was very pleased with Lalita ri.. [2] - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रूप तेरौरी मोपै बरन्यौं न जाइ - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, उत्तरार्द्ध (123)
sanskrit_text:
(राग गन्धार)
रूप तेरौरी मोपै बरन्यौं न जाइ। 
रोम रोम जो रसना पावौं तौ गाऊँ तेरौ गुन अघाइ॥ [1]
कोटि जतन जौ कीजै कैसैं हूँ सरवा सिंधु न माइ। 
कैसैं ‘व्यास’ रंक की बसनी, लंक, सुमेरु समाइ॥ [2]
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, उत्तरार्द्ध (123)
english_text: (Raaga Gandhar) Roop terauri mopai baranyaun na jaai. I am the mother of all the Sindhu. How 'Vyas' Rank's Basani, Lanka, Sumeru Samai.. [2] - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, latter (123)
english_translation: (Raaga Gandhar) Roop terauri mopai baranyaun na jaai. I am the mother of all the Sindhu. How 'Vyas' Rank's Basani, Lanka, Sumeru Samai.. [2] - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, latter (123)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जपौ मन राधा राधा नाम - श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (36)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कल्याण त्रिताल)
जपौ मन राधा राधा नाम।
जीवन अब तो वृथा जात है, करलो ये इक काम॥ [1] 
राघा नाम जपत हैं जो जन, संग रहे घनश्याम।
सखियन नाम ये प्राण भावतो, सुखदायक अभिराम॥ [2] 
दर-दर-दर भटको जिन प्यारे, बस वृन्दावन धाम।
श्रीगोपालहित नाम प्राणधन, सुन्दर सुखद ललाम॥ [3]
- श्री हित गोपाल दास [सेवा कुञ्ज वाले], निकुंज रस वल्लरी (36)
english_text: (Raaga Kalyan Tritala) Japau Man Radha Radha Naam. Now life is becoming meaningless, do this one thing.. [1] Those who chant the name Ragh, stay with Ghanshyam. Sakhiyan naam ye praan bhavato, soothing pleasure. [2] Wander from door to door, dear ones, only to find Vrindavan abode. Shri Gopalhit Naam Prandhan, Sundar Sukhad Lalam.. [3] - Shri Hit Gopal Das [Seva Kunj Vele], Nikunj Rasa Vallari (36)
english_translation: (Raaga Kalyan Tritala) Japau Man Radha Radha Naam. Now life is becoming meaningless, do this one thing.. [1] Those who chant the name Ragh, stay with Ghanshyam. Sakhiyan naam ye praan bhavato, soothing pleasure. [2] Wander from door to door, dear ones, only to find Vrindavan abode. Shri Gopalhit Naam Prandhan, Sundar Sukhad Lalam.. [3] - Shri Hit Gopal Das [Seva Kunj Vele], Nikunj Rasa Vallari (36)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: गंधेश्वरी , ब्रज - दिव्य लीला
sanskrit_text: गंध का अर्थ है सुगंध और इश्वरी का अर्थ देवी है। श्री राधा रानी जी को गंधेश्वरी भी कहाँ जाता है। ऐसा कहा जाता है कि जब श्री कृष्ण जी अपने दोस्तों के साथ घिरा हुऐ थे तो श्री राधा रानी जी के शरीर से निकलने वाली सुगंध से श्री कृष्ण जी मोहित हो गए, उनके हाथों से बांसुरी फिसल गई, और उनके सिर से मोर-पंख का मुकुट उसके चरणो (कमल सामान) पर गिर गया, और वह श्री कृष्ण जी बेहोश हो गये। इसलिए इस जगह को गंधेश्वरी तीर्थ के नाम से जाना जाता है। श्री राधा रानी जी को गांधीेश्वरी भी कहा जाता है। उस दिन से गंधर्व कुंड (राधा रानी के नाम पर नामित) श्री राधा कुंड के विजयी, मनोरंजक क्षणों का जश्न से मानते हैं। आज गंडेश्वरी गणेश्वरी नाम में बदल गया है।
english_text: Gandha means fragrance and Ishwar means goddess. Shri Radha Rani Ji is also called Gandheshwari. It is said that when Shri Krishna ji was surrounded with his friends, Shri Krishna ji became fascinated by the fragrance emanating from the body of Shri Radha Rani ji, the flute slipped from his hands, and the crown of peacock feathers from her head fell on his feet (Kamal Samana), and wow Shri Krishna ji became unconscious. That is why this place is known as Gandhishwari Tirtha. Shri Radha Rani Ji is also called Gandhishwari. From that day onwards Gandharva Kund (Namitha named after Radha Rani) celebrates the triumphant, entertaining moments of Shri Radha Kund. Aaj Gandeshwari has changed into name Ganeshwari.
english_translation: Gandha means fragrance and Ishwar means goddess. Shri Radha Rani Ji is also called Gandheshwari. It is said that when Shri Krishna ji was surrounded with his friends, Shri Krishna ji became fascinated by the fragrance emanating from the body of Shri Radha Rani ji, the flute slipped from his hands, and the crown of peacock feathers from her head fell on his feet (Kamal Samana), and wow Shri Krishna ji became unconscious. That is why this place is known as Gandhishwari Tirtha. Shri Radha Rani Ji is also called Gandhishwari. From that day onwards Gandharva Kund (Namitha named after Radha Rani) celebrates the triumphant, entertaining moments of Shri Radha Kund. Aaj Gandeshwari has changed into name Ganeshwari.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अनूपम माधुरी जोड़ी हमारे श्याम-श्यामा की - श्यामा सखी (सनम साहब)
sanskrit_text:
अनूपम माधुरी जोड़ी हमारे श्याम-श्यामा की।
रसीली रसभरी अँखियाँ हमारे श्याम श्यामा की॥ [1]
कटीली भौं अदा बाँकी सुघर सूरत मधुर बतियाँ।
लटक गरदन की मन वसियाँ हमारे श्याम श्यामा की॥ [2]
मुकुट और चन्द्रिका माथे अधर पर पान की लाली।
अहो कैसी भली छबि है हमारे श्याम-श्यामा की॥ [3]
परस्पर मिलकै जब बिहरैं वे वृन्दावन की कुञ्जन में।
नहीं वरनत बने शोभा हमारे श्याम-श्यामा की॥ [4]
नहीं कुछ लालसा धन की नहीं निर्वाण की इच्छा।
'सखी श्यामा' को दैं दरशन दया हो श्याम-श्यामा की॥ [5]
- श्यामा सखी (सनम साहब)
english_text: The unique Madhuri couple of our Shyama-Shyama. The juicy raspberry eyes of our dark-haired Shyama.. [1] The cute eyebrows, the rest of the beautiful face, the sweet lights. Our Shyam Shyama's mind dwells with the hanging neck.. [2] The crown and the moonlight, the redness of the betel leaf on the middle of the forehead. Oh, what a beautiful image of our Shyama-Shyam.. [3] When they met each other in the Kunjan of Vrindavan. No, rather become the beauty of our Shyama-Shyama.. [4] No longing for wealth, no desire for nirvana. May 'Sakhi Shyama' have mercy on Shyama-Shyam.. [5] - Shyama Sakhi (Sanam Sahaba)
english_translation: The unique Madhuri couple of our Shyama-Shyama. The juicy raspberry eyes of our dark-haired Shyama.. [1] The cute eyebrows, the rest of the beautiful face, the sweet lights. Our Shyam Shyama's mind dwells with the hanging neck.. [2] The crown and the moonlight, the redness of the betel leaf on the middle of the forehead. Oh, what a beautiful image of our Shyama-Shyam.. [3] When they met each other in the Kunjan of Vrindavan. No, rather become the beauty of our Shyama-Shyama.. [4] No longing for wealth, no desire for nirvana. May 'Sakhi Shyama' have mercy on Shyama-Shyam.. [5] - Shyama Sakhi (Sanam Sahaba)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: परम धन राधा नाम आधार - श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (38)
sanskrit_text:
(राग कान्हरो)
परम धन राधा नाम आधार।
जाकौ श्याम मुरली में टेरत, सुमिरत बारम्बार॥ [1]
जंत्र, मंत्र और वेद तंत्र में, सभी तार को तार।
श्री शुक, प्रगट कियौ नहीं यातें, जानी सार को सार॥ [2]
कोटिन रूप धरे नंदनंदन, तोउ न पायौ पार।
'व्यासदास' अब प्रगट बखानत, डारि भार में भार॥ [3]
- श्री हरिराम व्यास, व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (38)
english_text: (Raag Kanharo) Param Dhan Radha Naam Adhar. Jakau Shyam Murli Mein Terat, Sumirat Barambar.. [1] Mantra, Mantra and Veda Tantra Purush, all the levels are equal. Shri Shuk, don't you reveal these things, know the essence of the head.. [2] Nandanandan takes many forms, but you don't love me. 'Vyasdas' now revealed, Dari Bhar Purusha Bhaar.. [3] - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardha (38)
english_translation: (Raag Kanharo) Param Dhan Radha Naam Adhar. Jakau Shyam Murli Mein Terat, Sumirat Barambar.. [1] Mantra, Mantra and Veda Tantra Purush, all the levels are equal. Shri Shuk, don't you reveal these things, know the essence of the head.. [2] Nandanandan takes many forms, but you don't love me. 'Vyasdas' now revealed, Dari Bhar Purusha Bhaar.. [3] - Shri Hariram Vyas, Vyas Vani, Purvardha (38)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रहौ मेरे नैंनन मैं यह ध्यान - श्री किशोरी अलि
sanskrit_text:
रहौ मेरे नैंनन मैं यह ध्यान।
दामिनि रूप राधिका गोरी, नवघन स्याम सुजान॥ [1]
आलस अंग भोर ही जागे, दुह दुहुन के प्रान।
करत परस्पर लोभी लोचन, वदन माधुरी पान॥ [2]
अति अदभुत भूतल में जोरी, उपमा नहीं समान।
किशोरी रसिकजनन की जीवन, कहा जानैं कोऊ आन॥ [3]
- श्री किशोरी अलि, अष्टयाम प्रथम (14)

Karat, greedy lochan for each other, vadaan madhuri paan.. [2] Very amazing surface man jori, simile is not the same. Life of Kishori Rasikajanan, Kah Janain Kuo An.. [3] - Shri Kishori Ali, Ashtyam Pratham (14)

title: वंशीवट की माधुरी जो कहिये कछु बैन - श्री माधुरी दास, वंशीवट माधुरी (230)
sanskrit_text:
वंशीवट की माधुरी, जो कहिये कछु बैन।
नैनन रसना कीजिये, रसना कीजै नैन॥
- श्री माधुरी दास, वंशीवट माधुरी (230)
english_text: Madhuri of Vanshiwat, whatever you say Kachhu Bain. Let the eyes shine, let the eyes shine.. - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (230)
english_translation: Madhuri of Vanshiwat, whatever you say Kachhu Bain. Let the eyes shine, let the eyes shine.. - Shri Madhuri Das, Vanshivat Madhuri (230)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यह अचरज देख्यौ न सुन्यौ कहूँ - श्री स्वामी हरिदास, केलीमाल (91)
sanskrit_text:
(राग मलार)
यह अचरज देख्यौ न सुन्यौ कहूँ 
नवीन मेघ संग बिजुरी एक रस। 
तामें मौज उठति अधिक बहु भाँति लस॥ [1]
मन के हरिवे कौं और सुखनहिंने 
चितवत चितहिं करत बस। 
श्रीहरिदास के स्वामी स्यामा कुंजबिहारी 
बिहारिनि जू कौ पवित्र जस॥ [2]
- ललिता अवतार श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (91)
english_text: (Raaga Malara) Yah acharaj dekhyou na sunayou khoon new megh sang bijuri ek rasa. There is a lot of pleasure in the mind.. [1] Who else is the enemy of the mind, who keeps worrying about the pleasures. Shri Haridas's Swami Shyama Kunjbihari Biharini Ju Kau Pavitra Jas.. [2] - Lalita Avatar Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (91)
english_translation: (Raaga Malara) Yah acharaj dekhyou na sunayou khoon new megh sang bijuri ek rasa. There is a lot of pleasure in the mind.. [1] Who else is the enemy of the mind, who keeps worrying about the pleasures. Shri Haridas's Swami Shyama Kunjbihari Biharini Ju Kau Pavitra Jas.. [2] - Lalita Avatar Shri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (91)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: चलो मन ! श्री वृंदावन धाम - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, धाम-माधुरी (01)
sanskrit_text:
चलो मन ! श्री वृंदावन धाम।
जहँ विहरत नागरि अरु नागर,कुंजनि आठों याम।
भूख लगे तो रसिकन जूठनि, खाइ लहिय विश्राम।
प्यास लगे तो तरणि-तनुजा,तट पिवु सलिल ललाम।
नींद लगे तो जाइ सोइ रहु, लतन-कुंज अभिराम।
ब्रज की रेनु रेनु लखि चिन्मय,तन्मय रहु अविराम।
पै "कृपालु" मन ! जनि यह भूलिय, भाव रहे निष्काम।
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज,प्रेम रस मदिरा, धाम माधुरी (01)

 हे मन ! तू दिव्य चिन्मय वृन्दावन-धाम में चल, ज़हाँ लाडिली और लाल विविध कुंजों में आठों याम विहार किया करते हैं। यदि तुझे भूख लगे तो रसिक महापुरुषों की झूठन खाकर सुखी होना। जब प्यास लगे, यमुना का निर्मल जल पी लिया करना। जब सोने की इच्छा हो तब स्वाभाविक बने हुए लताओं के कुंज घरों में सो जाया करना। अरे मन ! ब्रज के प्रत्येक कण-कण में चिन्मय-स्वरुप देखते हुए सदा ही तन्मय रहा करना। "श्री कृपालु जी" कहते हैं कि हे मन ! किन्तु यह न भूलना की इन सब में तेरा भाव निष्काम ही रहे।
english_text: come on guys! Shri Vrindavan Dham. Jahan Vihar Nagari Aru Nagar, Kunjani Athon Yam. If you feel hungry then eat delicious food and rest. If you feel thirsty, tarani-tanuja, tat pivu salil llam. If you feel sleepy then Jai Soi Rahu, Latana-Kunj Abhiram. Braj's Renu Renu Lakhi Chinmay, Tanmay Rahu Aviram. Pai "kind" man! Know, forget this, remain selfless. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Dham Madhuri (01) Oh man! You walk in the divine Chinmaya Vrindavan-dham, you roam in the sacred groves of Jhan Ladili and Athon Yam. If you feel hungry then be happy by eating the lies of great men. Whenever you feel thirsty, drink the pure water of Yamuna. When you feel like sleeping, it has become your nature to sleep in the groves of creepers. He is a man! Always remain absorbed in seeing the Chinmay form in every particle, the symbol of Braj. “Shri Kripalu Ji” says the man! But do not forget that your intentions should remain selfless in everything.
english_translation: come on guys! Shri Vrindavan Dham. Jahan Vihar Nagari Aru Nagar, Kunjani Athon Yam. If you feel hungry then eat delicious food and rest. If you feel thirsty, tarani-tanuja, tat pivu salil llam. If you feel sleepy then Jai Soi Rahu, Latana-Kunj Abhiram. Braj's Renu Renu Lakhi Chinmay, Tanmay Rahu Aviram. Pai "kind" man! Know, forget this, remain selfless. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Dham Madhuri (01) Oh man! You walk in the divine Chinmaya Vrindavan-dham, you roam in the sacred groves of Jhan Ladili and Athon Yam. If you feel hungry then be happy by eating the lies of great men. Whenever you feel thirsty, drink the pure water of Yamuna. When you feel like sleeping, it has become your nature to sleep in the groves of creepers. He is a man! Always remain absorbed in seeing the Chinmay form in every particle, the symbol of Braj. “Shri Kripalu Ji” says the man! But do not forget that your intentions should remain selfless in everything.
