title: भक्ति प्रेम जोगी कहें - श्री जुगलदास, योग कल्पवल्ली
sanskrit_text:
भक्ति प्रेम जोगी कहें, सोही आठौं जाम। 
राधा माधव चाकरी, श्री वृंदावन धाम॥
- श्री जुगलदास, योग कल्पवल्ली
english_text: Bhakti Prem Jogi Kahen, Sohi Eighth Jam. Radha Madhav Chakri, Sri Vrindavan Dham.. - Sri Jugaldas, Yoga Kalpavalli
english_translation: Bhakti Prem Jogi Kahen, Sohi Eighth Jam. Radha Madhav Chakri, Sri Vrindavan Dham.. - Sri Jugaldas, Yoga Kalpavalli
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ज्यौंही-ज्यौंही तुम राखत हौ - स्वामी श्री हरिदास जी, अष्टादश पद (01)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विभास)
ज्यौंही-ज्यौंही तुम राखत हौ, त्यौंही-त्यौंही रहियत हौं, हो हरि। [1]
और तौ अचरचे पाँय धरौं सो तौ कहौ, कौन के पैंड़ भरि? [2]
जद्यपि कियौ चाहौं, अपनौ मनभायौ, सो तौ क्यों करि सकौं, जो तुम राखौ पकरि। [3]
कहिं श्रीहरिदास पिंजरा के जनावर लौं, तरफराय रह्यौ उड़िबे कौं कितौऊ करि॥ [4]
- ललिता अवतार स्वामी श्री हरिदास जी, अष्टादश पद (01)
english_text: (Raga Vibhasa) As long as you keep me, as much as you remain, you are Hari. [1] And uncle, if I hold you in surprise, then uncle, whose pain is heavier? [2] No matter what I want, you obey me, so why can I do what you want. [3] Kahin Shri Haridas, let me be the animal in the cage, stay aside, who should do what? [4] - Lalita Avatar Swami Shri Haridas Ji, Ashtadash Pad (01)
english_translation: (Raga Vibhasa) As long as you keep me, as much as you remain, you are Hari. [1] And uncle, if I hold you in surprise, then uncle, whose pain is heavier? [2] No matter what I want, you obey me, so why can I do what you want. [3] Kahin Shri Haridas, let me be the animal in the cage, stay aside, who should do what? [4] - Lalita Avatar Swami Shri Haridas Ji, Ashtadash Pad (01)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आयौ कर संतन की संगत - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, श्री वृंदावन शतक (41)
sanskrit_text:
आयौ कर संतन की संगत में बार बार,
सदाँ पद पंकज में सीस कौं नवायौ कर। [1]
न्हायौ कर प्यारे मारतण्ड तनया में जाय, 
रज कों लगाय अंग अंग हुलसायौ कर॥ [2]
पायौ कर प्रभु के प्रसाद को प्रसन्न है कैं,
नेम वनराज जू की परिक्रमा जायौ कर। [3]
लायौ कर ध्यान मन मगन होय हृदै बीच, 
बैठकँ निकुंजन में राधा गुन गायौ कर॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, श्री वृंदावन शतक (41)
english_text: Come again and again in the company of your children, who will ask you to sit in the house of Pankaj. [1] Take a bath, my dear Maratand Tanaya mein Jai, Raj koan lage ang ang hulasayou do.. [2] Can you drink the Prabhu's Prasad, go and circumambulate the name of Vanraj Ju. [3] By meditating, the heart becomes happy, by singing the virtues of Radha in the meetings.. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Shri Vrindavan Shatak (41)
english_translation: Come again and again in the company of your children, who will ask you to sit in the house of Pankaj. [1] Take a bath, my dear Maratand Tanaya mein Jai, Raj koan lage ang ang hulasayou do.. [2] Can you drink the Prabhu's Prasad, go and circumambulate the name of Vanraj Ju. [3] By meditating, the heart becomes happy, by singing the virtues of Radha in the meetings.. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Shri Vrindavan Shatak (41)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: छैल जो छबीला, सब रंग में रंगीला - ताज बीबी
sanskrit_text:
(कवित्त)
छैल जो छबीला, सब रंग में रंगीला
बड़ा चित्त का अड़ीला, कहूं देवतों से न्यारा है। [1]
माल गले सोहै, नाक-मोती सेत जो है कान,
कुण्डल मन मोहै, लाल मुकुट सिर धारा है॥ [2]
दुष्टजन मारे, सब संत जो उबारे ताज,
चित्त में निहारे प्रन, प्रीति करन वारा है। [3]
नन्दजू का प्यारा, जिन कंस को पछारा,
वह वृन्दावन वारा, कृष्ण साहेब हमारा है॥ [4]
- ताज बीबी
english_text: (Poem) The skin which is beautiful, colorful in all colors, the stubborn one with a big mind, I should say, is different from the gods. [1] The stool sleeps around the neck, the nose-pearl set is the ear, the earrings captivate the mind, the red crown adorns the head.. [2] The evil spirits are killed, all the saints are crowned, the life is seen in the mind, love is the groom. [3] Beloved of Nandju, whose ears are filled with joy, wow Vrindavan Vara, Krishna Saheb is ours.. [4] - Taj Bibi
english_translation: (Poem) The skin which is beautiful, colorful in all colors, the stubborn one with a big mind, I should say, is different from the gods. [1] The stool sleeps around the neck, the nose-pearl set is the ear, the earrings captivate the mind, the red crown adorns the head.. [2] The evil spirits are killed, all the saints are crowned, the life is seen in the mind, love is the groom. [3] Beloved of Nandju, whose ears are filled with joy, wow Vrindavan Vara, Krishna Saheb is ours.. [4] - Taj Bibi
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भजियैं नंदनंदन-श्रीराधा - श्री हित कमल नैंन, श्री हित कमल नैंन जी की वाणी, अष्टायामी पदावली (206.6)
sanskrit_text:
भजियैं नंदनंदन-श्रीराधा।
जातें जनम-मरन पुनि-पुनि यह, मिटत मोह भव बाधा॥ [1]
श्रीवृन्दावन धाम मनोहर, निशि-दिन पुजवै साधा।
जैश्रीकमलनैंन हित निरखि हरषि उर, गुन-गन निगम अगाधा॥ [2]
- श्री हित कमल नैंन, श्री हित कमल नैंन जी की वाणी, अष्टायामी पदावली (206.6)
english_text: Bhajiyan Nandanandan-Shriradha. Jaten birth-death puni-puni yah, mitaat moha bhava bhaad.. [1] Sri Vrindavan Dham is beautiful, worshiped every day. Jayashrikamalannain hit nirkhi harshi ur, guna-gana nigam agadha.. [2] - Shri Hit Kamal Nain, speech of Shri Hit Kamal Nain ji, Ashtyami Padavali (206.6)
english_translation: Bhajiyan Nandanandan-Shriradha. Jaten birth-death puni-puni yah, mitaat moha bhava bhaad.. [1] Sri Vrindavan Dham is beautiful, worshiped every day. Jayashrikamalannain hit nirkhi harshi ur, guna-gana nigam agadha.. [2] - Shri Hit Kamal Nain, speech of Shri Hit Kamal Nain ji, Ashtyami Padavali (206.6)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री नवनागरी प्यारी तू वृन्दावन की रानी - श्री विष्णुदास जी
sanskrit_text:
(राग विलावल)
श्री नवनागरी प्यारी तू वृन्दावन की रानी।
बिहारिन लाड़ली प्यारी तेरी कीरति जगत बखानी॥ [1]
जगत मैं जगमग रहयो यश बिन कृपा क्यों बूझही।
अभिमान अन्धा लोग करमठ ताहि कछुवन सूझही॥ [2]
करौ कृपा परम उदार ये मोही बार-बार सुहावही।
बलिजाऊँ श्री वृषभानु नन्दनी सुजस तिहारौ गावही॥ [3]
- श्री विष्णुदास जी
english_text: (Raag Vilawala) Shri Navanagari Pyari, you are the queen of Vrindavan. Dear darling, tell the world about your fame.. [1] Keep shining in the world, why is fame extinguished without grace. Pride, blind people, do their best, they understand everything.. [2] Please give me the ultimate loan, this charm is pleasant again and again. Balijaun Shri Vrishabhanu Nandani Sujas Tiharau Gaavhi. [3] - Shri Vishnudas ji
english_translation: (Raag Vilawala) Shri Navanagari Pyari, you are the queen of Vrindavan. Dear darling, tell the world about your fame.. [1] Keep shining in the world, why is fame extinguished without grace. Pride, blind people, do their best, they understand everything.. [2] Please give me the ultimate loan, this charm is pleasant again and again. Balijaun Shri Vrishabhanu Nandani Sujas Tiharau Gaavhi. [3] - Shri Vishnudas ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: यद्यपि राजत अवनि पर - श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, वृन्दावन शत लीला (74)
sanskrit_text:
यद्यपि राजत अवनि पर, सबते ऊँचौ आहि।
ताकी सम कहिये कहा, श्रीपति बंदत ताहि॥
- श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, वृन्दावन शत लीला (74)
english_text: Although on silver level, everything is unknown. So that it is said where, Shripati Bandhat Tahi.. - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Vrindavan Shat Leela (74)
english_translation: Although on silver level, everything is unknown. So that it is said where, Shripati Bandhat Tahi.. - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Vrindavan Shat Leela (74)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: लगै जौ वृन्दावन कौ रंग - श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (223)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
लगै जौ वृन्दावन कौ रंग।
सब संदेह देहके जैहैं, अरु विषयनि कौ संग॥ [1]
जैसैं बाजहि नाजु लगतही, करत है उदर मृदंग।
अैसैं सहजमाधुरी परसत, उपजत गुनकौ अंग॥ [2]
जैसैं कामी कामिनी देखत, वाढत दुसह अनंग।
अैसैंहिं व्यास विहार विलोकत, साधन सौं चित भंग॥ [3]
- श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (223)
english_text: (Raaga Saranga) Planted barley, which color is there in Vrindavan? All the doubts are there in the eyes, and with whom are the subjects… [1] Because of this, I feel the pain in my stomach, my stomach becomes moist. Aisain Sahajamadhuri parasat, upajat gunakau ang.. [2] Jaisain kami kamini dekht, vadahat dusah ang. Aisainhi Vyas Vihar Vilokat, Sadhana Saun Chit Bhang.. [3] - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, Purvardha (223)
english_translation: (Raaga Saranga) Planted barley, which color is there in Vrindavan? All the doubts are there in the eyes, and with whom are the subjects… [1] Because of this, I feel the pain in my stomach, my stomach becomes moist. Aisain Sahajamadhuri parasat, upajat gunakau ang.. [2] Jaisain kami kamini dekht, vadahat dusah ang. Aisainhi Vyas Vihar Vilokat, Sadhana Saun Chit Bhang.. [3] - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, Purvardha (223)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राग-द्वेष हमरे नहीं - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (306)
sanskrit_text:
राग-द्वेष हमरे नहीं, नहीं देह अभिमान। 
नित्त प्रिया मिलि भाव सों, ललित सु रसिक सुजान॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धान्त की साखी (306)
english_text: We have neither attachment nor hatred, nor body pride. Nitta Priya Mili Bhava Putra, Lalit Su Rasik Sujan.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, Siddhant's friend (306)
english_translation: We have neither attachment nor hatred, nor body pride. Nitta Priya Mili Bhava Putra, Lalit Su Rasik Sujan.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, Siddhant's friend (306)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: दुहुँनि की सहज बिसाँति - ललिता अवतार श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (81)
sanskrit_text:
(राग विभास)
दुहुँनि की सहज बिसाँति दोऊ मिलि सतरंज खेलत। [1]
उर रुख नैंन चपल अस्व चतुर बराबरि झेलत॥ [2]
आतुरता फील पयादे निग्रह
फरजी चौंप अनूपम पेलत। [3]
श्रीहरिदास के स्वामी स्यामा कुंजबिहारी
सह साह राखैं खेलत॥ [4]
- ललिता अवतार श्री स्वामी हरिदास जी, केलीमाल (81)
english_text: (Raga Vibhasa) A pair of innocent women were playing chess. [1]. [3] Sri Haridas's Swami Shyama Kunjbihari Saha Saha Rakhain Khelat.. [4] - Lalita Avatar Sri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (81)
english_translation: (Raga Vibhasa) A pair of innocent women were playing chess. [1]. [3] Sri Haridas's Swami Shyama Kunjbihari Saha Saha Rakhain Khelat.. [4] - Lalita Avatar Sri Swami Haridas Ji, Kelimal (81)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: देखा देखी रसिक न ह्वैहैं, यह मारग है बंका - श्री हित वृंदावन दास जी, युगल स्नेह पत्रिका (111)
sanskrit_text:
देखा देखी रसिक न ह्वैहैं, यह मारग है बंका। [1]
कहा सिंह की सरवर करिहै, गीदड़ फिरै जो रंका॥ [2]
असहन निन्दा करत पराई, कबहुँ न मानी शंका। [3]
वृन्दावन हित रूप अनन्य रसिक जिन दीन्ह पथ को डंका॥ [4]
- श्री हित वृंदावन दास जी, युगल स्नेह पत्रिका (111)
english_text: Look, I am not interested, this is a death, Banaka. [1] Where do you worship the lion, the jackal roams around… [2] Where does the stranger condemn you, why don't you feel any doubt. [3] Vrindavan Hit Roop Other Rasik Jin Dinh Path Ko Danka.. [4] - Shri Hit Vrindavan Das Ji, Couple Sneh Patrika (111)
english_translation: Look, I am not interested, this is a death, Banaka. [1] Where do you worship the lion, the jackal roams around… [2] Where does the stranger condemn you, why don't you feel any doubt. [3] Vrindavan Hit Roop Other Rasik Jin Dinh Path Ko Danka.. [4] - Shri Hit Vrindavan Das Ji, Couple Sneh Patrika (111)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृंदावन के मोटे गणेश की महिमा
sanskrit_text:
स्थान:
वृंदावन में मोटा गणेश मंदिर, वृंदावन के प्रसिद्ध बांके बिहारी मंदिर के पास अठखंबा में स्थित है।

दिव्य लीला:
ब्रज के पूरे क्षेत्र में, यह एकमात्र स्थान है जहाँ स्वयं सिद्ध श्री मोटे गणेश जी के दर्शन होते हैं। भगवान गणेश जिनकी सीधी सूंड होती है और जो सिंदूर से निर्मित होते हैं, उन्हें हाई सिद्ध गणेश के रूप में जाना जाता है। वृंदावन के मोटा गणेश द्वापर युग के समय से जाने जाते हैं जब साक्षात श्री कृष्ण भी इस धराधाम में थे। द्वापर युग में यह चार भुजाओं और सिंदूर के साथ प्रकट हुए, हर बुधवार को जिन्हें सिंदूर चढ़ाया जाता है।

जैसा कि अन्य स्थानों के गणेश जी के स्वरुप हैं, चाहे सिद्धि विनायक या अन्य जगह के हों,  उन सभी के दर्शन में गणेश जी के हाथ वरदान देते हुए रहते हैं।परन्तु इस वृंदावन के यह मोटे गणेश के दोनों हाथ अपनी जांघों पर है, जिसका अर्थ है कि वह वृंदावन को कभी भी नहीं छोड़ना चाहते हैं। उनकी एकमात्र इच्छा श्री राधा रानी और श्री कृष्ण की दिव्य लीला को देखना है। जो भी मोटा गणेश के दर्शन करने की इच्छा रखता है, उसे वृंदावन जाना चाहिए, वह यहां से एक कदम भी नहीं बढ़ाते। ब्रज के मोटा गणेश, नरसिंह देव, एवं दाऊजी, आदि सभी श्री राधारानी की  इच्छा एवं आज्ञा अनुसार ही गोलोक धाम से अवतरित हुए हैं।
english_text: Location: Mota Ganesh Temple in Vrindavan is located in Athkhanba, near the famous Banke Bihari Temple of Vrindavan. Divine Leela: Purusha Kshetra Purusha of Braj, this is the only place where self-realized Shri Mote Ganesha is seen. Lord Ganesha whose Siddhi is sunda and who is made of vermillion is known as Siddha Ganesha. Mota Ganesha of Vrindavan is known from the time of Dwapar Yuga when Shri Krishna was also present on earth. In Dwapar Yuga, he appeared with four arms and vermillion, to whom vermillion is offered every Wednesday. As there are incarnations of Lord Ganesha from any place, be it Siddhi Vinayak or from any other place, the hands of Lord Ganesha keep giving blessings in the darshan of all of them. Want to leave. His only wish is to see the divine leela of Shri Radha Rani and Shri Krishna. Anyone who wishes to have darshan of Mota Ganesha should go to Vrindavan, not a single step is taken from there. Braj's Mota Ganesh, Narasimha Dev, Avon Dauji, etc. all have incarnated from Golok Dham as per the wishes and orders of Shri Radharani.
english_translation: Location: Mota Ganesh Temple in Vrindavan is located in Athkhanba, near the famous Banke Bihari Temple of Vrindavan. Divine Leela: Purusha Kshetra Purusha of Braj, this is the only place where self-realized Shri Mote Ganesha is seen. Lord Ganesha whose Siddhi is sunda and who is made of vermillion is known as Siddha Ganesha. Mota Ganesha of Vrindavan is known from the time of Dwapar Yuga when Shri Krishna was also present on earth. In Dwapar Yuga, he appeared with four arms and vermillion, to whom vermillion is offered every Wednesday. As there are incarnations of Lord Ganesha from any place, be it Siddhi Vinayak or from any other place, the hands of Lord Ganesha keep giving blessings in the darshan of all of them. Want to leave. His only wish is to see the divine leela of Shri Radha Rani and Shri Krishna. Anyone who wishes to have darshan of Mota Ganesha should go to Vrindavan, not a single step is taken from there. Braj's Mota Ganesh, Narasimha Dev, Avon Dauji, etc. all have incarnated from Golok Dham as per the wishes and orders of Shri Radharani.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जब ते प्रीति श्याम से कीन्ही - श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
sanskrit_text:
जब ते प्रीति श्याम से कीन्ही,
ता दिन तैं मेरें इन नैननि, नैकुहुँ नींद न लीन्ही।
- श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर

जब से मैंने श्याम सुन्दर से प्रीति की है, उस दिन से अब तक एक क्षण को भी मेरे इन नैनों ने नींद नहीं ली।
english_text: Jab te preeti shyam se kinhi, ta din te meren in nanani, naikuhun nind en linhi. - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar Ever since I fell in love with Shyam Sundar, these eyes of mine have not slept even for a moment from that day till now.
english_translation: Jab te preeti shyam se kinhi, ta din te meren in nanani, naikuhun nind en linhi. - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar Ever since I fell in love with Shyam Sundar, these eyes of mine have not slept even for a moment from that day till now.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मन अटकौ रै जात है - श्री हित रूप लाल, श्री वृंदावन स्मरण (62)
sanskrit_text:
मन अटकौ रै जात है, एक एक ही ठौर।
श्रीवृंदावन वैभव कहौ, कैसे वरनौ और॥
- श्री हित रूप लाल, श्री वृंदावन स्मरण (62)
english_text: The mind gets stuck in one place only. How to tell the glory of Shri Vrindavan, how to choose it and.. - Shri Hit Roop Lal, Shri Vrindavan Smaran (62)
english_translation: The mind gets stuck in one place only. How to tell the glory of Shri Vrindavan, how to choose it and.. - Shri Hit Roop Lal, Shri Vrindavan Smaran (62)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ललिते सखि वरे श्रष्ठे यदुक्त पूर्वमेव हि - सनत्कुमार संहिता (32.145)
sanskrit_text:
ललिते सखि वरे श्रष्ठे यदुक्त पूर्वमेव हि।  कथं मर्त्याः विमुच्यन्ते संसारसर्प दंष्ट्रकात्॥ 
तदर्थं निर्मिता केलिरनघाप्तिस्तु मत्पदे। यो मर्त्यश्चिन्तयेन्नित्यं केलिनिर्गमनं मम॥
स सम्प्राप्स्यति मद्धाम वितर्को नात्र कश्चन।
- सनत्कुमार संहिता (32.145)
english_text: Lalite Sakhi Var Shresthe Yadukta Purvmev Hi. Kathn martyaah vimuchyante sansarasarp danshtrakat.. tadarthan nirmit keliraghaptistu matpade. Yo martyashchintayennityam keliniragman mam.. sa samprapasyati madham vitarko natra kashchan. - Sanatkumar Snahita (32.145)
english_translation: Lalite Sakhi Var Shresthe Yadukta Purvmev Hi. Kathn martyaah vimuchyante sansarasarp danshtrakat.. tadarthan nirmit keliraghaptistu matpade. Yo martyashchintayennityam keliniragman mam.. sa samprapasyati madham vitarko natra kashchan. - Sanatkumar Snahita (32.145)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वास करें ब्रज में फिर - ब्रज के सेवैयाँ
sanskrit_text:
वास करें ब्रज में फिर, दूसरे देशन की कहूं राह ना जानी। [1]
प्रेम समाए रहयौ हिय में, बनि है कबहूंन विरागी न ज्ञानी॥ [2]
संग रहे रसिकों के सदा, अरु बात करे रस ही रस सानि। [3]
हमें औरन की परवाह नहीं, अपनी ठकुरानी श्री राधिका रानी॥ [4] 
- ब्रज के सेवैयाँ
english_text: Live in Braj again, I don't know the way to another country. [1] O dear man, stay in love, it is said that when you become detached from knowledge... [2] Always stay with the lovers, and talk about only juice. [3] Don't care about us and others, our Thakurani Shri Radhika Rani.. [4] - Servants of Braj
english_translation: Live in Braj again, I don't know the way to another country. [1] O dear man, stay in love, it is said that when you become detached from knowledge... [2] Always stay with the lovers, and talk about only juice. [3] Don't care about us and others, our Thakurani Shri Radhika Rani.. [4] - Servants of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अहु राधे वृषभानु की - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य, युगल शतक (81)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
अहु राधे वृषभानु की, कुंवरी किसोरी बाल।
थोरी बै भौरीहि में, मोहे मोहन लाल॥
english_text: (Doha) Ahu Radhe Vrishabhanu's, virgin teenage hair. Thori Bai Bhaurihi Purush, Mohe Mohan Lal..
english_translation: (Doha) Ahu Radhe Vrishabhanu's, virgin teenage hair. Thori Bai Bhaurihi Purush, Mohe Mohan Lal..
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ऊधौ, कर्मन की गति न्यारी  - श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
sanskrit_text:
ऊधौ, कर्मन की गति न्यारी।
सब नदियाँ जल भरि-भरि रहियाँ सागर केहि बिध खारी॥ [1]
उज्ज्वल पंख दिये बगुला को कोयल केहि गुन कारी।
सुन्दर नयन मृगा को दीन्हे बन-बन फिरत उजारी॥ [2]
मूरख-मूरख राजे कीन्हे पंडित फिरत भिखारी।
‘सूर श्याम’ मिलने की आसा छिन-छिन बीतत भारी॥ [3]
- श्री सूरदास, सूर सागर
english_text: Udhau, the speed of action is unique. All the rivers remained filled with water, the oceans remained silent… [1] The cuckoo gave the heron bright wings and sang something. Beautiful eyes make the deer wander around like a light.. [2] Foolish kings call the wise and wandering beggars. 'Sur Shyama' The snatching away of hope of meeting is heavy.. [3] - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar
english_translation: Udhau, the speed of action is unique. All the rivers remained filled with water, the oceans remained silent… [1] The cuckoo gave the heron bright wings and sang something. Beautiful eyes make the deer wander around like a light.. [2] Foolish kings call the wise and wandering beggars. 'Sur Shyama' The snatching away of hope of meeting is heavy.. [3] - Shri Surdas, Sur Sagar
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मुकुन्दानुरागेण रोमाञ्चिताङ्गै - जगद्गुरु आघनिम्बार्काचार्य, श्रीराधाष्टकम् (6)
sanskrit_text:
मुकुन्दानुरागेण रोमाञ्चिताङ्गै रहं व्याप्यमानां तनुस्वेद-विन्दुम्।
महाहार्दवृष्ट्या कृपापाङ्गदृष्ट्या, समालोकयन्तीं कदा त्वां विचक्षे॥
- जगद्गुरु आघनिम्बार्काचार्य, श्रीराधाष्टकम् (6)
english_text: Mukundanuragen romanticchitanggai raha vyapyaman tanusveda-vindum. Mahahardavrushtya kripapaanggadrishtay, samalokyantin kada tvam vichakshe. - Jagadguru Aghanimbarkacharya, Sriradhastakam (6)
english_translation: Mukundanuragen romanticchitanggai raha vyapyaman tanusveda-vindum. Mahahardavrushtya kripapaanggadrishtay, samalokyantin kada tvam vichakshe. - Jagadguru Aghanimbarkacharya, Sriradhastakam (6)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री यमुनाष्टकं - श्री वल्लभाचार्य
sanskrit_text:
नमामि यमुनामहं सकल सिद्धि हेतुं मुदा।
मुरारि पद पंकज स्फ़ुरदमन्द रेणुत्कटाम॥
तटस्थ नव कानन प्रकटमोद पुष्पाम्बुना।
सुरासुरसुपूजित स्मरपितुः श्रियं बिभ्रतीम॥ [1]
english_text: Namami Yamunamaham for the sake of total accomplishment. Murari Pad Pankaj Sphurdamand Renutkatam..Tatstha Nav Kanan Prapatmod Pushpambuna.. Surasurasupujit smarapituh sriyam bibhratim..[1]
english_translation: Namami Yamunamaham for the sake of total accomplishment. Murari Pad Pankaj Sphurdamand Renutkatam..Tatstha Nav Kanan Prapatmod Pushpambuna.. Surasurasupujit smarapituh sriyam bibhratim..[1]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: किरपा ने कृपा करी - श्री ललितमोहिनी देव जू की वाणी (42)
sanskrit_text:
किरपा ने कृपा करी, गयौ मूँड को भार।
श्रीवृंदावन में बसि रहौ, निरखौ नित्य विहार॥
- श्री ललितमोहिनी देव, श्री ललितमोहिनी देव जू की वाणी (42)
english_text: Kirapa, please, give weight to the cow's penis. Stay in Sri Vrindavan, stay in Nirakhau Nitya Vihar.. - Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Shri Lalitmohini Dev Ju Ki Vani (42)
english_translation: Kirapa, please, give weight to the cow's penis. Stay in Sri Vrindavan, stay in Nirakhau Nitya Vihar.. - Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Shri Lalitmohini Dev Ju Ki Vani (42)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: देखौ माई सुंदर कुंज बनी - श्री हित कमल नैन जी की वाणी, अष्टायामी पदावली (20)
sanskrit_text:
देखौ माई ! सुंदर कुंज बनी।
बैठे नवल नागरी नागर, छबि नहिं जात भनी॥ [1]
दादुर मोर पपीहा बोलत, बरसत घन सजनी।
जै श्री कमल नैंन हित अति सचु पायौ, जागे सब रजनी॥ [2]
- श्री हित कमलनैन, श्री हित कमलनैन जी की वाणी, अष्टायामी पदावली (20)
english_text: Look mother! Beautiful Kunj Bani. Sitting in the naval city of the city, the image is not visible. [1] Dadur peacock papiha bolut, rain ghan sajni. Jai Shri Kamal Nain Hit Ati Sachhu Payau, Jaage Sab Rajni.. [2] - Shri Hit Kamal Nain, Speech of Shri Hit Kamal Nain Ji, Ashtyami Padavali (20)
english_translation: Look mother! Beautiful Kunj Bani. Sitting in the naval city of the city, the image is not visible. [1] Dadur peacock papiha bolut, rain ghan sajni. Jai Shri Kamal Nain Hit Ati Sachhu Payau, Jaage Sab Rajni.. [2] - Shri Hit Kamal Nain, Speech of Shri Hit Kamal Nain Ji, Ashtyami Padavali (20)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: दुख सुख भुगतै देह, नहिं कछु संक है  -  श्री भगवत रसिक - भगवत रसिक की वाणी, अनन्यनिश्चयात्म ग्रन्थ - पूर्वार्द्ध (47)
sanskrit_text:
दुख सुख भुगतै देह, नहिं कछु संक है।
निंदा अस्तुति करौ, राव क्या रंक है॥
परमारथ व्यवहार, बनौ कि ना बनौ।
अंजन है मम नैन, रसिक भगवत सनौ॥
- श्री भगवत रसिक - भगवत रसिक की वाणी, अनन्यनिश्चयात्म ग्रन्थ - पूर्वार्द्ध (47)
english_text: The body suffers happiness and sorrow, there is no doubt about it. Criticism and praise, what a disgrace... altruistic behavior, whether you become one or not. Anjan hai mam nain, rasik bhagwat sanau.. - Shri Bhagwat Rasik - Bhagwat Rasik's speech, Ananyanishchayatam book - first half (47)
english_translation: The body suffers happiness and sorrow, there is no doubt about it. Criticism and praise, what a disgrace... altruistic behavior, whether you become one or not. Anjan hai mam nain, rasik bhagwat sanau.. - Shri Bhagwat Rasik - Bhagwat Rasik's speech, Ananyanishchayatam book - first half (47)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: चरचा करी कैसे जाय  - श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी
sanskrit_text:
चरचा करी कैसे जाय ?
बात जानत कछुक हम पै कहत जिय ठहराय॥ [1]
मौन में ही कहनि ताकी सुनत श्रोता नैंन।
सोब ‘नागर’ लोग बूझत कहि न आवत बैंन॥ [2]
- श्री नागरीदास (महाराज सावंत सिंह), श्री नागरीदास जी की वाणी
english_text: How to discuss? But I don't know anything about what we say.. [1] Silent in my mind so that the listener can listen to the story. Sob 'Nagara' people extinguish the ban somewhere.. [2] - Shri Nagaridas (Maharaj Sawant Sinha), words of Shri Nagaridas ji
english_translation: How to discuss? But I don't know anything about what we say.. [1] Silent in my mind so that the listener can listen to the story. Sob 'Nagara' people extinguish the ban somewhere.. [2] - Shri Nagaridas (Maharaj Sawant Sinha), words of Shri Nagaridas ji
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जबते प्रीति श्याम सों - श्री परमानन्द दास, परमानंद सागर (417)
sanskrit_text:
(राग सारंग)
जबते प्रीति श्याम सों कीनी।
तादिन ते मेरे इन नैंननि ने नेकहु नींद न लीनी॥ [1]
सदा रहत चित चाक चढ्यो सो और कछु न सुहाय। 
मन में रहे उपाय मिलन को इहै विचारत जाय॥ [2]
परमानंद पीर प्रेम की काहु सों नहीं कहिये। 
जैसे बिथा मूक बालक की अपने तन मन सहिये॥ [3]
- श्री परमानन्द दास, परमानंद सागर (417)
english_text: (Raaga Saranga) Jabate Preeti Shyam Putra Kini. Since that day, my maternal grandparents neither said nor slept.. [1] Always remain happy and nothing else is good. Whatever solution is in your mind, think of the solution for meeting.. [2] Why don't you say son of bliss and love? Like a silent child sitting with his body and mind right.. [3] - Shri Parmanand Das, Parmanand Sagar (417)
english_translation: (Raaga Saranga) Jabate Preeti Shyam Putra Kini. Since that day, my maternal grandparents neither said nor slept.. [1] Always remain happy and nothing else is good. Whatever solution is in your mind, think of the solution for meeting.. [2] Why don't you say son of bliss and love? Like a silent child sitting with his body and mind right.. [3] - Shri Parmanand Das, Parmanand Sagar (417)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री चैन बिहारी कुंज, वृंदावन
sanskrit_text:
श्री चैन बिहारी कुंज की स्थापना श्री नरहरिदास जी महाराज ने लगभग 50 साल पहले की थी। कुंज के अंदर, श्री चैन बिहारी जी का मंदिर है, जो श्री नरहरिदास जी महाराज के इष्ट हैं।

स्थान:
श्री चैन बिहारी कुंज, वृंदावन के गोदा विहार में श्री रंगनाथ जी मंदिर के पीछे स्थित है।
english_text: Shri Chain Bihari Kunj was established by Shri Narharidas Ji Maharaj about 50 years ago. Inside the grove, there is the temple of Shri Chain Bihari Ji, who is the favorite of Shri Narharidas Ji Maharaj. Location: Shri Chain Bihari Kunj is located behind Shri Ranganath Ji Temple in Goda Vihar, Vrindavan.
english_translation: Shri Chain Bihari Kunj was established by Shri Narharidas Ji Maharaj about 50 years ago. Inside the grove, there is the temple of Shri Chain Bihari Ji, who is the favorite of Shri Narharidas Ji Maharaj. Location: Shri Chain Bihari Kunj is located behind Shri Ranganath Ji Temple in Goda Vihar, Vrindavan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: चीर घाट वृन्दावन
sanskrit_text: चीर घाट यमुना नदी के तट पर सबसे पवित्र घाटों (नीचे की तरफ सीढ़ियों की एक श्रृंखला) में से एक है। यह वह स्थान है जहाँ वृंदावन में गोपियों के वस्त्र चोरी करने की लीला श्री कृष्ण ने द्वापर युग में सम्पन्न की थी। ये स्थान पहले यमुना नदी के तट पर था। लेकिन वर्षो बाद, यमुना ने अपना रास्ता बदल दिया, अब चीर घाट यमुना से कुछ दूरी पर है। इस स्थान पर एक प्राचीन कदंब वृक्ष है जो अभी भी भगवान श्री कृष्ण के समय से विद्यमान है। वृंदावन के भक्त अब भी इस वृक्ष की पूजा करते हैं और यहाँ तक कि इस वृक्ष को प्रसाद भी चढ़ाते हैं। वेदों में यह भी कहा जाता है कि श्री कृष्ण अत्यंत कठिनता से ही कभी परमहंसों की समाधि में जाते हैं, लेकिन यहाँ ब्रज में, प्रेम में वशीभूत होकर वह गोपियों के वस्त्रों को चोरी कर रहे हैं। यही कारण है कि ब्रज रस सभी रसों में सबसे ज्यादा रसमय एवं प्रसिद्ध है (साकेत लोक, वैकुंठ लोक आदि में)। ईश्वर के रूप में श्री कृष्ण गीता में कहते हैं: भगवद गीता (4.11), श्री कृष्ण कहते हैं, "जिस भाव से लोग मुझे आत्मसमर्पण करते हैं अर्थात मुझे भजते हैं, मैं भी उन्हें वैसे ही भजता हूँ "।
english_text: Chir Ghat is one of the most sacred ghats on the banks of river Yamuna (a chain of rivers downstream). This is the place where Shri Krishna had performed the act of stealing the clothes of the Gopis in Vrindavan in Dwapara Yuga. This place was earlier on the banks of river Yamuna. But over the years, Yamuna changed its course, now Chir Ghat is some distance from Yamuna. There is an ancient Kadamba tree at this place which is still present from the time of Lord Shri Krishna. Devotees of Vrindavan still worship this tree and even make offerings to it. It is also said in the Vedas that Shri Krishna sometimes goes into the samadhi of Paramahansa only through the Atishay Katha, but here in Braj, under the influence of love, he is stealing the clothes of the Gopis. This is the reason why Braj Rasa is the most delicious and famous among all the Rasas (people like Saket Lok, Vaikuntha Lok etc.). Sri Krishna as God Gita says: In Bhagavad Gita (4.11), Sri Krishna says, "With the same feeling in which people surrender to Me, i.e. worship Me, I also worship them in the same way".
english_translation: Chir Ghat is one of the most sacred ghats on the banks of river Yamuna (a chain of rivers downstream). This is the place where Shri Krishna had performed the act of stealing the clothes of the Gopis in Vrindavan in Dwapara Yuga. This place was earlier on the banks of river Yamuna. But over the years, Yamuna changed its course, now Chir Ghat is some distance from Yamuna. There is an ancient Kadamba tree at this place which is still present from the time of Lord Shri Krishna. Devotees of Vrindavan still worship this tree and even make offerings to it. It is also said in the Vedas that Shri Krishna sometimes goes into the samadhi of Paramahansa only through the Atishay Katha, but here in Braj, under the influence of love, he is stealing the clothes of the Gopis. This is the reason why Braj Rasa is the most delicious and famous among all the Rasas (people like Saket Lok, Vaikuntha Lok etc.). Sri Krishna as God Gita says: In Bhagavad Gita (4.11), Sri Krishna says, "With the same feeling in which people surrender to Me, i.e. worship Me, I also worship them in the same way".
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: निकुंज वन, पानी घाट, वृंदावन
sanskrit_text:
निकुंज वन श्री नरहरिदास जी महाराज का भजन स्थल था, जिन्होंने इस सुंदर उद्यान वन की स्थापना की।

स्थान:
निकुंज वन परिक्रमा मार्ग, वृंदावन के पानी घाट पर स्थित है।
english_text: Nikunj forest was the place of worship of Shri Narharidas Ji Maharaj, who has established a beautiful garden forest. Location: Nikunj Van Parikrama Marg is situated on the Pani Ghat of Vrindavan.
english_translation: Nikunj forest was the place of worship of Shri Narharidas Ji Maharaj, who has established a beautiful garden forest. Location: Nikunj Van Parikrama Marg is situated on the Pani Ghat of Vrindavan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: तो सी तुही हरिदास दुलारी - श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (55)
sanskrit_text:
तो सी तुही हरिदास दुलारी।
तेरी सरि दूजौ नहिं कोई तेरेई रस बस कुंज बिहारी॥ [1]
तेरौ रूप कहत नहिं आवै तैसीये तेरी प्रीति महा री। 
तैसीये ललित केलि सुखरासी रसिकसिरोमनि प्रान अधारी॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (55)
english_text: So Si Tuhi Haridas Dulari. There is no love for you, there is no juice for you, just Kunj Bihari.. [1] Your beauty does not say anything, but your love is great. Taisiye Lalit Keli Sukharasi Rasikshiromani Prana Adhari.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's words, principles (55)
english_translation: So Si Tuhi Haridas Dulari. There is no love for you, there is no juice for you, just Kunj Bihari.. [1] Your beauty does not say anything, but your love is great. Taisiye Lalit Keli Sukharasi Rasikshiromani Prana Adhari.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's words, principles (55)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री राधे नंदलाल की - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, महल वर्णन (14)
sanskrit_text:
श्री राधे नंदलाल की, चरण रेणु सिरधार। 
चित चाहे कारज सरैं, करैं सकल अघ छार॥
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, महल वर्णन (14)
english_text: Shri Radhe Nandlal's, Charan Renu Sirdhar. Chit chahe karaj sarain, karein sakal agh chhar.. - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Mahal Description (14)
english_translation: Shri Radhe Nandlal's, Charan Renu Sirdhar. Chit chahe karaj sarain, karein sakal agh chhar.. - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Mahal Description (14)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: खेलत आजु प्रिया नव - श्री ललित मोहिनी देव जू, श्री ललित मोहिनी देव जू की वाणी (45)
sanskrit_text:
(राग बसंत)
खेलत आजु प्रिया नव रंगी।
चमकत रमकत लगी स्याम उर ललित मोहिनी संगी॥ [1] 
जोवन झलक ललक सुंदर की बाढ्यौ रंग अनंगी। 
यह सुख पीवत जीवत हम सब देखत केलि तरंगी॥ [2]
- श्री ललित मोहिनी देव जू, श्री ललित मोहिनी देव जू की वाणी (45)
english_text: (Rag Basant) Playing today Priya Nav Rangi. The shining splendor of Siyam and the beautiful Mohini sangi.. [1] Young glimpse of lust and beautiful greetings. In this happiness and joy, we all see only waves.. [2] - Shri Lalit Mohini Dev Ju, Speech of Shri Lalit Mohini Dev Ju (45)
english_translation: (Rag Basant) Playing today Priya Nav Rangi. The shining splendor of Siyam and the beautiful Mohini sangi.. [1] Young glimpse of lust and beautiful greetings. In this happiness and joy, we all see only waves.. [2] - Shri Lalit Mohini Dev Ju, Speech of Shri Lalit Mohini Dev Ju (45)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: व्रत, तप, निगम, नेम, यम - श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, जीव दशा (33)
sanskrit_text:
व्रत, तप, निगम, नेम, यम, संजम, करहु कलेस कोटि किन भारी। 
इनमें पहुँच नाहिं काहू की, परे रहत ज्यौं द्वार भिखारी॥ [1]
जोग यज्ञ फल मैंड़ करत हैं, तीरथ सब कर लीनें झारी। 
धर्म मोक्ष कोउ पूँछत नाहीं, इन मग सिद्धैं कौन बिचारी॥ [2]
- श्री ध्रुवदास, बयालीस लीला, जीव दशा (33)
english_text: Fast, penance, corporation, name, yam, sanjam, how heavy are the troubles I have to do? Why did the rewards not reach me, the beggars living beyond the door... [1] The fruits of the yagya of yoga are sacrificed, the linen is washed after doing all the pilgrimages. Who does not care about religion and salvation, but who is the poor person? [2] - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Jiva Dasha (33)
english_translation: Fast, penance, corporation, name, yam, sanjam, how heavy are the troubles I have to do? Why did the rewards not reach me, the beggars living beyond the door... [1] The fruits of the yagya of yoga are sacrificed, the linen is washed after doing all the pilgrimages. Who does not care about religion and salvation, but who is the poor person? [2] - Shri Dhruvdas, Bayalis Leela, Jiva Dasha (33)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्राप्ति में संसै नहीं - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (329)
sanskrit_text:
प्राप्ति में संसै नहीं, तन मन वचननि एक।
कुंजविहारिणी लाडिली, यही हमारी टेक॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (329)
english_text: The man of attainment is not a saint, but one who speaks in his body and mind. Kunjviharini Ladili, this is our technique.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, Siddhant's friend (329)
english_translation: The man of attainment is not a saint, but one who speaks in his body and mind. Kunjviharini Ladili, this is our technique.. - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, Siddhant's friend (329)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावन के तो गोविन्द राधे - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज - राधा गोविन्द गीत
sanskrit_text:
"वृन्दावन के तो गोविन्द राधे, लता गुल्म तरु कृष्ण भक्त हैं बता दे॥"
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज - राधा गोविन्द गीत (5931)
english_text: "Vrindavan's Govind Radhe, Lata Gulm Taru Krishna devotee, tell me.." - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj - Radha Govind Geet (5931)
english_translation: "Vrindavan's Govind Radhe, Lata Gulm Taru Krishna devotee, tell me.." - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj - Radha Govind Geet (5931)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अनोखी, पिय प्यारी की बात - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, युगल माधुरी (2)
sanskrit_text:
अनोखी, पिय प्यारी की बात।
समुझि सकी नहिं बात सखी ! यह, सोचि थकी दिन - रात॥ [1]
जब पिय कहँ देखहुँ तब पिय मोहिं, प्यारिहुँ – सरस लखात।
जब प्यारिहिं देखहुँ तब प्यारिहुँ, पिय ते सरस जनात॥[2]
पुनि इन दुहुँन लखहुँ जिन अंगनि, तिनहिंन रस अधिकात।
कह ‘कृपालु’ दोउ चिन्मय याते, नित नव रस सरसात॥ [3]
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, युगल माधुरी (2)
 
 प्रिया – प्रियतम के वैलक्षण्य से विस्मित होकर एक सखी कहती है – अरी सखी ! प्रिया – प्रियतम की अटपटी अलौकिक गति बुद्धि में नहीं समाती। बुद्धि द्वारा मैं दिन – रात विचार करके थक गई किन्तु यह बात नहीं समझ सकी।[1]
english_text: Unique, Piya Pyaari talk. Samujhi saki not butt sakhi! Yes, I thought about a tired day - Mouse.. [1] When I drink and see, then I drink, I drink - sweet lips. When I see something lovely then I feel loved, I love you sweetly..[2] Puni in duhunhan lakhahu jin angani, tinhinn ras adhikaat. Say 'Kripalu' dou chinmay yete, nit nav ras sarasat.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Couple Madhuri (2) Priya - A friend, astonished by the beauty of her beloved, says - Hey friend! Priya - Beloved's Atapati supernatural speed, intellect, not a man but Samati. At the door of my intellect, I got tired of pondering day and night but could not understand this.[1]
english_translation: Unique, Piya Pyaari talk. Samujhi saki not butt sakhi! Yes, I thought about a tired day - Mouse.. [1] When I drink and see, then I drink, I drink - sweet lips. When I see something lovely then I feel loved, I love you sweetly..[2] Puni in duhunhan lakhahu jin angani, tinhinn ras adhikaat. Say 'Kripalu' dou chinmay yete, nit nav ras sarasat.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Couple Madhuri (2) Priya - A friend, astonished by the beauty of her beloved, says - Hey friend! Priya - Beloved's Atapati supernatural speed, intellect, not a man but Samati. At the door of my intellect, I got tired of pondering day and night but could not understand this.[1]
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मैं नहीं देखूँ और को - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
मैं नहीं देखूँ और को, मोय न देखे और।
मैं नित देखोई करूँ, तुम दोऊनि सब ठौर॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: I don't want to see anything else, I don't want to see anything else. I will see you every day, both of you are everywhere.. - Couplets of Braj
english_translation: I don't want to see anything else, I don't want to see anything else. I will see you every day, both of you are everywhere.. - Couplets of Braj
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मन सुढाल में ढरौ अरु, जिय जु परौ जस जाल - श्री भट्ट देवाचार्य - युगल शतक (8)
sanskrit_text:
(दोहा)
मन सुढाल में ढरौ अरु, जिय जु परौ जस जाल। 
आलस उपजौ आन सों, लालस पद जुग लाल॥
english_text: (Doha) Man Sudhal Purush Dharau Aru, Jiya Ju Parau Jas Jal. Alas upjau un son, lalas pad jag lal..
english_translation: (Doha) Man Sudhal Purush Dharau Aru, Jiya Ju Parau Jas Jal. Alas upjau un son, lalas pad jag lal..
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कहा करें रसखान को - श्री रसखान
sanskrit_text:
कहा करें रसखान को, कोऊ चुगल लबार।
जाके राखनहार है, माखन चाखन हार॥
- श्री रसखान
english_text: Tell Raskhan to stop gossiping. JK is a food lover, a butter taster.. - Mr. Raskhan
english_translation: Tell Raskhan to stop gossiping. JK is a food lover, a butter taster.. - Mr. Raskhan
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: और कछू न रुचै ध्रुव पीय कौं, भावै यहै सुकुमारि लडाई -  बयालीस लीला, श्रृंगार शत
sanskrit_text:
"और कछू न रुचै ध्रुव पीय कौं, भावै यहै सुकुमारि लडाई॥”
- बयालीस लीला, श्रृंगार शत, प्रथम श्रृंखला (06)
english_text: "Who is interested in drinking Dhruva, Bhavai this Sukumari Ladai.." - Bayalis Leela, Shringaar Shat, First Series (06)
english_translation: "Who is interested in drinking Dhruva, Bhavai this Sukumari Ladai.." - Bayalis Leela, Shringaar Shat, First Series (06)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: ललित सरोवर ललित वन - श्री ललितमोहिनी देव जू की वाणी (23)
sanskrit_text:
ललित सरोवर ललित वन, ललित लाडिली रूप।
ललित बिराजै बिपुन में, ललित बिहारी भूप॥
- श्री ललितमोहिनी देव, श्री ललितमोहिनी देव जू की वाणी (23)
english_text: Fine lake, fine forest, fine ladylike form. Lalit Birjai Bipun Man, Lalit Bihari Bhup.. - Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Shri Lalitmohini Dev Ju Ki Vani (23)
english_translation: Fine lake, fine forest, fine ladylike form. Lalit Birjai Bipun Man, Lalit Bihari Bhup.. - Shri Lalitmohini Dev, Shri Lalitmohini Dev Ju Ki Vani (23)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वन्दौं श्रीराधाचरण - श्री हनुमान प्रसाद पोद्दार (भाईजी), पद रत्नाकर, वंदना एवं प्रार्थना (6)
sanskrit_text:
वन्दौं श्रीराधाचरण, पावन परम उदार।
भय विषाद अज्ञान हर, प्रेम भक्ति दातार॥
- श्री हनुमान प्रसाद पोद्दार (भाईजी), पद रत्नाकर, वंदना एवं प्रार्थना (6)
english_text: Lord Radha Charan, the wind is very generous. Fear is vivid ignorance every, love devotion dataar.. - Shri Hanuman Prasad Poddar (brother), Paad Ratnakar, Vandana and prayer (6)
english_translation: Lord Radha Charan, the wind is very generous. Fear is vivid ignorance every, love devotion dataar.. - Shri Hanuman Prasad Poddar (brother), Paad Ratnakar, Vandana and prayer (6)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्राचीन वृषभानु मंदिर बरसाना
sanskrit_text: प्राचीन वृषभानु मंदिर बरसाना में स्थित है, श्री राधा रानी मंदिर से लगभग २०० मीटर की दूरी पर। यहाँ श्री राधा के संग उनकी माता कीर्ति, पिता वृषभानु एवं भाई श्री दामा जू के दर्शन हैं।
english_text: The ancient Vrishabhanu temple is located in Barsana, at a distance of about 200 meters from Shri Radha Rani Temple. Here, Shri Radha is seen along with her mother Kirti, father Vrishabhanu and brother Shri Dama Ju.
english_translation: The ancient Vrishabhanu temple is located in Barsana, at a distance of about 200 meters from Shri Radha Rani Temple. Here, Shri Radha is seen along with her mother Kirti, father Vrishabhanu and brother Shri Dama Ju.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वसंत्यपि महाभागे मथुरायां च ये जनाः - वराहपुराण (152.21)
sanskrit_text:
वसंत्यपि महाभागे मथुरायां च ये जनाः। 
तेऽपि यान्ति परां सिद्धिं मत्प्रसादान्न संशयः॥
- वराहपुराण (152.21)
english_text: Vasantyapi Mahabhage Mathurayan Cha Ye Janah. Teypi yanti param siddhim matprasadanna samashasah.. - Varahapuran (152.21)
english_translation: Vasantyapi Mahabhage Mathurayan Cha Ye Janah. Teypi yanti param siddhim matprasadanna samashasah.. - Varahapuran (152.21)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: जंत्र, मंत्र और वेद तंत्र में - श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (38)
sanskrit_text:
“ जंत्र, मंत्र और वेद तंत्र में, सभी तार को तार,
परम धन राधा नाम आधार॥ ”
- श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार) - व्यास वाणी, पूर्वार्ध (38)
english_text: "Jantra, Mantra and Veda Tantra Purush, all the water is water, the ultimate wealth is Radha's name and water." - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, first half (38)
english_translation: "Jantra, Mantra and Veda Tantra Purush, all the water is water, the ultimate wealth is Radha's name and water." - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar) - Vyas Vani, first half (38)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सिर काटो छेदो हियो - श्री रसखान, प्रेम वाटिका (32)
sanskrit_text:
सिर काटो छेदो हियो, टूक टूक कर देहु।
पर जाके बदले विहँस, वाह वाह ही लेहु॥
- श्री रसखान, प्रेम वाटिका (32)
english_text: Cut your head and tease me, I will give you a bite. But instead of violence, wah wah hi lehu.. - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (32)
english_translation: Cut your head and tease me, I will give you a bite. But instead of violence, wah wah hi lehu.. - Shri Raskhan, Prem Vatika (32)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: लीनों बृन्दावन बसि लाह्यो - श्री अलबेली अलि
sanskrit_text:
लीनों बृन्दावन बसि लाह्यो।
सेवा-टहल महल की निसि-दिन, यह जिय नेम निबाह्यो॥ [1] 
अद्भुत प्रेमबिहार चारु रस, रसिकनि बिनु किनु चाह्यो। 
‘अलबेली’ अलि सफल कियो सब, जिन यह रस अवगाह्यो॥ [2]
- श्री अलबेली अलि
english_text: Linon Brindavan Basi Lahyo. Seva-tahal mahal ki nisi-din, yeh jiya nem nibhayo.. [1] Amazing prembihar charu rasa, rasikani binu kinu chahyo. 'Alabeli' Ali successful kiyo sab, jin yeh ras avagahyo.. [2] - Shri Alabeli Ali
english_translation: Linon Brindavan Basi Lahyo. Seva-tahal mahal ki nisi-din, yeh jiya nem nibhayo.. [1] Amazing prembihar charu rasa, rasikani binu kinu chahyo. 'Alabeli' Ali successful kiyo sab, jin yeh ras avagahyo.. [2] - Shri Alabeli Ali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कुँवरि राधिका तुम सकल सौभाग्य सींवा - श्री कुंभनदास, श्री कुम्भनदास जी की वाणी (159)
sanskrit_text:
(राग रामकली एवं देवगंधार)
कुँवरि राधिका तुम सकल सौभाग्य सींवा, या वदन पर कोटि शत चंद वारि ड़ारौ।
खंजन कुरंग श्ता कोटि नैनन ऊपर, करत जिय में विचारौं॥ [1]
कदली शत कोटि जंघन ऊपर, सिंघ शत कोटि कटि पर न्यौछावर करि उतारौं॥
मत्त गज शत कोटि चाल पर, कुँभ शत कोटि इन कुचन पर वारि डारौं॥ [2]
कीट शत कोटि नासिका ऊपर, कूँद शत कोटि दशनन ऊपर काहे न वारौं।
प्कव कंदूर बन्धूक शत कोटि अधरन ऊपर, वारि रुचि गर्व टारौं॥ [3]
नाग शत कोटि बेनी ऊपर, कपोल शत कोटि ग्रीवा दूरी सारों।
कमल शत कोटि कर जुगल पर, वारने नाहिन कोऊ उमां जुधारौं॥ [4]
दास कुम्भन स्वामिनी सुनख सिख, अद्भुत सुठानि कहालौ संभारो।
लाल गिरधर कहत मोहि तोलों सुख, जोलों यह रूप छिनु छिनु निहारौं॥ [5]
- श्री कुंभनदास, श्री कुम्भनदास जी की वाणी (159)
english_text: (Rag Ramkali and Devgandhara) Virgin Radhika, you are blessed with all the good fortune, you shower millions of times on this day. Hundred crores of eyes are on top, the male thoughts are rising.. [1] Kadli is on hundreds of crores of thighs are on top, Leo is on hundreds of millions of waists. Pakav Kandura Bandhuka Shat Koti Adharan Upar, Vaari Ruchi Garv Taroon.. [3] Nag Shat Koti Beni Upar, Kapol Shat Koti Greeva Duri Saron. Lotus crosses hundreds of thousands of feet, but does not allow us to unite. [4] Das Kumbhan, Swamini Sunakh Sikh, Abhut Suthni Kahlou Sambhaaro. Lal Girdhar says, Mohi tolan happiness, Joloon ye rupa chinu chinu niharaun..[5] - Shri Kumbhanadas, Speech of Shri Kumbhanadas ji (159)
english_translation: (Rag Ramkali and Devgandhara) Virgin Radhika, you are blessed with all the good fortune, you shower millions of times on this day. Hundred crores of eyes are on top, the male thoughts are rising.. [1] Kadli is on hundreds of crores of thighs are on top, Leo is on hundreds of millions of waists. Pakav Kandura Bandhuka Shat Koti Adharan Upar, Vaari Ruchi Garv Taroon.. [3] Nag Shat Koti Beni Upar, Kapol Shat Koti Greeva Duri Saron. Lotus crosses hundreds of thousands of feet, but does not allow us to unite. [4] Das Kumbhan, Swamini Sunakh Sikh, Abhut Suthni Kahlou Sambhaaro. Lal Girdhar says, Mohi tolan happiness, Joloon ye rupa chinu chinu niharaun..[5] - Shri Kumbhanadas, Speech of Shri Kumbhanadas ji (159)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री वृषभानु बाग बरसाना
sanskrit_text: श्री वृषभानु बाग बरसाना में स्थित है जिसे श्री श्रीवृषभानु जी, श्री राधा रानी के पिता जी का बाग माना जाता है। समय के साथ इसमें बदलाव आया है, परंतु यह जगह वही है।
english_text: Shri Vrishabhanu Bagh is situated in Barsana, which is reminiscent of the garden of Shri Shri Vrishabhanu ji, father of Shri Radha Rani. Isamen has changed with time, but the place remains the same.
english_translation: Shri Vrishabhanu Bagh is situated in Barsana, which is reminiscent of the garden of Shri Shri Vrishabhanu ji, father of Shri Radha Rani. Isamen has changed with time, but the place remains the same.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: आजु बन राजत जुगल किसोर - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु , श्री हित चौरासी (33)
sanskrit_text:
(राग गंधार)
आजु बन राजत जुगल किसोर।
नंद नँदन वृषभानु नंदिनी उठे उनीदें भोर॥ [1]
डगमगात पग परत सिथिल गति परसत नख ससि छोर।
दसन बसन खंडित मषि मंडित गंड तिलक कछु थोर॥ [2]
दुरत न कच करजनि के रोकें अरुन नैन अलि चोर।
(जै श्री) हित हरिवंश सँभार न तन मन सुरत समुद्र झकोर॥[3]
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु , श्री हित चौरासी (33)
english_text: (Raaga Gandhara) Aaju Ban Rajat Jugal Kishore. Nand Nandan Vrishabhanu Nandini woke up united in the morning.. [1] Staggering steps, slow pace, sharp ends. Dasan Basan Khandit Mashi Dimit Gond Tilak Kachhu Thor.. [2] Durat N Kach Karjani Ke Roken Arun Nain Ali Chor. (Jai Shri) Hit Harivansh Snabhar En Tan Man Surat Samudra Jhakor..[3] - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Hit Chaurasi (33)
english_translation: (Raaga Gandhara) Aaju Ban Rajat Jugal Kishore. Nand Nandan Vrishabhanu Nandini woke up united in the morning.. [1] Staggering steps, slow pace, sharp ends. Dasan Basan Khandit Mashi Dimit Gond Tilak Kachhu Thor.. [2] Durat N Kach Karjani Ke Roken Arun Nain Ali Chor. (Jai Shri) Hit Harivansh Snabhar En Tan Man Surat Samudra Jhakor..[3] - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Hit Chaurasi (33)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: देखो माई ये बड़भागी मोर - श्री सूरदास
sanskrit_text:
(राग मल्हार)
देखो माई ये बड़भागी मोर।
जिनके पंख को मुकुट धरत हैं नटवर नंद किशोर॥ [1]
बड़भागी है नन्द यसोदा पुन्य किये झकझोर।
वृन्दावन हम क्यों न भई रज लागत पग की कोर॥ [2]
ब्रह्मादिक सनकादिक नारद ठाड़े रहें कर जोर।
सूरदास सन्तन को सरबस देखियत माखन चोर॥ [3]
- श्री सूरदास
english_text: (Raag Malhara) Look, I am this unfortunate peacock. Natwar Nand Kishore is the crown on whose wings the earth is.. [1] Nand Yashoda is blessed with good deeds. Vrindavan why don't we brother Raj lagat the core of every step.. [2] Brahmadik Sankadik Narad Thade stay strong. Surdas considers his children as butter thieves.. [3] - Shri Surdas
english_translation: (Raag Malhara) Look, I am this unfortunate peacock. Natwar Nand Kishore is the crown on whose wings the earth is.. [1] Nand Yashoda is blessed with good deeds. Vrindavan why don't we brother Raj lagat the core of every step.. [2] Brahmadik Sankadik Narad Thade stay strong. Surdas considers his children as butter thieves.. [3] - Shri Surdas
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: न दृष्टा मथुरा येन दिदृक्षा यस्य जायते - स्कंद पुराण (2.5.17.29)
sanskrit_text:
न दृष्टा मथुरा येन दिदृक्षा यस्य जायते।
यत्र तत्र मृतस्याऽपि माथुरे जन्म जायते॥
- स्कंद पुराण (2.5.17.29)
english_text: En seer mathura yen didriksha yasya jayate. Here and there Mrityasyaip Mathure Janma Jayate.. - Skanda Purana (2.5.17.29)
english_translation: En seer mathura yen didriksha yasya jayate. Here and there Mrityasyaip Mathure Janma Jayate.. - Skanda Purana (2.5.17.29)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: दसहुँ दिशा में गोविन्द राधे - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज - राधा गोविंद गीत (6114)
sanskrit_text:
दसहुँ दिशा में गोविन्द राधे, जित देखुँ राधे दीखें बता दे॥ 
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज - राधा गोविंद गीत (6114)
english_text: Govind Radhe in every direction, please tell me if Radhe is visible as soon as I see.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj - Radha Govind Geet (6114)
english_translation: Govind Radhe in every direction, please tell me if Radhe is visible as soon as I see.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj - Radha Govind Geet (6114)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: राधे जू की कृपा शक्ति गोविंद राधे - श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, राधा गोविन्द गीत (6438)
sanskrit_text:
राधे जू की कृपा शक्ति गोविंद राधे।
अनहोनी को भी होनी बना दे॥ 
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, राधा गोविन्द गीत (6438)
english_text: Radhe Ju's grace power Govind Radhe. Make even the unexpected happen.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Radha Govind Geet (6438)
english_translation: Radhe Ju's grace power Govind Radhe. Make even the unexpected happen.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Radha Govind Geet (6438)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हमारे धन वृन्दावन प्यारी - श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (159)
sanskrit_text:
(राग गौरी)
हमारे धन वृन्दावन प्यारी।
खरचत खात घटै नहिं कबहूँ बाढत छिन छिन अति अधिकारी॥ [1]
ताही कौ अभिमान सदाई ताही बल बस कुंज बिहारी।
श्री हरिदासी रसिक सिरोमनि प्रान प्रान मिलि कीनी यारी॥ [2]
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत के पद (159)
english_text: (Raag Gauri) Our wealth Vrindavan beloved. When does the cost of the cot not decrease, the bigger the snatch, the more the officer... [1] That's why pride always prevails, that's just Kunj Bihari. Shri Haridasi Rasik Siromani Prana Prana Mili Kini Yaari.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's speech, principles' verses (159)
english_translation: (Raag Gauri) Our wealth Vrindavan beloved. When does the cost of the cot not decrease, the bigger the snatch, the more the officer... [1] That's why pride always prevails, that's just Kunj Bihari. Shri Haridasi Rasik Siromani Prana Prana Mili Kini Yaari.. [2] - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's speech, principles' verses (159)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सुभग गोरी के गोरे पाँइ - रसिक अनन्य श्री हरिराम व्यास
sanskrit_text:
सुभग गोरी के गोरे पाँइ,
ताके शरन रहत काकौ डरु कहत व्‍यास समुझाइ
- रसिक अनन्य श्री हरिराम व्यास 

श्री राधा के गोरे चरणों की जो भी जीव शरण लेता है, इन गोरे चरणों के प्रताप से वह निर्भयता को प्राप्त हो जाता है।
english_text: Vyas Samujhai - Rasik Ananya Shri Hariram Vyas Whichever creature takes refuge in the white feet of Shri Radha, attains fearlessness due to the majesty of the white feet.
english_translation: Vyas Samujhai - Rasik Ananya Shri Hariram Vyas Whichever creature takes refuge in the white feet of Shri Radha, attains fearlessness due to the majesty of the white feet.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: प्रथम महातम प्रकृति - श्री भगवत रसिक की वाणी, अनन्य निश्चयात्मक ग्रंथ [पूर्वार्ध] (45)
sanskrit_text:
प्रथम महातम प्रकृति, ज्ञान रवि तहाँ प्रकासै।
दूजै ब्रह्म प्रकास कोटि सूरज सम भासै॥
तीजै पंकज- नाभि - रमा बैकुंठ निवासी।
चौथे दसरथ सुवन राम गोपुर के वासी॥
पाँचे ब्रज के गोप नंद आदिक सब गोपी।
छठवे सखी समाज करै लीला रस ओपी॥
भगवत सतयें आदरन करहिं केलि राधा रवन।
सर्वोपरि सर्वेस गुरु रसिकराइ मंगल भवन॥
- श्री भगवत रसिक, भगवत रसिक की वाणी, अनन्य निश्चयात्मक ग्रंथ [पूर्वार्ध] (45)
english_text: First the greatest nature, the sun of knowledge shines there. Dujai Brahma Prakash Koti Sun Sama Bhasai.. Tijai Pankaja- Navel - Ram resident of Baikuntha. Residents of the fourth Dasaratha Suvan Ram Gopur.. Gop Nand etc. of the fifth Braj and all the Gopis. Chhathve Sakhi Samaj does Leela Ras OP... Bhagwat Satyen worships only Radha Ravana. Supreme Service Guru Rasikarai Mangal Bhavan.. - Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik's Voice, Other Definitive Texts [First Part] (45)
english_translation: First the greatest nature, the sun of knowledge shines there. Dujai Brahma Prakash Koti Sun Sama Bhasai.. Tijai Pankaja- Navel - Ram resident of Baikuntha. Residents of the fourth Dasaratha Suvan Ram Gopur.. Gop Nand etc. of the fifth Braj and all the Gopis. Chhathve Sakhi Samaj does Leela Ras OP... Bhagwat Satyen worships only Radha Ravana. Supreme Service Guru Rasikarai Mangal Bhavan.. - Shri Bhagwat Rasik, Bhagwat Rasik's Voice, Other Definitive Texts [First Part] (45)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: अन्तरीयगसुरत्नमण्डपे स्वीयकुण्डमनु - श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (5.3)
sanskrit_text:
अन्तरीयगसुरत्नमण्डपे स्वीयकुण्डमनु वार्षभानवी।
श्यामलेन सहागानकौतुकं कुर्वती स्फुरतु में सखीवृता॥
- श्री प्रबोधानन्द सरस्वती, वृन्दावन महिमामृत (5.3)
english_text: Antriyagasuratnamandape sviyyakundamanu varshabhanavi. Shyamalan Sahagankautukna Kurvati Sfuratu Purusha Sakhivruta. - Sri Prabodhananda Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (5.3)
english_translation: Antriyagasuratnamandape sviyyakundamanu varshabhanavi. Shyamalan Sahagankautukna Kurvati Sfuratu Purusha Sakhivruta. - Sri Prabodhananda Saraswati, Vrindavan Mahimamrit (5.3)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बाँकी चारु चन्द्रिका - रसिक वाणी
sanskrit_text:
बाँकी चारु चन्द्रिका बिराजै भाल बाँकी खौर,
बाँकी भौहें चंचल चितौन चख बाँकी है। [1]
बाँकी नखबैसर मधुर मुसिकान बाँकी,
कहैं हनुमान बाँकी अधर ललाकी है॥ [2]
मुख शशि भूषण श्रृंगार चन्द्रकला कीन्हैं,
बाँकी पर्यक बैठी मूर झरना की है। [3]
झुकि झुकि झूमि झूमि झाँकी करै देव वधु,
कैसी ये अनुपम श्री राधिका की झाँकी है॥ [4]
- रसिक वाणी
english_text: Banki Charu Chandrika Birajai, Banki Khaur, Banki Bhowheen Chanchal Chitoun Chakh Banki hai. [1] Banki Nakhbaisar melodious music Banki, where is Hanuman, Banki Adhar Lalki hai.. [2] Who is the face, Shashi, Bhushan, Shringar, Chandrakala, Banki Paryak Baithi Mur Jharna's. [3] Jhuki jhuki jhuki jhoomi jhanki kari Dev Vadhu, what kind of unique is this tableau of Shri Radhika.. [4] - Rasik Vani
english_translation: Banki Charu Chandrika Birajai, Banki Khaur, Banki Bhowheen Chanchal Chitoun Chakh Banki hai. [1] Banki Nakhbaisar melodious music Banki, where is Hanuman, Banki Adhar Lalki hai.. [2] Who is the face, Shashi, Bhushan, Shringar, Chandrakala, Banki Paryak Baithi Mur Jharna's. [3] Jhuki jhuki jhuki jhoomi jhanki kari Dev Vadhu, what kind of unique is this tableau of Shri Radhika.. [4] - Rasik Vani
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: केशी घाट, वृंदावन
sanskrit_text:
केशी घाट का नाम भगवान कृष्ण द्वारा राक्षस केशी को मारने की लीला के नाम पर रखा गया है। केशी दानव, जो कि कंस द्वारा भेजा गया एक विशालकाय अश्व दानव था, कृष्ण को मारने के लिए वृंदावन की ओर बढ़ रहा था। वह कृष्ण के कमल जैसे कोमल शरीर को अपने पैरों से कुचलना चाहता था, लेकिन कृष्ण ने उसके पैर पकड़ लिए, उसे हवा में गोल-गोल घुमा कर दूर फेंक दिया। केशी ने फिर कृष्ण को खाने के अपने चौड़े मुंह से हमला किया लेकिन कृष्ण ने अपने अंगूठे से केशी को चिढ़ाते हुए अपने हस्त-कमल को केशी के गंदे मुंह के अंदर डाल दिया और उसकी साँसे रोक दी। केशी पसीने से तर घुटने लगा, मल की भारी मात्रा निकास कर अंत में, उसका शरीर एक पके हुए तरबूज की तरह खुल गया। केशी को मारने के बाद, कृष्ण स्नान करने के लिए यमुना के किनारे घाट पर उतर आए क्योंकि उनका हाथ केशी के गंदे मुंह में डालने से गन्दा हो गया था। तभी से इस घाट को केशी घाट के नाम से जाना जाने लगा।
स्थान:
केशी घाट, चीर घाट और निधिवन के समीप, यमुना नदी के तट पर श्रीधाम वृंदावन में स्थित है।
english_text: Keshi Ghat is named after Lord Krishna's act of killing the demon Keshi. Keshi demon, who was a giant horse demon sent by KNS, was heading towards Vrindavan to kill Krishna. He wanted to crush Krishna's lotus-like soft body with his knuckles, but Krishna caught hold of his knuckles and threw him in a circular motion in the air. Keshi then attacked Krishna with his wide mouth of food but Krishna, after teasing Keshi with his thumb, put his hasta-kamal inside Keshi's dirty mouth and stopped his breathing. Keshi began to suffocate in sweat, expelling huge amounts of semen and finally, his body opened up like a ripe starfish. After killing Keshi, Krishna came down to the ghat on the banks of Yamuna to take bath as his hand had become dirty from putting it in Keshi's dirty mouth. Since then this ghat came to be known as Keshi Ghat. Location: Shridham is situated in Vrindavan on the banks of river Yamuna, near Keshi Ghat, Chir Ghat and Nidhivan.
english_translation: Keshi Ghat is named after Lord Krishna's act of killing the demon Keshi. Keshi demon, who was a giant horse demon sent by KNS, was heading towards Vrindavan to kill Krishna. He wanted to crush Krishna's lotus-like soft body with his knuckles, but Krishna caught hold of his knuckles and threw him in a circular motion in the air. Keshi then attacked Krishna with his wide mouth of food but Krishna, after teasing Keshi with his thumb, put his hasta-kamal inside Keshi's dirty mouth and stopped his breathing. Keshi began to suffocate in sweat, expelling huge amounts of semen and finally, his body opened up like a ripe starfish. After killing Keshi, Krishna came down to the ghat on the banks of Yamuna to take bath as his hand had become dirty from putting it in Keshi's dirty mouth. Since then this ghat came to be known as Keshi Ghat. Location: Shridham is situated in Vrindavan on the banks of river Yamuna, near Keshi Ghat, Chir Ghat and Nidhivan.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हे राधा रानी सदा - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
हे राधा रानी सदा, करहुं कृपा की कोर।
कबहु तुम्हारे संग में, देखूं नंदकिशोर॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: O Radha Rani, I always shower your blessings on me. When will I see you with me, Nand Kishore? - braj ke dohe
english_translation: O Radha Rani, I always shower your blessings on me. When will I see you with me, Nand Kishore? - braj ke dohe
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भानु दसम्म, जनम्म निसापति - श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री हित स्फुट वाणी (2)
sanskrit_text:
भानु दसम्म, जनम्म निसापति, मंगल - बुद्ध सिवस्थल लीके। 
जो गुरु होंय धरम्म भवन्न के तौ भृगुनंद सुमंद नवीके॥ [1]
तीसरो केतु समेत बिधुग्रस तौ हरिवंश मन-क्रम फीके।
गोविन्द छाँड़ि भ्रमंत दसों दिस तौ करिहैं का नवग्रह नीके॥ [2]
- श्री हित हरिवंश महाप्रभु, श्री हित स्फुट वाणी (2)
english_text: Like Bhanu Dasham, Janam Nisapati, Mangal - Buddha Shivsthal. The one who is the Guru of Dharma Bhavan, Bhrigund Sund Navike. [1] Third Ketu is joined by Bidhugras and Harivansh's mind-order fades away. Navgraha Nike of Govind Chhandai Bhramant Dason Dis Tau Karihain.. [2] - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Hit Sphut Vani (2)
english_translation: Like Bhanu Dasham, Janam Nisapati, Mangal - Buddha Shivsthal. The one who is the Guru of Dharma Bhavan, Bhrigund Sund Navike. [1] Third Ketu is joined by Bidhugras and Harivansh's mind-order fades away. Navgraha Nike of Govind Chhandai Bhramant Dason Dis Tau Karihain.. [2] - Shri Hit Harivansh Mahaprabhu, Shri Hit Sphut Vani (2)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: बरसाने के वास की आस करे शिव शेष - ब्रज के दोहे
sanskrit_text:
बरसाने के वास की, आस करे शिव शेष। 
जाकी महिमा को कहे, श्याम धरे सखि भेष॥
- ब्रज के दोहे
english_text: As for the abode of rain, please Shiva Shesh. Jaki tells Mahima, Shyam disguises himself as a friend.. - braj ke dohe
english_translation: As for the abode of rain, please Shiva Shesh. Jaki tells Mahima, Shyam disguises himself as a friend.. - braj ke dohe
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्यामा रटें श्याम श्याम श्याम रटें श्यामा - श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, श्यामा श्याम गीत (1)
sanskrit_text:
श्यामा रटें श्याम श्याम श्याम रटें श्यामा।
श्यामा श्याम आठु याम रटें ब्रजबामा॥
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, श्यामा श्याम गीत (1)
english_text: Shyama Ratan Shyam Shyam Shyam Ratan Shyama. Shyama Shyam Athu Yam Raten Brajbama.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (1)
english_translation: Shyama Ratan Shyam Shyam Shyam Ratan Shyama. Shyama Shyam Athu Yam Raten Brajbama.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shyama Shyam Geet (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: निहचै भजै बिहार कों  -  श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (290)
sanskrit_text:
निहचै भजै बिहार कों, और न जानैं देव। 
तन मन अर्पन रसिक कों, निर्भय ह्वै करि सेव॥
- श्री ललित किशोरी देव, श्री ललित किशोरी देव जू की वाणी, सिद्धांत की साखी (290)
english_text: I don't know who worships Bihar, and I don't know God. Who is the devotee of one's body and mind, who is fearless and who serves... - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, Siddhant's friend (290)
english_translation: I don't know who worships Bihar, and I don't know God. Who is the devotee of one's body and mind, who is fearless and who serves... - Shri Lalit Kishori Dev, Shri Lalit Kishori Dev Ju's voice, Siddhant's friend (290)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रुप - सिरोमनि लाडिली - श्री रूप सखी, श्रिंगार रस के दोहे (41)
sanskrit_text:
रुप-सिरोमनि लाडिली, रसिक - सिरोमनि लाल। 
चतुर-सिरोमनि निजु सखी, निरखत नैन विसाल॥
- श्री रूप सखी, श्रिंगार रस के दोहे (41)
english_text: Appearance-Syromani Ladili, Rasik-Syromani Lal. Chatura-Siromani Niju Sakhi, Nirkhat Nain Visal.. - Shri Roop Sakhi, Couplets of Shringar Ras (41)
english_translation: Appearance-Syromani Ladili, Rasik-Syromani Lal. Chatura-Siromani Niju Sakhi, Nirkhat Nain Visal.. - Shri Roop Sakhi, Couplets of Shringar Ras (41)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रसिकनी राधा राधा है -  श्री आनन्दघन जी, घनानंद ग्रंथावली, पदावली (792)
sanskrit_text:
रसिकनी राधा राधा है।
जाके मिलिबे की मोहन के नित ही साधा है॥ [1]
ब्रजमोहन मोह्वौ इन आछै रही न बाधा है।
परम प्रेम रस-निधि आनँदघन प्रेम-समाधा है॥ [2]
-  श्री आनन्दघन जी, घनानंद ग्रंथावली, पदावली (792)
english_text: Rasikani Radha is Radha. Jake Milibe is a follower of Mohan's daily routine.. [1] Braj Mohan Mohavau in achhai rahi hai na badha. The ultimate love Rasa-Nidhi is Anandghan Prem-Samadha.. [2] - Shri Anandghan Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Padawali (792)
english_translation: Rasikani Radha is Radha. Jake Milibe is a follower of Mohan's daily routine.. [1] Braj Mohan Mohavau in achhai rahi hai na badha. The ultimate love Rasa-Nidhi is Anandghan Prem-Samadha.. [2] - Shri Anandghan Ji, Ghananand Granthawali, Padawali (792)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कौन को लाल सलोनो सखी - श्री रसखान, रसखान रत्नावली
sanskrit_text:
(सवैया)
कौन को लाल सलोनो सखी, वह जाकी बड़ी अँखियाँ अनियारी। [1]
जोहन बंक विसाल के बाननि, वेधत है घत तीछन भारी॥ [2]
रसखानि सम्हारि परै नहिं चोट, सु कोटि उपाय करे सुखकारी। [3]
भाल लिख्यौ विधि हेत को बन्धन, खोलि सकै ऐसो को हितकारी॥ [4]
- श्री रसखान, रसखान रत्नावली
english_text: (Savaiya) Who is my dear friend, wow, you are my big eyes. [1]. [3] Even if you write for the sake of law, the bondages can be opened for the benefit of such people.. [4] - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
english_translation: (Savaiya) Who is my dear friend, wow, you are my big eyes. [1]. [3] Even if you write for the sake of law, the bondages can be opened for the benefit of such people.. [4] - Shri Raskhan, Raskhan Ratnavali
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: हमारी गौर वरनि सरकार - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, श्री राधा त्रयोदशी (1)
sanskrit_text:
हमारी गौर वरनि सरकार। 
पिय चित चोरी भानु किशोरी, अति भोरी रिझवार। [1]
तनु दुति तप्त स्वर्ण दुति ते हूँ, अति उद्दीप्त निहार। 
श्री श्रीअंग दिव्य सौरभ ते, सुरभित नन्दकुमार। [2]
श्री श्रीअंग मृदुलता लखि दउँ, कोटि मृदुल्ता वार। 
कह 'कृपालु' श्री अंग अंग लखि, पिय सुधि देह बिसार॥ [3]
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, श्री राधा त्रयोदशी (1)
english_text: Our gaurvarni government. Sweet hearted girl Bhanu Kishori, very beautiful Reejhawar. [1] I am like a thin, hot golden thread, looking very excited. Sri Sriang Divya Saurabh Te, Surabhit Nandakumar. [2] Sri Sriang Mridulata Lakhi Daun, Koti Mridulata Var. Say 'Kripalu' Shri Ang Ang Lakhi, Piya Sudhi Deh Bisar.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shri Radha Trayodashi (1)
english_translation: Our gaurvarni government. Sweet hearted girl Bhanu Kishori, very beautiful Reejhawar. [1] I am like a thin, hot golden thread, looking very excited. Sri Sriang Divya Saurabh Te, Surabhit Nandakumar. [2] Sri Sriang Mridulata Lakhi Daun, Koti Mridulata Var. Say 'Kripalu' Shri Ang Ang Lakhi, Piya Sudhi Deh Bisar.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Shri Radha Trayodashi (1)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: मेरी सरकार तो है गोविंद राधे, श्री वृषभानुदुलार बता दे - श्री कृपालु जी, राधा गोविन्द गीत (6163)
sanskrit_text:
मेरी सरकार तो है गोविंद राधे।
श्री वृषभानुदुलार बता दे॥ 
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, राधा गोविन्द गीत (6163)
english_text: My government is Govind Radhe. Shri Vrishabhanudular, please tell.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Radha Govind Geet (6163)
english_translation: My government is Govind Radhe. Shri Vrishabhanudular, please tell.. - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Radha Govind Geet (6163)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: श्री राधा बाग, बरसाना
sanskrit_text: श्री राधा बाग बरसाना में स्थित है। राधा बाग एक दर्शनीय स्थल है जहाँ पुरानी रास लीला स्थली, मंदिर, और इसके अंदर अति मनमोहक लताओं से आच्छादित वन हैं। यहां अनेकों रसिक भक्तों ने श्री राधा को लाड़ लड़ाया है। कुछ वर्तमान समय के रसिक जैसे श्री गौरांगी शरण (श्री हित प्रेमानंद जी के गुरु), हरिदास संप्रदाय के श्री अलबेली शरण आदि ने यहां सालों भजन किया है। यहां एक पुराना कुआं है जिससे श्री राधा रानी मंदिर में श्री राधा की सेवा के लिए जल जाता है।
english_text: Shri Radha Bagh is located in Barsana. Radha Bagh is a scenic spot with an old Ras Leela site, a temple, and a forest covered with beautiful creepers. Many Rasik devotees have worshiped Shri Radha here. Some present day rasikas like Shri Gaurangi Sharan (guru of Shri Hit Premanand Ji), Shri Albeli Sharan of Haridas sect etc. have performed Salon Bhajan here. There is an old well here which is kept for the service of Shri Radha in Shri Radha Rani Temple.
english_translation: Shri Radha Bagh is located in Barsana. Radha Bagh is a scenic spot with an old Ras Leela site, a temple, and a forest covered with beautiful creepers. Many Rasik devotees have worshiped Shri Radha here. Some present day rasikas like Shri Gaurangi Sharan (guru of Shri Hit Premanand Ji), Shri Albeli Sharan of Haridas sect etc. have performed Salon Bhajan here. There is an old well here which is kept for the service of Shri Radha in Shri Radha Rani Temple.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: सकुचत कहत कहावत दासी - श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (49)
sanskrit_text:
सकुचत कहत कहावत दासी।
कहँ मैं अधम नीच अति पामर, कहँ तुम नवल निकुंज निवासी॥ [1]
निज कारण देखौं जग माही, नित सब करत रावरी हाँसी।
याही सोच जरत निज छाती, व्यापी रहत हृदय चिंता सी॥ [2]
भूषण भार असन विष लागत, सुखद सेज जनु जरत चिता सी।
'भोरी' दुःख सब हरहु कृपानिधि, करि पद कंज अनन्य उपासी॥ [3]
- श्री भोरी सखी, प्रेम की पीर (49)
english_text: Sakuchat kahat kahavat daasi. Where am I, the lowest and the lowest, where are you the resident of the new world? [1] Look at the world's own reason, I laugh every day doing everything. This is the thought of my own heart, my heart is filled with worry.. [2] The seat of a jewel seems like poison, the pleasant bed of my life is like worry. 'Bhori', all the sorrows are merciful, Kari Pad Kanj is an exclusive worshipper.. [3] - Shri Bhori Sakhi, the pain of love (49)
english_translation: Sakuchat kahat kahavat daasi. Where am I, the lowest and the lowest, where are you the resident of the new world? [1] Look at the world's own reason, I laugh every day doing everything. This is the thought of my own heart, my heart is filled with worry.. [2] The seat of a jewel seems like poison, the pleasant bed of my life is like worry. 'Bhori', all the sorrows are merciful, Kari Pad Kanj is an exclusive worshipper.. [3] - Shri Bhori Sakhi, the pain of love (49)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: वृन्दावनं महत्पुण्यं सर्व पावन पावनम् - सनत्कुमार  संहिता (31.36)
sanskrit_text:

सर्व लोक वहिर्भूत निराधारं परिस्फुटम्॥ 
-  सनत कुमार संहिता (31.36)
english_text: Vrindavan Mahatpunyam, all the holy holy ones. Sarv loka wahirbhoot niradharam parisphootam..- Sanat Kumar Snahita (31.36)
english_translation: Vrindavan Mahatpunyam, all the holy holy ones. Sarv loka wahirbhoot niradharam parisphootam..- Sanat Kumar Snahita (31.36)

title: पद रज तज किमि - श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी, विनय (219)
sanskrit_text:
(राग तोड़ी जौनपुरी / राग काफ़ी)
पद रज तज किमि आस करत हो, जोग जग्य तप साधा की। [1]
सुमिरत होय मुख आनन्द अति, जरन हरन दुःख बाधा की॥ [2]
ललित किशोरी शरण सदा रहु, सोभा सिन्धु अगाधा की। [3]
परम ब्रह्म गावत जाको जग, झारत पद रज राधा की॥ [4]
- श्री ललित किशोरी, अभिलाष माधुरी , विनय (219)
english_text: (Raag Todai Jaunapuri/Raag Kafai) Pad Raj Taj Kimi As Karat Ho, Jog Jagya Tap Sadh Ki. [1] The joy of the face is immense, the sadness of the hindrances is always taken away. [2] Lalit Kishori always remains the refuge, the beauty of the Sindhu is infinite. [3] Param Brahma Gavat Jako Jag, Jharat Pad Raj Radha Ki.. [4] - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (219)
english_translation: (Raag Todai Jaunapuri/Raag Kafai) Pad Raj Taj Kimi As Karat Ho, Jog Jagya Tap Sadh Ki. [1] The joy of the face is immense, the sadness of the hindrances is always taken away. [2] Lalit Kishori always remains the refuge, the beauty of the Sindhu is infinite. [3] Param Brahma Gavat Jako Jag, Jharat Pad Raj Radha Ki.. [4] - Shri Lalit Kishori, Abhilash Madhuri, Vinay (219)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कबै हरि बनिहौं ब्रज को मोर - जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा (20)
sanskrit_text:
कबै हरि बनिहौं ब्रज को मोर।
लखि घनश्याम जानि घनश्यामहिं, ह्वैहौं प्रेम विभोर॥ [1]
प्रेम विभोर होत ही नचिहौं, झुकि झुकि पंख मरोर।
नाचत पंख मरोर मोर मन, उठिहैं सरस हिलोर॥ [2]
उठत हिलोर ‘श्याम’ ! इमि कहि कहि, शोर मचैहौं घोर।
मोर मुकुट हित हौं ‘कृपालु’ नित, दैहौं पंखन तोर॥ [3]
- जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज, प्रेम रस मदिरा, दैन्य माधुरी (20)
english_text: When did Hari become a peacock in Braj? Lakhi Ghanshyam Jani Ghanshyamahin, I am filled with love… [1] As soon as I am filled with love, I dance, bowing my wings and fluttering. The dancing wings are moving, the peacock's mind is moving, the music is moving... [2] 'Shyam' is moving! I am making noise somewhere. 'Kripalu' is my crown's hit every day, I am spreading my wings.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Daini Madhuri (20)
english_translation: When did Hari become a peacock in Braj? Lakhi Ghanshyam Jani Ghanshyamahin, I am filled with love… [1] As soon as I am filled with love, I dance, bowing my wings and fluttering. The dancing wings are moving, the peacock's mind is moving, the music is moving... [2] 'Shyam' is moving! I am making noise somewhere. 'Kripalu' is my crown's hit every day, I am spreading my wings.. [3] - Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj, Prem Ras Madira, Daini Madhuri (20)
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: रति केलि की सार गोविंद राधे, ठकुरानी राधा रानी बता दे  - राधा गोविन्द गीत (6412)
sanskrit_text:

title: टेढ़े रहें सदा मोहन रसिया सों - श्री अली किशोरी
sanskrit_text:
“ टेढ़े रहें सदा मोहन रसिया सों, बोलत अटपटी वाणी ।
सदा रहे अलमस्त निकुंज में, सर पे हमारे श्री राधा महारानी॥
हम श्री राधा महारानी जू के बल अभिमानी॥” 
- श्री किशोरी अली
english_text: "May Mohan Rasiya's son always remain crooked, the voice of the father speaks. May his Shri Radha Maharani always remain calm in his head.. We are proud children of Shri Radha Maharani Ju.." - Shri Kishori Ali

title: अमल अमोल है अनूपम हैं रेनु याकी - श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, वृन्दावन शतक (63)
sanskrit_text:
अमल अमोल है अनूपम हैं रेनु याकी,
सिद्धि कामना की देन वारी है अनन्द की। [1]
जाकौं अंग लाय लाय सार वस्तु पाय पाय,
गाय गाय बानी सुधा सानी प्रेम फन्द की॥ [2]
'लाल बलबीर' याकी महिमा कहाँ लौं कहूँ ,
और लोक लोक की बड़ाई सबै मन्द की। [3]
फन्द की हरैया है करैया आनन्द सदां ,
लीजिये विलोकि छवि वृन्दावन-चन्द की॥ [4]
- श्री लाल बलबीर, ब्रज बिनोद, वृन्दावन शतक (63)
english_text: Amal is priceless, Renu Yaki is unique, success is the gift of desire, joy is very different. [1] Jakaun Ang Ley Sir Vaastu Paay Paay, Gay Gay Bani Sudha Sani Prem Fand Ki.. [2] Where should I tell the glory of 'Lal Balabir', and the glory of the world is all dim. [3] Fan's haraiya is Karaiya Anand Sadan, take Willow's image of Vrindavan-moon.. [4] - Shri Lal Balbir, Braj Binod, Vrindavan Shatak (63)

[2] Where should I tell the glory of 'Lal Balabir', and the glory of the world is all dim. [3] Fan's haraiya is Karaiya Anand Sadan, take Willow's image of Vrindavan-moon.. author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: भोरी सब विधि अधम उद्धारन, अलबेली ठकुरानी
sanskrit_text:
भोरी सब विधि अधम उद्धारन, अलबेली ठकुरानी।
- श्री भोरी सखी 

श्री भोरी सखी कहती हैं कि श्री राधारानी प्रत्येक विधि से अधमों का उद्धार करने वाली हैं, इसी कारण से वह अलबेली ठकुरानी हैं हमारी।
english_text: Bhori sab vidhi adham uddharan, abeli thakurani. - Shri Bhori Sakhi Shri Bhori Sakhi says that Shri Radharani is the one who saves the half-man through direct method, that is why she is our Albeli Thakurani.
english_translation: Bhori sab vidhi adham uddharan, abeli thakurani. - Shri Bhori Sakhi Shri Bhori Sakhi says that Shri Radharani is the one who saves the half-man through direct method, that is why she is our Albeli Thakurani.
author: Braj Rasik Heritage

title: कुसुम सरोवर रासलीला
sanskrit_text:
एक दिन श्री किशोरी जी सखियों के साथ कुसुम वन में फूल चयन कर रही थीं। श्री श्यामसुंदर ने माली के रूप में दूर से खड़े होकर आवाज़ लगाई,” कौन तुम फुलवा बीनन हारी ?” साथ की सखियां भयभीत होकर इधर-उधर भाग खड़ी हुईं। श्री किशोरी जी का नीलाम्बर एक झाड़ी में उलझ गया, भाग न सकीं। इस हड़बड़ाहट में एक-दो फूल भी उनके हाथ से गिर गए। इतने में माली का रूप छोड़ कर सामने श्री श्याम सुंदर आकर उपस्थित हुए। उन्होंने नीलाम्बर को झाड़ी से छुड़ा दिया। श्री राधा के द्वारा पृथ्वी पर गिरे फूल श्री श्यामसुंदर ने उठा लिए। श्री किशोरी जी ने कहा, ”प्रियतम ! पृथ्वी पर गिरे फूल पूजा के योग्य तो रहे नहीं अब क्या करोगे इनका?” श्री श्यामसुंदर ने उन फूलों को सरोवर के जल से धो लिया और कहा प्राणवल्लभे ! अब ये फूल शुद्ध हो गए हैं। इतना कह कर श्री श्यामसुंदर ने वे कुसुम श्री किशोरी जी की बेनी में लगा दिए। श्री युगल किशोर के आनन्द की सीमा न रही। तभी से यह सरोवर ‘कुसुम सरोवर’ नाम से प्रसिद्ध हो गया।

स्थान: 
कुसुम सरोवर गोवेर्धन में स्थित है, 2 किलोमीटर की दूरी पर राधा कुंड से समीप है।
english_text: One day Shri Kishori ji was picking flowers in the Kusum forest with her friends. Shri Shyamsundar, standing from a distance in the form of a gardener, called out, “Who are you who plucked the flowers?” Her friends were frightened and ran here and there. Shri Kishori ji's Nilambar got entangled in a fight, but she could not run away. In this commotion one or two flowers also fell from his hand. Shri Shyam Sundar came and appeared in front of him, leaving the gardener's form behind. He freed Nilambar from the dust. Flowers fell on the earth at the door of Shri Radha. Shri Shyamsundar picked up the lie. Shri Kishori ji said, "Dear! The yogis of flower worship that have fallen on the earth will no longer remain, now what will you do with them?" Shri Shyamsundar washed those flowers with the lake water and said, Pranavallabhe! Now you have become completely pure. Saying this, Shri Shyamsundar planted the safflower in Shri Kishori ji's hair. Sree Yugal Kishor's limit of joy. Since then this lake became famous by the name 'Kusum Sarovar'. Location: Kusum Sarovar is located in Govardhan, at a distance of 2 kilometers from Radha Kund.

Shri Shyamsundar, standing from a distance in the form of a gardener, called out, “Who are you who plucked the flowers?” Her friends were frightened and ran here and there. Shri Kishori ji's Nilambar got entangled in a fight, but she could not run away. In this commotion one or two flowers also fell from his hand. Shri Shyam Sundar came and appeared in front of him, leaving the gardener's form behind. He freed Nilambar from the dust. Flowers fell on the earth at the door of Shri Radha. Shri Shyamsundar picked up the lie. Shri Kishori ji said, "Dear! The yogis of flower worship that have fallen on the earth will no longer remain, now what will you do with them?" Shri Shyamsundar washed those flowers with the lake water and said, Pranavallabhe! Now you have become completely pure. Saying this, Shri Shyamsundar planted the safflower in Shri Kishori ji's hair. Sree Yugal Kishor's limit of joy. Since then this lake became famous by the name 'Kusum Sarovar'. Location: Kusum Sarovar is located in Govardhan, at a distance of 2 kilometers from Radha Kund.

title: मोहिं वृन्दावन रज सौं काज - श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार)
sanskrit_text:
“ मोहिं वृन्दावन रज सौं काज । ”
- श्री हरिराम व्यास (विशाखा अवतार), व्यास वाणी , पूर्वार्ध (116)


मेरा वास्तविक काज केवल वृन्दावन की रज से ही है।
english_text: “Mohin Vrindavan Raj Saun Kaj.” - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar), Vyas Vani, first half (116) My huge work is only from the Raj of Vrindavan.
english_translation: “Mohin Vrindavan Raj Saun Kaj.” - Shri Hariram Vyas (Vishakha Avatar), Vyas Vani, first half (116) My huge work is only from the Raj of Vrindavan.
